“You promise you won’t have issues with a second alpha working here, right?” 

The question made Phainon jerk his head up from the papers he had been double checking, everything had to be accounted for before opening. Rationing out the dogs and who was reserved for what and when was always something he double checked. He didn’t want anyone ignored!

The question of a second alpha working in such close proximity did set his nerves on fire slightly. Phainon always did his best to be polite and charming, no matter anyone’s second gender. But fellow alphas were always such a hard egg to crack. He had been growled at more by alphas than by actual dogs at this point.

Phainon beamed at her reassuringly, somewhat for his own doubts, “Of course! I’m very civil, Cas! I’ll be as friendly as ever!”

Castorice studied him for a moment, her arms still wrapped around a bag of dog food as she rounded the desk. Phainon had offered many times to do the heavy lifting, but that only seemed to irk her. He blamed it on the whole ‘I may be a beta but I don’t need you babying me, snowy.’ stuff she had hissed at him once.

So instead, he was flipping through the papers, making sure everything was fine for today, writing down the orders that the first reservations had set for treats for the dogs and desserts for themselves. The dogs weren’t released into the front penned area yet, still locked safely in the back. 

She gave a sigh, walking past the front desk and heading to the back shelves, speaking flatly as she moved, “He’s mainly going to be working in the cat area.. And since you stay with the dogs mainly it’s fine. You’ll barely run into each other, I hope.”

Phainon could only manage to pout at her for a beat of a second before returning his focus to his paperwork, “I just said it was fine! Where is the trust in our friendship..”

Castorice shook her head dismissively, “It’s not you I’m worried about.. Aglaea said he’s trustworthy and he’s been nice to work with when I’ve had shifts with him. But it doesn’t make him any less spooky with you both here..”

Phainon clicked his tongue, looking up as he twirled his pen in between his fingers playfully, “I’ll be nice enough for both of us to get along!”

Castorice gave an exasperated sigh, “It’s the first time you two are on shift together.. I fear for my life.”

Phainon looked at her with woe written on his features as if he were wounded by this, “What? I’d never let him do anything to you, Cas!”

Castorice looked met his gaze, giving a louder sigh, “No.. Not because of that. I’ve worked around Mydei a few times.. He’s very.. What’s the word..”

“Mean?”

“Well, Not really? But also.. He really fits in with the cats.” She shrugged, her expression was unreadable as she attempted to think of Mydei’s personality.

“Huh?” Phainon could only blink at her blankly over there. Fitting in.. With the cats? Phainon had never been a huge cat person, sure he could put up with them, but he wasn’t like.. Seeking them out over a dog. Cats were always so moody, he hated that about them..

“Standoffish.. Feels like he might bite, and not in a mating way..”

It was now Phainon’s turn to give a sigh, “This is horrible news for the two dog fans..”

Castorice shrugged, “Exactly why we needed another cat lover, and he’s willing to help bake the pastries. I’m glad Aglaea knew someone, at least.”

Phainon’s thought process for replies to that halted as the entrance door opened, he could do nothing but stare at the man. Mydei, he knew that much from the description of him alone. The man was wearing a black hoodie and matching black sweatpants, an incredibly lazy outfit, but it’s not like they enforced a dress code. Even if Aglaea had threatened it many times due to Phainon’s choices.. (Cruel!)

Even in such a covering outfit, Phainon could tell he was well toned, the sleeves of his hoodie seemed to strain around his shoulders, and Phainon could only pray the man hadn’t noticed him oogling him as he walked into the cafe silently. Something about him was eerily like a cat as well, the sharpness of his eyes seemed beyond vibrant, searching, and his hairr seemed to fluff up like a golden mane, only to cascade into flows of red at the end.

Phainon felt a pang of confusion, knitting his eyebrows together as he watched him walk across the entrance way. His scent was strong, extremely strong. But, not for the reasons Phainon expected. It was sweet, maple-esque, a deeper tone of strawberries, maybe? Phainon couldn’t place it but.. It was lacking the same smells that made Phainon’s nose wither in disgust with other alphas. No.. He smelt.. Dare he say enchanting?

Castorice from the back of the room spoke first to greet him,“Hello, Mydei.”

“Hello.” Phainon felt his body tense up at that, clenching his hand into a ball before he managed to shake it from himself. The man’s voice was stern, deep and seemed to rest at quite a soothing octave. Phainon felt himself desiring to hear more words leave this man’s lips, before he slowly took in a deep inhale. Regretting that instantly as more of that sweet scent entered his lungs, intoxicating.

Phainon opted to try to ignore it, putting on his usual beaming smile as he left from behind the  desk - first dropping his pen of course - to cut off Mydei’s path, he extended his hand immediately to Mydei. Amber eyes regarded it for a second, eyebrows raised as he moved his gaze to look back to Phainon.

“I’m Phainon! It’s nice to finally meet you.”

Mydei slowly took the hand at that, and Phainon could only hope Mydei didn’t notice how he almost trembled over that simple act. His hands were calloused, rough, something about it made Phainon feel a pang of worry, something he bit down immediately.

“Mydei.. Likewise.” The reply was smooth, he merely shook Phainon’s hand rather gently for a man who seemed as toned as he was before continuing on his way past.

Phainon’s eyes lingered on his own hand for much longer than he cared to admit, almost missing how warm the other alpha’s hand had felt on his own. Even if Mydei’s hand was bigger than his. 

“Not staying around to chat?”

Mydei turned to look at him, blue eyes looking rather pathetically after Mydei. Mydei merely raised a brow at that again, seeming more amused than annoyed, thankfully. “.. I have to clock in?”

Phainon felt his cheeks burn at that, moving away to focus back on his. Anything that wasn’t Mydei, who had shot him another confused glance before going on with his own business as Phainon quietly conceded, “Oh.. Right!”

Phainon slowly walked towards the back, the left side of the room where Castorice had went about completely ignoring the two alphas meeting for the first time. Maybe for her own sake, but Phainon slowly crept on her, staring blankly at where Mydei had entered the back room to the right. 

He spoke quietly, leaning closer to her, but not close enough to scare her over an alpha being so close to her neck while her back was turned, “Cas, are you sure he’s an alpha?”

Castorice blinked, looking at Phainon over her shoulder, her brows knitting in confusion as she went about getting the dog food bowls gathered, “What, Mydei? Yes, I’m sure of it.”

Phainon leaned away at that, placing a hand on his hip as he spoke mainly to himself, “Huh.”

Castorice now turned to face him completely, her eyes scanning him, trying to read his thoughts as if he was a book before giving up and asking instead

“Why?”

Why? That was a hard question. Something Phainon had been asking since Mydei walked in, why did he smell so enticing? Why was he so interested in him? Phainon had never fallen victim to sickly sweet scents of omegas, nor had he found any betas interesting enough to seek romance from. So why was this alpha so.. Domineering over his attention immediately?

“No.. It’s.. Nothing I think.”

“Are you two going to have issues?”

Phainon waved his hands as Castorice studied him, her eyes narrowed in pure disbelief.

 “No way! Am I someone that goes out of their way for drama? Mydei and I are gonna be besties!”

“We’re going to be.. Come again ?” Phainon’s heart froze in his throat as that soothing voice spoke again, making his head jerk to the side as Mydei stood there, arms crossed

Phainon should feel the usual pricks of annoyance in the back of his skull, the annoyance of another alpha lingering around him. The annoyance of another alpha making his cafe smell like them. He doesn’t, he can only beam brightly at the sight of the man’s returnal, “Mydei!”

Mydei almost seemed to flinch at the reaction he had received in return before clearing his throat, “.. I just wanted to see if you two needed a hand before I started baking.”

Phainon began to nod, “Ye-”

Castorice immediately cut in however, “No, We’re fine here for now Mydei, thank you.”

Phainon gave Castorice a small look of complete dismay, defeat even as Mydei merely gave a nod and disappeared into the back. To which Castorice gave him a baffled expression, her hands still holding a few dog bowls before she passed by Phainon, still casting him bewildered looks as she looked at him.

“Why were you going to say yes?”

Phainon held that gaze for a moment before shrugging, “I’m just curious about him!” He didn’t know, actually. He was curious, yes, but not about his personality. Phainon was curious why Mydei smelled so tantalizing, and if it was really his scent or something else..

Castorice shook her head, moving to the dog pen at the side, they would be released soon after all, it was almost opening time. “We don’t need help. Let him prepare the pastries..”

“Fine..” Phainon was slightly aware of how bitter he felt over it when he thought of the back area. The cats and dogs were separated, dogs in the front, cats in the back. They got along, but two very different cafe experiences could be had. Dogs were hyper, excited to meet you, happy to love you at first sight. The cats however, were loners, easily gave into the tubed treats the cafe offered, but otherwise worked on a ‘the cat chooses you’ basis. 

Phainon felt his mind itch when he considered that man would be working back there alone. What was this emotion? Was he worried for betas and omegas being faced with him? That Mydei might hurt them? No.. That didn’t sound right. Then why did it bother him so much?

“Phainon.”

Phainon jolted back to awareness of reality at that, only somewhat noticing he hadn’t moved a foot from where he and Castorice were before. Still facing the shelves that she had long since been done with.

“Yep?”

He turned to find her, a few feet away, her eyes were narrowed, almost glaring at him. 

“You’re.. Your scent is getting really strong, are you sure you’re not becoming territorial with him being here? I’ve never witnessed you do this before.. You’re fine with alpha customers..”

Phainon could only look at her, bewildered. He.. He had never done that to his knowledge either. He blinked slowly at her, what type of explanation could he even give? He didn’t know.

He instead chose to give another friendly smile, urging himself to stop thinking about that man since it was clearly connected somehow. 

“It’s fine! I promise! Sorry about that!”

──────────────

“Is he just going to eat in the back alone, seriously?” Phainon’s voice was steady, but he couldn’t hide that he was a bit miffed that Mydei was staying in the back away from them. From him.

“I told you. He’s standoffish,” She paused, squinting,  “And he probably smelled you threatening to start mauling him with your scent this morning..”

Phainon gave a laugh, one mainly to hide how awkward he still felt over that, “I wasn’t! He can eat lunch with us.. No one is here right now.”

Castorice took a bite out of her tuna sandwich before rolling her eyes at him.“My original point still stands. Stinky .”

Phainon felt as though he might start whimpering, “It’s not like that, Cas!”

She shook her head, taking another bite of her meal before teasing him again, unamused,“ Stinky boy .”

Phainon moved to place his head in his hands with a loud groan as he dragged them downwards.  “I wasn’t trying to threaten him..”

“Then what pissed you off so bad?”

Phainon looked at his untouched tupperware, he had brought spaghetti today.. It was left overs, and normally he wouldn’t feel bad about that. But..

Phainon looked away from it with a rough shake of his head, his eyes begging her for mercy from across the small circular table,  “I was never mad!”

Castorice rolled her eyes again, seemingly tired of his antics, “Then what? Just territorial?”

Phainon willed himself to keep his tone steady, even if he felt like he should be groveling on the floor right now, it was so embarrassing. Mainly because even he didn’t really understand what was wrong with him!

“I told you I’m not.. It’s just he..”

“Grabbed your hand too hard?”

Phainon bit his tongue at that, he wished it was that. That he was territorial, that he was perturbed Mydei was encroaching on his territory, that he hated Mydei being here. But it wasn't, it was the fact that he wished that hand had kept his own clasped within it.

Phainon leaned against the wood for the chair, looking at the ceiling blankly before he slowly admitted it, “He smells really good.”

Castorice stalled in her eating, her eyes blinking multiple times as she stared at Phainon. Disbelief falling over all of her character, and hanging heavy on her expression, “..Good?”

“Yeah.”

“You think another alpha smells good?”

Phainon shrugged, “Why? Does he not to you?”

Castorice gave a muffled laughing noise before taking a bite out of her sandwich. Focusing on it rather intently now before sniffling a little.

“He smells like strong herbs, and like. The woods after a rain maybe.” She shook her head softly before dragging her eyes back to Phainon, who still was focused on the ceiling.”I don’t know if I’d say that’s ‘good’ or if I’d say you just have weird tastes.” 

Phainon met that gaze, his expression softening but falling into silence. That wasn’t at all how Mydei smelled to him. Why? He was quite certain that Mydei had been the one carrying that scent, he couldn’t have possibly confused it for anything else. Phainon’s eyes moved to the dog pen, staring at all the precious little creatures. No one that had come to the cafe today had smelled like that, and the door opening didn’t bring that scent through the breeze either.

Phainon for once thought it was cruel. The cafe was small, a center desk where they took reservations and made orders for food and toys, the dog pen took up most the right side, where the four tables were to the left and in the sunlight that breached through the windows. The back wall had shelves littered with dog toys and other accessories, meanwhile Phainon didn’t go in the back much. 

The back was where the small kitchen was, mainly used to just heat up food for customers and things. That was where the cats were kept and allowed much more freedom than the dogs, mainly due to being much more lazy and calm. The back was where most people went for more romantic peaceful dates rather than playing with their dogs. The back was.. Where Mydei was.

Phainon at the thought immediately latched onto his tupperware for the first time during his lunch break. “I’m going to go eat lunch with him.”

Castorice almost choked, grabbing onto the table between them, “Huh? What about the front!?”

Phainon was already getting up; however, he gave her a small playful wink as he gave her one of his signature grins along with it.

“That’s what you’re for!” He accompanied this by bringing his hands together in a begging fashion.

“Fine fine.. Just don’t start attacking each other back there.” She sighed at him, clearly beyond done with his antics, shaking her head as she took out her phone. 

Phainon at those words quickly scooped up his tupperware as he hustled across the room to the back room door, “Thank you, queen. You’re the best!”

When he opened that door, Mydei must not have heard it. 

One hand was eating a salad, while the other was gently petting a cat who was sitting on a shelf closest to him. Phainon couldn’t tell what expression he was making due to his face being slightly turned away, focusing more on the cat than his food.

Phainon couldn’t help himself as he felt himself smile at the scene before giving a bright greeting, “Hello Mydei!” 

The man in question at those words seemed to freeze before slowly turning his head to look at Phainon, a look of confusion tearing across his face. “Yes?” Was all he offered in reply, sounding more shocked than his face portrayed him to be.

“I’m here to eat lunch with you!” Phainon beamed at him, to which Mydei almost seemed like he grimaced at the news. Not a bother, Phainon was sure he could break down those walls Mydei was hurriedly trying to build!

“Why?” Mydei slowly inquired, narrowing his eyes as he watched Phainon enter the cat pen, getting increasingly close to the high rise table and stool Mydei was on. Phainon was rather happy that Mydei was sitting at a duo table! Made it easier on Phainon. He would have dragged a second chair over here anyways if Mydei hadn’t though.

As he reached the chair he paused, it was Mydei. There’s no way that it was anyone else. That scent that made Phainon feel hot in his own skin, a hunger that he didn’t even know he possessed, so sweet and delicious smelling. A scent that affected him like no other scent before, a dark feeling that made him want to touch Mydei.

Phainon attempted to choke that down as he pulled the seat to sit across from Mydei, who still was watching him with knitted brows. Seeming wholly unimpressed by him.

“What? I want to get to know my co-worker more!”

Mydei stared at him, his hand had now stopped petting the calico to his side and was now crossed over his chest. Phainon met that gaze however, soaking in the sight of him. Mydei was beautiful, his eyes were jewels given form, his face was chiseled, looked hard yet was so perfectly defined in all the correct places. Phainon couldn’t help but focus on that one earring, a beautiful little gold earring, nothing fancy. The braid also was an attention grabber, but Phainon feared to stare and marvel at his features for too long...

“Do you?” Mydei asked smoothly, seeming fully unconvinced by what Phainon had explained. Phainon felt his shoulders droop at that instantly.

“Why wouldn’t I?” Phainon attempted to hold in his ‘puppy face’ as Castorice and Aglaea called it, he was already almost whimpering from this much alone. 

Mydei leaned a bit away from him at that, and Phainon felt like he was going to go into mourning when his eyes moved from him as well and returned to the cat. Phainon couldn’t even say he was normal enough to not be jealous when Mydei returned a hand to gently petting the cat. Phainon bit his own tongue as he watched Mydei’s index finger curve upwards to delicately brush the top of its head with the back of it, the cat in return happily pressed it’s head into the touch.

Phainon was definitely jealous of a fucking cat.

“.. A hunch.” Mydei finally lowly spoke, keeping his gaze fixated on the cat.

Phainon at that said nothing, opening his tupperware instead to start eating his lunch before his break ended soon, he was so doomed. Even if he wanted to convince Mydei, he had no idea how. How to even begin to work around this. He instead gave a sigh, still not taking a bite.

“Then stop having that hunch, I want to be your friend, Mydei!” Phainon grabbed the edge of the table, sounding pitifully sad, apparently if Mydei’s gaze returning to him looking rather bewildered was anything to go off of.

Mydei then offered a snort, his eyes moving back to the cat at his side, “I don’t think we can be friends.”

Phainon felt his heart shatter instantly at that, he was desperate. He’d do anything to get closer to this man, to figure out why he was so attracted to him. To figure out how to move past these emotions and be normal about him! Alphas were not supposed to smell this good to him, right? So why did Mydei?

Phainon cleared his throat, attempting to remove his own inner turmoil along with it,“..Huh? Why not?”

“Aglaea told me you really hate cats.” The reply was flat, not an ounce of joking, Mydei didn’t bother sparing him a glance his way either.

Phainon really hated his big mouth right now more than he could ever hate cats! Why did he tell Aglaea that.. Sure he wasn’t fond of them, but he worked with them just fine! Ugh.

His voice a bit shaky, unable to hold in his shock over this, Phainon spoke his question slowly,“T-That’s a friendship deal breaker?”

Mydei shrugged, “No.”

“What the..?” Phainon felt like he couldn’t breathe, was this man just messing with him? It was genuinely confusing to him.

Mydei met his eye contact, seeming very unimpressed as he flatly explained further, “I just like them a lot.”

Phainon was stunned, confused, confuzzled, baffled, he could only slowly try to think of what Mydei wanted to hear. 

“That’s fine.. I think?”

Mydei scoffed, seeming to grow increasingly annoyed with him, and Phainon didn’t really mind that much as long as those eyes were focusing on him. “You think?”

Phainon raised his hands in mock surrender, waving them, attempting to save face anyway possible. “No it’s just! That’s fine! I don't hate hate cats, you know. I just love love dogs. You can love them!”

Mydei rolled his eyes at him before placing an elbow on the table to prop his own head up, watching Phainon’s quick movements with sheer boredom written on his face. Phainon felt his heart skip a beat as he noted how those golden hairs framed around his face at the movement, feathering about. The red only made Phainon fully convinced Mydei was the sunset given form.

“You’re lying, you know.” 

Phainon’s heart skipped another beat at those words, only to fall into his stomach as a heavy pit. Why was Mydei being so.. Stubborn about this? Couldn’t Phainon want to be his friend?

Phainon knitted his brow, willing his voice to be calm, “Huh? Why do you think that?”

Mydei waved his free hand that was holding his head up rather boredly at Phainon, as if shooing him. “You’re releasing so much of your scent it’s almost making my eyes burn.”

Phainon felt like a deer in headlights at that, the second time today..? 

“..What?”

Mydei now gave him a full blown scowl, clearly getting fed up with the fellow alpha,“You might be good at trying to lie about it, but your scent isn't.”

Phainon was stunned, he had no idea how to convey otherwise. He can’t just say he’s attracted to Mydei to his face, they barely knew each other. And he certainly couldn’t say it was Mydei’s alpha scent of all things riling Phainon up. 

He could only weakly choke out a denial built on nothingness, “That.. It’s not like that..”

A ringing causes Phainon to jump, watching Mydei quickly move to take out his phone, almost choking at the strawberry milk pink cover on it. A piece of him wanted to comment on it, but another shred of him knew not to keep pressing his luck currently. Mydei focused on it for a second before sighing and returning the phone to his pocket, taking a brief second to return to gently petting the feline as a goodbye gesture to it.

“Well, My lunch break is over.” Mydei confirmed Phainon’s suspicion as he got up from his chair, glancing at Phainon’s rather untouched food before giving a small huff of a laugh, picking up his own salad that he had only eaten half of as well.

“Goodbye.” Mydei said with a lazy wave, already turned away. Phainon felt heavy however, like his body was numb. He didn’t understand it.

Why was this alpha affecting him so damn much? Even as he had completely disregarded Mydei by now, Phainon could do nothing but watch him go. Phainon sat there, feeling himself flexing his knuckles before he moved to card a hand through his hair. This was beyond a nightmare. 

Alphas commonly worked together and got along, but now Mydei thought Phainon was being territorial over his place of work. Yet.. Phainon couldn’t help but lick his lips as he thought about Mydei. He was curious, so very curious about what was hiding beneath all his clothing. Nothing he was wearing today was form fitting, much to Phainon’s utmost dismay.

Phainon set his forehead on the table beside his lunch that was completely untouched. He was beyond doomed and maybe even messed up. Why was he sitting here hoping his new co-worker would come  to work in skin tight clothes? His fellow alpha co-worker? Aglaea was so going to fire him.

──────────────

“Do I need to make sure your shifts don’t line up?” Phainon almost choked at that, his gaze focusing on the ramen in front of him. He certainly was glad she wanted to meet up after work, he was starving from his lack of lunch. Granted it was his fault. But he was just so very.. Distracted by Mydei.

Now the duo were in their favorite little ramen shop, tucked away in a comfortable back booth. The fact she wanted to get dinner together was beyond strange, however. Especially that Castorice wasn’t here. He knew immediately from the invite that it was about Mydei, and yet he had still accepted, and now he would be grilled and fried for that.

He snapped his eyes to Aglaea, unable to hide the hurt in his expression, “No! We’re fine to work together, I promise.”

Aglaea tilted her head at him, as if uncertain of the truth within it. “I’ve never seen you be so aggressive to someone before, Phainon. It would be in both of your int-”

Aggression. Aggression would be easier, make more sense to Phainon. But..

“I’m not trying to be aggressive! I think.” Was all Phainon could say, it was agonizing. How the hell was he supposed to explain himself when he barely understood it himself.

Aglaea raised a brow, taking a sip of her drink rather politely, “You.. Think?”

Phainon let out an exasperated sigh, his gaze now sullen as it fell to the bowl of ramen. He was hungry, but it was hard to focus on eating right now. “It’s.. I don’t know, Aglaea.”

“You don’t know..?” She repeatedly, obviously not convinced. 

“..It’s hard to explain.”

“Alpha instincts are well documented, you’re being territorial over an alpha co-w-”

“I’m not!” Phainon bit his tongue at how quickly he had snapped at her before leaning against the plush booth chair, giving a pathetic garbled noise as he did so. Distressed was his biggest emotion right now by far.

She watched him keenly, her emotions read along the line of amusement at this point as he seemed to be having a bad time mentally, “.. Alright. Then what do you think is happening?”

Phainon sat there at that question, staring a hole back at Aglaea as he considered her question thoroughly. There was no question about it, he wanted to lean into Mydei and sniff at his scent glands, inhaling more of it until he couldn't think straight. Lick his skin, taste whatever else Mydei’s scent is hiding beneath it, he wondered how Mydei would react? Would he let Phainon hold him down and map out his skin with his tongue..  Would Mydei be sensitive to it, even as an alpha?

Phainon felt himself slowly bring his hands to his face, his cheeks burning as he attempted to refocus on the topic. “I.. He..”

“Spit it out Phainon. You are not a teenager.” Aglaea pointedly told him, moving to take a drink yet again.

“I am heavily attracted to him.” Aglaea paused in her mission to take a drink, instead hesitating a few inches from her mouth with it. She gave a sigh with a shake of her head. 

A small silence fell between the duo before the beta who was now staring at the drink in her hand looked to him again, tilting her head curiously.

“Oh. Maybe you are a horny teenager then.”

Phainon dropped his hands, feeling as though there was no hiding his embarrassment anymore. No point, instead he feigned hurt over this, “Aglaea!”

“My condolences. But you’re.. Trying to scent or entice another alpha?”

“I think so.” Phainon didn’t actually know what he was doing, he just knew he was doing his best to try to befriend Mydei. Not lunge at him to attack him like everyone was thinking he wanted to do.

Aglaea nodded sagely, before giving a brief chuckle. “.. Wow.”

“Don’t just say wow! Say something comforting!” Phainon could do nothing but plead at this point. He was much too far gone, he had never found someone this.. Enticing, his mind was racing. 

“Well. It’s rare to happen, but an alpha falling for another alpha does happen.”

Phainon felt himself groan. 

“He smells so good, Aglaea, It drives me insane.”

Aglaea shook her head at that before giving a small whistling noise. “.. Maybe I do not to separate your shifts, but for different reasons than expected..”

Phainon gave her a deadpan stare, before he moved a hand over his heart with a small groan, “You would doom me, one of your oldest friends, to a life of loneliness?”

Aglaea rolled her eyes, but humored him with a small breath of a laugh before she spoke, “Pish posh. Your instincts trying to mate with another alpha have already done that.”

Phainon full on pouted at that, leaning into the table as he let out a pained noise, “C’mon.. Be nice!! I’m already drowning here, don’t high five me while I do!”

“I’m unsure how to help you.” Aglaea admitted, shrugging her shoulders as she now was working on her own ramen. Clearly feeling the original issue was averted and now the main issue was Phainon himself.

“Tell me about him.”

Aglaea locked gazes at that with Phainon, before giving a small hum. Taking another bite of her ramen and chewing it, letting the heavy silence hang in the air as she thought about him. “He’s a cat lover. I thought that alone would be your dealbreaker. He has no interest in owning dogs.”

Phainon already knew about this, and had spent all day debating what Mydei had said to him about it. Were cats really going to be the make or break of a relationship before it even existed for him? The only relationship he had ever sought out? Cruel world.. Mercy.

“Turns out I’m willing to sacrifice some things for love.”

Aglaea looked shocked at that admission, blinking her eyes at him many times as she swallowed another bite. “Goodness, even owning a dog one day when you’re in a bigger apartment?”

Phainon moved lean back in the chair again, hanging his head off the back of it as he stared at the ceiling. “He has me wrapped his finger and doesn’t even know it, Aglaea!” 

Phainon sighed, “It’s so bad.. He even thinks I’m getting pissed at him when I’m just..”

Aglaea stared at him, emotionless, deadpan. “Horny like a schoolboy for him?”

Phainon jerked his head to look at her, pleading. This was so evil. “Come on..”

Aglaea rolled her eyes before moving to take another bite, she gave a small amused noise as she watched Phainon. “I’ve never seen you so affected like this by someone, Phainon.”

“Because I never have been. Not even omegas entering their heats, it never really bothered me too much!” Phainon looked to the side, rather thankful the small restaurant was empty right now so no one could raise questions over an alpha crashing out with a beta alone in the corner.

He moved his gaze to focus on her again, putting his hands forward for emphasis as he waved them weakly to her. “But now some alpha co-worker has me tripping over my own feet when I’m near him and wishing I was a cat! A cat!”

Aglaea raised her eyebrows at that, clearly missing some key context. “A cat?”

Phainon was quick to brush that off though, there’s no way he could explain he was pining over a man petting a cat lovingly. “ It’s not important . How doomed am I? Honestly? Could we possibly get along as just friends?”

“Hmm..” She hummed, looking at her ramen before looking at his as well. Becoming more and more amused by the fact Phainon was not managing to eat his food at all. “I’ve known Mydei for many years. He’s a nice man under it all, polite and upfront. But he is also a bit of a loner.”

“Castorice said he’s like a cat..”

Aglaea nodded sagely at that. Like that's the most normal thing she had heard this entire conversation. Maybe it was.“Ah. Yes, there’s a good analogy for him. I agree with her.”

She gave a small snort to herself. “Which is funny, you hate cats.”

“Stop saying that! He’s going to think it’s serious and hate me!” Phainon cradled his head in his hands again, dangerously close to slamming his head into the table to remind himself this was actually a situation he was in now. If crushes were normally like that he was beyond glad that ‘love at first sight’ had never happened to him before now!

Aglaea must have felt pity for him as she watched him wither away, her tone turning soft. “Truthfully, I don’t know too much about his personal life. He could already have a mate and just never told me.”

“You’re joking..”

She shook her head no, much to Phainon’s dismay. “Completely serious. I know of his hobbies being weight lifting, boxing, and baking, but outside that? Rather clueless.”

“Those.. One of those hobbies is not like the others, Aglaea.”

“Tell that to him, not me.” Aglaea could only shrug, she was being honest after all. That’s all she knew of the man. They had worked a different job together before Aglaea bought her own cat and dog cafe, mainly for fun. And in the years of working beside him, the most they talked about was about coffee in the morning, and work documents in the afternoon. 

“Anyways, I’ve known him for years and know he’s trustworthy, but I know next to nothing about his personal life. He’s very secretive, which I found to be fine when hiring him, by the way.”

Phainon was battling his demons, however. He had never done boxing in his entire life, so he for sure couldn’t go head to head against Mydei in the ring. Weight lifting? He hadn’t gone to the gym in months, the most exercise he did was take long jogs for the fun of it - But also mainly to walk the dogs at the cafe. And baking? Let’s not even try to discuss baking. Mydei would for sure hate to see his ass in the kitchen. 

“I’m good at none of those things you listed..”

Aglaea blinked several times at Phainon, seeming almost confused by the confession. “Well, They’re his hobbies. Not yours.”

Slowly, Phainon screwed up his face, seeming more and more concerned. “Ok.. Yeah but how else do I bond with him..” He slowly asked her, praying for an answer.

“You’re beyond hopeless, Phainon . How about you eat your ramen and think about how to talk to men later?”

──────────────

“You love me, right?” 

Phainon asked the samoyed between his hands gently, on his knees as it happily wagged its tail at him. Blissfully unaware of Phainon’s inner demons he was battling, and lacking the ability to speak English even if he did understand. Phainon pressed his forehead to the dog’s, “We’d be friends if you could speak, right, Snowball?”

Such a basic name, but since most of them were rescues he had no say in the matter, he could only love them no matter the fate dealt to them. No matter if their names were given to them by a little seven year old or not, it didn’t change the fact that they were all so wonderful. And he also thought it was really cute, honestly..

He rubbed her head gently, feeling himself sniffle. He hadn’t dared go into the back for lunch today, he decided he needed to give Mydei some space. But at what cost, he wondered? His own sanity? Just knowing he was in the same building and Phainon hadn’t even spoken more than three sentences to him today drove him up the wall.

Nothing was helping him. 

He had left the ramen shop, bid Aglaea goodbye, thought about Mydei on his way home, thought about Mydei at home, thought about Mydei in the shower, jerked off, and then thought about Mydei while getting ready for bed and jerked off yet again. He really was beyond horny for him, and what the hell was he supposed to do about that? Ignore him? It was impossible..

Way more impossible considering the very next day Castorice had called out sick, leaving Mydei and Phainon completely alone together for their shifts.

“Are you good?”

Phainon jerked up at that, giving a wordless and extremely embarrassed startled yelp at the same time, no longer kneeling to pet the big love-bug known as Snowball and instead snapped his head to Mydei. Who seemed to be confused by the sudden movements, but thankfully didn’t comment on the noise that had left Phainon’s mouth. Mydei was just outside the pen, and a piece of Phainon knew it was out of lack of desire to have the dogs excitedly greeting him. 

“I was just coming up here to write down some orders. Sorry to give you a heart attack. ”

As much as Phainon loved to hear that voice speak to him, he couldn’t deny the way Mydei had snuck up silently had indeed given him a fright. Embarrassingly. Phainon could only hope death came to claim himself soon after this mess up in front of Mydei.

“It’s fine! What.. Uh..”

“I’m unsure how.” Mydei stared at him, seeming mildly unimpressed as he spoke. But Phainon could only focus on how stunning he was. His clothes weren’t loose today, his hair was in a small low ponytail in the back, and his black shirt was tight, his jeans left things to the imagination. But Phainon was more than willing to fill in the blanks. He had to try his best not to stare at him, though he knew he was anyway.

“Huh?” Phainon asked dumbly, feeling almost numb as that sweet embrace took him again. Mydei’s scent.

Mydei seemed completely unaware of his plight however, instead just narrowing his eyes to the man still in the dog pen before crossing his arms over his chest. A motion that made Phainon’s knees feel weak as he could now see the muscles in their full glory against the sheer fabric of his shirt.

Mydei rolled his eyes at him, giving a sigh before opting to explain further. “I don’t know how to use the computer system to input what we’re out of in the back.”

“Oh.”

A gear seemed to slowly turn on the cogs before clicking into place for Phainon.  “Oh. You need my help.”

Mydei only stared at him with the same dumbfounded look, his brows starting to knit together as he tried to figure out what Phainon’s issue was. “.. Yes?”

“ Oh! Alright!”

Phainon immediately began to exit the dog pen, much to Snowball’s dismay who he lovingly later will inform he does in fact still love no matter what oversized cat comes in his life. Mydei only watched as he quickly moved, patting the several different dogs that came running at his swift movements.

“.. You are really excited to do this.”

Phainon paused as he was unhooking the gate, feeling the heat rising to his face yet again. He could only stare wide eyed at Mydei, before slowly nodding.

“Uh.. Yeah, I love working on the computer.”

Mydei seemed less than amused before turning away, heading to the main desk. The sight of Mydei’s back was something Phainon could only hope he would see more often.. Those thoughts however were not to be voiced, Mydei instead asked him a simple question.“Are you lying?”

“Absolutely.” A question Phainon answered like a good dog, his tail would absolutely be wagging if he had one while he trailed after Mydei.

Mydei had little to offer in the face of such brutal honesty. Murmuring a soft“Okay..” instead.

Phainon gave a nod as they rounded the table, pointing to the empty computer chair. “Here you sit down so you can see better, I’ll lean over.”

Mydei obeyed and sat down, something that made Phainon’s skin tingle with excitement. He was unsure if it was the close proximity, or the fact Mydei had listened to him so willingly. “Okay.” The oblivious to Phainon’s struggles man spoke smoothly as he sat, rather lazily leaning into the chair.

Phainon leaned down at that, to better see the monitor and handle the mouse better, but also to be even closer. Vividly aware that he was almost brushing shoulders with Mydei. “The program is pretty finicky, we all hate it, but we all also hate computers too much to change it.”

Phainon knew he was simply sputtering stuff to say it, but at this point he desperately wanted to convey to Mydei that he was friendly! Mydei, on the other hand, only grumbled a short; “.. I see.”

Phainon almost felt himself  grit his teeth at that before returning to his signature smile, looking to Mydei below him curiously. Desperately trying to ignore the way his stomach churned when Mydei looked slightly upwards at him. 

Phainon willed himself to stay sane, and speak in a level tone, praying that it wouldn’t be shaky as his senses were completely overwhelmed with Mydei’s intoxicating scent. “In this column you have to input the day it ran out - What do you need me to put there?” 

Mydei blinked at him slowly before returning his gaze to the computer screen Phainon was helping him with. “.. Churu squeeze treats.”

“Ok, got it, anyways. And then someone can input the day we reordered, and the day it arrived. The cost goes in the side column here.”

“.. Right.” Mydei slowly drawled out, giving a small nod as well.

“The main annoying part is logging into the system, for some reason we have to change the password every three-” Mydei cut in at this point, and Phainon was unsure if it was just due to his rambling or not.

“Have I angered you somehow?”

Phainon felt his throat tighten at this, moving his gaze from the monitor and to Mydei sitting in the chair who was only staring at him. His lips were in a slight downward angle, clearly annoyed as he gave a withering stare.

“Why.. Why do you ask that?”

Mydei narrowed his eyes at that, his tone seemed an octave lower as he spoke his question; “Do you really need to ask that?”

“Is it my scent?”

Mydei rolled his eyes at that before giving an annoyed exhale from his mouth. “I was told you were really capable around other alphas, but-”

Phainon couldn’t help but interrupt. “It’s not you! It’s..”

What could he say? What could he say that wouldn’t ruin his chances with Mydei? Even if they were both alphas, was it really that greedy for him to want someone for himself..? 

It certainly wasn’t Mydei’s fault. “It’s me. I’m sorry, It’s not you.”

Mydei stared at him, clear disbelief weighing heavy on his features. “Then why?”

Phainon found he had no good reply. No good lie. All he could offer was patheticness.“.. Sorry.”

Mydei stood up at that, and Phainon begrudgingly moved out of his way silently. “Whatever. Thanks for the help, at least.”

Phainon said nothing, he couldn’t bring himself to. He didn’t know how to comfort Mydei, and he didn’t know how to be ‘normal’ around Mydei. He didn’t know how to stop his instincts from trying to scent Mydei, to woo Mydei. He just.. He couldn’t bring himself to ask Mydei to stop walking away from him. To talk to him more. 

Phainon had no right to ask that of him.

──────────────

They usually were a very quiet cafe, not many customers throughout the day, and at night people on dates would flock in but still remained hush. Always easy to pull a smile from your loved one when you let them play with dogs, Phainon found! Well. At least he used to think that way until he bitterly remembered that Mydei was a giant cat fan.

Phainon couldn’t quite rationalize how, considering everytime he looked to the dog pen they were happily swarming whatever guest had went in there. Showering them with love and affection..

Phainon at the moment however, could do little more than smile happily and nod as he took down more orders, before sliding away to Aglaea at the desk worriedly, “We’re going to run out of tables..” Was all he murmured to her, sweeping his gaze across the very full tables. He certainly was dreading the idea of more people showing up.

“Is Mydei faring any better?” Aglaea’s knitted brow lessened a bit at that as she looked up from the receipts she was focusing on, giving a small amused hum. 

“Oh? Would you like to go find out? I’m sure he needs a hand with all the food, you know.”

Phainon had tried his best to ignore Mydei everytime he showed up in the front half to deliver orders of food, it was nearly impossible though. He felt his eyes lingering on him at every chance, becoming hyper aware the second he walked in due to his overpowering scent. Even though Castorice had been helping move orders around, Phainon could still smell Mydei through the door separating them.

Phainon leaned on the desk, clenching and unclenching his fists, “Sure you don’t want to send Castorice? I hear she likes cats.”

Aglaea gave a small hum, before giving a laugh. “I think cats may be growing on you.”

Phainon felt his usual grin grow as he looked at her, the order he had just taken still in hand, “Touche.” He paused, looking at her desperately, as if any signs of untruth would be written plainly there, “You really want me to go help him? You know I’m a useless cook.”

Aglaea shot Phainon a threatening look before giving a huff. She leaned back in the office chair slightly to scan the full tables. Something gleaming in her eyes. A look he knew well on the woman, mischief. “Oh, I’m sure Mydei can whip you into shape..”

Phainon kept his normal smile, even if his hands twitched at the idea of Mydei ‘whipping’ him into shape, only feeling himself sweat the tiniest bit under her gaze. She absolutely was messing with him, he could either go in there and make a fool of himself around Mydei, or not be around Mydei..

“Okay. I’ll go help him.”

Aglaea slowly nodded at his words, before giving a small laugh. “Ah yes.. ‘Help’ him.”

Phainon rolled his eyes, before giving her a smile regardless. He really couldn’t deny it. His ass was not about to do anything but give Mydei a headache, probably. Even though he knew this, he couldn’t stop himself as he walked to Castorice, who was seemingly distracted looking for something in the shelves.

“Cas,” Phainon asked as she approached her, making her jump slightly before looking over her shoulder to him questioningly, “Do you have any orders, I’ll take them back with me. Aglaea told me to go help Mydei.”

Castorice stared at him. “Did she tell you, or give you the free choice of it?”

“Well…”

“Yeah. Okay. Anyways, No, I do not. I took them back there before coming to get the treats they also wanted to give the dogs.. Any idea where the dental treats are?” 

Phainon shook his head to her as he walked away from her, giving a small wave as he left into the back. 

The back however, was much quieter due to the lack of dogs prancing about excitedly hoping people would pet them. The cats instead, seemed barely bothered by the people in the room outside of a couple who were feeding a very familiar calico a tube of treats. Phainon felt his hand twitch a little, the heavy scent of Mydei reaching his nose now at a much higher density, something Phainon would love to have injected directly into his bloodstream.

Instead as he looked at the customers and cats who paid him no mind, he moved to slap hands to his face lightly. He couldn’t think of Mydei like this, not now. If he was trapped in the rather quaint kitchen with Mydei and started trying to scent him, Mydei might actually finally lose it with him. Though.. A shard of Phainon desperately did want to see Mydei lose his hold on his instincts. To snarl at Phainon.. What was wrong with him? 

Phainon could only sigh to himself as he clutched the orders he had taken before and moved to the right towards the kitchen. The kitchen had a window in the front, mainly for dropping off orders, but Mydei didn’t seem to notice Phainon walking by it regardless.

The kitchen was rather spotless for how much activity it was having, and Mydei, the chef in question right now, immediately jerked his head up from the sandwich wrap he was making. Mydei’s look of focus almost immediately faded into pure confusion when he saw Phainon, and instead of letting Phainon explain himself, Mydei instead was extremely quick on the draw. 

“What?”

Phainon’s eyes moved between Mydei and the wrap he was currently attending to, some kind of meat in the middle that Phainon couldn’t quite discern. “I was told to come help you.”

Mydei stilled his movements completely at that, throwing him a look of disbelief as his brows creased. Something Phainon would call beautiful on Mydei’s face, if not for the fact Mydei looked close to wacking Phainon over his head.

“Help me? They sent you?”

Phainon moved deeper into the kitchen at that question, even as his nose twitched over Mydei’s nearing scent, “I’ll behave, okay? I promise.”

Mydei only blinked at him, “I meant.. I was told you’re a shit cook.”

Phainon winced at that, immediately having to bite down the urge to act painfully offended. They were right, Phainon ruined almost everything in the kitchen. He had once even burnt a pan trying to boil water. Something that Aglaea had never let him live down, rightfully so. The silence from Phainon made Mydei shake his head roughly. 

“Whatever. What role can I give to you that you won’t mess up?”

Phainon bit at his bottom lip at that, before giving Mydei one of his beaming smiles, “Whatever you trust me with, I’ll do!”

Mydei studied him, blinking slowly, “I don’t trust you at all with cooking, is the thing.” Mydei shook his head before returning to his current task for himself, seeming more distracted now as he delicately moved to place some diced onions on it. Phainon’s gaze watched those hands like a hawk, only wondering upwards to focus on Mydei’s nap as Mydei paid him no mind. He had no reason to, after all, an alpha standing almost behind you as another alpha wasn’t anything to worry about.

Even if Phainon desperately wanted to put his head in the crook of Mydei’s neck and rub against it. Basking in everything that was Mydei. Phainon clenched his free hand into a fist, hard enough to make his nails burrow into the skin to ground himself as he attempted to keep his smile up.

“Awe, Mydei.. Maybe they were just overstating!” Phainon knew he was straight out lying, but he couldn’t help but give him a pouting face as he walked in more into the kitchen. Honestly. He hadn’t been in this area of the cafe much. He was more so shocked to see how clean it was, it used to be rather unorganized, but since Mydei became the main person who took control of it, it seemed much more well put together. 

Phainon could only note this due to how now the orders were meticulously placed, dishes seemed to be washed upon obtaining them instead of handled later, and no dishes were laid about. The biggest mess currently was just what Mydei was working on.

Phainon felt a bit awkward, standing there as he awaited Mydei’s attention to be graced to him again, it took a few seconds. Watching calloused hands that were wrapped in plastic gloves move with the gentleness of handling a newborn as he wrapped up the food that Phainon could now identify as a tuna wrap. Mydei wrapped it in the dog and cat themed paper before looking at Phainon, almost borderline glaring at him.

“Table two,” Mydei paused, pointing to the paper in Phainon’s hand with his own free hand as he held out the wrapped sandwich, “Also give me that already.”

Phainon felt himself complying, trading the sandwich and orders he had taken, before feeling almost woeful that someone else was going to be eating food Mydei made. Come on. He could not be jealous of a cat and now someone else eating Mydei’s food, and yet.. He sighed, he didn’t even like tuna to begin with, nodding. 

“Table two.” He confirmed, almost skulking away. 

Phainon did his usual routine happily greeting customers and nodding, talking to them if they saw fit, yet he paused, “Phainon? We rarely see you back here!” He blinked, realizing they were regulars who saw him in the front constantly. 

Phainon laughed sheepishly, “It’s rather busy today! Someone has to help in the cat area, don’t they?” Phainon mused, giving a smile to the couple as his eyes wondered, pausing on the orange tabby that they had had for years. He never gave it much thought or looked at it, it usually was alone and never around the other cats or customers. 

Which was no different than today, as it sat on the far couch where no one was, upside down for it’s white belly to be seen for all. Two traitorous thoughts instantly crossed his mind. One, was simply that he was cute. The second, was that it reminded him of Mydei. He instantly had to swallow that thought and desire to go pet the loner cat. Instead, nodding at the couple and excusing himself to leave the scene, he had to return to Mydei after all.

“Theyre kind of cute.” Phainon murmured as he entered the kitchen again, making Mydei - who was now on the opposite side of the kitchen, seeming to be waiting for him - flash him a confused look. 

“The customer who wanted tuna..?”

Phainon waved his arms at that weakly, giving him a charming grin, “No, no. The cats, silly.”

Mydei still regarded him for a moment, deliberately between himself on what to say to that.“Silly? Me?”

Phainon continued to give his grin, one that was well practiced. One that he hoped would cover up how embarrassed he felt now over calling this grown man silly. A grown alpha who didn’t even like him. “Yes, you.”

“Right..” Mydei shook his head, but Phainon was quick to ask, “Is that so unbelievable that you’re silly?” Phainon found that he could only stand firm in what his big mouth had blabbered, lest he give in to shame and collapse on the spot. 

Mydei looked at him, screwing up his face as if he just couldn’t quite figure out why Phainon was intent on this line of thought. “I think so. Anyway, come here.”

Phainon regretfully didn’t even really fight the pull of that command, waltzing around the kitchen and to Mydei’s side and Mydei turned to focus on the counter. Painfully aware that he had probably gotten too close by how Mydei stiffened for the slightest of seconds before he pointed at the ingredients.  Mydei opted to not comment on it however, instead focusing on giving Phainon something to do.

“We’re going to put you on dessert duty, since most of it is just up to order, and not skill or actually heavens forbid turning on the stove.”

Phainon moved slightly, almost brushing himself against Mydei as he held a hand over his heart to give him a pained look. “You wound me.”

Mydei only met it with narrowed eyes. “ Hush up. I’ve heard about the boiling water incident.”

“Erk.” Mydei shook his head at that pathetic noise, tapping on the counter again as if trying to get Phainon to focus. It worked, Phainon was more than willing to obey whatever Mydei wanted him to do as his eyes moved to the tapping finger. Especially if it meant he got to stay this close to Mydei and breathe in his scent.

“This is extremely easy, okay? Even you can do this correctly.”

“You’re killing me here, Mydei..”

Mydei ignored his whine, “The order barely matters, just make sure it alternates between the yogurt, nuts, and strawberries. Or whatever fruit they substitute in.”

Phainon found himself beaming at those words all the same, giving Mydei a bright smile. “At least it’s good to know you trust me with something!”

Mydei only looked at him in modest disgust before exhaling softly, “Don’t look at me like you’re so happy.. This is the literal bare minimum. ”

Phainon shrugged, somehow feeling bold enough to brush against Mydei playfully, somewhat aware of how firm Mydei’s arms felt against his own. “It’s something!”

Mydei snorted a laugh, opting to not comment on the way Phainon had forced him to sway a bit before shaking his head. Phainon’s thoughts could only manage to linger on how sweet his laugh was, deep and rhythmic. Extremely calming.. A noise Phainon would like to pull more of from the fellow alpha.

Mydei, unaware of how Phainon’s heart was fluttering, gave Phainon a small devilish grin as he spoke, “Get it wrong and I’m making you go play with the cats as a form of punishment.” Mydei turned as he spoke and stepped to the other counter behind Phainon. Probably going back to working on his actual job instead of entertaining Phainon’s antics.

Phainon instead moved to attempting to make his first parfait, the instructions he was given were extremely simple. He could do this, right? 

Phainon shrugged his shoulders to no one over his thoughts as he moved back to prioritizing teasing Mydei.“That’s alright, the orange one kind of reminds me of you.” Phainon shut his mouth abruptly, painfully aware of the fact he should not have just said that. Mydei behind him seemed to freeze at that, and Phainon could do nothing but scoop yogurt into the small cup in the silence. His mind itching for something to feel the heavy air between them.

“ .. Huh?”

“Huh?” 

“Don’t also say huh . You’re the one that said something weird.” Phainon couldn’t see Mydei’s face while he was still focused on his task, but he didn’t need to. He could hear the clear disbelief dripping from his tone, “Why the hell would a cat reminding you of me be a good thing?”

Phainon’s tongue feels like cotton in his mouth, staring at the food he was working on before betraying himself to throw a glance over his shoulder to the man who was working diligently behind him. Apparently, he wasn’t the only one that had paused over his blunder, as Mydei fully met that gaze, turned to look at Phainon, as if just staring at him would aid in his investigation.

Debating his options, Phainon gave him a bright smile, laughing softly as he broke the gaze to look at the parfait that needed more yogurt. His hands felt numb. 

“It’s nice to be reminded of your friends!” Phainon offered innocently, causing Mydei’s eyes to search him, staring him down.

“.. We’re friends?”

Phainon knitted his brows at that, giving him a pathetic look before Mydei turned away. Seeming to focus again on his job. Something Phainon found nearly impossible between all his thoughts of Mydei. “You’re so mean, Mydei..”

“Well. It’s just news to me.” Mydei murmured nonchalantly, “You’re the one that's territorial.”

Phainon looked back to the yogurt, giving a big sigh, he was woefully unsure how to convince Mydei otherwise.  “I’m not territorial! I promise.”

“You say while releasing your protective scent in drones when I’m near usually.”

“Well, Yeah.” Phainon didn’t really have a defense, and that alone made Mydei make a snorting noise behind his back. Something that Phainon was keenly honing onto as he inspected the strawberries left for him by Mydei to use, already cut. Probably by Mydei.

“Yeah? So you agree?”

Phainon froze at the question, before shaking his head. To himself, and to the sharp inquiry. “No.. That’s not what I meant.”

A sentence Mydei easily counters. “Then what did you mean, Phainon? ”

Phainon felt a bit frustrated now, not at Mydei, but at himself. He didn’t comprehend his own feelings, he barely knew Mydei. Why did he smell as good as people explained omegas to smell? Why was everything about him so hypnotizing? Why could he barely stand in this kitchen with him without his legs quivering? Why did the way Mydei say his name go straight to his dick, making it twitch excitedly?

“I.. I don’t know!” Phainon condeeded. 

“Whatever,” Mydei seemed to have given up on the topic, his voice much more flat toned as he spoke, still music to Phainon’s ears but he wished it was happier. “I’ve finished two wraps, have you finished that one parfait yet?”

“Yes..” Phainon answered rather weakly, dropping some nuts in as the topping, only freezing as Mydei stood behind him, seeming to inspect it. Phainon looked over his shoulder to look at him, barely daring to move at all, barely daring to breathe for that matter. Phainon was now hyper aware of the way the colors and juices had all mingled together messily in the cup, hoping that it was okay regardless.

Mydei blinked as he stared the cup down before he moved his gaze to focus on Phainon.

“How did you make a simple yogurt parfait look like shit?”

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.html:
“Have you ever considered maybe you aren’t an alpha?”

Castorice’s question was innocent enough as she still ignored him, her back away from him as sshe moved to settle stuff on the shelf. The end of their shift was upon the duo; They had to clean up. But all Phainon could manage to do was stare at her with his mouth agape; “You think I’m an omega?”

Castorice shot him a withering glare, clearly one that read he was an idiot in many different languages, none of which Phainon was privy to. “No. I meant maybe you’re an enigma .”

Phainon leaned on the desk to take in her words, he had already clocked out, him slacking on cleaning up a bit was fine. He had the key to lock up the place anyways, and always made sure all the little guys were well taken care of.

“An enigma? Aren’t those.. I don’t know.. A myth?”

Castorice shrugged, giving him a sigh as she turned towards him, clearly done now, all that was left was for Phainon to round up all the dogs into the back. “Any other ideas why you’re so interested in an alpha and never cared about omegas or betas like I don’t know.. Every other alpha in existence and instead are falling for some other alpha?”

Phainon at the idea moved his gaze to focus solely on the dogs, thankful that at least they were always the one constant in his life. Always adorable!

He stepped over to smoothly round up the dogs, unsure if it was truly to put them up - or if he just needed some little guys to cheer him up. 

“I don’t know..” He really didn’t. Even if he tried to rationalize his thoughts into words - he just couldn’t. Nothing seemed to add up in his head, he had always acknowledged his lack of affection and desire to mate with betas or omegas was bizarre, but he took it as just not being interested in romance!

Blue eyes focused on the ever gentle Snowball, for once in his life he wished he understood anything about romance and winning someone over, because right it felt as though he was playing chess with Mydei - and losing. Phainon could only focus on the softness of the dog who always looked so happy to see him before giving a small groan, mainly to himself.

“How would I know if I’m an enigma?” The question was asked as he gently scratched Snowball's head over the gate, feeling more and more pathetic with each second that he questioned his secondary gender. He wasn’t supposed to be nearing thirty and questioning this still! Let alone the myth that was enigmas. But was it really that simple? The reason why he was never attracted to anyone’s pheromones before Mydei? He couldn’t puzzle it out.

“I don’t know.. Try biting Mydei’s nape..”

Phainon shot an almost shocked glare her way as he snapped his head over the pen gate, still keeping a hand focused on giving Snowball attention. 

“You know I can’t just do that!” Phainon remarked sharply before giving a sigh, returning his gaze to Snowball, “I could never mate with someone that didn’t want to be my mate..”

Castorice neared over that, now done with her own half of cleaning as she leaned over the gate to look at Phainon, her eyes flickering between Snowball and the chihuahua that was fully ignoring them still in the front. 

“I was joking, I know you’d never.” She told him rather softly, as if very aware of how he was almost scowling at her over the statement. “Stop bristling at me, you act as if it’d even do anything to him.”

Phainon opened his mouth to reply - Only to abruptly snap it closed as if his life depended on it when the door to the back opened. The duo were not good at being sneaky - It turned out, rather obvious by how both of them immediately shot to look at Mydei. Who in question knitted his brows slightly over both of them focusing on him.

Mydei’s gaze flicked between the duo for a few beats before landing squarely on Phainon. “Are you going to start herding the dogs up, or what?” Mydei’s voice came out horribly unimpressed, and he probably was. Phainon at that bit his own tongue slightly before giving the dog another pat, almost feeling dejected at this point as entered the gate to coax them to the door that led to the back in their pin.

Phainon could feel his skin prickle underneath Mydei’s gaze as he did so - Betraying himself and giving a sideways glance to the man who was now walking over to Castorice. 

Phainon moved quickly to say goodbye and good night to the dogs, giving them lots of love and affection - Even though he had just finished their last jog with them. Supposedly it was a ‘walk’ but they always dragged him into running, and how was he supposed to say no? As he made sure they were all set in the back and properly taken care of, he entered the front again, locking the door behind him.

Phainon’s gaze fell on the two that were now seemingly waiting for him, neither of them, eerily, said anything. Castorice stood beside Mydei politely, her arms gently held before her clasping her purse, meanwhile Mydei stood there with his arms crossed, looking less than amused over Phainon’s sluggish movements. 

“You guys didn’t have to wait for me..” 

Castorice tilted her head innocently at that, “We have plans to eat out tonight, though? I invited Mydei to join us.”

Phainon blinked at her words remarkably slowly, his gaze moving between the duo that still stood there waiting on him before he opted to give them a bright smile. “Alright! Sounds good to me!” Phainon moved to join them, at which they all seemed to immediately fall into a steady walking rhythm together before exiting. Phainon found himself yet again struggling to fight with the grip of Mydei’s pheromones. He shouldn’t smell so delicious and yet, Phainon only wanted to lean in and sniff him. Just a bit. 

Instead, he pursed his lips into a thin line, attempting his best to ignore how good the man smelled. “What are we eating?”

Castorice hummed softly at his words, “Mydei, You’re the new person. Anything you’re craving to make Phainon pay for?” 

Phainon immediately made a choking noise, “I didn’t agree to that?” 

Mydei, from the side of Phainon instead sent him an amused glimpse, “Oh? Phainon is paying?” 

Phainon wanted to say no, he was not. But as he left the building and turned the wait for them to leave the building in a single file line as well, the smallest upturn of Mydei’s lips were not lost on him. Not in the slightest. He could only give a small whimper and attempted to breathe in the outdoor air that was significantly less Mydei in nature.

“Since you’re new.. Sure.. Just this once..” A lie. He would pay for Mydei anytime that Mydei was willing to spend time with him. Phainon just hadn’t offered this to Castorice! She was trying to kill him.

Mydei gave a scoff at that, molten gold eyes falling on ocean blue, and Phainon took the sight in deeply. Mydei always looked rather stunning, he seemed to put his hair up while working and let it back down after he clocked out. His black turtleneck was rather tight and left nothing to the imagination underneath it, or the sleeves. The black pants were almost the same in that regard, almost. And Phainon was rather thankful for that. 

A part of him mourned the turtleneck, however, something carnal in him liked seeing the man’s neck on display. He had no reason to cover it - He was an alpha.. It was just a choice in style, one that made Phainon tighten his lips into a somewhat fake smile to avoid frowning over such shameless thoughts.

Yet, blinking at his outfit made Phainon painfully aware of the crisp cold air for once. Something he usually ignored and didn’t pay any heed to - Maybe a mistake if they were staying out late. Phainon shook his head from his thoughts to move past Mydei and Castorice, locking the front door as well before putting the keys into his pocket. He was rather thankful Aglaea entrusted him with the keys even if her original sentiment was along the lines of ‘you’d be here faster than me if there was an animal emergency.’.

“I’m not picky.” Mydei said from behind him, his voice as unenthused as ever about the situation. Phainon almost felt himself wanting to ask if Mydei was super sure he was willing to go eat dinner with them, but he knew it wiser to not blow this. 

“Do you drink, Mydei?” Castorice asked rather innocently as Phainon turned to give her a rather blank questioning stare, one that both Mydei and Castorice merely ignored to talk to each other instead. 

“No.”

“Oh, Quite a shame.”

“Is it?”

“Aglaea is quite fond of social drinking.. You may be brought into it one day.”

“.. Is that so? I have a right to refuse, don’t I?”

“Indeed. I was simply curious.. “ Castorice paused, and Phainon debated jumping in.. If not for the fact she continued rather quickly with her line of barraged questions towards Mydei; “What type of food do you enjoy?”

“Anything.”

“Really?”

“As long as it tastes good.”

Castorice nodded sagely at that, “I see.”

Phainon however, was tired of looking between them and closed the few steps of distance suddenly, moving in between them and putting a hand on both of their backs to force them in a certain direction. A gamble that made Mydei shoot him a fierce piercing glare, yet he obeyed the shove anyways and assumed walking in line with them, now with Phainon in the middle.

Phainon however, only smiled happily forward, looking at the rather dreary sky and praying it didn’t rain before giving an amused hum, “Sounds like I’m picking!”

──────────────

Phainon was actually going to kill Castorice. 

She had picked out a booth, only to ask that the two alphas sit on the opposite side- beside each other -  their legs basically touching as they sat there. Something Mydei didn’t seem to pay any mind to, something that Phainon absolutely paid mind to with every slight brush of contact Mydei accidentally made. It sent a burning sensation through every single one of Phainon’s nerves every single slight touch of Mydei.

Phainon had no escape either, he was against the wall on one side, and Mydei was equally a wall on the other. Phainon couldn’t ignore the closeness of Mydei, how strong his scent was, how it grabbed and pulled all of Phainon’s cords relentlessly. He wanted nothing more than to snake a finger into Mydei’s turtleneck and pull it down just a little, to let his scent escape even more. 

Phainon could only grip the menu tightly, so very tightly that his knuckles were on the verge of turning white. The pain he felt growing in his tense joints only aiding to keep him grounded, anything from the man’s molten gaze that now was focused on him squarely, “Phainon, are you alright?” Castorice across the table was the one to speak however.

Her face had concern written on all of its features as her eyes flicked from his face to his death grip on the menu, “You’re.. Seeming very distressed.”

Phainon shook his head roughly as he looked up from the menu, offering her a very small forced smile in an attempt of reassurance. “I’m fine!” An unconvincing set of words as his voice shook slightly, he knew, as he continued to ignore the man’s gaze beside him that was burrowing into his skin. 

Phainon quickly returned his gaze to the menu, attempting to calm himself, knowing he was probably attempting to scent Mydei accidentally. He had to focus on anything but the deep scent beside him, rich, intoxicating, sweet and enticing beyond belief. He was only halfway aware of the way Mydei’s head looked forward again, that piercing gaze leaving Phainon.

Out of Phainon’s peripheral vision he could clearly see Mydei setting down the menu to glance at his phone. The silence between the trio was heavy - Almost palpable from the difference of the buzzing restaurant. Phainon could only bite his inner cheek at it, he couldn’t think of what to say. His tongue felt heavy and cotton in his mouth when he even tried to focus on anything but Mydei. 

The man’s presence was all consuming for Phainon, it was without comparison for everything else he had ever been somewhat interested in. 

“I have to go.” Mydei broke the silence with something that made Phainon’s head snap up so quickly that it was jarring. 

“Go? Go where?” Phainon asked almost immediately, unsure of what emotion had flickered inside of him to cause such a quick response as he focused on the golden haired man, who only seemed to look at him almost confusedly. Before Mydei raised an eyebrow slowly, “Does it matter?”

Phainon felt his grip tighten on the menu, it did. It did matter. Why did Mydei need to leave? Mydei gave a scoff however, before exhaling from his mouth slowly, a breath that Phainon could feel on his own skin almost due to their closeness in the booth before Mydei slid his eyes from Phainon. 

“I have to leave, that’s all. Goodnight.” Mydei flatly said, placing a hand in between them on the booth to begin his exit. Something that was a mistake, Phainon found, as Phainon instead grasped his wrist like it was his only lifeline. Mydei froze at that, sending Phainon a very obviously baffled expression over it.

“Please, don’t go.” Phainon could feel himself practically begging and his hand savored the feeling of Mydei’s skin against his hand. His body warmth the wrist gave off.. So very Mydei. 

Mydei leaned somewhat closer at that, his eyes looking dangerous, as if attempting to challenge Phainon, something that Phainon assumed should be a challenge to his inner alpha. If it ever bothered to adhere to Mydei’s.

“You have not stopped giving off threatening pheromones since we were seated,” Mydei spoke softly, yet incredibly deeper, his gaze only sharpening as he narrowed his sunset eyes. “I apologize for interrupting your date with Castorice, but I would like to be excluded now.”

Phainon regarded him hard, staring back, attempting his best to stay sane as Mydei attempted to jerk his wrist free. Something Phainon found himself only clinging to more. “I promise I’m not angry..” 

Mydei seemed to only bristle at those words, growing more agitated over the fact Phainon wouldn’t let go, “Do you really want to start a fight with me in front of Castorice ?” 

Phainon at those words felt guilt spread through him as he looked to Castorice. Or well, should have, he blinked at the empty booth seat across from him, something that made Mydei copy the act, seeming equally bewildered at the significant lack of Castorice.

Phainon couldn’t believe he hadn’t noticed her sneaking off, but at the same time he felt it hard to care too much when his entire being was focusing on Mydei. All of his senses were clawing at him to not let this man slip away, yet he bit them down as much as he could, trying to figure out where she had gone for a brief second.

“When did she leave?”

“Probably when your pheromones spiked to hell and back trying to leash me down.” Mydei answered simply, sarcastically, and very annoyed as he still gave another yank on his own arm, still firm on Phainon’s own grasp. “Now look at what you’ve done. You’ve ruined your date entirely by not letting me leave noblely.” Mydei hissed at him, his glare somehow only narrowing further as he gave a deep sigh. A sound that seemed to come from the core of Mydei’s chest. 

“Will you unhand me already? You’re pissing me off.” Mydei growled lowly at him, another thing that should be making Phainon’s alpha yell at him, take it as a challenge as Mydei was visibly growing in anger.

But Phainon could only find a lack of it - Nothing screamed at him to prove his dominance to the fellow alpha, nothing pricked at his inner secondary gender to snarl back at him. No. With the rising amount of Mydei’s own pheromones over getting this ruffled up.. Phainon only found himself desiring Mydei more.

Phainon flashed him a genuine smile, one that was rather mocking in the way Mydei was riled up comparatively, “I guess you’re my date for tonight then!”

Mydei noticeably stilled in Phainon’s grasp at that, his entire body tensing and becoming rigid. Something that Phainon couldn’t place as shock or annoyance properly - At least, until watching Mydei’s face fall into a full scowl.

“We are both alphas.” Mydei reminded him rather flatly, his voice now losing the familiar edge of an angered alpha and more just like an annoyed Mydei once again.

Phainon nodded. “Yep.”

“We’re both pissed off already with each other.”

Phainon shook his head. “I said I’m not angry at you.”

“Then what is it, Phainon?” Mydei pressed, his tone dangerous as he leered at the other, “You start having heavy pheromones everytime I near, what is your issue regarding me if not anger or territory?”

Phainon found himself staring back, feeling almost dumb over the question as he pressed his tongue to the roof of his mouth hard. His teeth grinding a bit in his thoughts. 

There were many options here;

  1. He could say it was in fact anger, and piss off Mydei even further and lengthen the distance between them.
  2. ‘I don’t know’, and piss off Mydei even further and lengthen the distance between them.
  3. He could confess, which may only just heavily confuse Mydei, or piss off Mydei even further and lengthen the distance between them. But also at least it would be out there.

Phainon slowly blinked before unhanding Mydei finally, watching as the man immediately began to flex his arm and rub at the spot Phainon was gripping for his life onto. An act that made Phainon’s anxiety spike over the idea of accidentally harming the man.

“I think I have a crush on you , Mydei. Not Castorice or Aglaea.”

Mydei froze in his soothing movements on his wrist for the briefest second before throwing Phainon the most baffled expression Phainon had ever seen on him.

“.. What?”

Phainon moved to put his face into his hands, this was so much worse than just pissing him off. “Is that really that strange?” Phainon practically sighed out as he withdrew his face from his hands, casting a worried look to the man who was still sitting beside him, somewhat further away. But still there. His expression had barely changed. Mydei still looked absolutely clueless over this confession.

“Yes?” Mydei answered almost dumbfoundedly, as if Phainon had asked the stupidest question of all time. And maybe he had. It was unnatural, almost sinful for an alpha to fall in love with an alpha, not to say Phainon was in love just yet, maybe he was. But regardless of his emotions - They were considered unnatural by most.

Phainon found himself giving way to a pained groan over Mydei’s reply regardless. 

“I know!” Phainon conceded softly, fighting the urge to slam his head into the table until unconsciousness claimed him, “I know it’s strange, alright?”

“Is that seriously the reason?” Mydei asked, still completely gawking at Phainon as if he had seen a ghost. A ghost of Phainon’s shame, maybe, it had probably also bailed on Phainon. 

Phainon could only give him a pathetic stare back, feeling as if he was a scolded dog somehow. “Yes.” Was his meak admittance, something that only made Mydei blink slowly at him. Phainon slowly moved to grab his rather untouched phone on the table when he saw it lighting up silently with a text from Castorice. 

“Good luck! :p”

Phainon could only scrunch up his face, only to almost drop it as Mydei had gotten closer to also read the text. Phainon had nothing to hide - He wasn’t upset by the action by any means. Mydei could go through his phone right now if he was so curious, but the new closeness made him shudder slightly.

“She knew?” 

“.. Yes.” Phainon confirmed as he set the damned device down, giving a sigh.

A silence fell on them, something that Phainon couldn’t tell if it was a dire thing, or a fine thing to be happening. Phainon felt like he should be sobbing right now, this was the absolute worst. He had begged Mydei into staying, confessed his weird issue with Mydei, and then couldn’t think of anything to say. How could he? That sickly sweet scent still clung to his nostrils at any chance, every thought just returned to the owner of it.

“Can I at least move to the other side? This is awkward.” Mydei finally broke the silence, sounding almost deadpan as he asked the question.
