As if he fully knew Phainon would latch onto him again, something Phainon couldn’t deny. Phainon moved his gaze to meet questioning amber ones, and slowly nodded. At which, Mydei followed through and swapped sides, taking Castorice’s seat with an audible sharp exhale through his lips.

Phainon already mourned the lack of Mydei almost against him, but willed himself to be normal about it. As normal as he could be after these events. Mydei was granting him mercy by staying, by humoring him and eating a meal with him even after it all. Something about that train of thought made Phainon’s mind crawl to a stall.

“We never got a waiter.”

──────────────

After they had finally gotten someone to take their orders, the dinner was rather uneventful. Castorice had indeed completely ditched the duo during their bickering and Phainon’s refusal to unhand Mydei - And she had never returned. What an insane way to wingman. 

Phainon had stayed true to his word and paid for both their meals, even if he was vaguely aware of the alpha that was giving him a sharp glare - One that would be threatening if his alpha even ever felt like existing around Mydei as a competitor.

No. He had come to accept his secondary gender did not view Mydei as any type of competitor for mates or territory, no. Mydei was someone he viewed as a potential mate as his core, embarrassingly. Even more embarrassing was now Mydei knew that. Somewhat. He hadn’t confessed how good Mydei’s pheromones were to him; Something that made him borderline delirious.

“It’s raining.” Mydei, the star of Phainon’s thoughts murmured. His gaze focused squarely outside the restaurant as his arms were crossed over his chest - A pose he seemed rather fond of, Phainon was realizing. Phainon after handing over his money and accepting his change moved to join Mydei, looking out into the dreary cold rain.

“Don’t suppose you hid an umbrella in your turtleneck?” Phainon asked jokingly, something that earned a small smirk from Mydei. “Sounds rather uncomfortable.” Was Mydei’s curt answer.

“Hmm.. How long is your walk home from here?” Phainon asked, his own apartment was about a five minute walk, faster if he ran through the rain. Mydei at that, seemed to scowl at the thought. Something that gave Phainon slight insight that it was surely a much longer journey than Phainon’s. 

“About twenty minutes. Maybe ten if I sprint.” Mydei mused with an almost annoyed harrumph added to the end, giving a sigh. “You?”

Phainon stared out into the dark rain, blinking for a moment before he looked to Mydei, the grumpy man was already scowling and for once Phainon felt like it wasn’t quite directed at him. “About a five minute walk. Who knows if I sprinted.. Never tried to just sprint home.” Phainon slid his focus back to the outside world, rather content with waiting in the doorway of the restaurant for now, even as he thought that, his mouth moved on its own; “Want to go to my place and wait for the rain to settle? Or borrow an umbrella?”

Mydei didn’t answer, he was remarkably silent over the question. Something that made Phainon look at him again searchingly, only Mydei was staring at him with knitted brows. An indecipherable expression written on his face. “What?” What all Phainon managed to ask, confused by the reaction from Mydei.

“You say you have a crush on me and then want to take me home? I don’t have sex on the first date,” Mydei paused, “Especially not with other alphas.” 

Phainon gave a laugh at that, tossing him a genuine smile, “I didn’t mean it like that, alright? I meant no harm.” Phainon paused for a heartbeat, moving his attention back to the rain that didn’t seem to slow even as night began to fall. He had to bite the question on his mind back ‘have you ever tried love with another alpha?’ and instead opted to be more normal; “The two alphas things makes it harmless, doesn’t it?”

Blue eyes moved to meet unconvinced golden ones, Mydei seemed wholly still unsure of his options. His eyes slid to the rain outside before he gave way to a sigh, obviously defeated. “Alright. We’re sprinting to your house. Lead the way.” 

Phainon nodded at those words before moving in front of Mydei and stepping under the awning, the last lifeline before they were going to be drenched. Mydei followed suit, only giving him a small bow and moving his hands before him; “After you.. I don’t know where the hell you live..”

──────────────

Mydei was breathless by the time they reached Phainon’s apartment and entered the building, drenched, but it was much closer than Mydei’s by far. His lungs screamed at him over the chilly wet air being harshly sucked in, only sighing out of slight relief as they were now safe from the rain. The breath of air didn’t last long before Phainon was gently nudging him, his voice coming out somewhat breathy and airy, “This way to the elevator.”

He spoke, but was already leading Mydei anyways, who was obediently following while still trying to catch his breath. Somewhat aware of how heavily his hair was sticking to his face and neck. A true downside of long hair, meanwhile he couldn’t help but cast a glare of sheer annoyance at how Phainon’s hair seemed almost hydrophobic, almost dry already.

Phainon led him down a corridor before stopping at the elevator and clicking the bottom. Silence falling between them. Probably out of lack of air as they both walked into the elevator. 

Phainon was beyond strange to Mydei, even ignoring the events of today and Phainon’s alleged ‘confession’ (Something Mydei didn’t quite buy into), he was strange. Not for anything he did specifically, but the fact Mydei’s instincts never took any of it as a challenge. He never felt his secondary gender riling up over Phainon’s pheromones, even if they became heavy in the air with Phainon’s mood swings regarding Mydei. 

Phainon’s scent wasn’t really displeasing to Mydei either, it was heavy wooded, sure, but the underlying smell of vanilla that peaked through wasn’t a horrible combination he found. It mainly only irked him due to knowing it was Phainon pissed off at Mydei - Over nothing. Even when he was forced with the brunt of Phainon’s pheromones suffocating him, he never found his inner alpha yelling to challenge that flaunting of scents.

Strange. 

The elevator ride was wordless, like both had things to focus on in their own minds. As the door opened to release them both, Phainon continued to lead the way, stopping in front of a door with a dog themed door swag. A decoration that made Mydei bite his tongue to withhold his mocking laugh he felt rising in his chest as Phainon fished out his keys. 

Phainon unlocked the door and walked in, holding the door open for Mydei, who then could only stand in his apartment dumbly. The apartment was not lit, something Phainon moved to change behind him as he shut the door and locked it back. Mydei blinked as his eyes adjusted to the dim lighting.

“Make yourself at home,” Phainon walked past him, pausing for a moment to turn and give Mydei a once-over up and down rather obviously, “I don’t know if I have any clothes that would fit you that you can borrow..” 

Mydei could only scoff at those words; “Tightness around my chest doesn’t matter, if that’s your concern.”

Phainon met his gaze and nodded, rather slowly. As if he still had something he wanted to say but couldn’t quite figure it out. “Alright.. I’ll.. Go look for something you can wear to dry off in.” Was all he slowly offered, still walking away, leaving a still standing in the entryway soaked Mydei. 

Mydei wasn’t quite sure what he was supposed to do now. He was dripping wet, still had his shoes on, and didn’t want to drag water all throughout Phainon’s apartment. A piece of him felt as though he should just leave, he was already soaked. What’s the harm in just running home? More wetness? Think the capacity is already reached here..

As if sensing Mydei’s unsteadiness, Phainon’s head appeared out of the room he had entered. “I meant it when I said make yourself at home you know.. A little water won’t hurt anything.” With those words the head disappeared again, Mydei found himself still standing on the little part of hardwood flooring before the carpet - Scowling after the man. 

“I don’t want to pry.” Mydei simply said dully, still keeping his head trained to focus on anything but Phainon’s living space. He barely knew the man - Regardless of how strange he was and his equally bizarre confession. Even though it was said softly, more so for Mydei himself, Phainon seemed to have caught onto it. “Pry away!” Was the dumbass reply that man gave Mydei. Something that drew a sigh out of Mydei deeply. 

“I don’t want my scent to get all over your home.” Mydei said darkly, the idea of accidentally scenting another alpha’s home made him feel a sense of dread. It was basically like declaring war, something Mydei really would like to avoid. Not with just Phainon, but with anyone. He couldn’t be arsed to give a shit about territories, it was a waste of time.

Phainon fell into silence for a bit, still seeming to be looking for clothes for Mydei if he had to guess. Mydei was only vaguely aware of the chill seeping from his clothes and into his skin with the wetness now. He really hadn’t thought this out enough. He should not have been willing to come into another alpha’s home like this, he felt intensely uncomfortable. Mydei moved a hand to wipe some of his soaked bangs across his forehead to the side with a sigh as a drop slid down his face.

Phainon finally exited the room, pausing as he was met with the sight of Mydei still in the entrance. He blinked for a few moments, before giving a sheepish laugh as he moved to close the distance, “You can borrow these, they might be tight. Sorry.” Phainon’s arms extended with the clothes. A blue t-shirt and gray sweatpants. Probably the only thing he could figure would fit Mydei’s muscular build compared to his own. 

“Right..” Mydei spoke as he took the clothes, only barely registering how Phainon seemed amused by him still standing there. 

“The bathroom is the second door on the left, unless you intend to undress right here?” Phainon spoke rather softly, something that pricked at Mydei’s skin as he shot a glare to the other alpha. 

“.. I’ll change in the bathroom.” Mydei didn’t need much more convincing as he paused to take off his shoes at the doorway of Phainon’s apartment, unlike the owner of the apartment. He wasn’t an animal, unlike Phainon. He proceeded to brush past Phainon who gave a warm chuckle, clearly finding it funny how quickly Mydei rethought his no entry policy that was happening just then.

Mydei entered the bathroom and locked it behind him, finding the light after a moment to flick it on. His eyes readjusted quickly and he could only blink at himself in the mirror - He really did look like a soaked pathetic cat. His hair clung against his skin for dear life, acting as though it would never dry again, meanwhile his clothes were really not leaving anything about him hidden. 

The bathroom itself, however, was shockingly nice and well kept care of. Mydei glanced around it, taking note of how clean it was, contrary to most unmated alphas he had met and gleaned their lifestyles. Mydei didn’t look too much, he still didn’t want to pry, focusing instead of peeling off his soggy drenched clothing and swapping it for the new dry clothes. 

The shirt, was infact, rather tight, squeezing so. He looked in the mirror at it and furrowed his brows. He had never quite focused solely on how much bigger he was in comparison to Phainon, but now it felt almost mortifying to consider how much mass his muscles took. 

He found himself pausing, however, over the fact Phainon had given him boxers to borrow.

Mydei blinked at them, the idea of sharing boxers with another person, let alone an alpha made him almost tilt his head and reconsider how he ended up here yet again. Mydei now had two options here, refuse, and be soaked on his lower half still, completely wasting the pants Phainon had offered him. Wear the boxers and shed his own, which was just embarrassing to consider. 

Mydei sighed, removing his own boxers after a few more brief seconds. 

Once that was said and done, all he could do for his hair was attempt to strain it over Phainon’s sink before putting it up a bit messily. Something he stared at before moving to braid it instead, not something he did often anymore, but still a well practiced hairstyle for him. Once he was done there, he fished for his phone to make sure the water hadn’t completely ruined it. That was sorted as well. 

Mydei gave a nod to himself as the phone clicked on without issue, folding his clothes, and left the bathroom. Only to hesitate over his next actions. His horrible, dreadful, betraying first thought was wondering where Phainon had gone. Only to almost jolt out of his skin as Phainon appeared at his side silently, seeming to ignore the shock Mydei had as he pointed at the clothes Mydei was holding. “Want me to wash and dry those and give them back to you?”

Mydei moved his eyes to focus on Phainon for a brief moment, feeling a slight flush rising to his cheeks over what all that entailed. “.. I refuse to have another grown alpha doing my laundry.” Phainon only blinked slowly at him, before giving a small nod. “Alright.”

Phainon turned away at that, waving Mydei to follow him, “I have a guest bedroom if you want to stay the night. I looked up the weather, it’s not good!” Phainon gave a laugh as he said the last part, before looking over his shoulder at Mydei following him in silence. “It’s supposed to flood, so I really recommend using it.”

Mydei found himself pausing as Phainon had led him to the guest bedroom, something he hadn’t even agreed to yet. Mydei sent a questioning gaze to Phainon over it, who didn’t seem to pay it any mind as he shrugged; “It’s not much, but I couldn’t find a smaller apartment for less, somehow.” Mydei gave a sigh at Phainon’s confused thought process, Mydei was not questioning the damn room or price.

“Thanks.” Was all Mydei offered instead, still holding his clothes as he now had entered the room, standing in it blankly. He really had never gone over to sleepovers - Let alone adult sleepovers. The hell was he supposed to say? Phainon however, tilted his head, “You can put your clothes down, you know? I’m not bothered by you getting stuff wet..” Phainon gave another laugh as if he found Mydei’s rigidness amusing.

Phainon gave a hum once his laughter had ceased, “I’m still in my wet clothes too, afterall. You sure you don’t want me to throw them into the washer and dryer for you?”

“I’m sure.”

Phainon gave a small nod, hesitating before continuing “I’m going to go.. Get dressed myself, please do actually make yourself at home, Mydei. You seem like a terrified stray kitten ..”

Mydei felt himself scoff at the analogy, but bit back any of his retorts that he could make. Because he was. He was in fact acting like he was a terrified creature. Nothing about this situation made any sense to him. He shouldn’t be able to stand so calmly in an alpha’s home, he shouldn’t be able to be smelling Phainon’s scent and have zero desire to challenge it.

He didn’t understand himself or Phainon recently. Everything about the situation was going against everything his secondary gender had taught him to be natural.

Instead of trying to understand, he instead moved to focus on what he could manage to grasp. His own surroundings. Phainon’s guest bedroom, apparently. It was sparse, clearly a spare bedroom from the lack of photos or well, any decorations that made it feel lived in. The walls were pure white, the bed had a royal blue bedspread, and the wooden nightstand and dresser were both white as well. 

Mydei moved to the dresser in question, placing his still wet clothes on it almost in pain. He felt like he was intruding, and leaving a mess as he went, absolutely harrowing. 

He was only halfway aware of how tired he felt, maybe it was due to the rain and the sprint after food - But the fatigue was creeping into his joints with every movement. Even more so as he plucked his phone from atop the clothes pile and sat at the edge of the bed, clicking it on and typing in his passcode. 

Mydei was a somewhat trusting person about simple things like this, but he was still curious himself as he thumbed open the weather app. A screen that brought a sigh to pass through his lips as he laid backwards onto the bed with a flop. Phainon had indeed not been lying, he conceded as his eyes moved to the clock on his phone. Was nine pm too early to sleep? 

Mydei almost felt like he would say yes, if not for the way the bed was rather soft and welcoming. And Mydei, arguably, was exhausted mentally and physically from today. He almost moved to text Phainon that he was just going to go to bed here, but Mydei paused, realizing that he could just say it to him. But also, he just didn’t have Phainon’s phone number anyways.

So he sat up, readying himself to stand as he dropped his phone to the side allowing it to fall onto the welcoming bed. His thoughts of getting up to seek out Phainon were cut short as Phainon found him instead, standing in the doorway. Mydei met his gaze blankly, “I’m glad you aren’t just standing around anymore.” Phainon said as a smile broke on his face, one that was always somewhat curious to Mydei. How he could so boldly smile and nod to a man - An alpha at that - Like Mydei was lost on him. Did Phainon really lack the sense of challenge just like Mydei did regarding the other? Why?

“I’m quite tired, I’ll probably pass out here soon.” Mydei paused, studying the slight flicker of Phainon’s expression. Something that very briefly had wavered in his smile and eyes, something Mydei could only draw parallels to worry. “If that’s still fine wit-”

“Yes.” Phainon cut him off rather quickly before clearing his throat with a small cough, “Do whatever you need or want to. My home is your home.. Anyways, I hope you rest well, Mydei.” Mydei could only offer a small nod, watching as Phainon closed the guest bedroom door gently. Leaving Mydei’s gaze fixed on the door where Phainon had originally been. 

While the.. Rather polite sentiments were nice, Mydei did not share them at all. Everything smelled like Phainon. This was clearly all marked, scented, made to be known it all belonged to him. Even in the spare room the scent seemed to linger within it, just from a near proxy of being lived in by the alpha. 

Mydei fell backwards on the bed again, vaguely aware of the sticky wetness of his hair still clamping onto his skin as he did so, his legs dangling off the side again. How the hell did the day turn out like this?

──────────────

“Mydei..?” 

The voice calling to him was soft, as if almost frightened, distant.

 “Mydei?” 

The man in question rolled onto his back off his side at that, as if trying to move away from the voice attempting to rouse him. He lowered his arm that had been slung over his head in his sleep as he slowly blinked his eyes open, adjusting to the dimly lit room he was in. The unfamiliar bed, the unfamiliar walls and ceiling, he could only manage to blink a few more times before turning his head slightly to glance at the other alpha trying to stir him into wakefulness. Something that Mydei also was attempting to complete as he attempted to blink his sleep away.

“Did you forget to turn your alarm on..? Or do you just get up later?” The voice was still rather quiet, as if he was trying to be soothing as he spoke to Mydei.

Mydei took a moment to register the question silently, blinking at the white haired man before moving an arm to fumble about for his phone at the side of the borrowed pillow - The place where he always put it when he slept. Clicking it on to stare at the time numbly. 6:23. Mydei stared at the numbers for a moment more before clicking off his phone and tossing it to his side again. Only to press the palms of his hands against his face before giving way to a deep guttural groan. 

The other man in the room remained quiet - Motionless at this.

“I forgot.” Mydei finally mumbled the confession, his voice raspy from sleep and lack of use before he gave way to another yawn, slightly miffed at himself over it as he lowered his hands to cut a glance to Phainon again. Phainon had a small smile on his lips, an expression that seemed rather intensely soft and kind for an alpha that was staring down another alpha invading his living space. Mydei willing himself to sit up at that, only somewhat aware of the cold air touching his skin with the lack of blanket on him as he did.

“I understand. I have to go on ahead, I need to walk the dogs before we open. I’ll leave my spare key with you so you can lock the door once you leave.” Phainon paused his quiet ramblings for a brief second, his eyes flickering with an indecipherable emotion as he studied Mydei slightly, “I left some clothes in the bathroom as well, if you wanted to change into something that might fit you better.”

Mydei at that, still desiring to go back to bed offering a small hum of acknowledgement before moving a hand to run it through his hair, as if that would help him try to solve how ruffled and fluffed up it was. Going to bed with his hair wet was a mistake, trying to rein in his mane would be a sore issue this morning..

Phainon seemed keen on watching that movement to the most miniscule bit, even if Mydei had no idea of it as he had already tiredly resumed resting his eyes for a moment while sitting up. “Feel free to borrow anything you need, Mydei. Be it food, coffee, or just anything to begin your day with.. I’ll be off now.”

“Mm.. See you later, Phainon. .” Mydei was only halfway aware of how bad his voice must sound, only partially aware of a dull ache in the back of it. Phainon at those words froze, tensing up slightly. That growing familiar scent seemed to thicken now, something that made Mydei grip onto his consciousness quickly. Phainon’s annoyed scent. 

Mydei could only bring himself to scowl at Phainon, if he was going to be annoyed over Mydei stinking up his spare room he could have already left the room by now. Mydei gave way to a deep sigh out of pure frustration over this alpha that just couldn’t seem to make up his mind.

“Do you want me to wash the sheets and pillow for you?” Mydei asked, still fighting his own encroaching sleepiness as he spoke his words groggily. Phainon stood up a bit stiffer at that, “What? I can handle that.. You’re my guest, it's alright.” His soft yet slightly shocked voice was horribly betrayed by that scent he was not permeating the room with.  

Mydei removed his gaze from the man, finding he only grew more annoyed the longer he attempted to figure out any logic regarding Phainon’s behavior. Mydei didn’t have it in him to fight him on the matter anyways. “Okay.” Was all he offered instead, not finding it within him this early in the morning to argue with how dumb Phainon was constantly acting.

Phainon nodded in the corner of Mydei’s eye before walking past, “See you at work, don’t be late, sleepy head.” Phainon kept the same soft tone, soothing, kind, as if trying to be as gentle as possible. Effort that was wasted on a fellow alpha like Mydei who only stared at him rather incredulously over the nickname used for him there.

Phainon left the room without another word, yet left the door open, and Mydei found himself only keenly listening to see if he would truly leave Mydei alone in his home unattended. His complete bafflement came when he heard the front door open, and close. 

Mydei was left in the silence of Phainon’s home, the more awake he became, the more aware of just how invasive he felt over this. He was sitting in Phainon’s home, leaving his scent everywhere, surely the man would see it as a threat of some kind if he actually listened and didn’t wash it. But did he also want to use the man’s washer and dryer? Mydei moved to cover his face again, the situation was beyond frustrating. 

The other question on his mind was when had he shed his borrowed shirt in the night? He was attempting not to do that, but apparently in his sleep he most likely got frustrated with the snugness and removed it. He gave way to a deep sigh, one that was only mounting up more before he began to search the bed for it. 

Sure, Phainon had said he got more ‘better fitting’ clothes for him, but it’s not like he just wanted to leave the room messy anyways. Not when it had been so pristine at the beginning. Once he had located the shirt, he removed himself from the warmth of the bed, attempted to copy how the bed was made, and took his phone with him along with the shirt into Phainon’s bathroom. 

Mydei found himself staring at what was left out for him, a disposable toothbrush still in the plastic wrapping was baffling - Phainon must actually have guests over all the time. It wasn’t so far-fetched to believe an alpha with his good looks and puppy attitude didn’t have betas and omegas flocking to his bedroom doors. The key that was left beside it was what Mydei stared at for a brief moment - Something Phainon probably didn’t want him to have but no other choice since he was still in here.

Mydei felt himself scoffing as his gaze moved to the mirror. His hair was beyond rowdy from going to bed with it almost soaked, it seemed to be attempting to go anywhere but where it normally laid. Mydei would have to braid it like he used to, somewhat glad he at least kept his ponytail holder on his wrist, a hand moved to rub the wrist absentmindedly. Suddenly recalling how tightly Phainon had grabbed onto him. 

Mydei couldn’t puzzle it out. Why hadn’t Phainon just let him go? The excuse about having a crush on him was beyond bizarre, but if he had just let him go home he could have spent a long night with Castorice instead of an alpha stinking up his guest room all night. Smelling Mydei all night in his home probably had Phainon frustrated to hell - Mydei couldn’t quite blame him for immediately trying to protectively cover the scent of Mydei in the guest bedroom.

He discarded the thoughts - It didn’t matter, he would leave and Phainon after work could attempt to get rid of the scents all he wanted. Mydei would do his best not to trouble the man like this ever again, anyways. Mydei himself had been attempting to disregard how much everything smelled like Phainon. A scent that Mydei knew to usually address alongside annoyance over Mydei’s existence, an emotion lacking when it was simply lingering in Phainon’s home.

Mydei moved his attention to putting on the black shirt Phainon had left out for him, only keenly feeling his mind itch slightly over how deeply rooted this shirt did smell like Phainon. Once he popped it on over his head and wormed into the sleeves, he blinked at the mirror. A finger moved to the collar to drag it down a little. A v-neck? Mydei didn’t take Phainon as the type of person to wear things like that, but he supposed he did know nothing about how the man dressed for dates and what-not. 

At the very least it was less tight on Mydei’s chest, the short sleeves were fighting for their lives against the strain up his biceps. That was fine at least, the low cut of the v-neck was more awkward due to the difference in size between him and Phainon. Mydei opted to ignore it, continuing moving to braiding his hair neatly before focusing on brushing his teeth - Something he felt extremely weird about and grimaced as he realized he had forgotten to last night.

His eyes flicked to his phone - If he had been at his house he would have been late, but thanks to Phainon’s home being closer.. It was fine. He decided to forego snooping Phainon’s kitchen at all, disregarding his words of food or coffee and instead looked for the garbage can. Pausing for a moment as he looked at the toothbrush in his hand he had every intention of getting rid of for Phainon. 

He probably should just throw it away somewhere outside since his scent would be drenched all over it, huh? Mydei agreed with himself over the thought before moving to the exit, making sure to lock the top lock before bending down to slide the key under the door for Phainon. Something told him if he tried to return it to him at work he would decline politely and force himself to lie to Mydei over it. 

Mydei could only grimace at the idea of it. 

Such an extremely strange alpha.

──────────────

Work had been horribly uneventful; If you could throw away the fact Phainon could only think about the way Mydei had acted this morning. It was a level of vulnerability that Phainon felt graced by the Gods to be privy to this one time. It was also eternal damnation as he realized how irrefutably infatuated with Mydei he was. 

Mydei had so accidentally driven Phainon up the walls - Absolutely mad with how endearing he was trying to wake up. Phainon hadn’t intended to wake him up, he hadn’t! Mydei was a grown man, but as the minutes ticked past with no sign of any life from the guest bedroom - He had no choice but to intervene. Phainon knew based on the run time Mydei had said last night that if Mydei was at his house, he would have been running late.  Phainon also didn't expect to find Mydei now shirtless, leaving nothing to Phainon's imagination as he had fought against tracing those tatooes with his eyes across Mydei's toned chest.

He gave a sigh at the memory, the way his entire skin had broken into goosebumps over Mydei merely saying his name with a layer of sleep slurring his words slightly. Something that for once seemed to trigger Phainon’s alpha in a different sense than just over Mydei’s own intoxicating smell. Not to protect his territory, not to fight Mydei as another alpha. No. He wanted to tuck Mydei back into bed, he wanted to tell Mydei to rest well as Phainon pressed his mouth into the man’s neck inhaling his scent deeply, he wanted to provide for Mydei and keep him safe - Locked away for his eyes only. 

Phainon was beyond shameful as he thought more on it, unlocking his apartment dully, taking note there would be a rather significant lack of Mydei in there today. Well. The man himself. When Phainon opened his door he hesitated, immediately picking up Mydei’s still lingering smell.  His workday had been a lingering blur of thoughts of Mydei, the man in the back handling the cat area with Aglaea that day. And now the thoughts of  him seemed to haunt Phainon all the way home. 

Phainon closed his door behind him, feeling his heart lurch slightly as he looked down to take his shoes off - Seeing his spare key on the floor. He gave an exasperated exhale, he supposed he should have expected Mydei to be overly polite like that. Even if Phainon desperately wanted him to keep the spare key. 

Phainon picked up the key and moved to remove his shoes - Something he had neglected to do last night in his hurry to attend to the soaked cat named Mydei. Now with a horrible lack of his soaked cat, he moved to his bedroom before crashing into his bed, only to stare at the ceiling, the faintest scent of Mydei still lingering through the air teasingly.

How the hell was he supposed to be normal around that man? He was struggling beyond belief; Even their goodbyes at closing were awkward. Phainon rolled to his side on the bed, curling into himself. He had never found romance interesting, never sought anyone out, hell, he wasn’t even sure if he could recall having his first kiss. All of it felt wasted on him. And now he was a complete and utter mess over another alpha who clearly didn’t take his confession seriously. 

Phainon sat up without much thought, his feet moving on his own to the guest bedroom. It wasn’t a room that was ever used - Phainon didn’t like having guests over normally. They were too much of a hassle, and people would talk if you had betas and omegas over constantly. Even if nothing happened, it's not like people would believe you. 

As he flicked on the bedroom light he felt himself go taut as a bowstring. The familiar enchanting smell of Mydei was so heavy in the air here, Phainon had meant to wash the sheets, but found himself frozen in debate if he truly wanted that smell to leave his home. Phainon looked at the dresser, blinking slowly for a moment as he registered the folded stack of clothes on it. Mydei’s clothes that had got soaked in the rain and changed out of. He had forgotten them..?

Phainon ghosted his way to the dresser, picking up the clothes almost delicately - Vividly aware of how thick Mydei’s scent was lingering on them. His rational self told him to take them and wash them, to be kind and give them clean and dried back to Mydei the next shift they had together. Phainon, however, felt himself lose versus his unreasonable self as he instead took Mydei’s clothes and fell into the guest bed.

The bed that also smelled deeply of Mydei.

Phainon couldn’t help himself as he pressed that black turtleneck against his nose, it wasn’t quite just Mydei on it. It was the distant rain that clung to it mixed with Mydei’s scent of maple and hints of strawberries that clung to him. Addicting. Too addicting, Phainon found as he rubbed his head into the pillow. The pillow also had the touch of rain brewed into Mydei’s pheromones, most likely from his wet hair, but it was so intoxicatingly Mydei..

“The good news is Mydei is sick today,” Phainon’s head jerked up at that, his pen almost marking a straight line of ink across the page, “He’s sick ? Also how is that good news?!” Both questions tumbled out of the white haired man’s lips, the quickness of it made Aglaea shoot him a pointed glare over the desk.

“It’s good news because it means you won’t be releasing so many protective pheromones every time he’s near..” Castorice was the one to give an answer instead, shaking her head as she walked past where Phainon was sitting, who only threw her an incredulous look. Aglaea seemed to agree with this, nodding silently as she moved about.

“So, I will be handling the kitchen and the cat area for today,” Aglaea paused for a moment before she was about to pass the desk, her sharpened gaze falling on Phainon - Almost accusatorily. Phainon gave her a pouty stare in return, one that Aglaea rolled her eyes over, fully knowing he wanted to ask about Mydei. “Don’t know what he’s sick with. Maybe don’t make your cat boyfriend run through the rain next time.”

Phainon clicked his tongue at that, but he couldn’t deny that Mydei had sounded more raspy than normal after that. Almost like going to bed with your hair wet was normalized as a negative thing to do. It wasn’t Phainon’s fault! He had said Mydei could make himself at home and he had fully meant those words! Hell, Mydei could have snuggled with Phainon for warmth in his own bed that night and Phainon wouldn’t have fought against it.

Phainon’s hand twitched at the thought before he distractedly moved to tap the end of his pen on the documents he was going over. “I didn’t mean to.” Phainon offered almost feebly, knitting his brows in concentration to stare at the papers of veterinarian documents in front of him. “Should I give him apology soup?” A joke, more than anything, one that Castorice from across the room snorted at loudly.

“Not if you’re making it.”

“Hey! I never said that. I’d order some from somewhere.. If I knew what soup he liked..” Phainon attempted to snap back, only quieting down a bit when he felt a bit silly realizing he really didn’t know much about Mydei ashamedly. He knew barely even the barebones about him; He was good at cooking, had a slight temper, reserved, and loved cats. Great . And Phainon was already tripping over him like a lovesick buffoon. 

“Want his phone number to ask him yourself?” The question asked by Aglaea made all of Phainon’s previous worries fly out the window. To hell and back if he knew nothing about Mydei, he had plenty of time to learn! “It’d be nice of you since it’s the start of the weekend.” She mused onwards, humming in thought seemingly over how it was friday.

“You’d really give me his phone number?” Aglaea moved over to the desk, looking at the man who was now flabbergasted, his words were quiet, more like a plea than a question. “Phone.” She demanded with a hand outstretched over the desk. Phainon didn’t even think twice before scrambling to get it from his pocket and typing in his passcode, handing it to her. Phainon took his phone gingerly, typing for a moment in silence before handing it back. Almost, she snatched her hand backwards to cut a glare at him, jokingly, almost. “Make you still do your work, even with this power, alright?” 

Phainon mustered up his biggest puppy-esque pout face he could possibly manage; “When do I not?”

Apparently the wrong choice of words as that glare only narrowed, squinting at him, her voice thin and clipped. “Everytime Mydei is involved, actually.” Phainon could only offer a sheepish laugh at that as he raised a hand to rub nervously at the back of his neck. She kind of was right, anyways. Thankfully, she relented his phone back to him after that.

Aglaea shook her head as she watched him quickly move to investigate his own damned phone, “I know we’re not open yet, but try to save the flirting for after work hours.” Phainon gave a small hum in reply, and even he didn’t know if it was out of agreement or just acknowledging her words. 

Phainon hurriedly unlocked it to see that there was in fact a new added contact in his phone under the name ‘Mydei’. Phainon sucked in a tight breath of air as he tapped to open a new empty text window. 

Phainon; hihi!! its phainon! I hear youre sick.. do u want some delivery soup when im off shift
Phainon; or lunchtime i could run some by

Phainon put his phone down at that, hoping that Mydei had slipped off into a restful sleep after telling Aglaea he wasn’t coming in today. Hopefully. That was for the best for him after all. Phainon tried to push the all encompassing thoughts of Mydei out of his head - Trying to focus on looking over all the dog’s vaccinations and making sure everyone was up to date. He was really trying to not think about Mydei! He was! But his phone vibrating a few minutes later didn’t help his case as he flicked her eyes to the screen to see ‘Mydei’ on the notifications.

Phainon blinked at it for a moment before picking up his phone to unlock it and look at whatever Mydei had replied with. 

Mydei; Phainon? I’m alright. I don’t need more poison.

Phainon plucked those off rather easily and put them on the floor beside Mydei’s bed. A noise that earned a weird hissing sound from Mydei, one that Phainon couldn’t quite decipher the emotion of. 

Phainon moved to grab the blanket to tuck in Mydei - More So to be annoying than the actual act of it now that he knew Mydei was awake. He paused however as he moved it on top of the motionless Mydei.

“Mydei,” Phainon started slowly, blinking into the dark room as he could barely focus on the man who was propped up on a pillow exactly where Phainon had laid him gently. “Can I do something to you? Just this once?”

The silence of the room felt suffocating for a few seconds before Mydei heaved out a tired sigh, “You brought me my favorite cheesecake, it’s only fair for this one time. What is it?”

Phainon didn’t answer that, instead moving closer to Mydei, bending a bit as he focused on the man. Even in the dark those fierce amber eyes were piercing, Phainon had trained himself by now to ignore that however as he moved a hand to Mydei’s neck. 

Slowly finding the crook of Mydei’s neck, pushing Mydei’s shirt down just a tiny bit and gently rubbing his wrist against the skin there, his boldness today outweighed his better judgement it seemed. Only vaguely aware of the way Mydei’s eyes went into shock over the action and mouth had fallen agape, or the way his body had gone rigid over the action. 

Phainon didn’t stop at that reaction though, continuing his scenting of Mydei while he still had pushed over this boundary like the dog he was. A piece of Phainon was purring in satisfaction over it, the mingling of their two scents on Mydei’s body in such a well guarded location..

“You..” Mydei’s rough voice spoke hoarsely, something that Phainon gave a nervous laugh over as he removed his hand from Mydei’s neck.

“Sorry sorry, hope you rest well!” Phainon spoke softly, as if he was trying to coax a feral cat into trusting him. Maybe he was! “I’ll put up the cheesecake for you.” Phainon kept his wide smile on his lips, maybe not for Mydei’s sake in the dim lighting, but for his own. His own selfishness of boldly seeking to scent Mydei and being allowed to do so, the lack of fight Mydei had put up made Phainon’s heart rise to his throat.

But Phainon guessed there was always a thing as a late reaction as he turned away and moved to leave the room, only to feel his breath leave him as a tight grip found it’s around his waist. Phainon could only gasp as his back slammed into the mattress, a significant lack of Mydei there as the other alpha now loomed above him - Arms caging Phainon beneath him by placing both hands beside Phainon's head on the bed. Phainon dared not to even allow himself to think about the way Mydei’s legs were pressed against his own for his own ever thinning sanity to stay intact. He'd allow that to shatter when he got home, at least!

Phainon blinked a few times, staring upwards at the rather angry appearing Mydei. Now that Phainon could see Mydei’s face a bit more - A mix of light and his eyes adjusting to the dimness of the room - He could clearly tell the man appeared almost flustered. Mydei’s slight snarl however, did not match the emotion causing the red hue bleeding into the tips of his ears.

“You scented me.” The accusation was barely above his snarled tone, Phainon felt the sentence sounded more confused and a question than a statement. 

Phainon could only stare upwards into golden eyes that was searching his own for answers, the way Mydei’s hair cascaded a bit downwards, the way those locks of hair curled into red beautifully. Everything about Mydei made Phainon’s breath hitch to where he could only offer a shallow and brittle pained laugh before speaking.

“I did.” 

Phainon had already pushed his luck, so he dared to push it further. What did he have to lose? Mydei’s pheromones were overriding all his logic at this point, the sickly sweet of it was demolishing him. How was he supposed to stay focused and act normal when Mydei was quite literally on top of him and Phainon was lying where it would smell the most like Mydei possible. This was heaven, he had found the golden gates already.. They were simply Mydei’s glaring eyes. 

Phainon tilted his head slightly against the bedding he was pressed into. It wasn’t like Mydei was holding him down, but Phainon wasn’t going to fight it if Mydei wanted him in his bed either, so it didn’t actually matter if Mydei used force to hold him or not. He’d stay right where Mydei preferred him to be.

Mydei’s face over that reply seemed to flicker in between emotions that Phainon couldn’t quite decipher before he seemed to land on donning confusion, “Why?” The question was said extremely softly, like Mydei didn’t quite have a grasp on reality at hand. Maybe he didn’t, Phainon couldn’t say.

“Aren’t alphas supposed to be protective of their loved ones?” Phainon’s reply was a tease, he gave a small laugh along with it but watched rather nervously as Mydei’s jaw seemed to tighten over that.

Phainon wished Mydei wasn’t sick right now, wished he wasn’t feeling any ounce of unhealthiness. Wished that his voice wasn’t low and raspy, giving a horribly seductive tone to all of his spoken words. “Loved ones?” 

Mydei eyes seemed to move about Phainon’s face searchingly, his brows becoming knitted in the dark lighting before he gave a small huffing noise. One that Phainon didn’t know if it was in annoyance or sheer exasperation over the situation. “You are an idiot.”

Phainon could only give a weak smile at that, “You can scent me back, if you want. But I think being pressed into your bed already did that enough.”

Mydei was silent at that, searching Phainon’s face with those words before effortlessly pushing away from the other alpha and onto the other half of his bed. Giving a rather obnoxiously loud sigh as he moved his hands to cradle his own head. “I have such a headache. Go home .” His tone was coarse, more tired sounding than anything else as he spat out the words. 

Phainon moved in the rather soft sheets, turning ever-so-slightly to look at Mydei who now was curling in on himself. Phainon debated saying something, but the sense of encroaching dread told him not to. 

He instead opted to leave the room without another word, shutting the door softly behind him. Phainon couldn’t risk taking a last look at the man, he had bigger plans as he immediately had to grapple with the fact that he probably had just hurdled himself leaps and bounds across every boundary Mydei had ever set. Phainon moved away from Mydei’s bedroom door, instead hustling a bit into the kitchen.

Phainon debated washing the dishes for Mydei - But the rational part of Phainon screamed that he was overstaying his welcome by miles. Instead simply moving the dirty dishes Mydei had used into his sink, praying the man wasn’t angry over dirty dishes in there. Before he moved to glance at the spare fork and plate Mydei had obtained for Phainon.

Phainon gave a sigh before he moved to copy where he had seen Mydei looking through drawers, placing the clean fork up neatly with the other utensils Mydei kept in the one closest to his fridge apparently. The plate? Phainon blinked as he looked around the kitchen, before rolling his shoulders. He had just scented the man, going through his kitchen cabinets was probably one of his lesser offenses of the night. 

Once that was settled, he removed the dirty knife from the cheesecake platter and added it to the dirty dishes in the sink - Once again mentally pleading that Mydei would be fine with such an affront to his clean kitchen. Phainon thought putting the cheesecake up would be easy! He was wrong, he could only blink over how well stocked Mydei’s fridge was. Clearly, not a fan of eating out it seemed. 

Phainon didn't mean to go through his things - Really! But he couldn’t help it.. It was right there!

The first thing that made Phainon blink was the amount of condiments the man owned, but perhaps that was the difference between being a cook and burning everything you touched.. Phainon wheezed out a sigh, trying his best not to snoop as he pushed a few bottled drinks to the side. Mainly taking note of how many sports drinks the man actually owned as he made enough room for the cheesecake. Sliding it snuggly in and shutting the fridge with a deep sigh. Phainon stepped away silently, giving the kitchen a once over before deciding it was clean enough before fishing out his phone from his pocket.

Phainon; dont fire me but i think mydei may want me dead and hate me forever and ever

Aglaea; What did you do? Wasn’t he just asleep?

Phainon; i fought my inner demons and they won so bad

Aglaea; What does that entail, exactly?

Phainon; its so over. I did something so dumb.

Aglaea; Phainon, I am not solving your riddles three. Use your words.

Phainon stared at the text before coming to terms with the fact that he had no idea how to explain what he had just done to Mydei. He slowly clicked off his phone at that before turning off the kitchen light and moving quickly to leave the apartment, pausing in front of Mydei’s bedroom door before sighing inaudibly. Shoo’ing himself to leave the apartment with his better judgement and last shreds of dignity intact, and to just leave the poor sick man alone.

──────────────

Mydei finally sat up in his bed once he heard the distant click of his front door - Securing that he was alone once again in his own home. 

Even as he sat in the now very dark room, he fumbled a bit looking for his phone before slamming into his bed again. His mind was blank. Confusingly so. For the first time since meeting Phainon his dormant secondary gender had been riled up - And it wasn’t ever how he had expected it to. He had never expected Phainon to be so.. Outrageously bold with his decisions and scenting him, nor had Mydei considered his inner alpha may react to such a thing. 

Never could he have considered it would show its teeth in desire of wanting to be the one scenting Phainon, not the other way around.

Mydei could only roll slightly in his bed before landing on just staring at the dark ceiling above him. 

Was Phainon actually insane?

That was the only logical explanation Mydei could find himself landing on, no sane alpha would be offering to let another scent each other. That should be Mydei’s line of thought! If not for the fact he hadn’t exactly fought against Phainon doing just that to him. Mydei could only rub his face with his hands before giving way to a distressed and somewhat annoyed groan over the thoughts. 

Now his bed even smelled of Phainon too, hauntingly so. Mydei couldn’t help but feel even more flustered over when he had reprimanded Phainon, Phainon only seemed to enjoy it. The way his pheromones had only gotten stronger, as if he enjoyed the fact he was in Mydei’s bed and pinned beneath another alpha. Mydei wasn’t even quite sure if Phainon realized he was doing such a thing. And yet..

‘I think I have a crush on you, Mydei.’ Those words were said so easily by Phainon now were ringing in Mydei’s head. They were a string of words together so bizarre that Mydei had easily written them off. Yet the more Mydei stared into the darkness of his room, it was becoming more real by the second that Mydei wasn’t sure he could keep telling himself Phainon was messing with him.

Mydei rolled again, returning to his earlier self assigned task of finding his phone he discarded somewhere in his blankets over his shock of Phainon claiming to be outside his apartment. Once located, he immediately unlocked it, moving quickly to tap into Aglaea’s messages.

Mydei; You.

Aglaea; Me?

Mydei; You sent a literal puppy-incarnate shaped pipe bomb to my doorstep.

Aglaea; Oh. Phainon. He said he did something stupid.

Mydei, lying on his back, stared at that message. He should agree, it was dumb. But that gnawing feeling in the pit of his stomach that kept churning in his, that feeling of wanting to rub his own scent back onto Phainon that he had felt ever so briefly was not letting him out of its clutches. 

Mydei; Something like that.

Mydei; He has no idea what the words personal space mean.

Aglaea; That’s part of the ‘puppy-incarnate’ side of him, I believe. You’re just receiving the brunt of it.

Mydei leaned his head back against some of his collection of pillows, he really did have a killer migraine - And these plaguing thoughts of Phainon’s weird behavior were not really helping him in any regards with soothing that. While he did appreciate Phainon bringing him his secret guilty pleasure, he did not appreciate the extra stress suddenly added on top of that. 

If Mydei even tried to think of other things, the pheromones Phainon had immediately set out to seep into Mydei’s bed brought him right back to that man. 

Worst of all - Mydei couldn’t even tell if Phainon actually smelled good or bad. 

His inner secondary gender that usually riled itself up over other alphas, giving Mydei a rather poor time dealing with other ones, was always exceptionally quiet around Phainon. Well, Outside of today, but Phainon wasn’t usually so.. Handsy either. Mydei could only groan out his frustrations as the scent of oak and vanilla with a tinge of citrus deep beneath it haunted his senses.

Thus, he took up texting the main perpetrator once again.

Mydei; I’ll end up neutering your dog if he keeps this up.

Aglaea; Oh?

Aglaea; He’s never been really territorial, so it’s quite shocking that you’re having problems with him over that. I thought you two would be a good match given your.. Temper and his therefore lack of one.

Mydei; Don’t play coy with me, Aglaea.

Aglaea; My. What ever could you mean, Mydeimos?

Mydei clicked his tongue at that, squinting at his phone in the darkness. Aglaea and Castorice knew damned well what was going on with Phainon, if he was being serious about having a crush on Mydei he had certainly yapped about it to those two. 

Mydei; He scented my neck today.

Aglaea; Oh.

Aglaea; Oh my.

Aglaea; Did you attack him for it? How wounded is he? That’s my dearest pet dog, you know.

Mydei; He’s fine. You have other dogs at work, anyways.

Aglaea; Really? Quite benevolent of you.

Mydei; I think he mentally ‘wounded’ both of us enough.

Aglaea; Ah. Yes. He sure did stop replying to me when I asked what happened.

Mydei; He’s doesn’t know how to confess his crimes, I’m sure.

Aglaea; He assumes you want him dead and ‘hate him forever and ever’.

Aglaea; His words, not mine.

Mydei; I could tell.

Mydei gave a scoffing noise at that, tapping out of Aglaea’s dms to stare at the unadded contact number that had been texting him today. The one he knew to be Phainon. Even as he blinked at the phone number he couldn’t quite work out what to say to him. He raised a hand to rub one of his temples idly, this was not how he had expected his sick day to go by any means. 

Mydei had always opted in a life of an introvert, preferring a good book or workout instead of finding alphas he meshed with and partying or whatever they did. He wasn’t quite sure. He also never sought out relationships, a second person to keep up with just felt like a handful. The idea of an alpha of all things having any romantic interest in him was mind boggling, to say the utmost least. 

The fact the alpha was so bold about it to scent him as well, was even more baffling. 

His eyes drifted over those numbers again, unfamiliar yet familiar. The same could be said about Phainon’s brief existence in his life, Mydei barely knew him, yet Phainon saw it fit to try to wriggle a space into Mydei’s heart for himself. 

Mydei couldn’t comprehend that - But Mydei couldn’t quite say he understood love either. 

Love was at its core a mess of human contradictions that Mydei had never made any effort to detangle, never wanted to. And now there was another alpha assumedly trying his best to do just that.  As much as Mydei wanted to say he wasn’t interested, had no desires in such a thing - The fact it was another alpha made something in him stir that he had never quite felt before. As if he was taking it for a challenge. 

A competition to be the dominant one, and that made a piece of Mydei’s brain prick with curiosity and intrigue. 

He did what any normal alpha would do in this situation.

Mydei; You should take someone on a date before scenting them.

Mydei laid there staring at that text, almost feeling ashamed at how unabashedly shameless it was. But the receiver of it had already made several social errors, and Phainon didn’t have any legs to stand on and judge Mydei due to that. Mydei almost clicked his phone off to escape his own rising heat in his face, if not for the fact those three dots appeared almost immediately. 

87X-XXX-XXXX; oh. yeah.

87X-XXX-XXXX; im sorry. 

Mydei felt himself rolling his eyes over this, the man really was acting like a kicked puppy. Either that or he was incredibly dense, and Mydei was leaning more towards both of them being true at the same time.

Mydei; I am telling you to ask me on an actual date.

87X-XXX-XXXX; OH. OKAY!

87X-XXX-XXXX; mydei would you do me the honor of allowing me to take you on a date when we both are off work next and when youre not sick.

Mydei; Stop forcing yourself to sound formal when I just demanded that you ask me on a date. It doesn’t fit you.

87X-XXX-XXXX; please please please please please please

87X-XXX-XXXX; please

Mydei; ?

87X-XXX-XXXX; please

Mydei; Okay.

87X-XXX-XXXX; YAY 

Mydei; Grown ass man saying yay..

87X-XXX-XXXX; hehe

Mydei moved a hand to pinch the bridge of his nose with a large sigh, suddenly feeling like he had walked right into a trap. The trap had blue eyes and didn’t hold back with his pouting faces, either. Mydei’s sickness was certainly not getting better at this rate.

There were several ways it could end, at least. Phainon could realize they have nothing in common and decide to be just friends, realize that two alphas could never work, or realize he was just wrong about whatever he thought saw in Mydei. And the issue would solve itself when any of those occurred. Easy enough for Mydei, he would have no problems ignoring this ever happening once Phainon got over it and Mydei could cease considering this anything near a competition.

So he could only sigh at the upcoming ‘date’ and hope it would settle this once and for all.

Aglaea; What the hell did you say to him? My phone is borderline unusable now.

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.html:
Mydei had regretfully been sick for two solid days, locked in his house and trapped thinking about what Phainon had so boldly sought out and done to him.

He was trapped with Phainon still texting him of course as well. Sending Mydei so.. So many texts. 

Usually if someone got to the texting stage with Mydei - They gave up almost immediately over his one word replies. 

Mydei had never been one for talking much or giving flowery and doting words to those who wanted to court him. Even then, most of his ‘romantic’ encounters were people that were only interested in his looks and what he could ‘do ’ to them. 

Whatever that meant. 

As he now sat in a park on his day off, waiting for the yapping man in question, he couldn’t help but scroll through the mess of worried texts. All innocent enough, though it was obvious he was attempting his best to move past the social blunder he had committed against Mydei. And Mydei could only figure he came to his senses later on when he thought back on it and had some shame. 

Mydei could only hope that the silly idea of a ‘crush’ Phainon claimed to have would be shattered today, after all, Mydei had planned this perfectly. 

He hadn’t at first, at first he was going to allow Phainon to pick and choose whatever he wanted to do with Mydei, but when Phainon confessed he wasn’t sure what Mydei would like. Well. 

Mydei chose dinner at a nice and small cafe, quiet, and not extremely known. No. But it was well known for being a hangout destination for betas and omegas. 

The plan was simple.

They would see Phainon smiling and doting on everyone like he seemed to do at work from the glimpses Mydei had caught in passing, and attempt to garner his attention romantically. Phainon at which point would easily be more enticed by omegas and betas than Mydei right in front of him, and snap out of whatever crush he thought he had.

Incredibly simple plan.

He tucked away his phone again to instead focus on the empty park in front of him. He had decided this to be their meeting place because honestly, he wanted to get there early and just sunbathe for a bit. He had been locked away in his apartment for days, so on that park bench he tilted his head back and took in the sun hitting him warmly as he fluttered his eyes closed.

He wasn’t sure how long he had been that way. What he was sure of, was the way that ever familiar scent was lingering in his nose. He wasn’t in such a deep sleep to be able to ignore that scent as he slowly straightened himself, blinking tiredly before his eyes easily found purchase on Phainon sitting on the bench with him to his right. 

Mydei blinked a few more times before giving way to a yawn, “When did you get here?”

“Don't worry, it was just a few minutes ago.” Phainon’s voice was quiet, as if teetering on the edge of being unsure of how asleep Mydei still was, not daring to speak too loudly. 

Mydei wasn’t worried over Phainon however. He could only knit his brows over how silently the man had joined him, he didn’t know dogs even knew how to be quiet in the first place.

“You didn’t wake me? Were you just going to try to carry me again all the way to the restaurant?”

“Ha.” Phainon huffed out light-heartedly, his eyes twinkling slightly with mischief as he tilted his head to give Mydei a lopsided smile, “Want me to try?”

Mydei exhaled sharply at that, giving a small smirk over the teasing manner Phainon had spoken in. “Not on your life.”

Phainon at that shook his head, almost giving what sounded like a wistful sight before he laughed a bit warmly; “So cruel! I easily could, you know, you weigh next to nothing.”

“.. I highly doubt that.” Mydei considered how much he weighed and easily found it was in fact, not, ‘next to nothing’. 

Phainon didn’t seem fazed however, only shrugging his shoulders; “Compared to the great danes I’ve tried picking up in the past that flail and struggle in my arms, you’re quite light and easy to hold.”

Mydei paused over that wording. Easy to hold . He had to bite his tongue slightly to keep from questioning him further, feeling as if that was some type of trap, and shaking his head instead. Mydei opted to inspect Phainon; he had dressed up for this. Not fully in a suit and tie, no. But in black slacks and a deep blue dress shirt, it looked nice on him. 

Aglaea had assuredly given him advice; After all, she had informed Mydei about how terrible the man’s fashion sense seemed to be, and Mydei highly doubted Phainon was willing to brave his first ‘date’ with Mydei looking a fool. 

Mydei looked away immediately when Phainon caught his eyes, focusing his thoughts on the park’s dirt road ahead. The omegas and betas today would most assuredly be swooning over Phainon easily with that attire. 

“Let’s get going then.” Mydei murmured at those thoughts, the sooner Phainon stopped believing he had a crush on Mydei, the better; Mainly for Mydei’s own mental wellbeing. He had never had someone text him this much in his life, it almost felt like he had locked a dog out of his room and it was constantly scratching at the door begging to be let back in.

Phainon probably would even whimper, too.

“Alright!” Phainon replied happily, standing up and moving towards Mydei at a startling speed to offer his hand, an offer to help him stand up. 

Mydei felt his eye twitch over the polite action before sighing deeply and giving up; placing his hand in Phainon’s who gently took it. Mydei felt himself blinking as he stood, he certainly didn’t need help off the metal bench, and Phainon.. Had not let go of his hand yet. 

Mydei jerked his hand away, scowling towards Phainon who only immediately pouted over it. A well practiced act it seemed with how his bottom lip jutted out and his eyes seemed misty. An act Mydei would be immune to today, easily, all he had to do was turn away and immediately leave Phainon behind!

Out of sight, out of mind. 

Phainon didn’t allow himself to be completely out of sight nor out of mind however, instead quickly moving to fall in line beside Mydei with a small hum. “You look nice today.” Phainon finally said, and Mydei did his best to ignore the way he easily saw those deep piercing blue eyes roaming him while they walked.

Mydei wasn’t nearly as dressed up as Phainon, they hadn’t really said what type of attire to wear, and Mydei had no interest in trying to draw eyes away from Phainon. Thus, Mydei was barely dressed up at all, he didn’t want it completely obvious he was avoiding dressing up, but.. A thin line was being walked, for sure.

Just some jeans and a black collared shirt, there really wasn’t much there to even look at and compliment.

Mydei opted to ignore the compliment, it was probably meant as a slight against him anyway with his refusal to dress up as nicely as Phainon, giving a puff of amusement instead. “Right. You do too.” 

Mydei was focused forward, his eyes on looking at the path ahead - thankful that the restaurant wasn’t far away - and the trees lining the other side of him. Anything but looking at Phainon through more than his peripheral vision. 

“Do you go to this cafe often?” Phainon inquired in that ever innocent light-hearted tone that drove Mydei insane, what was driving Mydei more insane however was the way Phainon seemed insistent on being so close that their arms kept brushing into each other. Mydei at first wrote it off as an accident, until he tried to create some space between them only to immediately be ruined by Phainon cutting the distance as if he didn’t even notice.

Maybe he didn’t, but Mydei could only sigh over the growing scent of Phainon rubbing against him as they walked on the path. 

He probably should have actually had this man meet him at the cafe in hindsight.

“No.” Mydei finally murmured, not at all blind to the way that made Phainon’s head snap to attempt to stare Mydei in the eyes as they walked side by side. An attempt Mydei didn't aid in the slightest.

“You don’t?”

Mydei had to ignore his desire to smirk over the evident shock dripping from Phainon’s tone. If anything, Phainon certainly was fun to mess with. “No.”

Phainon was silent at that before giving way to a warm bubbly laugh as he put the pieces together, “Have you ever been?”

“No.”

Phainon obviously found this funny as he exhaled again in an odd fashion rather loudly before bumping against Mydei once more. “So it’s.. Your first time going to this cafe?”

“Yes. I’ve heard good reviews.” Mainly from omegas and betas online, though . Not that Mydei would tell Phainon that, anyway. He even had to inform the staff over the phone when he made the reservation that they were two unmated alphas eating together.. Seems they took rather good care of their preferred clients. Mydei couldn’t fault them for that.

“I hope they earn your praise as well, then.” Phainon rather gleefully mused, and something about that made Mydei almost feel guilty. Almost. Phainon seemed much more excited about this than Mydei had ever expected. That pang of guilt every time he could see the alpha grin at him from the corner of his eye was borderline haunting. 

Mydei only gave a weak hum in reply, mainly due to being uncertain if he could keep his voice level due to the gnawing guilt that was bubbling into his throat the happier Phainon seemed. 

──────────────

Mydei would say their dinner was fine. 

The cafe was quiet with a rather fine assortment of foods and desserts, Mydei passed on the desserts even though Phainon seemed rather uncomfortable or even nervous over that choice. But the scenery inside was warm, inviting almost. Mydei wasn’t a plant guy - Mainly because he sucked at keeping them alive when he did own them - But he appreciated the fake plants they had strung about. 

The people actually there were in fact mainly omegas and betas, and Mydei found himself sniffing his nose idly quite often. Not obvious in his action, but the pheromones were almost unmanageable. He supposed even if some of them were wearing scent blockers or taking medicine, if you collected enough in one place it would form a rather potent smell.

Not a cloying sweet one that was tempting to him just.. Very strong. Heavy scents of flowers and sweets, but Mydei honestly couldn’t discern if that was the fake plants and the cafe’s food or not. He tried not to figure it out, either.

The other thing was.. The way Mydei kept noticing it.

The deep uncomfortableness, the tightness of Phainon’s facial features, the way his lips were pressed into a thin forced smile, the way his eyes kept flickering to a specific spot behind Mydei. The way was tapping a finger nervously on the wooden table and he was shifting his weight every now and then uncomfortably. The way Phainon’s scent was strong in the way it usually was around Mydei, but much more controlled and dull under all the other blends of pheromones permeating Mydei’s noise.

It would be impossible for Mydei not to notice his plan working, as such he could only give a smirk to Phainon before speaking, “Something got your attention?” Or someone? He should say as he glanced a knowing look over his shoulder to where Phainon had kept looking anxiously.

It was easy to figure out, a pair of beautiful women seemed to be sitting behind their table just a few steps away. 

Ruby red hair, wearing a sundress of some kind that almost matched her hair, and eyes that seemed temptingly beautiful, round and doe-like - Yet immediately shied away from Mydei’s gaze as she turned her head away. The usual reaction, he noted, when he looked at people like that. His eyes moved across to her friend who gave a sheepish smile back to him. Mydei could only look forward again, giving a small scoff as he did so, it was obvious how much Mydei looking at her had easily bothered and riled Phainon up. 

His already annoyed looking face before Mydei had thrown that look towards her was now completely a grimace. Mydei closed his eyes at it before giving a low hum thoughtfully, it was incredibly easy to prove to Phainon that it was nothing but a foolish idea to think he had any desires towards Mydei romantically. All it took was getting him near where betas and omegas hung out and making him get a literal sniff of reality it seemed. To remind him that an alpha like himself would never be able to sate Phainon’s wants.

“Mydei , Maybe we should leave.” Phainon’s voice was quiet, yet obviously strained as he forced out his words.

Just a quick look and Phainon was already that territorial over someone he barely knew?

One that he immediately looked at widely, following up the arm until he found purchase on that woman’s face. A tinge of pink dusting her features instantly as his eyes found her own.

“We were wondering if Mr. Big, Buff, and Beautiful by chance is single?” 

Mydei pulled his lips into a taut line over that being his nickname, but more so..

Mydei surely hadn’t expected himself to draw any attention, but it worked all the same he guessed by the way Phainon seemed to be fuming, that ever familiar angry scent seeping into the air Phainon seemed to give off when Mydei started bothering him. 

Mydei opened his mouth to reply, he really did, but he hadn’t been quick enough in his start up.

“No.”

Phainon instead hissed out across the table, making Mydei look away from the beta and to the rather angry Phainon. He seemed absolutely furious, he had let go of the table by now, but he was tapping on the table a mile a minute, eyes obviously staring at that hand on Mydei’s shoulder.

Intense. 

Such a horribly intense gaze that Mydei found himself knitting his brows before he innocently asked;  “I’m not?”

Phainon’s jaw tightened at that as piercing blue eyes snapped to meet Mydei’s, an undecipherable emotion flickered through them for the briefest of moments.

“.. I guess you are.” Phainon darkly said with almost a snarl, one that made Mydei blink at him rather confusedly. 

He must really like her looks. Mydei could only find it slightly amusing how quickly Phainon had turned aggressive towards Mydei when he felt someone he was interested in was being taken by Mydei. Mydei decided to throw Phainon a bone, pointing towards Phainon instead as he looked at the beta yet again,  “Are you sure you’re not interested in that guy? He’s basically a puppy normally.” Mydei asked with a raised brow as he blinked to the woman.

Phainon at that made a weird snorting noise, one that made Mydei blink blankly as he quickly snapped his head to stare at the alpha across the table. Very aware of his ever growing annoyance. The way it was seeping heavily into the air with Phainon’s growing disdain. 

 “It doesn’t matter if she is.” Phainon muttered, he moved to put his elbow on the table before resting his head in his hand as he looked away sharply. Anywhere but at Mydei and the two women still waiting expectantly. 

Mydei however, was dumbfounded. Surely he wasn’t so upset over her interest in Mydei that he would immediately give up, right? 

“Huh?” Was all Mydei intelligently managed to say instead, baffled at the alpha’s reaction to this situation. 

Those piercing blue eyes shot back at him, narrowed and almost angry looking in nature. It was honestly the first time Mydei had seen Phainon even act on his secondary gender’s instincts. The flip between a nice soft attitude having man to an angry seething man that wanted Mydei dead was almost harrowing to endure for Mydei. 

“It’s not mutual.” Phainon practically spat out, his eyes only focusing on staring Mydei down intently, as if his patience had run dry ages ago.
