Mydei let out a knowing hum, almost playfully, which maybe was the wrong move as he tilted his head slightly blinking at Phainon. “You’re not interested in her?”

Phainon seemed to visibly strain his facial expression at that, as if he was unsure to be furious or annoyed at Mydei, but the way those blue eyes looked at that hand on Mydei wasn’t lost to him. “No?”

“But.. You’re clearly jealous.” Mydei slowly noted, slowly becoming more and more aware of the way those eyes were teetering on the edge of glaring. Something.. Mydei was becoming very uncertain if it was truly for himself.. Or her. 

Phainon’s lips turned downwards slightly at that, a thin frown marring across a face that Mydei didn’t even know held the capacity to show such an emotion.

“Clearly.”

Mydei felt that hand leave his shoulder at that, a movement that he slowly registered and looked towards. The woman was now, obviously, uncomfortable. 

“You two seem like.. You need to talk about something, I wish you luck!” Those words left her lips at a rate that Mydei found baffling before both of the women quickly seemed to dash away and out of the restaurant. 

Mydei blinked at where the ghost of her used to be blankly before turning his attention to the still scowling Phainon, blue eyes narrowed at him almost.. Dangerously?

“You’re.. Not going to chase after her?” Mydei prodded more, though he knew the answer that was clawing its way through the core of him. Mydei had the hopes of showing Phainon that his crush wasn’t real, that he would easily fold and come to terms that Mydei would never be what he actually wanted from love.

But not even Mydei could ignore the way that Phainon glared at the women as they left. The way his expression immediately seemed to lighten and soften at the edges once her hand was off Mydei’s shoulder. Mydei could try to rationalize that it was due to her no longer getting Mydei’s scent on her..  He could.. Try to rationalize it like that at least. Emphasis on try.

“Why would I ever do that, Mydei?”

Mydei cleared his throat at that, looking away slightly before picking up his glass of water for a sip. His throat was.. Very parched now, he would admit. Mydei savored the chilled drink before giving out a deep exhale, blinking at nothing before slowly meeting Phainon’s gaze that seemed wholly focused on waiting for his answer.

“Hadn’t you been looking at her all night?” Mydei softly inquired, rather aware of the way his tone had dropped slightly, as if trying not to let anyone hear.

“Yes.” Phainon answered rigidly, still very obviously annoyed beyond compare, not bothering to match Mydei in his quiet volume, a finger still tapping the wood. The movement was much slower, more precise, but much more irritated. 

Mydei shrugged his shoulders at that, moving a hand to fiddle with his braid at the side of his hair idly, amber flaked eyes moving away to study the plants hanging overhead. “Then why stare at her if you’re not interested in her?”

Phainon made a small amused noise, a huff, a grumble almost, one that seemed to be baffled over the question that Mydei immediately looked back to him with a questioning furrow of his brows; “Because she kept looking at you .” Phainon answered so matter-of-factly, as if it was obvious.

“I don’t like people looking at what’s m-” Phainon snapped his mouth closed at that, instead giving a deep sigh as he leaned into his chair as he shook his head roughly, almost tiredly, “Do you think I haven’t noticed?”

Mydei chose to ignore the first half, a piece of him not wanting to linger on whatever that full sentence may have been. “.. Noticed?” Mydei echoed instead, blinking at those words as he mulled them over. He really didn’t think Phainon had noticed that, no, or maybe he was simply hoping he hadn’t at the least.

Phainon still seemed rigid, uncomfortable and on edge as he gave Mydei a small stare that bordered delicately on becoming a glare. An expression that made Mydei figure Phainon was actively fighting his desire to be angry at Mydei still.  “The way there’s no alphas here but us and they put us somewhere where they could keep a close eye on us.”

Mydei feigned confusion slightly as he tilted his head innocently, casting a glance away as if to look at the other patrons in the cafe before returning it to Phainon. “.. So?”

Phainon studied him for a second under a stare that seemed very intense, very searching. It almost made Mydei want to squirm slightly, but Phainon seemed to relent and looked away to his side before heaving out a deep exasperated sigh. 

“Fine.”

“You’re not making much sense here.” Mydei mumbled innocently, taking up his previous action of pushing the ice cubes within his now almost out water dully, watching them as if they were suddenly much more interesting than they actually were.

Phainon’s eyes immediately snapped back to Mydei’s even if Mydei didn’t meet that stare, deep blue eyes almost squinting at him across the table. 

“I won’t say it.”

“I’m not quite following your meaning.” Mydei mattered dryly, not really attempting to follow the meaning behind his words anyway. 

“You are the only person that catches my eye.”

Mydei had to bite back the urge to ask ‘here?’ over that statement, instead mulling it over in his head and hoping his cheeks would cease their burning sensation. Instead only able to give a strange skewed expression to Phainon, one that not even Mydei knew the true emotions of but he hoped it displayed confusion..

Phainon studied that for a moment before sighing and finally stopping his tapping on the table to lean back. And a piece of Mydei was glad to see those harsh features of pure agitation seeming to melt away on Phainon’s face finally. 

“But you’re not going to make this easy on me, are you?”

Mydei huffed out a laugh, almost amused by the way he had no clue what was happening in Phainon’s head currently; “And what is that?”

“Proving that what I say is true and that I mean it .”

Mydei didn’t reply, instead opting to look away once more to use his straw, shoving around ice cubes in his water instead. Something about it earned a low quiet chuckle from Phainon, a sound that bordered on dangerous instead of his normal joy. 

Obviously, he was still irritated underneath his now softening expression. 

“I understand, and that’s fine. I accept your challenge regardless, Mydei.”

Mydei only stayed looking away as he unhanded his drink, now somewhat mourning the fact he had already eaten his meal so he had nothing to piddle with. Only the option of weakly avoiding Phainon’s eyes that seemed much more intense than ever before regarding Mydei. He wasn’t even sure what challenge Phainon meant. Proving that he was interested? Was that the odd challenge happening here? 

“Phainon, I..” Mydei only trailed off as he met that piercing stare, what did he want to say? What did he have to say? 

He honestly wasn’t used to this situation.

No one had ever sought out getting to know him, nor romantically trying to have a relationship with him. Usually they were flings only interested in his appearance and nothing else, and honestly, outside of that he wasn’t sure what more he could offer to someone.

Let alone another alpha.

Mydei didn’t regard himself as someone that was interesting, his hobbies were shallow, he didn’t even consider them things a partner would ever want to take part in. Where was the romance in your partner opting to read a book instead of talking to you? Where was the love in them leaving and going to the gym for the fun of it?

Mydei looked away again as he pulled his lips into a taut line.

He didn’t know.

Furthermore, he hadn’t really ever tried to romance someone himself either. No one had really interested him.

“I’m ready to leave.” Mydei mumbled instead, hoping that with leaving he could also pull away from Phainon. From today. Go home and lay down, curl up and forget that Phainon having a crush on him seemed more and more real by the moments. Forget that his anger may have actually been towards the beta touching Mydei and not the other way around.

Phainon however seemed unaware of his internal plight, only sitting up straighter and beaming before standing. “I already paid, so that’s fine!”

Mydei felt himself grit his teeth as he watched Phainon push in his chair politely. It was almost unsettling how quickly he had whiplashed between moods. But..

That was also just an alpha reaction, Mydei assumed. 

That felt reassuring in a way. That Phainon actually did have reactions like that, maybe it truly was triggered by the beta then, considering Mydei alone had never seen that occur. 

Mydei let himself breathe for a moment, comforted almost by the sliver of hope that had arisen. Mydei’s eyes swept over their circular table one last time before standing slowly with an inaudible sigh. It had all gone very poorly, but so long as Mydei slipped away quickly, Phainon probably would wisen up and realize his affections were to the beta and not Mydei.. Right?

Mydei cut a harsh glare to Phainon as the fellow alpha in question instead encroached on him instantly, reaching past him to push in Mydei’s chair for him; An action that made Mydei click his tongue in annoyance as he looked away. 

Mydei instead made for the exit, not bothering to check if Phainon was behind him as he quickly pushed the door open with a wave goodbye to the workers by the exit. 

He knew he was there anyway due to the quiet laugh behind him, “You’re in quite the hurry!” 

Phainon called as he followed Mydei out the door, to which Mydei only cut him a narrowed glance as he stalled his steps. Phainon seemed to be.. Doing much better at the least, back to being more akin to a puppy than a man who wanted to lean across the table and start choking Mydei just minutes prior.

“Mm.” Was all Mydei replied before staring in the direction his apartment was in with wistful hopes in mind. 

A silence fell on them, mainly due to Mydei trying to figure out how to tell Phainon he wasn’t going home now, before Phainon moved to the front of him with a tilt of his head. An action Mydei watched carefully, furrowing his brows at the way Phainon blinked at him widely. 

“Ah, Mydei.. There’s something on your shoulder.”

“Huh?” Mydei mumbled quietly before glancing away at his shoulder, the wrong shoulder it seemed as Phainon’s hand immediately snapped up to Mydei’s other shoulder, gently brushing at Mydei’s shoulder once.. Twice.. 

Before Phainon looked at Mydei’s face with a rather pleased gleam in his eyes. “I got it.”

Except, Mydei had of course noticed it. 

Noticed the way he used mainly his wrist to brush at the fabric there. 

Exactly where that beta’s hand had lingered on him, and Mydei wasn’t sure if it was due to her scent being left on Mydei and Phainon was jealous of him.. Or if Phainon was mad over her leaving her scent on Mydei. .

Phainon turned away once he considered his work finished, moving to continue on his way only Mydei didn’t follow in his steps. He lingered there dumbfoundedly. That feeling was back, that quiet annoyance that it should be the other way around. His inner alpha telling him to scent Phainon, that he should be the one being scented. 

The only time it ever wanted to thrash Phainon.

He could only pull his lips into a taut line as he let out a deep sigh, willing himself not to get as irked as the last time. Mainly due to the fact that there was a heavy risk of someone seeing him trying to throw Phainon into a wall or two with how close he had paused beside the poor cafe.

“Stop scenting me, Phainon.” Was all he could allow himself to snarl out in a hushed tone, a threat, or perhaps a promise heavily hanging in his words. 

Phainon’s silent steps paused at that, he didn’t turn around instantly either. He just froze his movements for a few moments before slowly turning to face Mydei, his expression was wholly indecipherable. Phainon’s eyes seemed to rapidly look at Mydei’s face before he decided on a harsh and brittle sounding laugh, “Sorry.”

Mydei instinctually found himself scowling slightly over that, huffing out deeply over it.

It sounded fake. Like he was sorry at all - and maybe that's why it was even more annoying - because Mydei knew he wasn’t. Phainon obviously was terribly bothered by the fact that beta had probably had her scent lingering on Mydei and he himself hadn’t even noticed. 

But Phainon had.

Now Mydei couldn’t ignore the lingering smell of Phainon, even a few steps away, he knew the woody vanilla scent was hanging onto his shoulder for dear life.

“Come here.”

“Huh?” Phainon questioned, yet he obeyed immediately despite his confusion, moving slowly back over to Mydei, who only gave narrowed eyes in response. 

“I’m making it fair.” Mydei muttered, moving a hand to Phainon’s shoulder - Rubbing his wrist there against the dress shirt’s fabric lightly.

Mydei was very aware of the way Phainon had gone stiff, the way he didn’t even seem like he was breathing, and more importantly the way his eyes had blown wide with his mouth agape. The way those blue eyes only stared at Mydei, he looked as though he was completely horrified by it. 

Serves him right. 

Mydei had to hold back on his instinct to purr in joy over scenting someone, it was another alpha after all. It meant nothing, even if it did press his buttons happily. Like hell he would let Phainon know that either . Instead he choked any emotions of joy down to focus solely on how embarrassing it must be for Phainon.

Now the fellow alpha would most likely be having his own issues with his secondary gender, comprehend the situation he inflicts on Mydei, and stop scenting him like he owned Mydei.

At least. That was the goal. 

The plan. 

But Mydei’s plans never seemed to hold any single drops of water with this damnedable puppy given form. 

Phainon instead broke into a wide gleeful smile when Mydei pulled away; “Do the other side too!” His voice was much too thrilled, too sing-song for this to have truly had any mental effect on his alpha. 

Mydei almost found himself scowling over the reaction, confused and very very baffled by how excited Phainon was. If he had a tail, he most certainly would have been wagging it at top speeds. “This is a punishment , why are you so happy?”

“This is not a punishment for me, Mydei!” Phainon teased a bit too happily with a laugh as both his hands clasped around Mydei’s, something Mydei felt himself twitch an eye over before Phainon did in fact bring his hand that was guided by Phainon’s to the other side of his neck. Not to his shoulder, no, Phainon’s hand guided Mydei’s smoothly into the crook of his neck, rubbing his wrist there harshly. 

Mydei only watched dumbfoundedly, this was partly his own fault, he guessed as he twitched his hand against Phainon’s neck that Phainon was rather forcefully pressing across the glands there. Mydei had in fact, wanted to scent Phainon so that the fellow alpha would get upset and understand the situation Phainon put Mydei into.. Yet Phainon was obviously thrilled over it, almost basking in the idea of carrying Mydei’s scent with him, and Mydei had to grapple with the desire to go along with it. To happily scent Phainon..

Mydei wasn’t even sure if he should say ‘almost basking’ either with the gaze Phainon was giving him as he kept Mydei’s hand there, much too long.. Mydei snapped it back swiftly, rubbing at the top his hand absentmindedly before knitting his brows to focus on it wholly. Anything but to look away at how those eyes were looking at Mydei like he was something fragile - Something to be protected by Phainon.

“With you? None.” And Mydei didn’t even really need to be looking at Phainon to know the expression he was making, yet was regretful that he was indeed looking at Phainon and able to see how his eyes had softened horribly upon speaking that in such a gentle tone towards Mydei of all people. 

Mydei could only bare to pull his eyes away, drifting to the side to watch the busy street of cars. Anything but look at how genuine Phainon seemed at this moment.

Phainon, however, had other plans as he gave a sharp whistle. 

“Alright, come with me.”

Mydei jerked his head back to stare at the other alpha who was still lingering awfully close to him, before exhaling sharply, tiredly. 

Mydei moved his hand to rub at his face, vaguely stuttering his movements as the scent of Phainon hit his nose rather hard. “Our date is over. Most likely due to the fact Phainon had rubbed them into his shoulder as well.

Mydei wished he was more immune to the way Phainon always seemed so happy as well, wished it didn’t make Mydei’s head feel a bit dizzy and like he couldn’t refuse the man. Bastard truly was basically a dog.

“That wasn’t discussed..” Mydei practically sighed out, every word lacking any punch behind it because he couldn’t find it in himself. His plan had failed, horribly. ‘I accept your challenge, Mydei’ seemed more and more like a promise, not just a threat as Mydei thought of it more.

Phainon gave a warm laugh before a smile crept onto his features, “That’s true, but what kind of date would I be taking you on if you made all the plans yourself?”

“Mm.” “I think this will make it a great one.”

Mydei bit down any snark about the scenting already doing enough damage to this date, but decided he would follow along anyways. Mainly because if Phainon grew to hate him anymore than he already does, it really would make working shifts with him a pain in the ass. Mydei could do it, he had done it before with other people of all secondary genders. But there’s a difference between ‘doing’ and ‘enjoying’ work. 

Mydei gave in, lowering his shoulders with a sigh before following the personified dog in front of him, it wasn’t like he had anything else to do tonight anyway. And the sun was only just now beginning its slow descent down the sky creating lovely hues that painted the sky red and orange. 

He could only be thankful of the beauty of it for a few brief seconds however, as Phainon ahead of him slowed his steps to return to his place awfully close beside Mydei just as he had done earlier. Mydei could only scoff over it.

“You’re supposed to be leading the way.” Mydei mumbled out, still not quite clued into where the hell they were actually going nor was he very lucid towards why he was allowing it to happen. If he hurried home now he could take a shower, get the smell of woods and vanilla off of him, put on his pink house slippers, and crash happily into his bed. 

Instead, the air was becoming nippy, and the warm touch of Phainon brushing up against him was becoming much more welcomed than Mydei cared to admit. 

“It’s alright. It’s usually on this road.” Phainon hummed out.

Mydei blinked at that before slowly dragging his eyes to stare at the man beside him as he briskly walked, narrowing his eyes. “Usually?”

Mydei could only heave out a deep sigh from his core, he would let this man have this night and nothing more. Probably. So he decided not to put up a fight. Just let it end quickly and swiftly with mercy, if Mydei is lucky.. 

It didn’t take long anyways, even in their newfound silence as Phainon stayed irritatingly close to Mydei with every movement.

“.. An ice cream truck?” Mydei asked dumbfoundedly as he stared at the line of children a couple of feet away as he stopped a good distance off. Studying the way they were conversing happily, probably trying to decide what they would get amongst themselves. 

“Mhm!” Phainon nodded as he paused his steps beside Mydei before looking at him expectantly, clearly trying to gauge the reaction Mydei would have towards this. 

“.. We are not children.” Mydei reminded him, as if Phainon needed the reminder at all. 

Phainon only furrowed his brows before exhaling a light laugh as he tilted his head. “You don’t have to be a child to like ice cream.”

Amber eyes flicked past Phainon at that to study the crowd there idly, “That is not my point.”

Phainon fell silent for a brief second before giving a rather dramatic shrug, that ever annoying cute smile gracing his features yet again.

“Say what you want! I’m getting the Spongebob themed popsicle.” 

Mydei’s mouth fell open at that, floundering slightly before he slowly croaked out his words painfully; “The what?”

Phainon clearly didn’t understand what the issue with his words were at all. 

“It has gumball eyes! The answer is obvious here, I need to have one.”

Mydei could only blink slowly at Phainon, as if slowly closing his eyes would help him riddle out what the hell was happening. He hadn’t stopped at an ice cream truck that played music for the neighborhood children in - Well. Ever. The idea of doing it now as a fully grown man was almost mortifying to consider.

“What do you want to get, Mydei?” Phainon asked gently, in a tone that made Mydei immediately avoid those eyes, instead focusing on the pictures a bit away. Squinting slightly. 

He couldn’t see.

He was near-sighted, regretfully, and from this angle and distance combined with lacking his glasses.. He couldn’t see.

Mydei gritted his teeth at it, giving up on squinting his eyes as if it helped him see at all in the dimming sunset above with a sigh, turning his head away. “Nothing.”

“Nothing?” Phainon slowly echoed with pure shock laced beneath his words before giving a small laugh, “Surely you want something? I’ve been told you have quite the sweet tooth and you skipped dessert..” 

Mydei snapped his head back to Phainon, glaring sharply at the man, “Aglaea needs to stop telling you things about me.”

“Awh. Why? It’s cute!” Those words fell out of Phainon’s mouth so instantly that even Phainon seemed slightly surprised as he said it before swiftly glancing away. Mydei blinked at him as he studied the pink hue slowly creeping into the man’s features even with the ever dimming light above him. That wasn't to say Mydei felt like he fared any better with how hot his face was suddenly feeling.. It didn't help that any direction he looked smelled like Phainon as well.

Mydei couldn’t help but shake his head over it. If anyone was painfully cute here, it was probably Phainon. Not Mydei. 

“I am not cute , nor is anything I do cute , Phainon.” 

“And yet.. You do cute stuff while being cute..” Phainon mused almost as if he was in thought before laughing as he focused on Mydei again, still with the dusting of red on his face, “Come on now. It’s just ice cream, Mydei. It won’t bite back, you know.”

Mydei decided to ignore the first half. He didn’t dare consider why his heart did an odd lurch over the way Phainon insisted on calling him ‘cute’ of all things. 

“I can’t see.”

“Huh?”

“I don’t have my glasses.” Mydei dryly muttered, looking past Phainon and the line of children still buying ice cream, “I’m not exactly someone you look at and trust around children, Phainon. I’m not going over there with them to look closer either.”

Phainon froze slightly at that, he seemed to deeply think about that. His brows became knitted and furrowed in thought, and at the very least, Mydei knew he was upset by those words before Phainon gave a deep sigh. Turning slightly to look at the children still discussing their desired choices.

“But, you’ll wait here while I get mine right?” Phainon asked in a rather hollow tone, as if he had just received the worst news from Mydei. And Mydei couldn’t really quite figure out why him not wanting to get ice cream was such a heinous crime to this man - Even if it was something Phainon was looking forward to. He could do it alone.

With those thoughts, Mydei gave a deep sigh, “.. You don’t need me to wait here. I’m going home.”

Phainon seemed to jolt slightly judging by the way his entire body moved before he swiftly returned to looking at Mydei. Waving his hands in defeat; “No no, I really really need you to wait here actually.”

“You don’t.” Mydei repeated as he watched that man seemed to deflate immediately at those words.

And Mydei knew a piece of him was doomed with how Phainon immediately seemed to tilt his head and pull his face into the most pathetic expression he had ever seen a man make. It was as if he was teetering a thin line between breaking down and crying, like Mydei leaving was going to leave Phainon sobbing on the floor immediately. 

“Please..” The way his voice was barely above a broken whisper didn’t help Mydei in trying to ignore this seemingly well practiced pout. He sounded truly desperate for Mydei to stay around.. 

“Fine.” And Mydei was not immune to whatever the hell this man was doing to his heart that was now twinged carefully in a bit of sorrow over making Phainon look like that.

Phainon seemed to immediately perk up at that, almost annoyingly as he gave another glad and carefree smile to Mydei; “Yay. Okay, I’ll be quick!”

Mydei almost bit his tongue to hold back the way he wanted to mock how Phainon had said ‘yay’ so flatly and out loud. Though he could only pull his face into a scowl as he silently stood a good bit away, watching as Phainon made it up to the side of the ice cream truck. Mydei moved his hand Phainon hadn’t used to scent himself to rub at the bridge of his nose. 

This had been such a horrible first date, If anything Phainon probably has had hundreds of better first dates to compare it to and easily realize Mydei is not for him. 

That should make Mydei happy and have a weight off his shoulders.

But as he looked at how clearly that man looked as he talked to the children in line - even without his glasses he was able to see that stupid dopey smile - Mydei felt almost saddened.

Before he had come to terms and hoped Phainon would move on, but now it felt almost odd to consider the man truly figuring out he didn’t care for Mydei. Sure, that was doomed to happen with most people that met Mydei, but it felt almost.. Worse to consider Phainon doing it.

Was it just because Phainon was so upfront and honest with it that Mydei folded slightly? 

Mydei couldn’t say for certain.

What he could say for certain, was the way he let out a deep sigh as he watched Phainon reach over the truck’s window and receive not one, but two ice creams handed to him.

He clicked his tongue as he watched the alpha almost skip back to him, eyes twinkling and looking much too happy for Mydei to be able to insult him without feeling guilt yet again. 

“I got you a Spongebob one too!” Phainon happily explained, before reaching out the very square shaped popsicle to Mydei expectantly. One that Mydei slowly accepted with a huff of a laugh. This man truly was basically a lost puppy when he wasn’t having his alpha mood swings it seemed.

“What a good boy, Thanks.”

──────────────

“And then he’s uncomfortable around children..” Phainon wailed out pathetically, allowing his head to fall dejectedly into the desk before him with a rather embarrassingly loud thud accompanying it. He was only vaguely aware of the way papers shuffled at the force of it. Phainon faked a loud obnoxious sniffle to really sell it.

Castorice, however, was more than just immune to the fake sniffling and pathetic acts. Well, the pathetic acts weren’t fake in her opinion, that was probably just Phainon.

“Sounds like you’re a bad pair..” Castorice sighed out, “He’s an alpha, likes cats, and doesn’t like children. He’s like.. A walking red flag for you personally and you just keep going back..”

A bad pair.

Phainon felt his hands drag across the papers beneath his head at that slowly. He didn’t know what to believe. He had never felt any attraction to anyone before Mydei, and now it was obvious that Mydei didn’t believe him at all. 

Phainon had realized it immediately when they entered that cafe, the smell of omegas and betas was almost unbearable. Phainon at first had been completely confused on if Mydei just really expected the food there to be amazing, but as Phainon watched people glancing at them both, he had a sneaking suspicion Mydei was testing him in a way. 

Testing to see if he would crumble and chase one of them instead.

Mydei however, couldn’t possibly understand how silly that was to Phainon.

After all, Mydei was the first person to actually smell like an omega to him, not those other people Mydei had taken him around. Mydei was the only one with a scent so intoxicating that Phainon desperately wanted to drink it in, to bury his face against his scent glands and even lap at them pathetically. 

Mydei was the only person that seeing unmated people interact with him drove Phainon insane, it was an agonizing feeling that he hadn’t ever felt before. The desire to lash at them, to make sure they unhanded him, to hide him away and keep him from anyone who desired to gaze at him. 

Phainon thought the test would be easy, of course he could resist the temptations of betas and omegas, he always had. But he now knew he did falter when someone wanted Mydei’s attention and sought it out in the same way Phainon did..

A bad pair.

Phainon wanted children one day, even if he had to adopt. The fact that Mydei didn’t like children had been crushing him the entire night and day, but it was rather obviously the case with how Mydei had refused to get closer to the ice cream truck with them there. 

Phainon could only lightly bang his head into the desk before letting out a pained groan. Not over the hitting, no, over the fact he still didn’t want to give up Mydei.. He was willing to give up owning a dog, and now having kids in the future for a man that didn’t even believe Phainon liked him. For an alpha who assuredly thought Phainon was still just fucking with him.

It didn’t help that ‘what a good boy’ was stuck replaying in his head painfully, or the way he had almost immediately gotten hard over such a simple and harmless thing Mydei obviously had meant in a teasing manner and had to pray Mydei didn't notice the thick arousal that probably seeped into Phainon's scent. But how was he supposed to ignore such a low octave humming out something so seductive to him!? He wanted that man to call him a good boy more and more..

Phainon was so miserable.

But the idea of giving up on getting to know Mydei made him even more miserable.

There was something about him, not just the scent, that made Phainon curious about him. 

Mydei didn’t make sense.

Mydei was an alpha, well-built, patient, kind, straight forward, baked, and seemed to be quite focused on things he put his mind to. Sure he was standoffish, but he seemed nice enough talking to him. Yet the simplest and most confusing fact about him remained true.

Mydei was single.

It couldn’t possibly be because no one looked his way, that was quite glaringly obviously not the case considering the beta who so openly desired him in the cafe. So why was Mydei single and giving Phainon even the tiniest of his attention and time? Even if Phainon knew Mydei was just doing it out of pity or something, why did he bother?

“Are you really using all your time on break to mope about Mydei?” Castorice sighed out from somewhere to his right and cutting through his thoughts, which garnered a muffled groan from Phainon.

“.. Yes, when he’s not near me is the only time I can think clearly..” 

And even then ‘clearly’ was still somewhat muddied, he had to admit. 

Mydei was a rollercoaster for Phainon to even think about. The first person he ever was interested in the scent of, and it didn’t even line up with what other people said he smelled like. Was Phainon’s nose actually broken? Mydei was also the first person he had ever wanted to try to pursue romantically, and Mydei didn’t even take him seriously in that regard. 

Not that Phainon could blame him.

Phainon had looked into it a lot lately online, and alphas falling in love with alphas happened rarely, sure. But not in the way Phainon had grown attached to mydei, none of them wrote about their scents being alluring or sweet. Just that they were friends for a long time and slowly became more interested in each other, giving up on their secondary genders mattering so much to them.

But he barely knew Mydei.

Phainon banged his forehead against the front desk once more for good measure before sitting up with a dreadfully slow pace. He was so beyond cooked; He was absolutely fried. 

He slowly reached for his phone. He had to know. He had to. 

Phainon; do you hate children?

Short and to the point, Mydei wasn’t working the same shift as him today, so as long as Mydei wasn’t someone that slept until two somedays. It was fine..

Phainon felt as though he could breathe freely when he saw those three dots appear, an easy sign to know Mydei was in fact awake and willing to reply to Phainon.


Mydei; ? No.
Mydei; I think you misunderstood me last night.
Phainon; oh.
Phainon; oh my god really
Mydei; Yes. I am quite fond of children.
Mydei; Due to my appearance, however, I am not fond of talking to children whose parents I do not know.
Mydei; I am well aware of the looks I receive from parents due to my tattoos.
Mydei; I’ve no desires of starting qualms where I can avoid them.
Phainon; oh.
Phainon; ohhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh my god
Mydei; ? What?
Phainon; nothing. sorry for the weird question. have a nice day, see you later.
Mydei; You will be gone before my shift starts.
Phainon; hehe… maybe so..
Mydei; ? 

“He might actually be almost perfect and I’m an idiot.” Phainon mumbled as he resumed his stance of slamming his forehead into the desk.

“Oh? Almost perfect?” 

Phainon sat up quickly at that, blinking at the blonde beta who only gave him a pitying look as she stared down towards him. 

“What makes Mydei not perfect then for you?” Aglaea continued curiously, putting a finger to her chin as if this was suddenly the most interesting topic in the world while they were slow today. 

Phainon could only offer a weak smile, looking away nervously to the pen of dogs to the side; As if they could help him in this situation. “Differing opinions on cats.”

Aglaea only shrugged before placing another stack of papers beside Phainon on the desk, and Phainon really hadn’t expected he would have any paperwork to deal with when he signed up for working at a dog and cat cafe, and yet.. 

“It’s not like he owns one himself. If anything, the fact you like him means you could put up with owning a cat anyway.” Aglaea mused, with a small breath that was almost a laugh, but not quite there, more pitying than anything Phainon supposed. 

“.. That’s true.” Phainon conceded, there had indeed been no cats in Mydei’s apartment. Just a really tired and sick lion.. And that addictingly sweet scent that had Phainon bordering on the line of delirium all night long during their date. It took a lot of convincing to will himself to take a shower in the morning. He wanted Mydei’s scent to stay on his neck for weeks as a source of comfort.. Alas.. 

“Honestly, I’m quite surprised Mydei has been this nice to you.” Aglaea continued on, fully unaware of Phainon’s inner turmoil and bold actions he once again inflicted on Mydei last night, but that certainly did garner his attention as he snapped his gaze to her once again. 

“Huh?”

Aglaea as she leaned on the desk eyed him for a brief moment before shrugging her shoulders, brushing a lock of hair back off her forehead elegantly. “I don’t ever remember him befriending a single other alpha before you. I guess your docile temperament really compliments his own.”

“He’s normally super aggressive to other alphas?”

“I wouldn’t say that.. He’s.. It’s more like they get possessive around him.”

Phainon knit his brows over that before swallowing hard before looking away from Aglaea and back to the papers on the desk that he was assuredly going to have to face once again once his break ended. 

Aglaea didn’t miss that for even a beat of a second as she breathed out a sigh, “I meant towards other people, not him , Phainon.”

“R..Right.”

“.. Poor Mydei. You’re saying the first alpha he’s befriended is also one that’s trying to court him?” Castorice muttered as she passed by hurriedly before opening the dog pen and entering it with swift movements. Movements Phainon only watched with a flabbergasted expression.

“Whose team are you on here..?” Phainon mumbled out before stalling in his own thoughts again.

He hadn’t ever been on a date before.

That date with Mydei was his first with Mydei, and his first ever in general. And with how he acted in the cafe and angering Mydei quite obviously with the scenting, he wasn’t sure if Mydei would be kind enough to grace him the chance of a second date. He was actually fucked..

Phainon instead let out a weak groan as he heard the clicking off Aglaea’s heels as she turned away to leave them both in the front. Done with her delivery it seemed. 

“I’m going to bake him a loaf of bread.”

Castorice made a garbled snorting noise across the room, nearly immediately losing it before she quieted herself down slightly, “I’m sorry? You’ll do what?”

Phainon stood at that, mainly to stretch his limbs loosely before he flashed her a small grin, one that he meant with good intentions but one she knew very well to be evil in nature.

“Aglaea said food is Mydei’s love language, and he likes baking. So! If I bake him bread it will surely warm his heart.”

Castorice however, kneeling in the dog pen, could only give him a look he could call ‘horrified’ over those words.

“You.. Are a horrible cook, Phainon. We all know that, even he knows that.. You won't just warm his heart.. You'll make it stop beating completely.” 

Phainon moved his hands dramatically at that, attempting to motion how serious he was even though he was absolutely ignoring that stop beating part, “Exactly! He’ll know how much he means to me that I would try to make him something and find it endearing! At least I hope.” Phainon explained, giving her a small thumbs up, “Everyone loves bread right? I could follow a guide!”

Castorice only continued her rather blank and horrified stare before she slowly moved to focus wholly back onto the husky that was rolling for her attention. A small noise came from her, one Phainon knew very well due to his days of practicing it. Fake sniffling.

“Mydei is going to eat bread and die soon..” Castorice weakly told the dog in front of her before scratching their ear lovingly. And Phainon could only feign the agony of his friend having no trust in him with a pathetic sounding groan leaving his lips.

“So.. That’s a no on helping me taste test the bread I make for him?” Phainon slowly inquired as he leaned onto the desk with his hands, blinking the biggest puppy-eyes he could manage. Ones that Castorice was very easily immune to by now.

“I shall pray for Mydei’s safety and wellbeing if he actually indulges in your bread, I however am not eating your baked poison.”

Chapter End Notes

mydei has a crush on his co-worker..

Mydei didn’t work today.

And that meant it was a terribly boring day off for him. 

He once hadn’t cared - He preferred the silence and the alone time, he thrived in it even. But now he couldn’t shake this weird feeling of loneliness that was eating into him, that was seeping into his bones each time he checked his phone and found no notifications. Phainon had even left him on read, and it had been many hours since then.. 

Mydei considered at first maybe he was swamped at work, understandable, everyone did dump  their paperwork onto the alpha who accepted it with a much too bright smile each time.. Until about ten minutes later when he realized Phainon also did not work today. 

Mydei could only figure his plan to show Phainon that he didn’t have a crush had worked out perfectly.

If only the thought of that didn’t annoy him slightly. 

Mydei could only scroll through social media and seek cat videos to clear his mind of whatever weird feelings he may have. He didn’t want to dwell on them too much.

He didn’t have to, instead blinking at the notification banner above his beloved cat photos before tapping into it curiously. 

>> Aglaea has added Mydeimos to the chat.

Aglaea: Good afternoon Mydeimos, while I did not wish to seek you out on your day off, Fate is never kind. 

Castorice; … We have a situation.

Mydei felt his face drag into a scowl over that as he tapped the back of his phone case and readjusted himself on his couch. If it was just Aglaea, he would have assumed she was asking him to come into work. But Castorice being in the chat too..? 

Mydei; What is it?

Castorice; We have to figure out what to do with Phainon.

Mydei paused at the mention of the man that had ceased communication with him today, tilting his head at that text message. 

Mydei; ? What?

Aglaea; He started a fire in his kitchen while baking bread, apparently, and they’re evicting him. 

Mydei; What?

Aglaea; It is the third time he has set it on fire.

Mydei; ?

Castorice; He was trying to bake you bread..

Mydei slowly moved to pinch at the bridge of his nose over that, closing his eyes for a moment to try to comprehend how and why the hell this had become a situation?

Mydei; I feel like all I’ve said since being added is ‘what’, but I’ll go ahead and say it again. What?

Aglaea; Not to worry, if he hadn’t caught his apartment on fire he may have served you literal poison instead. This is the better outcome. 

Mydei’s confusion almost made his head hurt over this ‘baking bread for him’ shit. What on Earth did they mean by that? Was it some kind of.. Euphemism he was painfully unaware of?


 Mydei; This doesn’t explain why he was making me bread in the first place? When did I say I wanted bread?

Castorice; He is unwell.

Aglaea; He is unwell. 

Mydei; ?

Mydei knew that. If his interactions with the fellow alpha that seemed fond of scenting Mydei had told him anything; It was that Phainon was horribly ‘unwell’ . 

Mydei; So what is the issue outside of his idiocy?

Castorice; We have to rehome him.

Mydei; Why did you phrase that like he’s a pet dog? He can get a hotel.

Aglaea; He cannot.

Aglaea; Hotels require you to fill out your rut and heat cycles so that you are not a potential risk to their company.

Mydei; You’re implying his rut is soon, then?

Aglaea; According to him, quite. Maybe even simply later today.

Mydei; … He has horrible timing with being a complete moron. 

Aglaea; The issue arises of finding someone willing to house him during his rut as well.

Aglaea; Even as betas and my trust in Phainon, I do know how he acts during his rut.

Mydei sighed before dragging a hand through his hair roughly, the idea of spending time around another alpha that was deluding themself into being interested in Mydei in his own home for days on end felt.. Insane. The fact it would be during his rut as well was even worse. Without his apartment and his scent everywhere, Phainon would probably be feral having to smell another alpha everywhere. 

Phainon would be pissed off his entire rut smelling Mydei, and Mydei would have to deal with it every time he came home. 

Wonderful.
 Mydei; I see. 

Mydei; You want me to put up with him and his rut?

Aglaea; Or we could debate who is least likely to get mauled by him.

Aglaea; And I don’t think you win that debate, Mydeimos.

Mydei; ? Because of his ‘crush’ on me? 

Castorice; Why is crush in quotes like you don’t believe it.. That man wants you so very badly..

Mydei; He really doesn’t.

Aglaea; Mydeimos’s denial aside..

Mydei; ?

Aglaea; I do believe at the least, Mydeimos is a better fit between us to fight off any advances Phainon may make towards him.

Mydei; Does he not have any other friends to ask? He barely knows me.

Aglaea; They’re all betas and omegas.

Mydei paused at that. That made sense, honestly. Considering Phainon had a guest room, he most likely had over people he enjoyed having sex with all the time - And just simply never mated them. It wasn’t out of the ordinary to think about a pretty and outgoing alpha like him easily having hundreds of people willing to fuck him. Finding someone that would treat him normal during his rut was probably a rather tall order. 

Mydei; … Right.

Mydei; I’ll ask, but I don’t have a guest room. He probably won’t want to suffer around me for such a long period either.

Castorice; He will want to.

Aglaea; He will want to.

Aglaea; Also. He was quite nervous and refused to even dare ask you, so good luck with that.

Mydei; ? Then I have my answer already.

Aglaea; That’s not what I mean.

Mydei; He doesn’t want to. What else could it mean?

Castorice; Mydei..

Mydei scoffed at that, instead clicking off his phone and chucking it to the end of his couch. He was quite sure that man would easily find someone willing to house him and most likely help him along in his rut instead of being forced to deal with Mydei. 

Whatever.

It was less of an issue for Mydei to deal with, he figured as he picked up his earlier discarded book and began to read it again. 

Mydei wished he could claim he sat there and read for hours, passing by the time easily. Instead he hadn’t, he had instead immediately fallen asleep and taken a cat nap for a solid two hours before waking up due to a crick in his neck. Probably due to his head hanging off the couch.. He slowly cracked it before leaning to get his phone lazily. Blinking a yawn away as he looked at the mess of unread notifications he had to backread through.

Aglaea; I assure you. He wants to, he just doesn’t want to burden you either.

Castorice; I agree with Aglaea.

Aglaea; Mydeimos?

Castorice; Mydei? Are you there?

>> Aglaea has added Phainon to the chat.

Aglaea; Mydei, are you there now?

Castorice; Sheesh, he really thought Phainon wanted nothing to do with him and tapped out immediately..

Phainon; h...huh? when did i say anything like that!!!! thats nowhere near what i feel about him??

Castorice; Can you not scroll up?

Phainon; no?? I can only see up to where you guys added me..

Aglaea; Ah. Well. Mydei was going to offer to let you stay at his apartment, assumed you wouldn’t want to due to a lack of a guest room. We said you felt nervous asking, he immediately decided that was a ‘no’ from you, and stopped replying to us around an hour ago.

Phainon; he was going to what

Phainon; mydei are you there?

Phainon; this is legitimately the worst day of my life im convinced lolllllll 😔😔

Aglaea; You’re so dramatic. I’m willing to bet he went to sleep.

Castorice; I’ll bet on that.

Phainon; mydei.. wake up sleepy head..

Mydei heaved out a sigh at that, before tapping out and looking at his messages with Phainon instead. They were.. Certainly more lively now. Or well, were. Phainon hadn’t sent too many messages compared to normal. Probably busy moving in with someone for the time being, so Mydei didn’t quite blame him for the lack of messages today.

Along with his apartment catching on fire.. He clearly had bigger issues to deal with than messaging a fellow alpha on his day off.

Phainon; SORRY FOR THE LATE REPLY

Phainon; today has been the worst. i think i have to pack up cooking for good..

Phainon; ANYWAY havent really had a chance to catch my breath, i hope your day is going well!

Mydei opted to ignore those, instead tapping into the group chat slowly. He really didn’t know what to say, surely they had already figured everything out by now and didn’t even require his input by now. Against his better judgement, he still found himself politely offering again.

Mydei; I was asleep.

Mydei; He can still stay with me if he wants, but I assume someone else has given him a guest bedroom by now.

Mydei stared at his phone for a few moments, waiting, but no one replied out of the three in there. Since he was asleep for a good two hours, he easily figured Phainon had called up someone to house him and ease his rut for him. Mydei almost clicked off his phone again, almost turned on the volume this time, and almost threw it once more before doing other things.

Almost.

Aglaea; Hello Mydeimos. The dog is on his way.

Mydei; ? The dog?

Castorice; Phainon.

Aglaea; Phainon.

Phainon; meeee 😊

Mydei; Oh. Alright. So he is staying at my place?

Aglaea; It would seem that way, not to worry. If he wrongs you I will kill him.

Mydei; It’s fine. He’s just banned from my kitchen.

Aglaea; Rightfully so.

Castorice; All kitchens thank you.

Phainon; thats fair

Mydei didn’t reply to their agreements, instead opening that man’s damn messages again. 

Mydei; Do you need my address?

Phainon; nope!! I remember 

Mydei; Oh.

Phainon; is it weird that i remember it

Phainon; i change my mind. i forgot. send it to me.

Mydei; I’m making dinner. Figure it out yourself.

Mydei; Door is unlocked though. Just come in.

Phainon; 😭okay thank you 💙


──────────────

Phainon was exhausted.

Between catching his apartment on fire, being told that was his last strike, and then having to hurriedly move all his belongings into storage; His day had been hell on earth. The absolute worst. 

It shouldn’t have been! 

He had a clear goal in mind; To give Mydei a gift from his heart! 

It was common for alphas to give gifts when attempting to court other people, he was no better! He wanted to give Mydei a gift he would probably enjoy and now he had just become a burden to him instead. He could only curse himself for this, if his natural rut wasn’t so soon he would have stayed at a hotel and never told a soul.. But what was he supposed to do!?

Now he could only look out the window of Aglaea’s car as she drove him pathetically to Mydei’s apartment with the meager supplies he was bringing along for daily life.

Don’t get him wrong, living with Mydei for even just a bit was a dream come true for him here. 

But as much as a dream it was, it was a nightmare! 

His fingers gripped into his own skin and threatened to draw blood as he so much as thought about spending his rut around Mydei. Around Mydei during all his freetime.. Basking in Mydei’s scent constantly. There was no way he was actually going to stay sane. Mydei’s pheromones even off his rut made him want to tackle Mydei - To lick his scent glands, to taste him, to sink his teeth into him, ravish him, pleasure him in ways he didn’t know possible as an alpha, show him that even with their secondary gender being the same they could mak-

“Phainon, I don’t know what you’re thinking about. But let’s stop that and keep the approaching rut at bay while you’re still in the car with me.” Aglaea said as she looked at him through her rearview mirror, a delicate arched brow told Phainon all he needed to know about the pheromones he was producing at his thoughts in the backseat. 

“.. Sorry.” Phainon weakly mumbled before looking out the window at the passing buildings, eyes barely registering them as they zoomed by. He was doomed. His heart felt like it was going to strangle him by how stuck in his throat it was when he thought about living with Mydei. 

“Try to behave yourself around him, won’t you?” Came Aglaea’s rather knowing voice, as if she knew he was falling down the spiral of thinking about that damned beautiful alpha yet again. 

“.. You know that’s going to be hard for me.. I’ll do my best!” Phainon attempted to perk up, attempted to put on his normal dazzling smile, all that only fell flat judging by the shake of Aglaea’s head in the front seat.

“You are incredibly erratic and almost violent in your rut, I trust him the most to punch you into a wall for it.”

“.. There’s a reason why I didn’t want to ask him. We should have warned him..”

“I know.” Came Aglaea’s lackluster reply, one that was remarkably flat as she focused on the road. No intentions on actually telling Mydei how Phainon was during it and Phainon could only retrieve his phone and debate it between his fingers. 

“I don’t know if I’ll be aggressive towards him for once as well during it.. I really hope not..” Phainon mumbled as he looked at his black screen, giving a deep sigh before clicking it on and typing in his passcode.

Phainon; mydei

Phainon; im actually really aggressive and violent on my rut.

Phainon; its why i was scared to ask you i really will die if im mean to you

Mydei; Whatever.

Phainon; whatever ???

Mydei; I’ll throw you through the window if I need to.

Phainon; haha.. that somehow does make me feel better..

Mydei; 👍K.

Phainon; that doesnt.

“I hope not for both of your sakes, as well.” Aglaea sighed out, clearly noticing his frantic typing as she continued on with a few spared glances to him in the backseat. “Just try not to get on Mydeimos’s bad side, please.”

Phainon laughed at that, he really didn’t want to be thrown from the second story, that was sure. Angering the only person that had ever made him desire more from romance.. That was a fate worse than death. “Wasn’t aware he had a bad side.”

Aglaea scoffed lightly, as if that was the most amusing thing she had heard all morning if Phainon ignored how loudly she laughed hearing he caught his kitchen on fire. Again. For the third time this year.

“He’s an alpha.”

Wish he wasn’t.

Those were the words Phainon wished he could say to that, and maybe he would have if he wasn’t rather sure Aglaea would throw him out of the car while it was still moving if he did..

“Mm.” Was the more normal noise he opted for instead.

“You’re lucky you’re not already on it. He must actually like you.”

Phainon’s brain short-circuited just a tad over that. “Like me?”

“Maybe not in the way you’d prefer just yet, but yes, I do think he has grown fond of you in his own way.” Aglaea explained with a shrug as both hands remained firmly on the wheel, “He wouldn’t let you stink up his territory on your rut otherwise..”

Phainon didn’t even attempt to stop the beaming smile he felt creeping onto his lips as he tucked his phone away again. “If that’s the case, I’m taking this small praise in stride!”

“Don’t do that, I fear what that may cause for Mydeimos... Regardless. We’re here.” Aglaea immediately shot him down dryly, making sure to silence his half-started refusal of it ‘going to his head at all’ before it left his lips. “Get out of my car, it’s already going to smell like you for the next week.”

“Hehe. Sorry.” Phainon said flatly, as he bent across the set to withdraw his rather heavy backpack. He certainly had stuffed his clothes into it like a pack rat before Aglaea had come to the storage unit and immediately unpacked him with a scowl on her face, and then repacked his belongings nicely.. Phainon couldn’t help the way he beamed, the way his heart thudded over Mydei being so caring and motherly, he truly was not built to be an alpha, it was almost a shame. Phainon couldn’t find anything but pure affection for Mydei in his heart regardless of that fact however. 

“Alright alright, I’ll be back.. ” Phainon sighed out, standing from the chair slowly to excuse himself as he simmied away, looking back to watch that alpha. To stare at the way his muscles seemed evident beneath his sleeves - To look at that neck that was so deserving of Phainon’s claim, golden eyes that were only looking at cleaning up the dishes Phainon had used. 

“In a normal shirt, I assume.” Mydei practically hissed out, not bothering to meet Phainon’s eyes that watched his every move, instead simply moving to put away the lasagna again.

“As normal as possible, Mydei!”

“.. That’s worrying from your mouth.”

Chapter End Notes
