Chapter Notes

i think in a more gentle world mydei would be heavily against hurting people. he wasn't born for strife - he was born for cooking and going to the clubbbbbbbbb.
now all of you here must suffer due to my hc for him.
light angst. gl

Mydei tried his best to ignore it.

Really.

He did.

But the way Phainon was practically glued to his arm, holding it against his own chest in a tight grip and rubbing his head on Mydei’s shoulder every chance he got  - It was beyond impossible to ignore him or the stares they were getting as they leisurely ‘walked’. His arm was more like a leash to his pet dog, if anything..

The other concerning fact was the way Phainon was bristling. The way he was borderline sneering and immediately giving off a scent Mydei could only draw lines to being protective over an assumed mate, and well. As much as Mydei wanted to deny it, the current situation told him there was no denying it was over him of all people - Even if that fierce scent made Mydei’s own hair stand on end at the challenge. 

A challenge that Phainon didn’t seem even aware Mydei knew was out there, a challenge that was utterly insane; Phainon only snuggled into him as closely as possible while inviting Mydei to try to thrash him if Mydei even dared get near... To Mydei. 

What a life.

Mydei slowed his steps, they hadn’t even gotten to the park yet and the way Phainon kept practically growling at anyone that passed was insane - Mydei couldn’t even wrap his head around it.

“Phainon.” Mydei mumbled out as he stopped walking, Phainon easily followed his pace and stopped with him - He was attached to Mydei’s arm after all. And while that was beyond embarrassing, the way Phainon was seemingly two seconds away from mauling people was way worse. 

“Yes, Mydei?” Phainon answered, his tone not matching his current scent - Not in the slightest. It was gentle and warm, and so very sweet to Mydei’s ears as Phainon only remained clinging onto him as if he was terrified someone may tear Mydei from him. 

“Are you.. Okay?” Mydei could only fathom to ask that as he looked at Phainon on his right, so close to him, still pressing his head into Mydei’s shoulder as if it somehow would abruptly lose his scent if he stopped. 

“I’m great!” Deep ocean blue eyes immediately met gold at that, holding contact as Phainon did in fact - Seem great. He was almost beaming while they stood in the middle of the sidewalk with Phainon practically wagging his tail over Mydei even looking at him. 

Mydei shook his head at that, almost disapprovingly over those words. He couldn’t figure out how to fully process the way Phainon was acting, he was beaming and smiling at Mydei - sure. But he was also giving off a scent that was extremely territorial, even Mydei’s inner alpha was wanting to bite into the challenge.

It was an annoying itch in Mydei’s head he couldn’t scratch.

“Are you? You’re almost snarling at random people we pass by.” Mydei inquired with a sigh, eyes only wandering away from the fellow alpha to instead look at the distant park. He had only wanted to walk and get some fresh air - but the air was anything but fresh due to how Phainon was being so defensive.

“I’m fine, Mydei! I promise.” Phainon said that, sure, but Mydei wasn’t blind. He could still see even as Phainon smiled and beamed at him - those eyes were darting about to watch any other person that came near, protectively gripping onto Mydei for dear life. 

“.. Right.” Mydei mumbled, instead beginning to walk away as he gave up and chose to drop the damn topic. He would get nowhere with Phainon while he’s in denial about it, anyway. 

Mydei let them fall into silence over that - Phainon seemed satiated enough with random people passing by so long as he was allowed to keep Mydei’s arm. And Mydei wasn’t strong enough to deny it was a little endearing how protective Phainon was over him - even if his inner alpha wanted to slap him upside the head just a tad.

“You smell so good today, you know?” Mydei didn’t even stop walking at those words registered in his head, if anything, Phainon seemed very consistent in thinking Mydei smelled good. He had given up even trying to rationalize such an odd thing for an alpha to think about him.

“Do I? More than normal to you?” Mydei asked rather mindlessly, only thankful now to see the greenery of the leaves of the park as they entered it. Anything but the walls of the city surrounding them as they went - too many people and Phainon really did seem rather unwell. Was he still just.. Suffering from his rut in such an odd way?

Mydei couldn’t say - he had never stuck around another alpha for their rut, nor did he really know if he had ever been so possessive over someone on his own rut.

“Mm.. Maybe it’s because I can compare it to other people now..” Phainon answered almost quietly, and Mydei didn’t even halt his stride as Phainon once again pushed his own forehead into Mydei’s shoulder - obviously sniffing at him. A part of Mydei wanted to press a hand to his face and shove him away, yet another part of him felt a flutter of embarrassing feelings towards that act. 

Mydei cleared his throat instead; “I don’t think I smell any different, so.. Maybe?”

Mydei did however, halt his steps as he recognized someone coming closer, her lips painted red and curved into a smile as she too, shared the recognition. One of his old customers for his baking hobby - a beta. 

“Oh! Mydei!” Her voice easily rang out as she hurried her steps closer, and Mydei was achingly aware of the way Phainon had tensed up - gone rigid while holding onto Mydei. He could feel those hands wrap around his biceps tighter, like he was suddenly being threatened. 

“Hello.” Mydei chose to greet back, attempting to be as warm as possible as he watched her eyes flicker from him and to the other, clear, obvious, alpha latched onto his arm. Though, her smile never faded - most likely writing Phainon off as just playing around with Mydei, or something like that Mydei figured.

“How have you been doing? I still dream of eating your red velvet cake again, you know?” She happily told him, and Mydei was very painfully aware of the way he could feel Phainon’s hand twitch at that - even while clinging onto Mydei’s own arm already. 

Mydei shifted slightly, trying minisculely to tug his arm from Phainon, but that only spurred on the opposite effect, if anything as Phainon moved slightly closer to him. 

“Ah. I’ve been alright, thanks for asking.” Mydei said as normally as he could, trying his best to seem normal with a giant bristling alpha attached at his hip. 

“Will you open up orders again one day?” She innocently asked - though Mydei watched her blue eyes darting between Mydei and Phainon - bright blue, somehow haunting him.

“Maybe if I have the time.. Started helping a friend’s business.. This is my co-worker; Phainon.”

“Nice to meet you, Phainon!”

“.. Nice to meet you, too.” For once, Phainon hadn’t even tried to seem thrilled like normal, he sounded almost cold, distant.

“Uh..” She wasn’t a fool however, immediately picking up on his strangeness and instead returning a soft smile to Mydei, one that bordered on weariness. “Let me know if you ever open up baking orders again, Mydei. I have to get going now!”

Mydei could only turn slightly, watching as she quickly passed by them both rather flustered. Mydei could easily imagine why based off Phainon’s scent. She was doomed to think he was aggressive as all hell - and Mydei couldn’t even tell her he wasn’t. He wasn’t sure what Phainon’s headspace was currently. 

“Alright. Take care.” Mydei said after her, before giving a loud and rather dramatic sigh as he looked back to Phainon - at the way Phainon was still bristling almost towards her as she went. Mydei couldn’t even shake his unease over the way Phainon was watching her - making sure she truly left before his eyes met Mydei’s. 

“.. Side business?” Phainon asked, his voice still teetering on the lines of anger and Mydei could only shrug weakly over it; Not even quite sure why Phainon had swapped his mood so easily. The sneaking suspicion that he was still territorial due to his rut was clawing into Mydei’s mind. He really should get this man home and away from people before Phainon lashed out..

“Mainly for fun. I barely charged anything outside of what the cost of making it was.” Mydei explained easily, it was true. Baking and selling what he made was his hobby for years - nothing any deeper than that. 

“Really?” Phainon sounded less than convinced, his hands still tightly wound around Mydei’s arm in almost a worrying way - Mydei couldn’t help but crease his brows as he watched Phainon. Watching the way he shifted uncomfortably - unconvinced of it. 

“.. Yes.” Mydei slowly said, his eyes still trailing the man who looked rather upset or distraught now;  “You.. Are you alright?”

“She was just.. Very friendly with you. It’s surprising.”

Was it surprising? It’s not like Mydei was usually mean to people, sure, he himself knew he wasn’t the most outgoing, but he didn’t have bad relations with most either. 

“I’ve always been polite to my returning customers, it’s not surprising.” Mydei nearly mumbled out, blinking at the white haired man that still appeared rather miffed over it all. Mydei really couldn’t wrap his mind around it. If anything.. Phainon was treating him like he was some type of unmated omega..

“.. Why didn’t you charge her much?” Phainon asked, blue eyes holding contact with gold and Mydei could only move his free hand that wasn’t being held hostage by Phainon through his hair, threading through it lazily with a huff. 

“It wasn’t her specifically. I didn’t charge anyone much. It was just a hobby and pastime - I don’t need money.” Mydei wasn’t even sure why he felt the need to defend himself so much here - this wasn’t Phainon’s business and it certainly wasn’t very deep. 

“.. Mm.”

Mydei could only heave out a deeply exasperated sigh over the clear unhappy sounding tone Phainon was humming in - somehow. 

“Phainon.” 

“Yeah?”

“Are you.. Jealous?” Mydei knew the answer, but he asked anyway, watching as Phainon for once unhooked his hands from Mydei, leaning away slightly to blink at him - expression somewhat blank and indecipherable as he did so. 

“No.”

Mydei rolled his shoulders, giving a smile over that; “Your scent disagrees, you know?” 

“Did you think she was pretty?” Mydei lightly teased, mainly because well, if he had learned anything, Phainon was clearly dead set on saying his scent was due to his affection for Mydei. 

“.. Mydei.” Phainon’s voice alone let Mydei know he didn’t share the teasing joking mood of Mydei asking that question.

And nothing had prepared Mydei for the way Phainon’s mood had utterly and completely flipped - no longer a clingy puppy, and instead shoving Mydei to the side harshly, so quickly and awkwardly that Mydei practically tripped over the bushes Phainon shoved him into. Mydei couldn’t stop himself from hitting the floor with his back - knocking the breath out of him. 

Of course he couldn’t stop his fall, not with the way Phainon chased after him to straddle him easily.

“Phainon?” Mydei choked out slightly, more confused and baffled over the sudden mood change, completely lost on why he needed to be shoved into the bushes in general. 

“You..” Phainon’s voice was remarkably quiet, confusingly so to Mydei’s ears with how strained he sounded. Barely put together, like he was fighting some kind of urge now - And Mydei wasn’t really desiring to hear out whatever urge that was. 

“Get off of me.” Mydei hissed out, still rather laying there regardless as Phainon only tilted his head at him. For a brief second, Mydei was slightly worried that he was being mauled by another alpha and would actually have to thrash Phainon - but those ocean blue eyes.. 

They were regarding Mydei like he was some kind of fragile treasure. 

“No.. Mydei..” Phainon’s voice still kept that same level of volume, like he was trying to make sure no one caught them in the literal bushes where Phainon had shoved Mydei into. And Mydei could only find himself blinking, studying the way Phainon was staring at him, the way Phainon had been acting towards him.. 

“You said..” Mydei cleared his throat slightly, trying to put his thoughts into words. “My scent smells really good to you, right? Like an omega?”

“Mm..” Came Phainon’s poor nonresponsive answer, still unmoving as he had Mydei trapped beneath him, head still remaining tilted as he took in the words Mydei was trying to convey to him. 

“So.. You’re an alpha in the end phase of his rut, with someone you perceive as an omega.” Mydei tried to reason with him - as if that was possible in this state. Phainon was still rather clearly off his shits, even if he was dead set on disagreeing with the sentiment.

“You’re mine..” Phainon murmured softly, and Mydei only found himself rolling his eyes as that with a deep pained sigh. 

Mydei stared at him - expression completely deadpan as he found himself leaning into the grass. He clearly had to de-escalate whatever was Phainon’s issue, regardless of the reasoning. “.. Right. Whatever, but we need to get you home.”

“Home.” Phainon echoes that in a way like he’s amused almost by it - which was fair. Phainon technically didn’t actually live there, it was Mydei’s home, not his. 

“Away from everyone else you’re trying to maul.” Mydei mumbled out, more so to correct himself since Phainon seemed to have gotten lost upon that one incorrect word being used.

Phainon took a few moments to debate something, eyes never once glancing away from Mydei beneath him; “Mydei.. I want you again.” 

Mydei didn’t miss a beat however, he honestly had expected something as crude as that to leave Phainon’s mouth anyway. The alpha was clearly delirious and not thinking straight still - those feelings about having sex the first time were yet again creeping into Mydei’s skull. 

“Phainon, we are in public.” Mydei growled out instead, trying to choke back those feelings, it was hopeless - really. Until Phainon was truly off of his rut and able to think clearly, Mydei wouldn’t be able to shake them. 

“I’ll be quick..”

Mydei only snorted at those words;  “You absolutely won’t be, let’s go home, Phainon.”

Phainon knitted his brows at that, dissatisfied by his response obviously before giving a rather pouty look to Mydei; “Can I bite you first.. Just a little..”

“Bite me..?” Mydei could only blink at that, over that extremely bizarre request - though it added up. Leaving marks on Mydei probably would satisfy his possessive alpha behaviors he was exhibiting on the walk. “Fine. Only if you’ll agree to go home with me with no issues.”

“.. I agree to that.”

Mydei wasn’t ready for that reply. 

He thought he was, but he wasn’t. Instead Phainon immediately grabbed him extremely roughly, a force he hadn’t been expecting by a long shot as Phainon flipped him almost easily onto his chest - Nearly knocking the air out of him. His entire vision felt disorientated from the quickness of it as he tried to focus on what was happening. 

Mydei found his fingers gripping into the grass beneath him before immediately attempting to stand up. An attempt immediately thwarted by Phainon sitting back down into the straddling position again with his entire weight on Mydei’s lower back.

Mydei nearly groaned at the air being pressed out of him before he snapped his head to the side to bite out his annoyed words - To tell Phainon he was actually going to kill him, only Phainon only met his gaze with half-lidded eyes as a hand found its way onto the back of Mydei’s head to gently press it back down to the grass.

“Phainon?”

Mydei jolted as soon as he said that word, feeling the man in question’s finger immediately dip below the collar, tugging his shirt down slightly. Mydei wanted to question where the hell he was going to bite him - Wanted to tell him to hurry up and get off of him. He wanted to do many things.

“You’re an alpha.. So this is fine, right?”

Mydei blinked at the question, trying to mull over what the hell he meant by that.

“I already said yes, just get on with it so we can go home.” Mydei hissed back his reply, growing more and more frustrated with the position he was being held in - his secondary gender already beginning to bite at his mind. 

However, his mind only blanked out those thoughts as he felt it.

Those sharp fangs sinking into Mydei's nape.

Mydei couldn't even process his emotions as they swarmed into his head, he couldn’t. His entire body went rigid, taut, and high strung - Muscles screaming from how instantaneously he had gone so tragically stiff. Mydei could only open his mouth, leaving it agape, unsure if he wanted to insult or to start trying to bite Phainon’s head off.

Mydei’s entire body screamed at him - His vision now was beyond blurry if he even tried to focus, he needed to do something. Anything. He shouldn’t be claimed like this, forced into the floor and marked. He wasn’t built for this. He wasn’t. 

He needed to retaliate against Phainon.

He needed to teach him a lesson, how easy would it be to snap his bones? To thrust himself around to face him and crack a few of them under his knuckles? To make him never be so bold to do such a heinous thing to him again? 

Mydei could only give a low groan at his thoughts - At the way he felt Phainon’s tongue lap across his nape, across the mark he had just delivered onto Mydei. 

The only sane thing he could manage to do was slowly clenching his hands into fists, shallowly allowing himself to breathe. He desperately wanted to beat Phainon. 

“You’re so pretty like this.” Phainon quietly said, words that Mydei wasn’t sure if it was a compliment or not, but his inner alpha told him to attack him for it. For both crimes. 

“.. Get off of me.”

Mydei managed, with as much clarity as possible, for a man that wanted to strangle Phainon. Not even in a jest, his hands twitched to be wound around Phainon’s throat, to wrench his life from him. 

Phainon moved at that, he obeyed, but not nearly fast enough. Instead as soon as Mydei felt his weight shift off of him - Mydei rolled, immediately moving to punch a fist into Phainon’s ribs that met its mark easily. Mydei didn’t even bat an eye over the shocked expression Phainon made before gasping out spit over the hit, Phainon didn’t even have a chance to adjust before Mydei moved again.

This time landing a second punch to his face, directly into his jaw and lips and with that one Mydei easily felt something crack beneath his fingers. A feeling that made Mydei’s secondary gender almost purr in satisfaction of showing another alpha who was truly in charge here.

A feeling that didn’t last as Phainon staggered instead, falling to the ground while Mydei scrambled to his own feet - staring at the man with a heavy pant. Feeling like he had just ran miles - Not been forced to the ground and given a claiming bite while an alpha. Mydei could only stare at the baffled Phainon, he could only stare as those feelings wore off of him, hands twitching in sheer raw ache over how hard he had hit Phainon.

His eyes couldn’t help but watch the blood seep from Phainon’s busted and bruised lip, those feelings of rage abating quickly as it had come and now only all-consuming guilt was left in its wake. 

“That was the ho-”

Mydei didn’t want to hear it.

He couldn’t, as soon as Phainon seemed to have enough clarity to speak, Mydei quickly turned away and swiftly made for his own apartment. He couldn’t do this. He couldn’t.

“Mydei!”

Mydei didn’t want to hear that voice from behind, he didn’t. 

He just wanted to go home and try to forget about it all. 

“Mydei.” 

Mydei hated how much closer it sounded now, clearly running to catch up to him. Not willing to let him just leave and lock himself in his room, it seemed. 

“Mydei, wait!” Phainon practically pleaded as he passed Mydei, instead cutting off his direction of retreat by standing directly in front of Mydei - just a few feet away. Mydei could only figure that was to avoid being hit again by him.

“This is enough proof that two alphas cannot get along, Phainon.” Mydei almost growled out, returning to narrowing his eyes into sharpened daggers at the fellow alpha in front of him that seemed breathless - still extremely intent on blocking Mydei’s route with his own body as blue eyes seemed wide and panicked.

That alone made Mydei feel even more guilty - How easily had he been ruining this man’s life since meeting him? 

Golden eyes could only trace where blood was seeping from Phainon’s lip - his face already becoming swollen and red from the hit. 

“.. I don’t agree with that.” Phainon mumbled out darkly, brows knitting as he stared right back at Mydei.

“You’re actively drooling blood from your chin, and you want me to think anything besides that?” Mydei pointed out with almost a sigh, watching as Phainon moved a sleeve to wipe his own blood away, smearing it into an even more unsightly thing as he did so.

“Okay, and?” Phainon asked with a small laugh, his eyes looking at the blood on his sleeve before looking up at Mydei again, catching his gaze and only giving him a weak smile.

A pained smile - it obviously hurt to force his lips into that position.

Mydei couldn’t bite down the guilt over that. Over even just his normal smiles being painful for him due to Mydei. 

“.. And?” Mydei echoed out, his eyes only able to focus on the bleeding crack of Phainon’s lips. How was he supposed to focus on anything but the pain he had inflicted on Phainon?

“That was arguably the hottest thing that’s ever happened to me.” Those words leaving Phainon’s bloody lips only made Mydei’s eyes trail slightly upwards to look him in the eyes, searching for any hints of lying - any hints of ulterior motives or meanings.

He found nothing.

“What?” Mydei quietly whispered out, more baffled than anything over those words. 

“I mean it hurt a lot, but the way you looked at me was really hot..” Phainon admitted in a rather hushed tone, growing more embarrassed with each word as Mydei watched the growing color of red blossom on his face - much like the bruise of where Mydei’s fist had registered with his jaw.

“Are you insane?” Mydei further questioned him, raising a brow slowly. 

“Maybe!” Phainon most confusedly gave a sheepish laugh as he said that, light and airy - like he wasn’t bothered by any of it. 

Mydei didn’t share the sentiment.

“I actually wanted to snap your neck, Phainon. I wanted to..” Mydei couldn’t help the way his voice faltered, trailing off as he looked to the ground - he couldn’t even dare to think about why he felt that way. The burning on the back of his neck was something he was desperately trying to move out of his mind, desperately trying to keep his instincts squandered away. 

He didn’t want to hurt Phainon again.

“I get it.. I angered your secondary gender.. I’m really sorry.” Phainon said rather weakly, and Mydei could only blink at those ocean blue eyes - eyes that seemed to be pouting, pleading almost for Mydei to forgive him. 

“I’m the one that hit you, a mating bite doesn’t affect me. Why are you apologizing?” Mydei nearly growled out, he couldn’t help it - it was driving him insane, the way Phainon was so earnestly apologizing with a thin line of blood running from his lips still.

Mydei felt sickened by it - sickened by the fact he had hurt Phainon, and sickened by the way he felt some demented sense of pride in doing that to please his instincts.

“I overstepped with that bite, even if it doesn’t affect you.” Phainon pointed out, and Mydei agreed, but technically he did say yes - he wouldn’t if he was aware of where but.. That blood. Mydei could only grit his teeth over it. “And don’t worry about the hitting! Really, I’m fine!”

“You’re not fine, you are still bleeding.” Mydei practically was growling at this point, deep down he understood that both of them were at fault for different things but.. 

“Mydei, Honestly… I got hard from it, don’t worry about it, okay?”

Well.

That certainly did derail his thoughts a little, he would admit.

Mainly due to the absurdity of it, but still.

“You.. What?”

Phainon only shrugged, giving a light-hearted smile as he did so - as light-hearted as he could manage while still bleeding at least; “Yeah, so don’t worry about hitting me. I’m sorry I bit you there.”

“That’s.. Still not a good thing.. We can’t..” Mydei couldn’t help but trail off, more than just a bit stunned over the admittance, but it also still didn’t stop the fact Mydei had indeed hit him. Twice. Even if Phainon was somehow into it. 

“Why? Because your instincts made you lash out at me?” Phainon asked with a level of sincerity that made Mydei only shuffle uncomfortably, eyes flickering away from the man. He was impossible - the way Phainon’s scent had sweetened, like he was trying to soothe Mydei through it only added to Mydei’s guilt.

“It’s okay. If you ever let me bite you there again, I’ll just keep a better hold on you if hitting me makes you feel bad.”

Mydei clicked his tongue at that, looking back to the fellow alpha to try to glare at him, try being the keyword. It was remarkably hard with those blue eyes looking so very pouty with blood leaking from his lips. 

“That..” Mydei mumbled, giving a deep sigh;  “You’re really unwell, Phainon.”

“It’s hard to think around you, Mydei.” Phainon countered as he moved his hand again to wipe away blood once more, not even hesitating before nearing Mydei and taking hold on his arm again; “Let’s go home, yeah? Like I promised.”

Mydei didn’t have the heart to fight him on it, not the strength to try to yank his arm away from Phainon as the alpha started leading him away. 

He could only quietly mutter a “.. Yeah.” rather weakly under his breath as Phainon led him off.

The walk back was remarkably quiet between both of them, a rarity for Phainon to keep silent for so long - but Mydei easily figured his jaw would be killing him. Of course he’d stay quiet. Considering Mydei’s knuckle that he used to hit him ached, he was sure Phainon receiving the blunt of the blow hurt way, way more. And that alone made Mydei feel a sinking feeling of guilt with every step. 

Even as he opened his apartment door and let Phainon in, even as the man gave him a sweet smile, that guilt made him nauseous. He could only blink golden eyes away, anywhere but at Phainon.

“Take a shower.” Mydei chose to say immediately, which rightfully stunned Phainon.

“Mm?”

“Your scent is driving me crazy, in a bad way, mind you, and you have blood stains on your clothes.” And jaw. That addition died on his tongue as he looked away from Phainon, instead moving past him easily - moving to grab a drink from the kitchen.

“Ah!” Phainon said in that same happy voice, like he had already moved on from being hit. Like he wasn’t even bothered by it at all, and for some reason that only made Mydei feel worse. The pure understanding that Phainon was trying to not appear hurt for his own sake - made it worse.

“I’m sorry! I’ll be quick!” Mydei didn’t even blink at those words.

It was as if Phainon wasn’t allowed to feel his own pain due to knowing it would make Mydei feel guilty - but what was the point if Mydei already felt that way? 

He didn’t know.

“Don’t worry about it.” Mydei mumbled, throwing out his thoughts as he instead got a glass of apple juice tiredly - hovering in his own kitchen as he heard Phainon getting a change of clothes before ducking into the bathroom rather hurriedly. Mydei only moved when he actually heard the water turn on in his bathroom, flopping into his living room couch before digging out his phone from his pocket.

This was probably going to go badly, but he needed to tell someone, anyone that would hear him out. 

And so he tapped the group chat..

Mydei; I hit Phainon today. Twice. 

Aglaea; Oh.

Aglaea; Before I share my thoughts: Did he deserve it?

Mydei; He gave me a mating bite and I kind of lost it.

Aglaea; Oh.

Aglaea; Hit him a third time from me.

Aglaea; Wait. Did you say he could mark you?

Mydei; Technically, He asked if he could bite me and I said fine, if it would make him go back home and just to make him get off of me.

Aglaea; Ignoring whatever ‘make him get off of me’ means; He bit you there randomly?

Mydei; Yeah, I’m not mad about that. I’m upset at myself over hitting him.

Aglaea; Hit him a third time from me regardless.

Mydei; I wasn’t gentle with my punches. I actually wanted to snap his bones in half.

Aglaea; And how did he take it?

Mydei; .. I’d say too well honestly.

Castorice; wHAT DID I MISS?

Castorice; Woopsies! Caps lock.

Aglaea; Mydei, have you and Phainon been having sex during his rut?

Aglaea; Oh. Hello Castorice.

Castorice; WHAT???

Mydei; Er.. That’s kind of personal, isn’t it?

Castorice; OH MY GOD THEY HAVE BEEN???

Phainon; Mydei, I’m fine.  I know you have some negative feelings about recent events and I’m really sorry, I don’t want to upset you, but I don’t want to be apart from you either.. I’m the one that caused it to happen, I overstepped by a mile and you let me know that. It’s alright.
Your message could not be delivered.

Phainon; please dont lock me out, mydei
Your message could not be delivered.

Phainon; please….
Your message could not be delivered.

Phainon pocketed his phone at that - of course he wasn’t going to Aglaea’s house. He could never do that! His feet were moving on their own, quickly, borderline running to Mydei’s apartment. 

He didn’t even bother with the stupid little elevator to his floor - instead scaling the steps two at a time before practically sliding to Mydei’s apartment door.

Of course he tried to open it with the handle first - locked.

Option two was to start pleading with some knocking.

“Mydei! Please, open the door!” Phainon called against it, breathy and winded due to his run here. Almost panting - he wasn’t even sure if it was due to the run here or the fact Mydei was shutting him completely out. 

‘For his own health’ who gave a damn about that?!

“Mydei! I know you can hear me, please!”

Phainon didn’t!

He wanted this door open! 

He’d prefer being punched over Mydei punishing both of them like this!

“Please.. Mydei..”

It wasn’t fair.

Mydei wasn’t being fair with this - even if he thought it was better for both of their sakes.

“Mydei.. It’s my fault..”

Phainon wasn’t even sure when he started crying.

It didn’t make any sense to him.

He knew Mydei was upset he had hit Phainon, but Phainon wasn’t upset at him..

This was too cruel..

“I overstepped.. You didn’t do anything wrong, Mydei..”

Phainon wasn’t even sure if Mydei could hear him at this point.

Not with how Phainon was borderline whimpering out his words through his tears.

“I won’t do it again!” 

He wouldn’t.. He would never cause Mydei to feel such a level of regret.

He promises that much!

“So you’ll never act out on your instincts either! It’s fine!”

Phainon tried to reassure Mydei - he did.

Even if Mydei wasn’t listening to those words.

Phainon meant them.

“Mydei.. Please..”

He could only press his forehead to the door.

Weakly trailing his hand against the wood.

How was he supposed to comfort Mydei if the alpha wouldn’t even let him in..?

“I’m fine! It didn’t even hurt!” 

Phainon didn’t even know if lying was helpful or not right now.

It didn’t matter.

Mydei wasn’t listening to him anyway.

“Please let me in..”

Chapter End Notes

dog scratching outside the damn door.

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.html:
“It hasn’t gone away, has it?”

Mydei looked away at her words, focusing on the outside world beyond the glass windows - Anything but at the blonde woman across from him with this awful question she knew the answer to.

Mydei huffed, tugging at his scarf with his index fingers lightly, slightly downward - just a bit of breathing room in the stuffy coffee shop they were talking in. 

“No, It hasn’t.”

It wasn’t too cold out yet - but he still was wearing collared shirts and turtlenecks, or merely a scarf.

Because Phainon’s bite hadn’t healed at all on him.

It was bugging him, the way he had this constant reminder of Phainon on his neck - he shouldn’t. It should be gone by now, and yet it still looked the same as the day he shut Phainon out of his life two weeks ago. 

“Your dog must have rabies for it to last this long.” Mydei mumbled as he met her gaze again, moving lazily to take a sip of his hot chocolate. He wasn’t big on the way coffee made him feel, too buzzy and tingly in his body - and meeting up at a coffee shop, what else was he to buy as a drink?

“Well,” Her voice was soft, very aware of the fact she was dealing with a rather sensitive subject it seemed, “There’s a lot more wrong with him since you started ignoring his existence.”

“Mm.” Mydei looked away at that again, eyes focusing on nothing outside in particular - it was a sunny day, a nice day. He didn’t mind getting afternoon drinks with Aglaea, even if he had known this would be the topic. 

“He’s been moping over me longer than he even knew me.” Mydei pointed out, eyes still watching cars go by before he took another sip of his still rather burning hot chocolate. He couldn’t even really taste it yet through the sear of the liquid. Mydei could only set the styrofoam cup back down gently and lean against the back of his chair with a low sigh.

“And yet you miss him too.” Aglaea told him without a hint of malice, more exasperation, and at those words he moved his eyes back to her slowly.

He did.

He had been checking up on Phainon through Aglaea the entire time - wondering how he was doing, if he was doing better, or if he had moved on yet.

She never had any good answers for him - just more that made him feel even more guilty. 

He truly did think it was for the best for both of them; that two alphas couldn’t possibly be together - especially not with Mydei unable to control himself when Phainon wanted to claim him in such a deeply emotional way. 

Even if back then he didn’t even think the bite did anything - yet now as he looked at his neck every morning in the mirror with that lingering bite mark. He didn’t know what to think. He didn’t even think he was mad - if anything, he was baffled it was still there.

“That’s true.” Mydei muttered as his eyes looked at his cup before moving it leisurely - swirling the contents of it slightly. There wasn’t any point in lying, he asked about Phainon to Aglaea after all. 

“Then why keep causing pain to the both of you, Mydeimos?” 

Mydei pursed his lips over that - considering it. 

He didn’t have a great reason. He was usually very calm and in touch with his inner emotions - a person who was easily able to defuse situations and handle the rowdy or feisty emotions of others. So why did he have to struggle so much when Phainon was involved..?

“I can’t just show up and apologize. He would never accept it after what I did to him.” Mydei breathed out lowly, almost inaudible as he focused on her - on the way she was staring him down. Not her normal stares - it was uncharacteristically much softer, as if she fully understood that not even Mydei knew what to do currently. 

A rarity for him.

“Mydeimos, He would accept whatever apology you offered him in a heartbeat if it meant you would be in his life again, and deep down you know that.”

Mydei didn’t meet her eyes at that, instead dropping his gaze back to his cup to give it another slow swirl between his fingers. 

He did know that.

He had heard Phainon begging - pleading for him not to do it outside his door.

And yet Mydei did.

It’s not like he didn’t have regrets about it, he merely told himself it was for the best. That Phainon would move on and meet someone that wouldn’t be a risk to him - someone not also an alpha like himself.

“I don’t recall the last time he smiled, even.” Aglaea only carried on and Mydei moved to take a sip of his scalded hot chocolate - ignoring the pain of it burning his tongue to instead stare at the table where it formally was.

He knew that as well.

Aglaea had already talked about how she barely saw him doing anything outside of his job and going back to Aglaea’s home to sleep. 

She had already told Mydei about how he didn’t even really manage to give fake smiles to customers at work - like even trying to falsify his happiness was beyond painful for Phainon.

“Regardless, I regrettably must be on my way, Mydei.” Aglaea spoke out again after a few moments of silence, as if she was truly trying to let Mydei brew on his own sickening emotions on the matter. 

“Ah.” Mydei replied simply, watching as she stood up and slung her purse over her arm - she was remarkably casually dressed today - a simple blazer and skirt. Eyes that always twinkled when she smiled, even as she was smiling rather pityingly at Mydei currently. 

“Walk out with me, would you?” Aglaea invited him and well, Mydei had never been one to not accept Aglaea’s courtesy. 

“Sure.” Mydei agreed easily, standing to join her as she already began walking out of the shop easily - even with the bell of the door ringing after her and the employees saying goodbye to them both. 

She only stalled her steps immediately out of the doors to turn to him, head tilting as she gave him a very obvious one-over. One that Mydei felt almost judged under as he shifted his weight, hot chocolate still firmly in hand. 

“Give me your scarf.” She demanded, her hand extending towards him expectantly and well - he could only blink at that. 

“.. Huh?” Mydei said that word, sure, but he was already moving to remove it at her command, not really even debating it much because that would be doomed to be a losing fight for him. He knew that..

Aglaea moved to place a hand on her hip, only swaying the extended one slightly for dramatic effect as she raised an eyebrow at him; “You don’t need it, It’s warm out today and it’s clashing with your outfit.”

“.. Is it?” Mydei mumbled the inquiry, eyes flicking down to inspect himself. He was wearing a black shirt, jeans, and a dark brown cardigan.. He really didn’t know how a brown scarf was clashing with this.. 

“Yes.” Aglaea dryly said as he fully unraveled it, handing it to her slowly .

Only more stunned as she completely turned away at that, continuing on her merry way towards the direction of where she parked and Mydei found himself standing there blinking after her. 

“Wait,” Mydei called slowly, debating if his scarf was really worth trying to fight Aglaea over, or if he should just already start looking to buy a new one; “You’re just taking it?” 

“Yep, see you later Mydei.” Aglaea replied easily, not even turning to face him again as she walked away, the clacking of her heels echoing against the pavement as Mydei awkwardly shuffled his weight between his feet. 

“.. Huh.”

Mydei stood there watching her walk, just a few more moments before heaving out a sigh - Hand immediately drifting upwards to the back of his own neck to feel at that bite that was still there. Grazing lightly against the skin that had never healed, only able to feel it tingle over his touch.

“I need a new scarf..” 

──────────────

“Phainon.”

Phainon only curled into his blankets more at that - everything had been so horribly wrong lately. Nothing even felt real, no matter how much he knew it didn’t make sense. He had barely known Mydei, yet now there was a clear part of himself that left along with Mydei.

A piece of him he couldn’t even try to get back, anytime he tried to smile his thoughts drifted to that alpha - drifted to whoever might be making him smile instead of Phainon. Drifted to whoever might be his lover in life instead of Phainon.

Phainon had never had qualms with his secondary gender - if anything it was great, it had never truly given him many problems outside his ruts.

But now he wanted nothing more than to be anything else but an alpha.

He just wanted to be someone Mydei could love back. 

Phainon would do anything for that..

But no matter how hard he wanted or would, he couldn’t.

Mydei didn’t want an alpha. That much was clear now, and Phainon was just that.

And he couldn’t change that about himself. The one thing he had no control over was what drove a wedge between them, the one thing Phainon wasn’t able to change for the sake of Mydei..

All Phainon could do now is wilt away in bed and mourn the days that had never come to fruition due to his own greed towards Mydei - his own emotions that had fully won over him.

“I have a deal to make with you.” Aglaea continued when Phainon barely gave her any signs of life outside scrunching just a bit more pathetically into a ball. 

He had been looking for a new apartment, but it was rather hard to focus - and most were just out of his current price range (This is not Aglaea’s fault, he is aware he’s bad with spending his money.) or not even worth what they were charging..

He was really lucky with his last apartment..

That statement was.. Odd, however. 

“.. A deal?” Phainon echoed as he didn’t even turn around as she flicked on the light, instead snuggling more into the depths of his blankets to try to avoid the world leaking into his eyes again.

Everything was so much easier when he just slept and wasn’t awake to think about Mydei and how easily he had ruined everything with him. 

“Mhm.” Aglaea hummed, clearly, not intent on going anywhere; “You agree to come out of the house with me somewhere, and I’ll give you this.”

Phainon didn’t move at that, keeping his back to her as he debated declining - whatever she had, he probably didn’t want it.

Let alone to be taken somewhere to try to ‘get his mind off Mydei’ like last time, not even alcohol could stop his dizzying thoughts from drifting to that sunset haired alpha. If anything, being in a bar with betas and omegas had only made him jealous and irritated.

Jealous that he wasn’t them. Irritated that Mydei would never love him like he could love them.

Because he was an alpha; they weren’t. 

If anything, he found himself even more disinterested in people now.

He never had been interested in them romantically before, sure, but after Mydei it felt worse - numb and distant. Even as they were clearly trying to win his affections in the bar, his eyes could only dart around trying to see if Mydei was there.

He wasn’t.

Phainon gave a low groan at the memories before slowly shuffling to turn in the bed - flopping onto his other side to blink eyes open and process what Aglaea was offering him in her outstretched hand.

“.. A scarf?” Phainon observed slowly, blue eyes lingering on it before moving to her face for answers. 

He didn’t want a scarf.

“The very one Mydei was wearing when I met with him earlier, yes.” Aglaea explained with a shrug of her shoulders.

He wanted a scarf. 

Phainon moved to prop himself up a bit more at that on his elbow, blinking at the simple brown scarf in her hands slowly. 

“It’s.. Mydei’s?” Phainon asked for clarification, eyes drifting back to hers to look for any deceit. As if she had any reason for such a thing..

“You miss him right? Well, his scent is right here. So long as you agree to my deal.” Aglaea told him, instead moving into the guest bedroom a bit more with a scrunch of her nose - and was fully aware of why. He was horrible at keeping his emotions in when he got off work, he couldn’t even imagine the pheromones of this room, even for a beta.

“Is it actually his?” Phainon only asked again, and at that she shook her head lightly before crossing into the room and handing it to a now sitting up Phainon - a now very willing to accept a scarf Phainon. 

“Go ahead and inspect it.”

Phainon didn’t need to be told twice, or really to be told to inspect it - it was so obviously Mydei’s it made his heart ache. 

Yearn for the alpha that wasn’t his to want. 

That scent that no one but Mydei had was so very drenched into the cloth - practically rolling off of it that it made Phainon nauseous knowing he would never see the source of it again. Never even be near the person behind it again.

So sweet..

Phainon couldn’t help but crinkle it into his hands before pressing his face into it - drinking deeply into that scent. 

Mydei’s scent.. 

The most confusing smell he had ever grown attached to - maple and distant strawberries. Not at all fitting for an alpha.

But it was Mydei’s.. And Phainon loved Mydei’s.. 

“I accept..” Phainon breathed out, not even really sure if he would actually be able to remove his face from sniffing at the fabric - no matter how pathetic he must look. 

Aglaea had certainly seen him do worse in the past weeks without Mydei, anyway. 

“Get dressed, then.” Aglaea paused, as if able to sense a demonic aura in the room over the idea of Phainon getting dressed; “And not in something hideous or I will dress you myself.”

Phainon couldn’t stop the scoff that left him, still nosing at the fabric in his hands before leaning away from it slightly to look at her egregiously - knowingly.

“.. Are you making me go looking for a new love interest again?” Phainon mumbled out as he moved his eyes back to the scarf - the one Mydei wore today… 

It smelled so deeply of him, Phainon felt almost completely intoxicated just by being so brutally reminded how good Mydei smelled to him. How direly he missed that alpha.. It was even worse than he had thought, just smelling him alone on clothing made Phainon’s entire body ache to be near him again. 

“Something like that.” Aglaea confessed in a teasing tone, one that made Phainon press out a heavy sigh. 

“.. It won’t work, Aglaea..” 

Phainon knew it wouldn’t, if a damn scarf made him sick to his stomach with pure yearning - there was no way he could replace Mydei. 

It was hopeless. 

He would have to figure out a different way to combat the fact he had already so easily lost the love of his life in a wink of an eye due to his own selfish actions. 

If he hadn’t done that to Mydei.. Surely they would have at least still been friends. They would have at least still worked together. 

Mydei wouldn’t have blocked Phainon everywhere. Mydei wouldn’t have quit working at the cafe.

If only Phainon hadn’t bitten him..

“It’s alright. Trust me on this one, I know a good spot to find someone right for you.” Aglaea continued, unaware of his turmoil before shuffling into the room more - something Phainon wasn’t even sure he desired to look at as she opened the closet. Clearly deciding she was going to go ahead and dress him herself.

“.. I’m wearing this scarf.” Phainon murmured, pressing his head into it again - and Aglaea gave a quiet hum at that, as if she had expected him to say something along those lines. Probably was right to, anyway. 

“Whatever makes you happy, Phainon.” Was her quiet reply as he heard her flicking through hangers in the closet; “Just means I have to match your outfit with it..”

Phainon tutted quietly at that, sniffing at the scarf almost sadly, or well, extremely sadly.

It was strange how a man that was in his life so very briefly now could easily be called the one person that smelled like ‘home’ to Phainon.

He couldn’t help but feel anything besides mournful over the fact he had so effortlessly shattered it all - driven only by his own greed towards the alpha.

Aglaea fell into a silence as she worked, and Phainon didn’t mind - instead drowning out his own sorrows in the scent of Mydei. 

It was hopeless - He was hopeless. 

The idea of replacing Mydei sounded so farfetched to him.

It shouldn’t.

He knew it shouldn’t - he barely knew Mydei. He barely spent much time with him compared to most people before they would feel such a level of deep longing. He knew that. And yet it was simply how his confusing conflicting feelings worked - a mess of tangles and threads that felt so easily snapped by Mydei.

And yet he wasn’t even mad at Mydei for refusing him.

How could he be?

Phainon found himself loyal to the man, unrelentingly so, hauntingly so that even a void in himself had quickly formed where Mydei’s searingly hot skin had touched him before. How could he ever be angry at Mydei when he had at least been willing to look Phainon’s way? When he had at least let Phainon try.

Phainon was the issue here. Not Mydei.

That’s what he had told himself, that’s what he would continue to tell himself. 

Phainon jolted as Aglaea flopped something onto his legs, peeking from the scarf to blink at the clothes she had picked out. A rather formal looking black collared shirt and some jeans.. Phainon really didn’t feel like dressing up to try to woo people, honestly. Schmoozing was definitely not anything he had any desires to do.

“Come on then, we’re on a schedule.” She told him rather lightly, betraying her own words as she left the guest bedroom quickly - shutting the door behind herself with a click. And Phainon could only blink at the clothes as he pressed that scarf against his nose still, inhaling the traces of Mydei.

How was he supposed to get dressed up to go try to get over Mydei while only wishing he was by Mydei’s side still? It was impossible.

He’d definitely at least get wasted and pray the man stopped haunting his thoughts until he sobered up - even if it hadn’t worked the first time he tried. 

Regardless, he could do nothing more than regret his past choices and get dressed for whatever Aglaea would be taking him to. It was a deal, after all, and he would rather catch a second kitchen on fire than let Aglaea take the scarf from him now. Not when it still smelled so deeply of Mydei..

──────────────

“.. The gym?” Phainon gawked out quietly. One of his hands pulled up his scarf idly just a bit to faintly sniff at the pheromones still deeply rooted in it, his feet stalling slightly as he followed behind Aglaea, blinking at the building. Phainon was well toned from just his normal activities of walking dogs constantly and lifting heavy things - he wasn’t really a gym frequenter.. Nor did he think he would ever be one.

“Mhm. I’m sure there’s someone in here that would pique your interest.” Aglaea didn’t stop however, still striding towards the door to open it - propping it open as she looked to the rather sullen looking Phainon in hell.

Phainon couldn’t help but scowl over the logic of why they were here.

“Aglaea.. Just because I like Mydei doesn’t mean I just like people that work out..” Phainon practically breathed out those words, darkened and depressed as they left his mouth. A bitter taste on his tongue as he obeyed her whims anyway. 

“I bought you a one-month trial. Don’t make me waste my money.” Aglaea teased, at least, Phainon assumed it was a tease as he walked into the gym past her - immediately freezing to give her a baffled look. 

“Wait, I didn’t bring any clothes for working out.”

Aglaea didn’t even bat an eye at that, and that alone made Phainon feel like he was walking into the jaws of the lion’s den. 

“That’s fine, you’re just here to scope it out for anyone that interests you.” Aglaea told him simply, a small knowing smile faintly dancing on her painted lips. One that made Phainon crease his brows - over the smile and her words. 

“.. Aglaea..” 

‘This is unlike you’ were words that died on his tongue as he instead continued after her, standing behind her as if he were a child as she spoke to the woman behind the desk.

Phainon couldn’t help but roam his eyes in the reception area - it was a nice gym. Not the type of gyms he would usually dare to go to, this was beyond fancy if anything. The marble walls were enough to say it probably cost a good amount to actually go here full time. Way more than Phainon himself would ever pay to go to a gym..

Not to mention the distinct lack of pheromones and scents - as if they worked tirelessly to keep it as clean as possible. Looks wise and scents wise.

When Aglaea ceased talking with the receptionist and they were allowed in, Phainon couldn’t help but quickly flock to her side - leaning down slightly; “Are you trying to make me find a glucose partner?”

Aglaea slowly cocked her head to the side to look at him, her eyes hollow as she tried to mull over what he had just asked her; “.. A what?”

Phainon creased his brows at that, feeling even more concerned the further they walked through the sleek building.

“A sugar daddy and or mommy?” 

Aglaea’s eyes left him though, instead giving a small laugh over the question before dipping her head forward in a nod; “No, Phainon. I am not. I was looking for him.”

“Him?” Phainon asked, copying her gaze only to feel as if he had suddenly been choked. 

“Aglaea? .. Phainon?”

Phainon found himself trembling over those words, his bones shaking as he tried to take in the man in front of him - the man that was clearly on his way to leave. Unfair.

Aglaea was cruelly unfair today, it seemed.

Phainon was powerless but to give in and rake his eyes over the man in front of him - savoring the way he was wearing black shorts and a red tank top. That was all. 

Phainon wasn’t even sure he knew how to breathe as he tried to comprehend Mydei’s body standing a few feet away from him. 

The main thing Phainon took note of - was how shocked Mydei looked, it was as if he was looking at a ghost and well.. Phainon was sure his expression fared no better as he stared right back at him silently.

Phainon found himself only watching the man of his dreams awkwardly look away - the way he moved to slowly rub as his arm slyly.

“Phainon, I’m sorry I..” Mydei trailed off, knitting his brows as if he was trying to think of exactly what to say.

Phainon was sure he stopped breathing over that already however.

Mydei was going to shut him out again.

Mydei was going to say sorry and leave.

Again.. 

Phainon didn’t even think twice as his feet moved without a thought, without a second given care as Mydei’s ears flicked back to him widely. And Phainon wouldn’t have to apologize again later for his next action, probably, as he quickly moved to place a hand before Mydei’s head, tucking a leg between Mydei’s own and sliding under one of them - completely toppling the other alpha’s balance easily as Phainon pressed into him.

A second time of shoving Mydei to the floor, this time keenly protecting the man’s head from the floor, at the least if they did go down that far.

They didn’t. 

Instead Mydei only halfway fell - catching himself and Phainon rather easily as he crumpled downwards into an odd sitting pose. It didn’t matter though, instead Phainon only pressed his head into the man’s chest, bringing both arms around Mydei’s chest in a tight hug. 

“Pha-”

“I’m sorry!” Phainon cut him off instantly, not daring to look up at Mydei’s face as he spoke, instead only nuzzling against the tanktop there, not even giving half a mind to wander if anyone else around would be seeing two alphas like this. 

“I’m sorry I bit you, I’ll never do it again..” Phainon continued on, feeling the way Mydei had stiffened beneath his hold; “I’m sorry, please..”

“I’m sorry.. Don’t..” Phainon only continued as the silence from Mydei dragged on, only able to focus on the way Mydei was breathing against him, that scent he had so desperately craved so close to him again and not just through his clothing. “Don’t close the door on me again..”

Phainon wasn’t ashamed to admit he was crying again, he felt beyond hopeless - just begging for Mydei to accept him, not to shove him away. He couldn’t be an omega or a beta like Mydei wanted in his love life.

But he could be whatever else Mydei wanted if Mydei voiced it.

“Please..”

Phainon tensed up immediately as he practically whimpered out that word - instead feeling a hand gently touching his head, stroking his hair softly. Phainon felt his heart lurch against his chest over it - opting to pathetically attempt to bury himself into Mydei’s chest even more. Desperately craving more of those gentle touches.

“Calm down, Phainon..” Mydei mumbled very quietly, yet his voice still rumbled against Phainon’s ear with his head on his chest in Mydei’s half sitting position, with a completely flopped Phainon on the other half of his body. 

“I can’t..” Phainon confessed, instead biting his own cheeks to try to ground himself to reality - only able to focus on that hand in his hair so tenderly caring for him. 

“Mydei..” Phainon only weakly continued, rubbing his head slowly into the red tanktop’s fabric, clutching onto Mydei’s back like his life depended on it; and at this point, Phainon wasn’t even sure if he could say it didn’t depend on him.

Phainon had nearly felt like he truly had died when Mydei left him so quickly.

“Please.. Forgive me..”

“I was never mad at you, Phainon.” Mydei finally said, his voice sounding more tired than anything else; “I didn’t.. Like the fact I hurt you.”

“.. You did hurt me, it’s alright.” Phainon admitted, finally, agreeing that the punch did in fact hurt, but that’s okay. He deserved it. 

Mydei tensed at that and took a sharp inhale of breath, in such a way that Phainon found himself immediately tightening onto him, latching onto him like he was his only lifeline. Mydei clearly hadn’t handled that news well, and Phainon almost bit into his own tongue over it, over the way that hand in his hair had disappeared so instantly. 

The way Mydei was instantly retreating again made Phainon feel nauseous. 

Mydei was silent for a few seconds before deeply sighing, his voice remarkably strained and quiet as he spoke; “.. Yeah, I did. That’s why it’s for the be-”

“Being away from you hurts more than your punches..” Phainon quickly cut him off, not willing to hear it again. He couldn’t. He only could emotionally will himself to cling onto the alpha more - pressing into him and also trying to make him completely fall over. Mydei didn’t budge with those attempts, however. 

“If you’re going to say it's for the best for my sake..” Phainon wasn’t even sure when he started crying again, was it when Mydei stopped petting him? He didn’t know. “Then treat me badly..”

Phainon could feel the way Mydei’s breath stuttered, the way he still was so very tense underneath Phainon..

“If leaving me alone and not seeing me anymore is you being nice for my own health,” Phainon continued on;  “I'm begging you.. Treat me poorly..”

Those words drew a heavy sigh from Mydei, one that Phainon felt as it left Mydei’s chest; “.. If anything, I’d rather you work on treating yourself better too, Phainon..”

Phainon was silent for a few brief seconds over that. 

That wasn’t even something he had time to consider with the lack of Mydei. 

It was impossible.

It felt like his entire heart had gone with Mydei.

How was he supposed to treat himself better when he was the cause for his sunshine leaving him?

“Then help me..” Phainon bartered, because, well. He had learned in these two weeks without this alpha, being ‘better’ wasn’t really a thing he had tried to do. “Don’t leave me again.. Help me do better..” 

Mydei softly laughed at that.

A warm and soft noise – but it was most assuredly Mydei giving a low laugh, not a mocking one either, more akin to the lines of a sad laugh more than actual happiness.

“We’re both a mess, you know? I don’t think you want to be so dependent on me.” Mydei said rather lightly, still very quiet but in a tone that made Phainon’s heart flutter with an ounce of hope.

“.. That’s fine, can’t we be a mess together?” Phainon asked quietly, it was fine if Mydei was a mess - but being without Mydei.. Couldn’t they at least fumble through life together? 

“I’ll behave this time..” Phainon offered quickly after those words, desperately trying to reassure Mydei that he would do better, that he could control himself.

Ignoring the fact the first thing he did upon seeing Mydei was borderline tackling him to the floor.

“Phainon.” Mydei sternly spoke, still quiet, but more forward;  “Look at me.”

Phainon stayed motionless for a second, creasing his brows over that before giving in. How could he deny Mydei now? He couldn’t. He rubbed his tear-stained face against Mydei’s chest before looking upwards at him. 

Phainon’s breath hitched over the soft expression on Mydei’s face, a small almost saddened smile that graced his lips as golden eyes stared at Phainon - looking as if he was some fragile treasure that had fallen into his lap and not shoved Mydei to the floor again.

“I’m sorry for shutting you out of my life. I did miss you.” Mydei confessed, and Phainon could only find himself blinking over it. Over the idea of Mydei saying this.. 

“.. You missed me?” Phainon parroted, rather quietly, not fully comprehending that this was real. Like the past two weeks hadn’t happened. 

“Why is that so shocking to you?” Mydei asked rather light-heartedly, in such a tone that Phainon’s head felt dizzy - swimming through his emotions and not desiring to let this man go.

“Because..” 

I’m an alpha.

You don’t like those.

Mydei blinked at him over the way he trailed off before offering a smile Phainon could only think to call comforting; “I thought about you a lot and checked in on you.” 

“.. Huh?” Phainon intelligently asked, still staring into those golden flaked eyes. 

“That’s shocking too huh? Ask Agla-” Mydei started, tilting his own head away from Phainon to look at Aglaea, only scoffing immediately; “Oh. She’s gone.”

“She’s gone?” Phainon echoed, attempting to look behind himself and over his shoulder - but not at all willing to unhand Mydei. Not in the slightest as he tried to look. 

“.. That does answer why we haven’t been scolded for our etiquette in public yet.” Mydei mumbled in a voice that was more akin to talking to himself than actually to Phainon. 

“Should we..” 

Phainon couldn’t even say those words, he couldn’t even consider leaving - parting from Mydei again. Not when he wasn’t sure he wouldn’t see him again, not when he didn’t know when the next time they would talk would be. Days? Weeks? 

Months?

“Leave too? Probably.” Mydei continued his sentence anyway, and Phainon found himself once again pathetically clinging to Mydei like a koala.  “.. Don’t hang onto me tighter, you can walk me home.”

“Ah..” Phainon perked up slightly, releasing Mydei from his grip over those words, over that promise to instead scramble upwards.

“Or.. Well.” Mydei slowly said, still staying on the floor as he eyed Phainon, and Phainon couldn’t help but admire how relaxed Mydei looked with both hands behind his back - obviously he had been leaning on them to hold himself upright over Phainon snuggling into him with his full body weight. 

“Need a hand up?” Phainon asked with a lop-sided smile, an expression that felt almost foreign with how long he hadn’t given such a look to someone, extending a hand towards the unmoving Mydei who stared at it for a moment with a sigh, his eyes darting away and to the side.

Almost nervously, like he didn’t want to look at Phainon, and that returning reluctance made Phainon’s heart plummet. 

Had he.. Said something wrong?

“.. That’s the thing.” Mydei confessed simply, flicking his gaze back to Phainon with a shrug of his shoulders.

“Huh?”

“You uh..” Mydei started, slowly looking at Phainon’s hand again before taking it slowly, allowing Phainon to help yank him up before he continued. “My ankle.”

“Your ankle?” Phainon parroted as Mydei seemed to hesitate for a moment, giving a deep sigh.

“I twisted it pretty badly when you lunged at me.” Mydei once again confessed, and Phainon now understood how Mydei felt over hitting him.

Phainon had thought to protect Mydei’s head - but not his legs he was purposefully tripping up..

“.. I injured you?” Phainon ghosted out the realization slowly, his stomach feeling more and more sick as his eyes drifted downwards to Mydei’s shoes, not even daring to pause his eyes over how much skin Mydei was showing in public with those very small shorts on.

“Don’t look like such a kicked dog over it. It’s fine.” Mydei shrugged it off easily, giving another hollowed sigh.

Phainon couldn’t shake it however, feeling almost light-headed over the fact his abrupt irrational feelings had caused issues for Mydei again.

“But.. I..”

“If it bothers you, then consider us even for the punches.” Mydei mumbled without much of a second thought, giving another small laugh as he spoke.

“I..” Phainon craved to hear more of Mydei’s laughter, but his eyes couldn’t help flicking down to his ankle, worrying about the walk home.. “That still doesn’t feel right!”

Mydei blinked at him, focusing wholly on Phainon for just a moment before slowly tilting his head to the side questioningly; “That so? Alright. Carry me home.”

Phainon swore his brain malfunctioned and misheard.

Short-circuited and made up a dream where Mydei was accepting him back into his life, and also was demanding him to carry him..

“.. What?” Phainon asked in a quiet and weak voice, unwilling to blink as he watched Mydei wave a hand dismissively, unblinking as he watched Mydei’s cheek grow a deeper shade of pink.

Oh.

“Joking.” Mydei added with a small laugh, clearly trying to move past it, however, Phainon had no intentions of that!

Instead he once again scooted closer to Mydei before immediately tucking a hand beneath his legs and one against his back, only giving a small laugh as Mydei instinctively put a hand on his shoulder.

“Phainon- Wait a second,” Mydei mumbled, watching Phainon keenly but not at all fighting against the impending bridal carry that they both knew was about to happen in the gym. “You can’t..”

Phainon didn’t listen to that however, instead fully tucking Mydei into himself and heaving the man up - barely able to bite down the bubbling laugh he felt in his chest over the way Mydei so easily swung his arms around Phainon’s neck to hold onto him. 

He was honestly rather shocked at how willing Mydei was towards this - zero fight or any qualms.. Merely leaving one arm hooked around Phainon’s neck for stability and the other touching his collarbone.

Though Phainon did wish Mydei would tuck his head a bit closer.. He wouldn’t be greedy though! He was taking what he got here!

“Why not? You’re pretty light! Way lighter than some of the dogs I have to pick up, you know?” Phainon explained, ignoring the faint weirdness of Mydei just allowing Phainon to do this - even if it wasn’t him joking and his ankle did hurt that much. 

“.. If you insist.” Mydei mumbled, and Phainon felt his heart thudding against his ears as Mydei’s head lowered into his shoulder - almost tiredly. As if Mydei had been waiting for this. Was he just that tired after working out? 

His body was burning to touch, that much was certain, but that was probably just from whatever extortion he had done in the gym considering his hair was faintly wet and he smelled of soap when Phainon bothered to look past his normal sweet scent. Showered here before leaving, probably..

“I do insist!” Phainon replied happily, making sure he had a decent handle on Mydei before turning to leave the well.. Entrance of the gym, it’s not like he even got very far at all inside. Let alone did Aglaea.. Wherever she ran off to.

Phainon took maybe three steps to the exit until he felt a tug against his neck, one that he could only squint over and drift his eyes to Mydei’s face instead of navigating out of the building. 

“By the way.. Is this my scarf?” Mydei asked, and Phainon had to thank whatever god would hear him out for the way Mydei gave him a small smirk over it - the way he seemed more amused than angry. The way he seemed so pliant in Phainon’s arms.. 

“Uh… Yeah.” Phainon admitted painfully, even if Mydei was being kind and gentle right now, he still was embarrassed to be reminded how pitifully he was clinging to anything that smelled remotely of Mydei.

“.. I see.” 

Phainon didn’t miss it - how could he possibly ever miss the faint dust of blush that immediately crawled into Mydei’s features? He could never miss that..

Instead he gave a nervous laugh, looking upwards more again to focus on leaving - not even batting an eye over the way the receptionist looked at them both confusedly, either because Phainon had literally just gotten here, or due to the 

“Do you.. Want it back?” Phainon offered, but he was praying the answer was no. Hoping to whatever gods once again would hear him out that Mydei actually hated this scarf and didn’t mind Phainon keeping it for himself. 

“It’s fine. I was confused why Aglaea stole it earlier, but I guess I can figure it out myself now.” Mydei mumbled out, his head still lulling against Phainon even as Phainon turned to open the glass door with his back.

Phainon would for sure have to send out many prayers of thanks tonight, if he wasn’t religious, he had found a reason to be today, because sheer luck alone surely hadn’t been enough to bring Mydei back into his arms.

Literally.

They fell into a hushed silence after that - not that Phainon minded, he was practically humming to himself as he carried his beloved fellow alpha through the now quiet night city. 

Phainon couldn’t help but peek every few seconds, eyes darting downwards to look at Mydei’s face - to take in the way he had closed his eyes, the way he was pressed against Phainon so tenderly.

Phainon didn’t dare comment on it. 

Instead he just held Mydei a bit tighter, basking in the warmth of him while walking through the streets - a bit thankful no one was really out currently, probably because it was nearing eight and most people had returned home by now. But, whatever. 

Phainon didn’t even care if he got home at two in the morning if it meant he got to spend that time with Mydei.

Mydei..

“Mydei.” Phainon vocalized his thoughts, his spiral of thinking about Mydei. There were a lot of them, but one main thing was lurking in his mind as he carried the alpha that was rather compliant today with being held gently like this - not at all voicing his concerns or anger or even seeming angry.

“Hmm?” 

Phainon’s feet didn’t stop, he could only continue on and hope for the best; “May I start earnestly courting you?”

Mydei didn’t instantly answer that, but his body didn’t give any clear signs of discomfort in Phainon’s arms either - if anything, he felt like Mydei was just an overly large cat in his arms that was rather content today. As if they both had been equally waiting for this, and that idea felt crazy in Phainon’s head to even consider.

To even consider Mydei was equally desiring his company again.. 

“.. Courting me?” Mydei echoed out after a few seconds, and Phainon couldn’t help but to shyly laugh as he walked, tilting his head a bit to peek at the late afternoon sky - the vibrant hues of red and dark orange bleeding across it into sunset.

Quite a late sunset in the day..

“You know, like.. To be lovers.” Phainon pushed himself to murmur out slowly, unsure of why Mydei would be confused by that in general.

It’s not like Phainon hadn’t wanted to before, either.

He wanted to do right by Mydei he just.. May be a little bit unwell towards the only person that's ever gotten him to glance at them romantically.. He could admit that! He knew it, okay?

“.. Hm.” 

“Or just friends, I’m okay with that too.” Phainon quickly added with a sheepish laugh, anxious and forced, but a laugh. Very aware of those golden eyes that were studying him harshly.

He wasn’t okay with it really.

The idea of only being friends with Mydei would easily be the worst thing ever - it would tear Phainon up inside if he had to sit by and watch Mydei fall in love with someone else.

But, the idea of not being in Mydei’s life at all was much, much worse. He knew that for a fact given the last two weeks. 

“I am an alpha, Phainon.” Mydei told him softly again, as if Phainon could ever forget such a fact, as if Phainon could ever forget mourning the fact he too was an alpha.

It was unforgettable.

“.. Yeah.” Phainon sorrowfully pressed out as he stepped on that familiar pavement to Mydei’s apartment, not even upset that Mydei was an alpha.

He was upset he was one, as well. 

“I’m not sure how courting me would even work.” Mydei gave a laugh as he said that, and Phainon loved that sound more than anything else in the world - it was such music to his ears that he had painfully mourned for these past two weeks.. And now he had the owner of it pressed against his chest so sweetly..

“Well.. I..” Phainon breathed out, trailing off as he tucked his head slightly lower, hoping Mydei didn’t notice the way Phainon was desperately trying to sniff at him. 

Mydei smelled odd.

At first, Phainon had written it off as the mix of soap and gym lingering on the alpha’s skin - but it was odd. Phainon wasn’t even sure what it was, he most assuredly smelled like Phainon remembered, but there was something else Phainon couldn’t put a name to.

“You may try, I’m just unsure how I’ll respond.” Mydei replied, clearly oblivious to Phainon’s actions and at that, Phainon gave up on it regardless and focused on his merry walk with his lion in his arms. 

“You’ll let me?” 

Phainon really couldn’t believe it.

“Phainon, You are currently holding me in your arms, and carrying me through public. You think me declining being courted by you is on the table currently?” Mydei tiredly asked, and while Phainon was focused ahead, he did see the way Mydei cut his eyes at him, borderline scowling over the way Phainon’s tone had changed to shock, probably.

“Uh..” Phainon didn’t know how to reply to that, because realistically, yes. He did think that - Mydei had been absolutely avoiding him for two weeks, the man had every ability to still tell Phainon no.

Regardless.

Phainon felt a beaming smile creep onto his features as he looked at Mydei, a glimmering twinkle in his eyes as he met those amber eyes that seemed almost unimpressed by the current situation; “So, Will you unblock my phone number?”

Mydei barked a laugh at that, loud and unrestrained.

“Right, right, that.”

“Whew..” Phainon breathed out a sigh of relief at that, he really did miss texting Mydei - even if some people would consider him a pathetic little double texter. He didn’t care! Also he had fifteen double texted Mydei before, mind you. So a ‘double texter’ was setting the bar a little low for him!

Mydei didn’t comment on the way Phainon seemed so relieved, nor did he comment on Phainon struggling to open his apartment complex’s door with Mydei in his arms.

Mydei still didn’t comment as Phainon stood in the elevator with him.

Mydei remained complacent, silently in Phainon’s arms and allowing Phainon to cherish him closely.

It was odd to Phainon.

He was thankful, yes, but the way Mydei was so willing after two weeks - so allowing of Phainon to touch him and hold him, was odd. Even the zero signs of anger when Phainon had shoved him to the floor and cried on him.

It was odd.

He couldn’t shake it. Not even as he reached that door that had been closed to him before, the same door he had debated many times to stop by and wait outside - but he didn’t want to make Mydei truly grow to hate him. So he allowed it to close..

Phainon shook his thoughts away, instead beaming at the alpha in his arms as he stopped his tracks - ignoring the way his arms were tired. Mydei wasn’t heavy! He wasn’t! But a long walk with him in his arms.. Well.. That’s different.. 

Phainon didn’t mind the strain though! 

It was a blissful day for him.

“Here you are!” Phainon sang out, nodding towards the familiar door as Mydei’s golden eyes locked onto Phainon’s face - but said nothing. 

Phainon moved to release his hold on Mydei, pausing as the man turned his back as soon as he hit the floor gently with his feet. Mydei huffed out a quiet ‘thank you’ before moving to dig in his pockets for his keys, probably, but Phainon couldn’t help but stare at the back of him.

Stare directly at where his hair was slightly lifting up due to his head looking downwards.

Stare at the nape of Mydei’s neck.

Stare at the clear bite that was lingering on Mydei’s neck.

Phainon’s mind blanked.

“Mydei?” Phainon asked slowly, almost timidly as his eyes only traced over that mark - again and again, committing it to memory.

“Hm?” Mydei hummed out quietly before turning his head slightly to look at Phainon questioningly. Almost looking confused over his name being said as he twirled his eyes lazily - jingling them between his fingers.

“Is that.. My bite still on your neck?”

Mydei paused the key twirling at that, instead catching them in his hands.

“Oh.” Mydei moved his free hand slowly to rub at the nape of his neck, eyes drifting away from Phainon as he did so, almost looking embarrassed. “Yeah, it is.” 

“It.. “ Phainon wanted to see it.

He wanted to look at it closer, wanted to spin Mydei around and make him move his hand off of it.

He wanted to see his claim on Mydei.

“It’s still there?” Phainon asked with a heavy swallow, doing his best to not act on it - he couldn’t. 

He had to be normal, he had to be sane and not overwhelm Mydei. For both of their sakes.

Mydei looked at him again, hand still covering the bite before giving a quiet laugh, almost shyly.

“.. Yeah.”

Phainon had to look away - had to force himself to try not to think about it; “Ah.. Sorry.. About that.”

Mydei only removed his hand from his neck to slowly wave it off, instead turning to fumble around with his keys and his door - and Phainon had to force himself to focus on the sounds of the lock unlatching instead of staring at Mydei’s neck.

It was still there.

His bite was still there..?

“It’s fine, it’ll heal eventually. Goodnight, Phainon.” Mydei mumbled, even though Phainon felt giddy over the fact it hadn’t.

Ecstatic. 

“.. Goodnight, Mydei.”

Phainon hadn’t even the slightest passing thought to question the way Mydei hadn’t limped or been in pain at all as he walked into his apartment, either.

Chapter End Notes

mustve been the wind... im sure its nothing
