chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

this is mainly just fluff. so like.
happy few hours before 3.3.... im sure nothing bad happens. (clutches my head)

“Is Mydei going to become an omega?”

Mydei couldn’t stop the hacking cough that left his throat, strained and so very painful as he choked on his chicken sandwich. Tears pricked at the corners of his eyes mercilessly from his wheezing as he listened to the girl’s conversation, they both had been so set on this meeting. 

To torture him, it seemed. 

“I don’t think so. His scent seems the same to me.” Aglaea mumbled out, golden eyes slowly raking over him - as if his body would have been changing already.

‘Already’. 

He had no idea how long it took someone to even turn into an omega, if it was at all possible. 

Mydei could only slowly look at Castorice with tears still daring to escape at the corner of his eyes, completely and utterly stunned by her question as she only stared back at him with a quiet ‘hmm’.

“Phainon told me it was different.. But you’re right, it's still the same alpha Mydei that I remember..” Castorice said as she looked Mydei up and down once, twice, three times. As if his body would possibly just change on the second or third glance overs. 

Even leaning slightly closer to him to obviously sniff at him - something he had to bite the urge down to shoo her away over, but there was no point.

He was fighting a losing battle with them.

Mydei could only opt to sit his chicken sandwich down on the table with a deep sigh before taking a swig of his water - desperately needed after the zero warning saw trap Castorice had put him into.

“Hm, well. Phainon has always had different opinions on Mydei’s scent regardless.” Aglaea said with a knowing nod, taking a bite of her own salad as she unabashedly joined Castorice in giving Mydei a languid look over.

Something about that was way more threatening than Castorice doing it, however.. 

“How do you feel, Mydei?” Castorice asked to his right, making him look back at his sandwich almost pathetically.

The fact he had sat between the two betas really shouldn’t feel like he was trapped between a rock and a hard place, but he truly was feeling such a thing now. 

He could only hope whatever god would hear him out and free him. 

“Fine.” Mydei murmured, not even batting an eye at her regardless of his inner feelings he was currently battling.

“Not like a beta or omega?” Castorice pressed onward and Mydei could only let out a quiet ‘pft’ as he picked up his sandwich again - almost hopeful he would be able to eat his damn food now that he was aware this was the sudden topic change.

They had betrayed him fully from quickly swapping from the new Animal Crossing game before to this. 

What was their issues?

“.. What would that even feel like? No. I feel normal.” Mydei replied curtly before taking another shallow bite of his sandwich - mainly in fear of the follow up question one of them may slap him with if he let his guard down.

For being two betas, they were absolutely relentless. 

“But you don’t feel normal when you’re around Phainon?”

Mydei sighed at that deeply as he swallowed, exasperated.

He didn’t.

He had a rather strong sense of yearning from the second Phainon had practically thrown himself at Mydei - The desire to hug him back just as tightly. Even going as far as faking an injury to make Phainon indulge his own desires without outright being honest - pathetic. 

“No.” Mydei admitted almost tiredly, he slowly was coming to terms they may have had fooled him into talking about his problems by offering him food.

Granted, he could have just cooked at home and enjoyed their company; But he still felt somewhat duped. 

“Does he smell enticing to you?” Aglaea asked, her voice laced with teasing but Mydei could only sigh despairingly at his sandwich that he was floundering and failing to eat..

Did he?

Well. No.

He smelled like Phainon, like oak, citrus, and vanilla very deep within it all. It wasn’t ‘enticing’ at all. If anything, it still irked him off slightly when he got home and smelled it all over himself after leaving Phainon’s close vicinity. 

It was bizarre.

“He smells like he always did - Just another alpha.” Mydei clarified, not bothering to even stop the way his voice came out so very roughly - tiredly. How could he? The entire situation was beyond insane.

He understood their curiosity, but he had no answers. 

He literally felt fine, nothing had changed outside of him feeling very fond towards Phainon, but even that he was willing to brush off as ‘reuniting with someone he had a crush on’ feelings, or something.

“This is so strange..” Castorice murmured as she leaned back into her own chair, clearly miffed as she crossed her hands over her chest - puzzling over whatever bizarre situationship was overtaking two of her friends, even if she didn’t truly know Mydei very well.

“Are you sure you’re not going to fall into a heat randomly?” Aglaea asked her query in such a stern tone, and, well..

Mydei was rather thankful he had been neglecting the idea of taking more bites - he surely would have almost died over the thought of being randomly in heat due to choking if not. 

“I’m quite sure of it.” Mydei grumbled out, now taking a bite of his food once more.

If he died due to choking with their insane questions, at least he would die eating tasty food.

Worth it, probably.

“Maybe Phainon really is just a freak..” Castorice wondered out loud, mainly to herself in a ghost of her normal voice, and Mydei was very aware of those lilac eyes still meticulously staring at him as he ate. 

As if he would randomly catch aflame and become an omega, right during their lunch. 

“There’s no ‘maybe’ about it; He is one, but I’m more concerned about that nasty bite on Mydei’s neck.” Aglaea mused out, giving a short scoff - the closest thing to a laugh Aglaea gave to them usually. 

“Mm.” Was all Mydei ‘said’ in reply as he took another testing bite of his food, immediately regretting it as Castorice sighed deeply at his side.

A bad sign of her about to say something off the walls again.

“You know,” Castorice began, her voice light and soft - almost dreamy. And something about that made Mydei glare at his sandwich between his hands. Everything was a trap with these two..  “I once jokingly asked Phainon what if he was an enigma..”

There it was. 

The insane idea that was completely off the walls - immediately making Mydei slowly turn his head to narrow his eyes at her. 

“I’m not turning into a damn omega.” Mydei borderline growled, slightly bristling over the idea by this point but Castorice was completely unfazed, merely giving a slow sigh yet again over his reaction before turning her attention wholly on Aglaea. 

“I know, I know..Isn’t there like.. Another myth alpha out there?” Castorice asked, and those words made Mydei arch a brow upwards, staring at her before slowly turning his head to look at the beta the question was for. A clear look of thought had become a fog over Aglaea’s face.

A worrying expression from her, for sure.

“Are you implying that Phainon might be a Prime Alpha?” Aglaea inquired almost teasingly, as if she fully believed it to be a thing.

“.. He hardly seems aggressive enough for that.” Mydei mumbled out.

Of course he had heard of those strange ideas of a more dominant and wild alpha, one that didn’t even seem to care about their mate’s secondary genders and claimed whatever they wanted for themselves.

“He’s actually extremely aggressive and violent on his ruts, however.” Aglaea countered him, as if for some reason she was suddenly on Castorice’s side here of Phainon being an oddity with his secondary gender.

Mydei, personally, was still on the team of Phainon just being a weird ass dude in general.

“But he wasn’t aggressive towards Mydei on his rut, was he?” Castorice countered her back, and suddenly Mydei felt as though he no longer had a say in this topic - instead finally savoring his own food as the two girls discussed whatever the hell his lovelife was currently. 

“He might already see Mydei as his mate, alpha or not.” Aglaea retorted with a wave of her hand dismissively, a movement Mydei keenly watched considering the lettuce attached to her fork as she did so. 

“But if that’s true, then that mark on Mydei’s neck isn’t going to go away, is it?” Castorice fired back - making Mydei look back to her, watching her wag a finger at Aglaea, as if they were both cracking some sort of code as Mydei only silently ate his sandwich.

“Well..” Aglaea sighed out, pausing her thoughts as Mydei moved his eyes back to her; now fully entertained by the fact the duo had bizarrely taken up theory crafted about whatever was wrong with Phainon. “If it’s truly taken root on Mydei.. Then it’s a one-sided mating mark.”

“That would solve why Phainon acted like such a drowning rat over Mydei’s rejection too!” Mydei’s eyes slid back to Castorice at that, merely watching her beaming as she nodded her head slowly; “Wow.. Phainon is already so whipped for Mydei either way, huh?”

Mydei had to wonder if she was really asking him, or just making a statement at this point as he blinked at her, still gnawing at his now rather worryingly dwindling supply of chicken sandwich.

He feared having to try to keep up in this conversation without the sandwich to rely on..

“Has he been clingy again?” Aglaea asked, and at that he could only sigh, golden eyes facing forward again to give a sullen look at his chicken sandwich.

He wasn’t avoiding joining in anymore it seemed.

“Mm.. Not too bad, if anything..” Mydei trailed off, huffing out a small amused laugh. “The daily gifts are a bit odd, but the texting is about as normal as it once was.”

A silence fell upon the table over those words.

And Mydei had a small dire feeling that he had messed up terribly by mentioning those damned gifts.

A new pandora’s box had just been opened, assuredly, and all he could do was slowly take a bite of his sandwich - almost languidly and in pain. Preparing his nerves for whatever follow up questions he had just earned himself in passing.

“Daily.. Gifts?” Castorice said in a tiny voice to his side, so very quiet as almost sounding like she was in complete and earnest shock - baffled over his words.

Mydei could only sigh and set his sandwich down again, moving to cross his arms over his chest instead before staring at the ceiling.

“He’s taken up leaving daily boxes outside my door and scurrying off like a scared pup with his tail between his legs before I even see him.” Mydei explained easily, keeping his eyes focused on the ceiling like his life depending on it - even as Castorice gave a meek little cough to clear her throat rather obviously.

“What the.. He’s actually courting you like you’re an omega?” Castorice inquired very very quietly, and Mydei physically had to look around the small family-owned restaurant to try to see who was eavesdropping for her to have dropped her volume so much.

No one was around, it was just them in this corner, yet she was speaking as if she were terrified of people overhearing.

Mydei could only arch a brow slowly; “I won’t refuse free things.”

Aglaea laughed at that, genuinely. A sound that made Mydei snap his head towards her so quickly he feared he would get whiplash.

“You’re rich, Mydei. Tell that broke boy to stop buying you things.” Aglaea pointed at him with her fork, clearly, intending to scold him. But Mydei could only sigh. They both knew he couldn’t do that.

“You already know he wouldn’t listen. He’s doing it because he desperately wants me to accept him - telling him about my family past and my money wouldn’t dissuade him.” Mydei fired back easily with a small ‘harumph’ and shrug of his shoulders - still keeping them crossed over his chest as he stared her down.

“Stop tensing up.” Mydei hissed at Phainon jolted under his touch, a useless direction considering he knew the man was tensing up due to the fact he was touching him anyway.

Even as the machine began sputtering out water and Phainon’s eyes were locked forward, more steady due to Mydei holding onto him - Phainon remarkably, did worse.

The worker still clapped though, giving them both almost pitying looks as Phainon remained almost frozen until Mydei let go of him and rose to his feet again with a sigh.

“How is your aim that bad?” Mydei practically growled out, his voice low, but not really very serious, if anything - he was teasing. Something Phainon only looked at him due to and beamed happily over. 

“Who knows?” Phainon said with a grin, one that made Mydei scrunch his face up - feeling a weird sense of deja vu as he stared at the man, only more baffled as he watched Phainon fish out his phone from his pocket. Eyes blowing wide as he stuffed it back into the same pocket almost instantly.

“Wait!” Phainon immediately latched onto Mydei’s arm, yanking him slightly; “It’s almost eight thirty, we have to get to the ferris wheel!”

Mydei felt himself knitting his brows over that, yet allowed Phainon to drag him along regardless, only slightly casting a look back at the worker who seemed just as baffled. 

Almost thankful no one had been watching them much - not like there was a reason to watch them, if anything, this was just two weird alphas bonding to the average fairgoer. 

“What’s so special about eight thirty on the damn ferris wheel?” Mydei hissed out as he focused forward against, staring at the way Phainon had once again claimed Mydei’s upper arm against his chest like a leash - leading this time.

“Shh, my beloved Mydei! Come on!” 

Mydei didn’t dare think the way his heart had easily fluttered over that slip of a nickname and how easily Phainon had called him something so sweet like that. 

It didn’t fit Mydei.

Yet he had no qualms of being called that by Phainon all the same.

It was a tease though, nothing was meant behind it, anyway.

Though, as they quickly approached the ferris wheel, Mydei couldn’t help but notice how empty it was. Not a soul was currently on it - or in line. Mydei could only worriedly crease his brows as Phainon practically skipped up to the person running the machinery. 

“Just the two of you?” The man running the booth asked gently, and the way he gave a smile to Phainon as Phainon didn’t stop at all made Mydei raise a brow, even more so when Phainon only nodded.

Mydei only found himself sniffing the air - even the scents of others were lacking for some reason, as if the ferris wheel had been written off for most the night and Mydei found himself trying to remember if he ever saw it moving in the first place.

“Yep!” Phainon answered happily, completely and utterly unaware of Mydei sniffing at the air and worriedly looking around for any signs of life - only somewhat gripping onto Mydei’s arm tighter as he continued to drag him forward.

“Go right ahead then.” The man replied as the glass doors opened, and Mydei could only uselessly blink at the man running the booth before looking back to Phainon.

“Phainon, wait-” Phainon did not wait, even readjusting himself to make sure Mydei was swiftly shoved inside before following after him, only causing Mydei to give an annoyed sigh. “You didn’t give him our tickets.”

Phainon only beamed at him however before sitting down with a sly smile while patting the spot next to him, staring expectantly at Mydei. 

Mydei scoffed at that before sitting across from him, ignoring how instantly sullen he looked over that choice as the rickety machinery whirled to life. Mydei could only somewhat worriedly look at the ground from the window, the dirt grounds he would much rather have beneath his feet than cold metal encasing him like a tomb.

“Wow.. It sounds old, I sure hope it doesn’t break down..” The tone Phainon had said that in - so sarcastic and high toned made Mydei languidly drag his eyes to stare at the alpha in front of him.

To stare at the annoying dog that surely would have a tail wagging behind him if it were possible.

“Phainon.” 

“Yes, Mydei?”

“Have you purposefully trapped me in here?”

“Yes, Mydei.”

“And that has something to do with eight thirty being the time?” 

“Yes, Mydei.”

“.. You’re not a puppy, you’re a wolf.” Mydei hissed out over the way Phainon was still beaming, still so very happy that he had locked Mydei into this deathtrap of a contraption so easily. 

He had come to terms that he could die eating a chicken sandwich - dying in the air due to a demonic machine breaking and exploding sounded way worse, however. 

“It’s nothing bad! It’s just that-” Phainon was cut off as the machinery abruptly came to a stop, swinging their cart easily due to the slow steady momentum slowing to nothing as they reached the top. 

Mydei couldn’t even help but narrow his eyes into a glare as he kept his balance, staring down the ever plotting alpha that only looked at him innocently. 

Mydei almost opened his mouth to scold him again, truly, he did. But the first loud pop in his ear easily distracted him, making him tear his eyes away from that white haired man swiftly to find the cause of it.

“Fireworks?” Mydei mumbled out, more to himself than to Phainon as his eyes only focused out the side of the glass - staring at each burst of color and sparkle that flared into the sky. Only barely aware of Phainon quickly swapping sides to sit beside Mydei.

“Mhm! At eight thirty they shoot off fireworks every night while in town.” Phainon explained easily, and Mydei had to ignore the way Phainon was slowly pressing against him again - as if those two weeks apart had meant absolutely nothing. As if he just couldn’t wait to have Mydei all to himself again.

And Mydei had to hand it to him - trapping him on a ferris wheel to get him utterly alone was a new one.

Something about that thought made Mydei’s mind itch.

“Do you wear turtlenecks and scarves a lot now to hide that bite on your neck?” 

Mydei stiffened at that, blinking at the vibrant colors outside the glass before slowly turning his head to stare at the alpha - the same alpha that was now once again stinking up the place.

A smell Mydei once assumed was the man angry at him, a smell he now recognized was Phainon trying to be possessive towards him. 

Even if accidentally.

Mydei only blinked at him blankly; “Yes.”

Phainon creased his brows at that, only tilting his head slightly; “Do you feel.. Normal?”

“The girls already trapped me into a conversation over this, mind you.” Mydei sighed deeply; “Yes, I feel fine. No, I’m not an omega or beta or whatever now.”

“Oh..” Mydei gave a scoff over the way Phainon seemed so obviously downtrodden by that.

“Stop sounding sad over that.” Mydei mumbled at him, cutting a glare to the depressed looking dog who was now clearly pouting over the news Mydei was not an omega or beta.

“Well.. I was kind of..” Phainon trailed off, giving a small cough to clear his throat innocently before obviously trying to look at the fireworks distractedly. An action Mydei only glared at him over. 

“Go on.”

Phainon’s blue eyes slowly slid back to Mydei, coming to terms with the fact he wasn’t escaping this situation. Mainly due to the fact he had locked them both inside this damn metal box. So the fact was; It was all his fault. 

“Well.. If you were an omega we could have such a cute family one day, that’s all.” Phainon quickly sputtered out like a waterfall, very obviously hoping Mydei wouldn't be able to riddle out what the hell he had just said if he said it quickly enough.

Mydei could, however, because of course he could.

“.. You speak as if you don’t have a brain.” Mydei hissed at him, bristling over the idea of giving birth and also at this fellow alpha hoping he was an omega. It was almost insulting if he spent too long considering it, his own secondary gender was currently debating throwing the damn man out the glass window at the mere passing idea of it.

“Aglaea told me I should be forthcoming and honest with you!” Phainon waved his hands in mock defeat as Mydei only snarled at him slightly over that excuse.

“I doubt she meant that as in telling me you wish I was an omega so you could impregnate me, you utter fool.” Mydei growled deeply, still somewhat debating at least choking the man to shut him up.

Phainon laughed at that.

He laughed so earnestly that Mydei found himself leaning away, blinking at Phainon and watching him just.. Laugh. 

“Probably not!” Phainon conceded, still huffing out a small wheeze of a laugh or two even as Mydei forced himself to look away - to focus back on those loud popping fireworks and not on the odd flips his mind and heart were doing over that calm sweet laugh.

Mydei wasn’t even sure how long he was staring at those fireworks - doing his damnedest to ignore the alpha sitting so close their knees were touching but eventually the machinery flicked back to life - beginning its movements again.

Mydei had to bite back a growl over the way he jostled only slightly at it beginning to swing again - a growl over the way Phainon’s hands had so instantly darted to his hips to help steady Mydei. Help he most certainly did not need, especially as those hands only remained there for a few long and extra seconds before removing themselves once Mydei gave him a narrowed glare.

“The fireworks aren’t over, but he only agreed to stop us up here for a few minutes, sadly.” Phainon explained innocently with a kind smile, one that made Mydei feel his eye twitch over before looking away again and out the damn glass.

“How did you even get him to agree to it?” Mydei inquired rather quietly, because honestly, it was baffling. How on earth did he already set this up when Mydei got here first? Did he have the ferris wheel booth worker’s phone on speed dial..?

Mydei didn’t understand this weird ass alpha, at all, he found.

“I’ve known him for years!” 

That only made Mydei slowly cross his arms and lean back into the cold metal bench, blinking at the equally metal ceiling before letting out a loud huffing noise.

“Of course you have.” Mydei said with a roll of his eyes dramatically, because it wasn’t even that had to consider Phainon knowing everyone. The man was usually such an extroverted dog that the idea of him knowing most people wasn’t farfetched.

At all.

Phainon only offered a quiet hum at that, also merely waiting for the doors to free them now as they arrived at the bottom once again.

It didn’t take but two seconds of the doors swinging open on their car for Phainon to immediately dash to his feet - beaming at the still sitting Mydei.

“One more game, Mydei!” Phainon said rather gleefully, and Mydei was powerless to tell him no - to not indulge him as he allowed the fellow alpha to drag him away swiftly as he stood up.

Mydei’s eyes only roamed over the man who was working the booth - the cheerful wave he gave as they passed was strange to Mydei. 

Strange because he wasn’t exactly used to strangers being so excited to see him come or go - though, as golden eyes moved back to focus on the alpha gripping his wrist and the grin on his lips. He understood why easily, Phainon’s energy was addicting and contagious. 

Even more so as those blue eyes looked behind him at Mydei with a twinkle dancing in them.

Mydei forced himself to break that eye contact, instead focusing on the game booth they had already gone to once today - the same one with the stupid giant lion Mydei had jokingly claimed to want.

“Didn’t we already play this one?” Mydei mumbled out, eyes roaming the machines again as Phainon quickly approached it, giving a huff as he was quickly ushered to a red stool regardless of his words with Phainon plopping beside him. 

“Mhm. But this time I’ll win the big lion plush for you.” Phainon told him as he leaned slightly back in his own stool with a twinkle in his eyes - something that made Mydei arch a brow curiously.

“Oh? What’s with the new confidence?” Mydei inquired, giving a small scoff as Phainon leaned back to hand over the tickets to the worker who clearly was waiting for the night to end - and for these two grown ass alphas to go home. 

Mydei only copied and faced to the front, staring at the bullseye mark dully. 

“I don’t mind you having stuff to hold in your arms, now.” Phainon answered lightly, giving a small laugh and that made Mydei feel his thoughts stall. 

“.. Huh?”

Mydei had barely even focused as the game shot to life with the worker yelling go, well. Mydei certainly wasn’t winning due to how stunlocked he had been - he already had missed a ton just from his hands not even being on the silly handles of the gun.

Instead his eyes only drifted to Phainon’s side, staring in mere awe over it.

The man wasn’t missing at all - if anything, it was nearly perfect. 

Had he just been purposefully losing all night long?

Mydei might actually kill him.

It didn’t take long for even the worker to be impressed, clearly clapped at Phainon easily filled the bar. And Mydei only found himself blinking blankly over it as Phainon turned slightly to beam at him - clearly desiring praise for his easy win.

Mydei offered none; “Were you just faking all night?”

Phainon laughed at that, loudly as he stood before slowly moving to stand close to Mydei - leaning down to Mydei who was sitting at the stool still.

“If you get to fake an injury to make me carry you, my dear Mydei. I get to fake having poor aim so you hold my arms and guide me at least once, don’t I?” 

Phainon’s voice was low, quiet as he spoke, and Mydei could only feel his face burning over the way his words had almost fanned over his ear hotly. Mydei found himself staring into nothing over that, hairs standing on end over the way Phainon gave a light-hearted laugh, stepping away slightly.

“You wanted the lion, right?” Phainon innocently asked, and that made Mydei’s eyes trail back to the oversized lion - only pausing on the only slightly smaller sized white dog below it.

Mydei could barely think over the heartbeat he now heard thudding in his ears, the embarrassing heat in his face, and the way he felt so very uncomfortable in his own skin.

“.. The dog.” Mydei corrected him, voice quiet and almost pathetic to his own ears - so obviously flustered but Phainon didn’t comment, he only laughed slightly.

“The dog?” Phainon asked for clarification, almost teasingly.

“Yes.”

Phainon only hummed gently, and Mydei had to brave the shame in his face to blink at that alpha that was still so keenly watching him; “Are you sure? I’m getting it for you, not for me, just so we’re clear.”

Mydei sighed at that, standing while knitting his brows together.

This man was going to be the death of him, one way or another.

“.. I want the dog.” Mydei admitted, more to himself than to Phainon as he stared at the alpha to his side - coming to terms with his own reality more than the damn plushie on the wall.

“Alright! If you say so! The dog it is!” Phainon happily said before moving a few feet to talk to the worker - and Mydei only stared after him.

Eyes flicking before the plushie he had opted to get, and to the alpha he feared he desired in ways that defied his own nature. 

It was almost a horrific thought.

The idea of wanting to be close to that man, to keep being in the presence of an alpha that desired more from him, that wanted to love him.

But even if it was against his nature, there was nothing saying he couldn’t indulge himself with what he wanted.

Just this once.

Phainon only turned back to him, beaming over the big stupid white dog plushie he had obtained.

“Here is your dog you wanted!”

And Mydei only found his eyes taking in the gleeful alpha, blue eyes dazzling as they stared into gold; Mydei was powerless against laughing as he took the damn plushie from the man.

“ Right.. Here he is.”

Chapter End Notes

Chapter Notes

i cried

cried
cried again

“Phainon,”

The alpha in question only hummed happily, glancing over his shoulder slightly to beam at the fellow alpha sulking after him with a rather large plush dog bundled in his arms. Phainon almost was jealous towards it, almost, as his eyes met with narrowed golden. 

“I’m not dressed for a dinner reservation.” Mydei hissed at him, and Phainon couldn’t help but give a laugh, slowing slightly to fall side by side with Mydei while still holding onto his wrist tightly - thankful the alpha was allowing that much.

“Don’t worry about it! You look great.” Phainon sweetly told him, because well, the man did look stunning in everything - Phainon feared for his sanity if he stared for too long even, fingers soothingly rubbing a small circle into the free hand Mydei had given him.

Phainon almost felt nervous over the glare that earned him from Mydei, but the way the alpha still had one arm holding a plush white dog to his chest really diminished any attempts of seeming mad. Thus, Phainon could only smile widely as they walked. 

How could he be anything but happy?

Everything just felt so right when Mydei was around him - like it all finally clicked into place why he could never figure out love or manage to have close relationships like love with others.

It was as if Mydei was the missing puzzle piece that always itched and gnawed at his brain was missing. 

How was he supposed to ever want to let go of someone like that?

Easy. 

He wouldn’t, instead he only somewhat tightened his grip on the alpha still trailing after him silently - sulking with his arm leading the way. He’d do anything to make sure this man accepted him, he most assuredly wouldn’t mess this second chance up. 

Not for anything! 

He would make him happy this time!

“Phainon.” 

Phainon slowed his steps at that - only slightly aware of his pace speeding up in his jumbled thoughts - slowing to match Mydei’s once again to fall beside him.

“You still haven’t explained nearly enough.”

Phainon barked a laugh at that, savoring the blonde’s borderline scowl in the night air - it truly was baffling how perfect Mydei seemed no matter the situation. 

“Which question do you want me to answer first?” Phainon innocently inquired, eyes blinking upwards as the twilight sky slowly fell overhead - something was so romantic to him about walking almost hand in hand with Mydei through the night.

The path ahead only illuminated by the rising moon above, the street lights, and the passing cars. Rarely a still open business too that Phainon fought urges to glance through the windows into.

“Where are we going?” Mydei asked, a question that he had already asked before, so Phainon only looked at him with a teasing smile at his side, daring to scoot minisculely closer to him as they walked. 

“To dinner! Our reservation!” Phainon answered easily, swinging Mydei’s arm softly are they walked - still keeping a hold on his wrist firmly as he smiled at him almost smugly. 

Mydei didn’t return that smile, only narrowing his eyes yet not pausing his footsteps to keep up with Phainon’s path, still holding that plushie up against his body as they went.

“.. Where?” Was the resounding query Mydei posed, and Phainon could only look forward as he gave a quiet ‘hmm’ noise as if he needed to think about that one teasingly.

“At a cafe.” Phainon answered almost just as teasingly, almost able to sense the way Mydei slightly bristled over that - something that made Phainon feel somewhat nervous.

He didn’t want to upset the alpha, truly. He just wanted to keep it a secret! Just a bit longer..

“You are insufferable. Why do you have such a good aim?” Mydei hissed out, following his anger with a second question. Clearly, still stuck on the way Phainon had easily won that rigged water gun game 

Phainon shrugged his shoulders loosely.

“Lots of practice.” 

“For?”

Phainon didn’t miss the slight annoyance in Mydei’s growled out word, and he couldn’t help but move even a tad closer in their walks.

He hated to admit this - but Mydei smelled somehow more delicious when he was angry, a piece of him hated making him angry, hated upsetting him. But he smelled so good Phainon couldn’t help but tease him slightly to sniff at the thick air around him.

Mydei always smelled sweet to him, but it was never as strong as when he was annoyed.

He knew other alpha’s scents soured and rotted when angry - yet Mydei’s pheromones only became more intoxicating to him.

It was a dangerous game.

The only time Mydei’s scent ever smelled even slightly off apparently was when he was sad - a souring scent that made Phainon’s hair stand on end.

One that haunted Phainon’s nose, regretting deeply the fact he had ever smelled it in the first place and that he remembered it was due to them having sex on his rut.

But Phainon couldn’t dare think about that, only brushing himself into the alpha slightly to his side with his own arm before giving a laugh over his confusion with Phainon’s aim.

“For winning you a plushie later on in life, it seems!”

“Are you going to actually answer my questions, or just piss me off the more I ask?” Mydei asked him in a tone that was clearly teetering on anger, a tone that made Phainon blink and look at Mydei’s face instead of the street ahead. Only feeling his heart flutter pathetically over the way that blue gem on his ear gleamed under the streetlights. 

Phainon laughed at that view lightly, mainly due to how cute Mydei looked growling at Phainon while holding an oversized white dog plushie. As if he was even able to be threatening with that and not charming.. Phainon found that idea laughable!

“Sorry, sorry! Honestly, I used to be really good at basketball and that’s kind of like aiming a gun, isn’t it?” Phainon said with a genuine smile, hoping to calm the angered alpha who only stared right back at him with an expression of utter confusion - or maybe even shock. 

Phainon couldn’t decipher it.

“.. No?” That simple word from Mydei made Phainon’s eyebrows shoot up to his hairline in shock.

Honestly, he thought it did translate over pretty well!

“Oh.. Sheer luck, maybe?” Phainon offered with a lop-sided smile, only watching at Mydei full on scowled at him before sighing deeply visibly - as if he had suddenly come to the realization that the topic wasn’t worth his annoyance. 

“You’re truly insufferable.” Mydei mumbled out with a lazy and slow shake of his head before continuing on; “There’s no way it’s just luck.”

Phainon couldn’t stop the laugh that bubbled up and escaped his throat, because honestly that was the only practice he had. “I told you! My only practice was basketball!”

Mydei scoffed at that, a noise that made Phainon blink to look at him, staring at the way he was smirking even if he sounded annoyed.

Only praying that his heart would stop beating so painfully loudly over seeing Mydei’s lips slightly upturned.

“Okay. Why did that worker at the ferris wheel know you?” Mydei inquired with a huffing noise, one that made Phainon arch a brow slowly before shrugging his shoulders.

“Oh! Yeah, that.. I went to the fair earlier this week and begged them.”

That one was easy.

He had gone there very shamefully, bought an entry ticket. And begged. 

“.. What?” Mydei said a voice in such an egregious tone that Phainon couldn’t stop the chuckle that left his lips as he focused forward again, still rubbing a small circle into Mydei’s wrist slowly. 

“Yeah. I said there was this pretty alpha I wanted to impress.” Phainon only somewhat teased, giving a small huff of a laugh at the memory.

“.. You can’t be serious.” Mydei said in a very, very disbelieving tone, one that made Phainon only laugh once more.

“Oh, but I completely am! They were so amused by the way I said you were a fellow alpha, that they said they’d allow it if I warned them beforehand.”

The memory of it really was rather humorous and maybe embarrassing. Phainon found he usually had no shame with Mydei involved and just wanted to make him happy, so that part was debatable.

The humorous part easily was the way no worker fully believed him and gave him looks of ‘oh, we’ll see about this ‘alpha’ you want to impress’. Meanwhile the entire time with Mydei at the fair he could visibly see them staring Mydei up and down, most likely baffled by the man’s build and the fact they were clearly there together.

They most likely wouldn’t have believed Phainon if he said Mydei was very gentle and tender due to his well built appearance alone..

“I got there before you.” Mydei pointed out roughly, seemingly unconvinced of his story, but Phainon only laughed lightly at that.

“Yep! I warned them earlier that day, left to change and get ready - which mainly meant Aglaea scolding my choices. And then you beat me there!” Phainon leaned into him slightly, just enough to sate himself more than anything as he sniffed the air lightly - savoring the fact this alpha was back in his life. 

“Huh..” Mydei mumbled out quietly, and Phainon almost worried he was aware of Phainon’s pathetic attempts to be closer to him.

Instead, Phainon only swiftly continued the conversation as he leaned away again slightly - eyes never truly leaving those blonde locks out of the corner of his peripheral vision; “So, a lot of the workers were watching to see if you actually were an alpha.”

“And the verdict?” Mydei asked innocently, a question that made Phainon swallow down another laugh - he couldn’t keep laughing at the poor confused alpha, not when he was allowing Phainon to touch him.

“We got stuck on the ferris wheel, didn’t we?” Phainon teased lightly, only smiling at his eyes flickered the falling sky, truly settling into the nighttime.

“Hm.”

They fell into a silence at that, not a very long one however as Phainon directed Mydei into taking a specific turn - one that instantly made Mydei make a quiet snorting noise. One of a man who was solving Phainon’s silly secret date idea.

“.. Phainon.”

“Yes, Mydei?” Phainon could only blink wide, fakely innocent eyes at Mydei, giving him a small smile. His goose was cooked, surely. 

“Are you taking me to Aglaea’s cafe?” Mydei hissed out the realization he had come to and.. Well.

Phainon’s goose was completely cooked.. 

Leave it to the beautiful alpha he wanted to make into his boyfriend to spoil the surprise.. Not to say he didn’t expect him to puzzle it out quickly, or anything. He completely did.

“Yep! I have a reservation!” Phainon instead happily told him, snapping his head forward to focus on the path and not at the alpha borderline leering at him over those words. 

Mydei’s eyes were stunning - they sometimes caught the light and glittered with golden flakes, breathtaking in every sense of the word. They also were akin to a cat’s that narrowed and tore a hole into Phainon’s facades he tried to display easily. He didn’t dare look at the way they were glaring at him now!

Mydei was silent for a few brief seconds before sighing rather loudly and dramatically; “.. It didn’t used to stay open this late, did it?”

“Nope. Still normally it doesn't.” Phainon agreed with a small laugh, still swaying Mydei’s arm loosely - more than over the moon that the alpha was still allowing him to do this.

Though, considering Mydei didn’t deny he had lied about his injury, Phainon shouldn’t be too shocked. 

He’d have to find a way to ask about that.

Eventually.

“.. Huh?” Mydei’s tone was clearly aghast, so much so that Phainon’s head snapped to look at him curiously, not at all shocked when Mydei was staring right back at him - obviously baffled.

“I asked for a favor and they were all very willing to help.”

Mydei was silent for a few moments 

“You’re all demons.” Mydei mumbled out rather quietly, making Phainon laugh lightly before bumping into him with his own shoulder playfully.

“Awe, c’mon Mydei! The cats miss you.” Phainon told him sweetly, beaming as the blonde shot him a testing glare - one with no bark behind it as Phainon couldn’t ignore that plushie still carried under his arm lazily.

Mydei sighed out loudly; “Is that the excuse you’re picking?”

“Yep!”

Mydei was silent for a moment with Phainon’s sheer joy, seeming to crease his brows as he considered something to himself before giving a small bark of a laugh - almost seeming way too amused about whatever he thought of.

“Interesting. How much did you pay for this experience?” Mydei asked and that question made Phainon whistle rather innocently before driving his eyes to Mydei’s hand, staring at the way it was so limply allowing Phainon to hold onto his wrist.

A piece of his desperately wanted to drift his hand lower - to weave their hands perfectly together.

Would Mydei allow that..?

Phainon flicked his eyes back to Mydei to offer a wide smile; “Not a dime!” 

Mydei looked away at that, focusing forward with a quiet ‘tch’ leaving his mouth.

“Wow. I’m sure Aglaea’s investors wouldn’t like to hear that.” Mydei sounded almost amused by it however, completely betraying his own words that seemed as if they were scolding Aglaea’s choice to let them have a silly dinner reservation here. 

Aglaea’s investors.

Phainon was aware she had to get investors to be able to open up this dog and cat cafe due to not having enough funds herself, but..

“Oh, didn’t you know?” Phainon teased, only smiling a bit wider as Mydei’s eyes returned to him - a brow arching upwards.

“Hmm?”

“Most of the business was funded by one person who kept their name anonymous and donates monthly, it’s really sweet.” 

Phainon explained with a shrug of his shoulders, still smiling as he chanced a glance at a passing car - he had made their reservation at nine thirty, so he really didn’t mind the nice leisurely stroll with Mydei.

“Wow.” Mydei said in a very lackluster tone, one that bordered on quite plainly not having any interest in the topic but Phainon only laughed over that reaction lightly.

“Mhm. So no! They don’t mind doing this for us.”

“I see.” Mydei grumbled out rather quietly, allowing the silent air to drift between them again as they made their way through the quiet streets.

But there was still something that had always bothered Phainon about Mydei.

It only bothered him more and more when he looked at Mydei - when he thought about the personality Mydei had.

“Have you gone on a lot of dates before, Mydei?” Phainon asked in a voice that he hoped was friendly and sweet, prayed that he didn’t give any signs that if he said ‘yes, i’ve been on hundreds’ Phainon would be jealous as all hell. 

“In general? Not really.”

Those words were so very confusing to Phainon. He was almost sure Mydei had claimed such a thing before - but the fact Mydei was single had always been beyond a befuddling thing to him.

Wasn’t he borderline perfect?

Phainon couldn’t help but look at him, taking in how fluffy his hair looked, soft and well maintained. His facial expression wasn’t scowling currently, he almost looked amused or happy, it was light in its nature and almost gentle seeming.

Phainon didn’t even dare consider looking Mydei’s body up and down - he didn’t need to even stop to think about him naked again.

“We would have to talk it out instead, wouldn’t we?” Phainon only continued with his grin growing slightly, leaning onto the table slightly with a low ‘hmm?’ leaving his throat.

Mydei stared at him silently.

And Phainon didn’t dare break that silence, only staring right back - determined to keep the alpha’s gaze held if he was so determined to stare at him.

“Alright.” 

Phainon blinked at that word. At the way Mydei spoke it and turned his head slowly away and broke eye contact.

He blinked.

Really hard.

“.. Alright?” Phainon echoed out, not really sure what on earth Mydei was on about with that word. Was he.. Angry that Phainon kept teasing him or bringing it up?

The mere thought of that made Phainon sniff at the air, trying to see if he had missed any slight changes with Mydei’s scent and well.. He found nothing confusedly.

“Let’s look at apartments together.” Mydei added dryly before giving a start of a smile - as if he was obviously amused by something but Phainon couldn’t name it.

Probably because Phainon felt like he had just been hit over the head with a really heavy rock.

Phainon was dead silent, only able to hear the heartbeat in his ears as he stared at those golden eyes. Mydei’s expression had fully relaxed as he leaned into his chair more, just staring right back at Phainon.

Waiting.

“Seriously?” Was Phainon’s really great reply, one that was hoarse - voice almost cracking as the word fell out of his mouth.

“Are you already regret-”

Phainon was quick to interrupt that, only leaning closer across the table, very glad he blew out that damn candle now; “No! Don’t finish whatever your demonic mouth was about to say!” 

He paused, staring at the way Mydei didn’t seem any less amused - like he had completely expected Phainon to interrupt him in a rush. Like he was winning some sort of argument that Phainon was not aware they were even having.

“I’m just shocked you’d go for it.” Phainon continued with a small sigh as he leaned back - willing himself to try to be normal. 

Mydei only smirked, a hand gently patting at his stuffed animal.“I do hate my apartment, after all.”

“Yeah.. But..”

“And bills are so rough. Now that I’m jobless.” Mydei said with a long, almost dreamy sigh tumbling out of his lips - almost in a tone that sounded like he was faking being distressed about it. There was no true woe in his words and well..

Phainon couldn’t say he wasn’t willing to be Mydei’s sugar daddy regardless, so even if he was jobless and just baked for his keep - Phainon didn’t mind!

He still technically worked! And doing your hobby as a job sounded wonderful!

“You sound like you’re joking..” Phainon told him despite his thoughts, giving a small laugh as he did so - though he didn’t miss the glint in Mydei’s eyes. 

“Do I? Strange.” Mydei started, moving to cross his arms over his chest with a loose shrugging motion as he did so. “Maybe I secretly have some really good investments. Who knows?”

“Mr. Mydeimos, do you want me to move your stuffed animal?” 

That voice made both of them jump slightly, and Phainon was horrible embarrassed he didn’t see Hyacine approaching considering she came from behind Mydei.. But in his defense!

Mydei smiling and smirking was really, really distracting!

“Oh..” Mydei gave no more signs of his shock, instead slowly picking up the dog to stare at it for a moment, blinking before looking at Hyacine almost uncertainly.

“I’ll do it for you!” Phainon said extremely quickly, hopping out of his chair without much of a second thought to take it instead from him and turning away. It would be easy to place it on one of the many shelves cats lay on since Mydei surely doesn’t mind the hair and no other customers were here.

But furthermore, with his back turned he did take a chance to rub his scent on it - just a little!

As a treat..

“But, Phainon, you’re off-shift I-”

“Too late! Your hands are full!” Phainon interrupted as he stalked away, not even turning back as he heard Mydei very loudly scoffing over his words. 

“Okay.. Here is your water and sandwich.” Hyacine spoke behind Phainon’s back, clearly shuffling around to place things on the table for him - though Phainon paid it no heed as he slowly rubbed his wrist on the stuffed animal a few more times silently before placing it down.

Only to turn around with a beaming smile on his lips - very aware of those golden eyes keenly watching his every move. 

That alone made Phainon sweat nervously as he slowly walked back, innocently looking for a cat to distract Mydei with. 

They were all still very much asleep, regrettably..

“.. Thanks.” Mydei said as his eyes drifted off Phainon and to Hyacine - who also only turned slightly as Phainon crept back, now somewhat ashamed of scenting the poor stuffed animal with Mydei’s knowing eyes on him.

“Phainon, I bought your water with a silly lemon wedge, but the parfait will take a minute!” Hyacine told him with a beaming smile and well.

He could only give her a small thumbs up while trying to swallow the lump in his throat; “That’s okay!”

Hyacine gave a few nods, smiling at them both before curtsying much too politely; “Please excuse me, then!”

Mydei was silent as he watched her go, turning just a tad to keep an eye on her before returning his gaze to Phainon - his brow immediately arching upwards.

“Territorial, aren’t we?”

That question made Phainon swallow hard - again.

Nervously moving to rub the back of his nape slowly, blinking at Mydei with wide-eyes as if he didn’t understand before laughing sheepishly;  “Haha.. Towards what?”

Mydei seemed amused if anything, only scrunching his brows together before pursing his lips ever so briefly.

“Won’t even let the poor omega touch the stuffed animal and get her scent on it.”

Phainon forced out a hollow laugh, doing his best to keep the blush from rising in his face over being called out on his antics.

He couldn’t help it!

He won it for Mydei, it was only his right to make sure it went to Mydei’s home smelling of him too!

“I.. Wasn’t even thinking of that, I was just being polite!” Phainon lied slowly, with another weak laugh thrown in - as if the shakiness of his voice wasn’t a dead give away or something. 

“Hmph.” Mydei gave a scoff, “Terrible liar, I saw you rubbing your nasty paws on it.”

Phainon found himself almost choking over the words ‘nasty paws’ before moving to take a slow deliberate sip of his water - struggling to stay sane over the way Mydei seemed to be fully enjoying himself with a grin on his lips.

Phainon knew Mydei was stunning - but when he smiled fully, how was he supposed to keep innocently lying?

“You must be seeing things..” Phainon mumbled out in a croak of a voice as he set his water down slowly, only opting to change the subject with a point of his finger as Mydei had begun unwrapping his sandwich slowly;  “What kind of sandwich is it? Maybe she surprised us all.”

Mydei was merciful it seemed, or just sated when he finally had food in his hands - Phainon really couldn’t tell - and allowed the topic change to run its course easily.

Instead, he took a bite before slowly nodding.

“Tuna.”

Phainon only joined him in nodding. “Ah, well. Hyacine did warn you.”

Mydei looked at him for a second before ceasing his nodding, as if he was heavily considering something.

“It’s fine.” Mydei mumbled out regardless, eyes flicking back to focusing on his food.

Phainon huffed out a breath slowly, doing his best not to stare at the alpha and instead focusing out the window again at the void outside.

Mydei had agreed to move in, but they said he never had many alpha friends - was he really sure he would be comfortable at all?

Phainon would be fine - he might have to jerk off every night smelling this scent everywhere, but he’d be fine! That’s just a change in his nightly pattern!

But if Mydei grew to be agitated every day of his life, Phainon would debate lighting himself on fire.

Phainon sighed at his own worries before speaking, eyes glued to the window still. “Okay so.. About moving in together.. Do yo-”

“You guys are moving in together?”

Phainon stiffened at that before jerking his head to stare at Hyacine slowly putting his parfait in front of him - eyes wide as she looked between both the alphas. 

“Hello, Hyacine.” Mydei greeted flatly as he swallowed another bite. Clearly, he had seen her approaching but Phainon certainly hadn’t!

“Sorry sorry, I’m not meant to eavesdrop but like..” 

“We were discussing it.” Mydei informed her rather softly - like he didn’t mind at all that Hyacine knew this information.

Phainon, however, most assuredly would not be living this down next time they had a shift together. He was quite sure the news was going to spread like wildfire and well.. 

A part of him ashamedly was kind of proud! While also somehow horribly embarrassed at how quickly he was moving Mydei along..

“Wow.. That’s unlike you, Mr. Mydeimos.” Hyacine quietly said before giving a small laugh, “Oh! That reminds me! Pardon me..”

Hyacine slowly leaned at that, obviously close to Mydei. 

Phainon blinked for a few seconds so very briefly before going rigid once again as the realization hit him - she was sniffing Mydei.

Phainon found himself easily clenching his fist under the table until it hurt over that one. He’s normal! He’s got this! 

The fact Mydei was just as owl-eyed staring as she did such an action calmed Phainon just the slightest bit - both simply watching her sniff at Mydei.

Phainon was also slightly sniffing at Mydei - not nearly as obvious, but more so keeping an eye on any changes, any attempts to woo the omega so close to him.

“Hmm.” Hyacine hummed melodically as she leaned away, once again tucking her hands behind her back now that she had delivered Phainon’s very forgotten parfait to him. Both alphas only remained staring at her as if she had two heads silently.

And that seemed to finally get to her as she looked between the both of them quickly,  “Sorry, Aglaea asked me to sniff you and see if you’re what I remember you smelling like..”

Mydei scoffed at that, immediately only narrowing his eyes over that.

Phainon was the one to speak instead after his scoff, now cocking his own head to the side in his interest towards this topic; “Did she? And what’s the verdict?”

“Mr. Mydeimos smells the same as I remember him to smell.. Well..” Hyacine paused, and that alone made both alphas physically reel over what that ‘well’ could mean. 

“Maybe a little like Phainon, but otherwise it’s fine!”

Mydei didn’t seem bothered by that, instead mumbling out his reply softly; “.. Probably because he kept rubbing into that arm you're sniffing.”

Phainon moved to take another swig of his water at that - feeling rather parched over the way Mydei had now confirmed he did notice him purposely bumping into him as they walked.

But, the important part was he didn’t tell Phainon to stop!

Another win for him in his book.

Hyacine seemed stunned over Mydei’s words, 

“Oh! Yeah, that would explain it..” Hyacine only slowly nodded, still seeming to carry her feelings of shock on her face - as if she wasn’t even trying to hide it; “Anyway, there’s your parfait, Phainon! I’ll leave you to be, now!”

“Thanks!” Phainon replied, not daring to touch the damn parfait and instead leaning back to watch her go.

How close had they actually been?

Phainon couldn’t help but wonder such a thing considering how she would have remembered his scent, and acted odd about Mydei hanging out around Phainon. 

Even more confusing now was the way she seemed energetic towards helping when he explained the situation to them all and Aglaea offering to help - so what was so confusing about Mydei actually being here?

“You’ve gotten way better at controlling your pheromones.” Mydei’s smooth as honey voice ripped Phainon from his thoughts, easily making ocean blue eyes snap to golden amber that were staring him down - almost studying him.

Phainon laughed sheepishly at that before moving a hand to swirl his cup of water, watching ice cubes make a small jingle as they collided into the glass; “Haha.. Have I? I never really even noticed myself trying to scent things around you before..”

Phainon was very aware of the way Mydei watched him like a hawk, every action he did - the way those golden eyes were keenly gazing at him swirling a cup of water.

For the first time in Phainon’s life, he felt like the prey here.

“Mm.. You seem much more controlled.” Mydei mumbled out with a quiet huff, eyes still unmoving even as he mindlessly took another mouthful of his sandwich in his silence.

Phainon hummed over that before giving a laugh, one that was almost nervous because he truly never had even meant to. Nor was he making an effort now to stop it. An effort to regulate his emotions better? Sure!

His pheromones? Maybe!

He didn’t know!

“That’s a good thing, yeah?” Phainon found himself ashamedly timid as he asked - as if that could possibly be anything but a good thing?

Mydei stared at him for a moment before giving a small laugh - one that died down rather abruptly as he seemed to consider something.

His expression became almost immediately indecipherable as he paused eating his sandwich - only staring at Phainon with a slow tilt of his head to the side, a movement Phainon always watched in awe over how beautiful he was.

“What do you think about that mark you put on my neck?”

That mark.

Even thinking of the way it was still there drove Phainon to insanity. How was he supposed to be normal about an alpha with his bite mark on him? More importantly, it was Mydei with that bite mark still on him.

It was as if Phainon had staked his claim on another alpha and Mydei’s body had just.. Accepted it.

“I don’t know..” Phainon mumbled, trying to ignore the way he felt overly excited even thinking about it again, instead giving a small smile;  “Maybe you just have bad skin and it hasn’t healed due to that?”

Mydei’s quickly dipped into a scowl, only momentarily before he barked out a laugh, shaking his head disapprovingly;  “Are you trying to piss me off?”

“Joking, joking! I have no idea, really.” Phainon moved to lean back, waving his hands over his chest defensively;  “I thought it would have been healed and gone by now.”

“You and me both.” Mydei rumbled out that reply instantly, returning to working on his sandwich yet again. 

“Why worry about it, you can’t see it on yourself anyway, right?” Phainon inquired innocently, because Phainon certainly wasn’t worried about it! He was very gleeful, actually! 

He wished Mydei would show it off, if anything!

Mydei took a moment to retort however, either due to not wanting to be rude with food in his mouth - or thinking deeply on how to snark back without insulting Phainon.

Phainon couldn’t really say! But he knew the alpha most likely was furious to be almost branded in such a way.

“.. That doesn’t mean I can just forget you’ve marked me.” Mydei eventually hissed out, almost in a tone that was either extremely tired, or annoyed. Phainon really couldn’t tell between the two with this topic.  “I’m an alpha, I’m not supposed to get a mating bite.”

Phainon found himself falling silent - only slightly mourning the fact no cats had come up to them for Mydei’s sake. 

He would just have to take him here during the day!

But even then, he wasn’t sure if the cats would be interested in them without treats..

“But it’s really hot that you have one, so does that help?” Phainon innocently asked, not daring to look at the alpha as he said such words, focusing instead on looking for cats yet again. 

“What?” Mydei’s voice came out so stunned and quiet that Phainon found himself laughing light-heartedly as he looked back at Mydei - grinning over the way Mydei had his shock so plainly written on his usually stoic face.

“Oh, I can’t be honest?” Phainon playfully asked, faking a look of sorrow or distress as Mydei stared at him.

“.. You’re insufferable.”

A look that didn’t seem to work as Mydei only slowly shook his head - though, he was obviously smiling just a tiny bit over it. Clearly amused by something Phainon had said or done, so Phainon would be counting that as another win - thank you!

“You’ve told me that many times before!” Phainon fakely whined out, pouting just a bit more but Mydei was obviously growing immune to such a ploy from him. Barely even blinking as Phainon jutted out his bottom lip.

Mydei didn’t even bat an eye; “Because it’s true.” 

“But you missed me!” Phainon countered - pointing a finger at Mydei as he perked up yet again, throwing out his attempts to seem like a kicked dog since they clearly weren’t working on the cat lover.

“I did.” Mydei flatly agreed, and that alone sent Phainon’s train of thought spiraling. 

Mydei wasn’t supposed to admit to missing him.. Even if he already had admitted to it!

He wasn’t supposed to do it again!

“Don’t just admit to that..” Phainon meekly told him, feeling unsure of his words as they left his lips - dry and hoarse. 

Something so monotony said should not make him this flustered and yet.. 

How was it supposed to not make him flustered when he just wanted to rub himself into that alpha and bask in his scent? He didn’t need any confidence boost in regards to how much he thought Mydei would allow, okay?

“Oh? I can’t be honest either and say it was mutual?” Mydei fired back quickly, and Phainon found himself choking just a bit more over that as he blinked at Mydei.

“I never said I missed you..” Phainon tried to tease back, tired being the keyword because he felt like he was losing this game of chess horribly right now - this was much different than the date where Mydei had obviously been trying to show Phainon he would prefer someone else..

Mydei actually flirting back and being genuinely nice was making his head spin painfully.

“Should I repeat what Aglaea said you were doing during those two weeks, then?”

Phainon thought about that for about three whole seconds. Only three seconds. Before shaking his head extremely roughly.

“No, nevermind. I missed you too, Mydei!” Phainon found himself pleading for mercy slightly, he didn’t want to hear what she had said about him because well. Phainon had been absolutely miserable - probably to be around as well.

He was doing his best not to think about it too much!

“You’re insufferable.” Mydei told him, lacking any venom or bite behind his words as he finished his sandwich with a smile dancing on his lips minisculely.

“You keep saying that, you know?” Phainon pointed out, laughing over the fact he did keep calling him that. Phainon was starting to debate if that was just Mydei’s favorite adjective or not in life.

“Because it’s true.” Mydei countered with a loud huffing noise - still easily making Phainon’s heart swoon with the upturn of his lips and twinkle in his eye.

‘But you like me’ were words that died on Phainon’s tongue as he instead slid his parfait across the table and to Mydei, one that Mydei’s own hand snapped to - obviously to stop it from sliding off the table.

“That’s for you, by the way.” Phainon told him with a grin, one that made Mydei arch a brow instantly as his golden eyes dropped to the parfait instead. 

“.. Why order it then?”

“For you.”

Mydei scoffed loudly, but instead of snapping a retort he did immediately accept it and start to eat it. And Phainon found himself easily amused by that as he moved to prop his head up on his head, giving a smirk over Mydei slowly eating the parfait. Even if those golden eyes were narrowed like an angry cat being sated by treats.

Phainon would let the alpha eat in peace.. For now.

After all, Aglaea had told him food is his love language.

.. And Phainon’s bread offering for courting hadn’t exactly gone well originally.

──────────────

Phainon wasn’t ashamed to say he had gone to sleep smiling while rolling around on his bed in Aglaea’s guest room after walking Mydei home. (And slightly jealous of the plushie dog going fully home with Mydei.)

He wasn’t ashamed!

He was absolutely still giddy from last night, and he was still full of that glee as he returned home and swung the spare keys Aglaea had given him around with his finger.

The rest of the night had been just idle chit chatting and a formal walking of Mydei back to his apartment - Mydei had offered to walk him home but Phainon was quick to point out Aglaea was there. That had easily changed his mind for some reason.

Probably the whole sniffing ordeal Mydei seemed to be going through.

Regardless! It felt unreal. 

Everything about last night was beyond insane to him - Mydei had accepted him back into his life, accepted to go on that date, been so very sweet to him, and then even considered and agreed to being roommates.

The roommate thing was especially crazy because honestly, Phainon spoke without thinking! Like at all!

He had no idea how he was supposed to keep his hands off that alpha when they lived together and he could smell him constantly? Hadn’t the last time they ‘lived’ together gone so badly? 

Though, that was mainly due to his rut.. The fear still lurked in his stomach, however!

But he will do his best. For Mydei’s sake. He would help him with his bills until he got a new job at the very least. That was the least he could do for the alpha he was head over heels for.

Only Phainon found himself pausing as he entered the guest bedroom now that his daily chores were done in life and the door shut behind him, blinking at his phone slowly as he finally had checked it.

Mydei; Phainon.
Phainon; hello mydei! good afternoon sunshine! 💙❤️
Mydei; Phainon.
Mydei; Do you actually want me to break your spine?

Phainon blinked at that, painfully slowly as he tilted his head as he sat on the edge of ‘his’ bed for the last almost three weeks. 

Phainon; woah! what did i do?!
Mydei; The box.
Mydei; You’re seriously trying to piss me off?
Phainon; no no no! thats for me 💙
Mydei; .. For you?
Phainon; mhm! so i never misbehave again!
Mydei; ? It’s for you?
Phainon; yep! my gift to you! whenever you want!
Mydei; .. I see.
Phainon; yep! dont be mad!
Phainon; thats why you have the key to it after all 💙

Phainon moved to run a hand through his hair slowly, he really hadn’t intended it to anger Mydei? 

He completely thought the alpha would enjoy such a gift!

Aglaea certainly had not, however, when his package showed up at the doorstep - if anything, Phainon thought he almost saw god on that day.


 Mydei; Right.
Mydei; Interesting.
Mydei; I’m still angry.
Phainon; what!
Phainon; do you want me to come over?? i can prove its for me if you want!
Phainon; im not busy today.. mydei dont be mad..
Phainon; mydei ill die
Mydei; Come over.
Phainon; 🫡im On My Way! 💙

Mydei didn’t give a shit - he only greeted the man with an extremely bloodthirsty glare as Phainon knocked at his door.

Phainon on the other hand beamed at him in silent reply, seeming more than just a little happy to see him again - even though Mydei was being extremely obvious about how the feeling was not mutual today through his demonic glare alone.

Mydei moved away slightly, allowing the man inside before kicking the medium sized box towards him; “Pick it up. And explain yourself thoroughly.” Mydei growled at him, bristling as he even thought about what Phainon had been implying to him; it was beyond ludicrous that Phainon would be that bold.

Reprehensible even.

Only Phainon blinked at him wide-eyed and innocently as he held his hands up in mock defeat and  lowered himself down slowly to open the accursed box again. Plopping completely onto the floor to move the box into his criss-crossed lap in the entryway of Mydei’s home.

Clearly not daring to come any closer to the furious Mydei leering at him.

Courting gifts.

Those were what Phainon had been gifting him.

But this wasn’t a gift - it was an insult to him, even watching Phainon’s hands find purchase on the contents made him borderline snarl at the man who seemed more nervous now. Most likely due to how much Mydei was bristling at his mere existence.

As if it was finally seeping into his thick skull how pissed off Mydei actually was.

Mydei felt his face pull into a full-on scowl as Phainon dragged out the collar first, those ocean depths blue eyes nervously dancing between the growing in anger alpha and his own hands.

“They’re for me, Mydei.. Like I said..” Phainon informed him again very quietly, and Mydei only felt himself fighting the urge to bare his fangs over every word Phainon dared utter to him. 

Like hell he would allow Phainon to collar him, no matter how much he beg-

Mydei felt his thoughts stall as Phainon unhooked it slowly, ocean blue eyes pausing in his tracks over the low growl that clawed its way out of Mydei’s throat in instinct - a fist clenching at his side at the sheer bravery and stupidity Phainon was displaying.

Phainon only chuckled rather quietly however, keeping his eyes on the red leather collar before moving it up to his own neck and clicking it into place there - his index finger tugging at it slightly to test the tightness for a moment.

“They’re to be used on me.” Phainon stated again with a weak smile - as if he was begging Mydei to understand what he meant now. His finger was still tugging at it loosely as he spoke for emphasis on the matter. “This is mine.”

Mydei could only stare at the red leather collar now snug around Phainon’s neck - it did nothing to sate his own anger however, still only gritting his teeth over the fact Phainon had so boldly sent it to him.

“There’s still more. Explain the rest.” Mydei grumbled at him, and at that Phainon looked at the box again, once again retrieving the contents with a smile still on his lips - a smile that did nothing but frustrate Mydei further at his pure audacity to be anything along the lines of happy currently. 

Phainon obeyed however, tugging out an equally bright red leash effortlessly before slowly unraveling it to its full length with steady hands. An action Mydei watched meticulously while he stood there arms crossed over his chest absolutely seething towards the alpha intruding in his home.

Everytime he even considered the fact Phainon had been so foolishly bold to leave such a package as a ‘gift’ it only pissed him off more - Mydei was not his pet. He was not some beast to be leashed and collared like Phainon was implying. 

Well.

As Mydei’s eyes stalled at that collar around Phainon’s neck, he was considering more and more that someone else was the pet within this relationship..

Whatever this ‘relationship’ was.

Phainon said nothing as he was blissfully unaware of Mydei’s thoughts, merely working silently from his seat on the floor before taking the metallic hook of the leash and clicking it onto the collar around his neck - blinking upwards at Mydei who still only glared daggers at him. Not an ounce of warmth in his withering stare.

“It’s for me.” Phainon repeated as he held onto the leash loosely - tilting his head to the side as if appearing cutely would disarm Mydei’s rampant building anger.

Mydei didn’t accept that however, only scowling more at him; “There’s still one more item.” Mydei pointed out in a hissed out tone, bordering on one that clearly wanted to thrash Phainon for his crimes.

If he was a more aggressive alpha, maybe he would have done that already. Phainon should be counting his good graces here, Mydei figured as his patience ebbed away with every passing second.

“So there is..” Phainon mumbled out his agreement as his eyes dropped to the box again, hands moving to pick up the last item - not quite as gungho about putting it on as the other things. Naturally.

“Go on then. It’s for you, isn’t it?” Mydei snarled his words out at him and Phainon shot him a look - mainly of pure shock before laughing quietly. 

“Yes.. This is also just for me, Mydei.” Phainon agreed softly with an amused exhale, moving to slowly work out how to even put it on. Phainon fumbled with it for a few moments, giving out a quiet sigh before shyly looking at the still clearly furious Mydei.

“Will you.. Help me?” 

Mydei found himself struggling against the urge to bare his fangs toward him yet again - if he dared consider trying to put that damnedable thing on Mydei, he was skipping the punching and betraying himself to murder this alpha.

Aglaea be damned.

Mydei felt a low growl escape from his throat as he shoved forward rapidly, not being gentle at all as he lowered himself and snapped the damned thing from Phainon’s hands - turning it slightly to inspect it in between his fingers with furious movements.

A muzzle with a damn bone-shaped gag.

Even if hell frosted over, Mydei would never put that on.

That thought alone made him bristle, even more so when Phainon leaned closer to him; “It’s for me, it’s okay.” His voice was warm, smooth, and remarkably soft - clearly trying to be soothing for the furious alpha in front of him. 

Yet, somehow, that only pissed Mydei off more - instead moving to shove that bone-shaped gag into Phainon’s mouth roughly. Fierce eyes narrowed into a deep glare as he did so, not softening at all no matter how wide-eyed Phainon’s own blue ones were as they stared back at him.

“Open your mouth and shut up.”

Phainon obeyed that growled out command as he opened his mouth just a bit for the gag to fit in there snugly, sharp fangs biting down on it - the same ones that had bitten and marred Mydei’s neck.

Mydei found himself growing even more pissed off at the thought as he jammed it into there.
