Phainon was late.

It wasn’t his fault! But also he did completely forget to tell Mydei he had work today! He uh.. Was busy and didn’t really think about it when his mouth wasn’t full!

At least, in his defense, he had told Mydei when he got home later, and Mydei, the ever talkative, had hit him with a solid ‘Okay.’ text back. That was fine! The address Mydei had texted him to come to today afterwork, was less than fine!

He could not afford this! Was Mydei out of his mind?! Even so, he scaled the flights of stairs (he didn’t dare try to figure out the very fancy elevator with the front desk staff staring at him) until he found what should be the address while panting heavily - only to pause as a woman immediately approached him with a smile on her lips.

Not a comforting one, a smile that seemed like she was hiding something - a much too thin smile, taut and stressed, eyes that seemed to be fully inspecting Phainon from head to toe.

Oddest part was how she most obviously sniffed at him. An action that Phainon found himself taking a step away from, furrowing his brows. She, however, straightened herself back up, moving to brush off nonexistent dirt off herself as she only blinked at him innocently.

All before slowly turning to look at the door just a few feet away, slightly ajar; “Do you know the alpha in there looking at this place?”

That question was odd. For sure, Phainon could only think of the alpha he was very much so acquainted with as he stared her down for answers silently. Snow white hair - but she didn’t seem to actually be that old, nails so very manicured, with the most red lipstick he had ever seen in his life.

He didn’t know much about fashion, but the fact her entire formal attire was blood red made him also feel stunned, she was much too eye-catching. She looked as if she were attending a business conference - not sniffing at Phainon in a damn apartment complex hallway.

The worst part.. Was she was a beta. Why.. Why did she want to know about Mydei?

“Uh..” Phainon started very slowly as his thoughts stalled over the thoughts of a beta trying to talk to Mydei, desperately trying to meet with that man just beyond those doors. The same man Phainon did not want to share with her, not even the slightest bit.

She only innocently looked back to him, that smile still uncomfortably on her lips - like her teeth didn’t fit her face; “Blonde hair, red at the end, very amber eyes.. Can’t mistake him!”

Of course Phainon knew him, but he wasn’t sure how to exactly escape this conversation either, would she just be waiting outside for them both if he did try to just go to the tour he was already late to?

If that was the case - would she just tattle on Phainon for not bothering to hear her out and instead ducking into the apartment? Would Mydei be mad at him for it?

That question alone made bile threaten to burn at his throat as he coughed slightly, only to clear that rising horrible feeling.

“..You mean Mydei?” He asked slowly, not really feeling the name fall out of his mouth correctly - as if it felt foreign for once in his life and not a happy blessing to be saying it. 

Even worse.

The way she raised a brow so curiously haunted him, just before she seemed absolutely delighted by that. 

“Ah.. Yes, him! So you do know him! That Mydei..” Her tone was so sing-song, so forced, that Phainon found himself shuffling his weight between his feet before looking at that door nervously.

He desperately wished he was already by Mydei’s side right now..

Phainon wasn’t even quite sure what to say or what to call himself in regards to Mydei, well.. 

“.. We’re uh.. Roommates?” Phainon slowly told her as his eyes moved back to her - making him realize he really, really needed to ask Mydei to go out with him at the least.. Even if the idea of doing that made his face burn slightly.. Surely Mydei wouldn’t say no, right?

Phainon was pretty sure they did things partners would do with each other.. Even if their secondary genders didn’t match up, Phainon didn’t mind.

He was sure he could handle Mydei during his rut and help him along through it! And he knew Mydei could do the same for him, did anything else really matter then if they liked each other enough?

She looked absolutely bewildered by that - her head jerking back slightly before she coughed out a slight laugh; “I see.. How.. Interesting! Regardless, I was simply wanting to get in contact with him..” 

Phainon found himself instinctively almost bristling at that - for once gritting his teeth over the idea of whatever the backstory here was between her and Mydei. At the way a beta so desperately wanted to meet Mydei again she had followed him to here..

But.. Then again, that meant Mydei told her where he was..

That thought alone made Phainon bite back just a bit of sorrow that threatened to form a lump in his throat - a thing he opted to ignore to instead focus on being what he knew was overprotective towards Mydei as he leered at her.

Clearly, his annoyance was picked up by her as she raised a perfectly plucked brow before moving a hand to dig into her small rather useless sized purse - only to withdraw a rather fancy looking envelope. Pure black colored with a golden seal on it, Phainon could only blink at it widely.

“I have to go, so I’m unable to talk to him myself when he leaves - perhaps you would give him this letter from Castrum Kremnos for me?” She asked with a tilt of her head, a movement Phainon only blinked over due to how not a single hair on her head moved with the movement.

Those words though..

Phainon could only take the envelope slowly, flipping it back and forth a few times only to marvel at that golden wax seal on the front with the giant initials of C.K. so boldly present. 

Phainon blinked a few times at it before throwing her a look of confusion; “.. Castrum Kremnos? What does that company want from Mydei?”

The beta at that seemed taken aback, physically reeling slightly with raised brows almost dramatically before she gave a borderline sheepish laugh. At least, he assumed it was sheepish. 

It almost seemed like she was mocking Phainon before she waved a hand dismissively; “What.. An interesting question! Do please give him that, would you?”

Phainon really couldn’t think of a good reason to decline such a desire, especially if it was a good offer for Mydei’s life. Instead, he could only ghost his hand over to obtain that letter with almost a tremble as he tried to study the woman meticulously; “Uh.. Sure? I guess.”

The absolute speed at which she perked up as soon as he touched that envelope was electric, moving so quickly to evade the scene that Phainon almost felt like he had been handed a pipe bomb that she wanted no evidence of connection with.. And maybe he had been.

“Thank you so much! I’ll be off now! Have a good day!” She quickly said to him, waving politely as she ducked away towards the elevator. And maybe he would have believed she actually wanted him to have a good day if not for the way her voice was horribly clipped - jagged and almost mocking. 

A tone that made him glance at that letter in his hands with a lurking fear before back at her; “You too..”

Phainon found himself watching her wave in a daze - up until the very second those silver metallic elevator doors snapped closed. At which, he only slowly turned to face the apartment door with a small sigh.

Back to the current situation at hand; The fact this was way out of Phainon’s price range!

Phainon could only clutch that letter and slowly open the door to that apartment, sniffling a little as he did so. 

This was the worst - that was his first thought when his eyes fell onto a plate of damn cookies set out on a table at the side of the entryway. This was really too far out of his price range.. Cookies!? 

Phainon could only breathe out a sigh, he should have said something in the texts but Mydei was already here - what was he supposed to do!? Just not show up to be here and look at an apartment with his not-boyfriend-desired-boyfriend!?

No! Of course he had to come!

Phainon could only drag his eyes across the sleek maroon walls with a sense of dread every time he passed by an opened door leading into a new room.

Why were there so many?!

Thankfully, it wasn’t hard to find the man he was after as he slowly smelled it - that same scent he knew to be Mydei’s. That sweetness that Phainon found he could easily get drunk off of. 

The owner of it, however, was standing in the obvious kitchen - back turned to him completely focused on his current task.. 

“Mydei!” Phainon happily sang out as his eyes landed on that alpha that seemed to be fully inspecting a microwave, only turning with a hand tapping his chin idly as Phainon called out to him.

“Phainon, you’re..” Mydei’s eyes trailed downward as Phainon approached, and Phainon immediately halted over the way those golden eyes stalled completely on his hands. The way Mydei’s eyes didn’t move an inch away from that envelope he was holding; “What.. Is that?”

That tone alone and the flickering emotions on Mydei’s face were sign enough that Phainon should not have accepted this letter - there was an odd emotion that Phainon was horrified to decipher, almost shaking if he even considered it.

Hurt.

A level of hurt that Phainon had never wanted to cause to this man, a quick flickering of utmost sorrow and woe that completely plagued his facial expressions with a crack of his voice.

“Why do you have that?” Mydei only continued, seeming more and more upset by the second with those eyes only drifting between Phainon’s face and that cursed letter;  “Phainon? Why?”

Phainon found himself reeling at that - choking down the lump that was forming so painfully in his throat;  “A lady in the hallway asked me to give it to you..”

This was obviously distressing to Mydei, whatever that letter was. The idea of Phainon being the cause of such a level of obvious hurt and almost fear made Phainon debate jumping out the surely expensive windows of this apartment. As soon as he found one.

Mydei only stared at him, those eyes still a wildstorm of emotions as he slowly spoke in such a quiet tone that only made Phainon feel worse; “.. A lady?”

“A beta.. I think.. Snow white hair, dressed really formally, immediately jumped at me when I said I did know you..” Phainon found himself speaking six hundred words a second, every word simply tumbling out of his lips at lightning speeds while he was under the watchful gaze of Mydei.

One gaze that, almost, seemed to lighten up just a bit over those words. Just enough to bite back Phainon’s growing desire to jump out the window, just a bit.

“.. Is that so?”

“I’m not lying! She was really unsettling in pure red, it was really weird! She asked if I knew the alpha touring this place and then when I said I did she gave me this and spoke about Cas-”

“Okay.” Mydei interrupted Phainon’s rambling bluntly, shaking his head before he closed the distance with a hand extended, eyes only dropping to that letter in Phainon’s hand with a rather cold tone etched into his voice; “Give me that.”

Phainon didn’t even second think that, handing it over with almost a shaky hand - praying that Mydei’s emotions of sadness and betrayal quickly passed him by. 

He truly hadn’t meant to upset Mydei.. If he had known he wouldn’t have accepted the thing!

“Right.. I was told to anyway..” Was all Phainon said however, watching as Mydei took it gingerly, slowly rolling it between his fingers before bringing his other hand to touch it. Solely to grip it and shred it into pieces slowly, repeating it until it was certainly unsalvageable. 

Phainon almost felt aghast as he watched; “You’re just tearing it up!? What about whatever investment is in there?”

Or whatever else they could be wanting, Phainon wasn’t too clear about what Castrum Kremnos did outside of manufacturing weapons, but he knew they had good social ties if anything..

“I’m not interested.” Mydei answered flatly, only turning slightly to move to the rather fancy looking silver garbage can placed in the corner - probably not even something they had intended on visitors using. Not like Mydei cared, however, as he dumped the shreds of paper into it before wiping his hands together.

As if the letter had somehow gotten him dirty. 

“Mydei! The Kremnos family has really good opportunities in it, you should hear them out a little.” Phainon tried to point out in a rather hushed tone, not sure what else he should reasonably even be saying about this when he knew nothing about whatever situation made Mydei be so adverse.

And of course the way Phainon visibly saw Mydei’s jaw tighten made him almost immediately regret saying such a thing, especially as those golden eyes moved to land on him. 

Mydei seemed to be loosely holding in his anger by a thread, one that seemed so very close to snapping; “I’m not interested, Phainon. Don’t bring it up again.”

Something about that didn’t sit right with Phainon, this was obviously something that bothered Mydei beyond belief - and Phainon was supposed to just.. Never learn about it? Never ask? Never know why he was avoiding it so harshly?

He would try his best for Mydei’s sake but.. 

“.. It’s that bad of a subject for you?”

Mydei barely even blinked at that, barely even reacted - he merely walked up to Phainon with a small scowl before pressing out a sigh, moving to pass Phainon in that arched fancy doorway.

“.. Yes, Phainon, it is. Come look at this second bedroom.” Mydei mumbled out and the topic change made Phainon feel himself sweating.

He didn’t want to talk about Castrum Kremnos, that’s fine. Whatever!

But uh..

Phainon could only stall his steps - something that wasn’t unnoticed as Mydei copied to stare at him, eyes still somewhat icy from his emotions. “Ah, Mydei, that too.. I can’t afford this, like at all.”

“That’s fine, I can.” Mydei answered so monotonously that Phainon felt almost unwell, he would have questioned that. But considering that letter.. “Also, why are you.. Wearing..”

Those golden eyes left Phainon’s face rather obviously, only to immediately pause just a few inches below. And Phainon barely had to wonder why as he gave a rather devious smile to Mydei.

“The collar?” Phainon asked innocently, pulling a finger up to that red leather collar to tug at it slowly - keenly aware of Mydei’s eyes tracking that movement with an emotion buried in those eyes that was tragically indecipherable for Phainon. 

He had worn the collar all day - he had no shame and would admit that!

Though, the girls at the cafe all had lost their minds; Something about a bet that he didn’t quite grasp what the hell they were going on about but Aglaea only sighed and waved it off stating ‘At least it’s in theme for the dog section..’ and allowed it to stay on him. 

It didn’t clash with his outfit either! 

He was wearing a normal solid black shirt with some jeans, he was normal today! According to Aglaea at least.. Phainon never personally thought his outfits were bad, everyone else was just super dramatic.

Phainon was glad for her allowing him to keep the collar on though, he enjoyed telling people in his own silent way that someone else had a claim on him.

“Will you be my boyfriend?”

Those words tumbled from Phainon’s lips so quickly that Phainon found himself almost choking over the way he had just.. Said that, no flare, no fashion. Just blurted it out, and he found himself tensing up over it.

Only Mydei slowly looked up from his phone at that, blinking at nothing before tilting his head to focus on Phainon for a moment.

“Oh.” Mydei said, monotonously as if he hadn’t expected such a question, and Phainon couldn’t blame him when this certainly was not a dramatic way at all. Only Mydei shrugged his shoulders before looking at his phone again;  “Sure.”

Somehow, that felt like a giant weight off of Phainon’s shoulders, merely because now it was official. He was Mydei’s.. And Mydei’s was his.

That alone was insane, especially considering the gap of time where they didn’t even talk.. But Phainon didn’t care about that! He meant what he said - if anything, he fully had come to terms with the fact his life was now miserable without Mydei.

That had been the ceaseless unrelenting fact in those days without him, believing he had ruined it all and would never see him again. That Mydei would avoid him until the end of the earth..

And now Mydei was standing here staring at his phone for an apartment for them both, hand in hand with Phainon, and accepting the title of Phainon’s boyfriend..

“Okay.. Yay!” Phainon found himself beaming out, nearly blurting those words out as he scooted closer - only to immediately nuzzle his head into Mydei’s shoulder, no longer giving a single care in the world if someone saw him do such a thing to another alpha.

Only that seemed to make Mydei jerk a bit, almost seeming like he had physically winced before he slowly looked at Phainon. The look was “Yay? You cannot be saying yay as a grown man..”

Mydei seemed to have a true moment of realization before he physically tensed up - his eyes never leaving Phainon for even the briefest second as he slowly studied him. As if he was desperately looking for something, anything, and Phainon had nothing to offer him but a cheesy smile.

That’s his new boyfriend, after all! The most stunning and beautiful man he had ever laid eyes on! A fellow alpha, but willing to put up with him and accept him regardless! Mydeimos!

“Wait.. How old even are you?” Mydei dryly inquired, his head tilting slightly with his long forgotten phone still clutched tightly. Though he was now obviously focused on this topic and well..

Oh my god.

Phainon’s boyfriend knew nothing about him.

And in hindsight, Phainon knew nothing about Mydei either..

Phainon could only raise his free hand to fakely cough into it to clear his throat under that fierce unwavering gaze that awaited his answer silently; “I’m .. Twenty-six..”

Mydei didn’t even flinch at that, instead he only slowly raised both of his brows. 

“Wow.. And you’re saying yay?” Mydei asked rather flatly, and a piece of Phainon wondered if this was actually shocking news to Mydei or not considering the lack of actual expression on his features.

“Do you prefer ‘yippee’ or what? How old are you? How haven’t we discussed this before!?” Phainon couldn't stop (nor did he even try) the flow of words from leaving his lips, nearly flabbergasted at the fact he also had no idea how old Mydei was. He hadn’t thought about it before!

“Twenty-four.”

.. Younger?

Mydei was actually younger than him?

There was no way.. Seriously? 

Phainon could barely find his voice, cracking out as he had to ask a follow up question as he tried to swallow the fact Mydei was indeed younger than him; “Is that a no on me saying yippee.. Or..?”

Mydei however was significantly less bothered, instead looking at his phone again even as Phainon rubbed his thumb against the hand he still had claim to. 

“.. Do what you want.” Mydei mumbled out, and well, now Phainon was baffled over the way Mydei could text and use his phone with just one hand.

He had a talented boyfriend.. Or maybe Phainon just sucked at texting - both could be true at the same time.

“Should we just give up for today?” Phainon offered, taking note of the subtle frown that seemed to be taking form on Mydei’s face - as if he was dreadfully being pulled into thoughts and well.

Mydei only audibly sighed before shaking his head, eyes still not leaving his phone.

“No. I had many lined up with different realtors anyway.” Mydei told him, and something about that tone of voice made Phainon furrow his brows. He sounded tired. Like he had expected this to go awry something - and Phainon wasn’t sure if he could possibly guess why.

“That.. Sounds like a lot of effort?” Phainon laughed out lightly.

Mydei had been a storm of emotions all day - not that Phainon could blame him. He knew there was much more to this story, even if Mydei was refusing to say all the details, it was easy to see how badly Castrum Kremnos being brought up affected him. 

Even if he didn’t speak to that woman directly and was just given a letter, it had without a doubt given Mydei a sickening amount of horrid emotions.

“I don’t.. I don’t trust people.” Mydei told him, in a very hushed tone - as if he was forcing himself to say those words. To admit to such a thing.. And Phainon found himself immediately squeezing Mydei’s hand he still held at that.

Of course he did.

Why wouldn’t he do that when his boyfriend had started physically trembling? 

If anything, Phainon only rubbed himself into the growing distressed alpha - his scent was always so delectable. But Phainon hated when he got upset, when it had just the slightest undertones of being upset. Phainon didn’t find himself wanting to fight his instincts now, instead only pressing himself into Mydei a bit more.

“Ohhhhh, but you trust me?” Phainon teased, trying his best to lighten Mydei’s mood, at least a little 

Though, it only earned a raise of one of Mydei’s eyebrows as he tossed a lazy look to Phainon slowly; “Should I not?”

“No no! I am, if anything, your most devoted and trusted companion!” Phainon reassured him - because without a doubt it was true! Even if Mydei was obviously joking just as much as Phainon was, he now had to defend himself! 

Mydei studied him for a moment before only moving to be even closer to Phainon - a thing that made him feel like his balance was failing him before he realized it was to show Phainon his phone screen, tapping at some pictures.

“This one said she could make time for us right now - the other bedroom is smaller than that one but.. You said you didn’t care.” Mydei informed him, while quickly thumbing through an assortment of photos the new realtor had apparently sent ahead of time.

And well, Phainon was amazed that this man set up so many so quickly..

“And I don’t! So long as you’re okay with me crawling into your bed at night!” Phainon confirmed it with many quick shakes of his head - as if nodding while those golden eyes stared him down helped his situation at all.

However, Mydei did scoff at that before he looked back at his phone; “.. Right. Whatever, just no funny business on the daily.”

Phainon only nodded again, very animated as he agreed to those demands - even if a piece of him was in slight mourning. 

“Okay, okay.. Only if my precious mate wants me to.” 

Those words made Mydei’s thumb on his phone freeze mid text, instead blankly looking at Phainon with an egregious expression on his face.

“.. Mate?” Mydei echoed out, almost seeming like he was in a daze and well. If Phainon was a normal person he probably wouldn’t blame him for being confused!

However, Phainon was flooring it, he did not care!

Thus, Phainon only nodded again! 

“Mhm!”

Mydei seemed to blink at him, a few times, a few times too many as well before he cleared his throat slowly, dramatically. Only to scrunch up his facial features in thought before giving a laugh - one that was remarkably gentle.

Probably because he was embarrassed by this, Phainon could tell that much from the way the dusting of red was creeping into his face again cutely. 

“You don’t think you’re moving too.. Quickly in regards to me, do you?” Mydei asked in an odd voice, one that made Phainon wonder if the question was truly for him, or for Mydei as well.

And, well..

“Nope! I’ll marry you one day.” Phainon told him, which was only repeating what he had said earlier. Because he meant it both times anyway, so of course he would reassure Mydei that they would be married someday and this all was moving at a perfectly normal pace!

So long as you did not ask anyone that was actually sane and normal!

Mydei only gave a small smile, an incredibly simple thing, but something Phainon cherished with all of his being everytime he watched the alpha offer that expression to him.

“.. You’re a strange one.”

──────────────

“Mydeiiiiii..”

Mydei didn’t stop walking even with his name being called in such a sweetly sick voice - instead making a beeline for the living room like he had always intended to. Even preening slightly to hear Phainon clicking the door shut and locking it behind him. Though, Mydei found himself sighing over how easily he had given in to Phainon’s desires.

The alpha had simply asked if he could sleep with Mydei tonight, and without even missing a beat, Mydei had embarrassingly said yes to him.

In his defense, it was hard not to feel overwhelmed with all the feelings Phainon was so boldly putting onto the table without a care in the world.

That white haired alpha was talking about marrying Mydei before even asking if they could date - how was Mydei supposed to feel anything but light-headed the entire day after that?

Well, ignoring the other things that had occurred. At the very least, the way Phainon had been so intensely and blatantly protective over Mydei the rest of the day made his heart flutter in such a betraying fashion.

His inner annoying alpha was irked over the idea of another alpha being so defensive for his own sake - but it was Phainon. And Mydei was certainly learning that's just what Phainon was like.

“What?” Mydei called back idly, not stopping even as he moved to unbutton the top button of his shirt - at least make it a bit looser.

“You really think that apartment is fine?” Phainon asked from behind, clearly getting closer from the sound of voice nearing. 

That question made Mydei almost stall his path before giving a slight hum. 

It wasn’t nearly as fancy as the original place, not by a longshot, but it was obvious from Phainon’s body language that he had been heavily uncomfortable in that first apartment anyway.

That was fine - Mydei hadn’t really enjoyed the layout of the kitchen there, nor the fact Caenis would know he lived there if Phainon had liked it. 

“Why wouldn’t it be? Do you not like it?” Mydei fired back - it wasn’t much of a worry for him, the kitchen was much nicer and that was about all he cared about. He had instead been keenly watching Phainon look around, studying him to see what his mood and body language would tell Mydei even if the alpha didn’t voice it.

The only issue with that was obvious.

Phainon had been doing the same damn thing to him. 

It was impossible.

“I mean, it’s great, like really good, I’m just..” Phainon trailed off, and Mydei had to fight the desire to turn and look at him as he turned into his living room;  “Worried about your bank account..”

It was endearing, and somewhat comforting to know how deeply Phainon actually cared about such a silly thing.

“.. Phainon, you really don’t need to worry about such a thing in regards to me.” Mydei mumbled out as he slowly sat on the couch lazily, heaving out a sigh before moving to dig out his phone from his pocket to check any unread messages.

“I can’t help it! I’ll be so useless in helping with bills” Phainon practically wailed out as he followed Mydei into the living room, only crashing dramatically onto the couch beside Mydei before completely laying down on it - making sure his head flopped onto Mydei’s lap as he stared upwards at Mydei.

Mydei tensed up at that, mainly out of pure instinct as he blankly stared at that man that seemed to only make himself more comfortable with his head laying on Mydei’s lap. 

Mydei heaved out a sigh, coming to terms with how beyond doomed he was that he was fine with this position as his eyes trailed the alpha’s features; “.. I told you, It's fine.”

Phainon was arguably very pretty - Mydei had surely inspected him before but never this closely, never allowed himself to slowly move a hand to trace a thumb against the stubble of the day growing there. 

Everything about him seemed so.. Divine, in a way. As if he were a perfectly sculpted being, much too soft and gentle looking with his snow white hair and piercing blue eyes. Piercing, but so incredibly softened as they only stared back at Mydei, allowing Mydei to touch his face as he pleased.

Phainon however hummed before slowly closing his eyes, leaning into that hand that had slid up to his cheek softly. 

“Have you ever had a roommate before?” Phainon asked without reopening his eyes, seemingly at peace just laying in Mydei’s lap like this. 

Mydei felt himself borderline cracking up over the question; why the hell would he have ever had a roommate? He was only having a roommate now because.. Well.. Those funny feelings he was struggling to accept about this alpha laying his head in his lap.

Even if they were dating.

God, Mydei was embarrassing.

“No.” Mydei told him with a heavy sigh, mainly at himself and his own issues coming to terms with this alpha and his feelings for him.

“Really? I’m your first?” Phainon’s blue eyes opened at that, appearing almost baffled to consider that, though, Mydei didn’t really know why. Especially since Phainon knew he was rich now..

Mydei only sighed and dropped his hand from Phainon’s cheek - instead moving his other to idly comb through the man’s hair while trying his best to ignore the way Phainon seemed to keen into his touch happily.

“You’ve been my first for a lot of things.” Mydei admitted mindlessly as he watched Phainon slightly rub his head against Mydei’s hand and that really, really, made Mydei narrow his eyes just a bit at his realization.

He was really basically dating a humanized golden retriever, huh?

Only Phainon immediately perked up at that, blue eyes darting to meet Mydei’s instead of being somewhat closed while preening for Mydei’s touch; “Woah! Like what?”

That question was more embarrassing the longer Mydei thought about it.

The longer he realized just how out of his own comfort zone he actually was by now. .

Mydei only shallowly coughed, trying his best to swallow down the burning in his cheeks over the fact he most assuredly was having to admit to embarrassing stuff here..

“First alpha I’ve dated.. First boyfriend, really.. First time having sex..” 

Phainon immediately sat up at that, so quickly that Mydei found himself almost wincing as Phainon moved at lightning speed to face him while sitting on the couch - eyes beaming over those words.

“Woah! Woah woah, I took your virginity?”

Mydei moved his hand slowly to rub at his head almost in thought before moving to play with his own braid he always had slowly. Mindlessly. Nervously. 

“Yes.” Mydei flatly said, betraying his inner feelings with how dully he had admitted such a thing. Like it didn’t even bother him, like he wasn’t burning in his own skin over the fact he hadn’t had sex before Phainon.

Only Phainon looked more and more flabbergasted with every word as his mouth fell agape, floundering for a brief moment before finding his words again; “During my rut?!”

That was humorous, in hindsight.

A piece of him also still couldn’t believe he agreed to sharing Phainon’s rut with him, granted, he regretted the aftermath more than the actual sex. But, well.. 

“Yeah.” Mydei said as he only leaned into the plush of the couch more, raising a brow as he inspected the completely bewildered Phainon.

Phainon however at that, moved slightly to sit on his haunches - still turned sideways on the couch as he buried his head into his hands with a quiet groan escaping his throat. 

“And you let me do that to you?! Oh my god.. Mydei..” Phainon mumbled in such a tone that Mydei found himself laughing.

Just a slight warm chuckle, but that was enough to make Phainon peek from behind his fingers rather obviously as they hid his face.

“It’s fine. I was willing.” Mydei told him with a smile lingering on his lips, because well, he had willingly let Phainon do all that to him. First time having sex or not - it didn’t matter.

Because at least it was with Phainon, and he seemed to be the most genuine man Mydei had ever met.

Alpha or not.

“I mean, okay, but like. Oh my god.. During my rut?” Phainon dropped his hands from his face before giving a deep sigh, almost like he was in mourning over it all, over his own thoughts and actions; “I would have been so much sweeter if I had known and was in my right mind..”

Mydei huffed out a laugh again over that tone of voice; “It’s not important.”

Phainon on the other hand immediately moved to lean forward, seeming more and more distressed as he spoke again.

“It is too! To me! Oh but that means we gave each other our virginities on my rut.. That’s kind of sweet..”

Those words made Mydei blink slowly, dreadfully slow as he inched towards the realization of what exactly Phainon was implying here before giving a quiet laugh.

Finding himself mainly amused over the fact they both seemed to be idiots.

“You.. Were a virgin too?” Mydei practically laughed out the question because did they really both have sex for the first time during Phainon’s rut? And both of their first actual sexual experiences were.. With another alpha that for all biological reasonings, should not work out well?

“Yep! That’s all yours, now!” Phainon once again seemed to be happier as he moved once more to readjust - instead sitting on the couch normally before putting his head against Mydei’s shoulder. Lazily leaning on him while a hand found its way to Mydei’s thigh to rest on top of it.

If it was anyone else, Mydei would have shook it off and growled at them..

However, his alpha had returned to being quiet regarding this man once again. Seeming content in the way Phainon was being lovey-dovey, but also not overly dominant in that showing of love.

“.. We’re kind of a mess.” Mydei admitted as he only felt that man leaning into him heavily, almost obviously sniffing at him but Mydei opted to ignore that. 

He had no desire to sniff Phainon - Phainon still smelled like a stinky fellow alpha, but more power to Phainon for enjoying how Mydei smelled, he guessed..?

Phainon only barked out a laugh before nuzzling his head into Mydei’s shoulder, an act he appeared to be very fond of doing; “That’s alright, I think.”

“Is it?” Mydei inquired in a teasing tone, there was definitely something wrong with the both of them, but Mydei wasn’t really sure if he cared anymore with how easily he was faltering when his mind thought of Phainon.

If anything, when Mydei’s thoughts trailed to Phainon he felt those creeping feelings an alpha normally felt towards their lovers.

That level of protectiveness.. Possessiveness.. Things reserved only for omegas and betas usually. Yet.. Even now as he drifted his eyes to focus on that hand that was merely resting atop his thigh; he desperately wanted to return to lacing his own fingers between Phainon’s.

Greed.

A type of greed he had never quite felt towards someone before.

“I mean, we’re together now.. So something has to be going right in my life.” Phainon interrupted his thoughts with a smooth laugh, one that made Mydei tense only slightly.

Tense due to the way Phainon was always so honest when it came to Mydei.

Honest, yet horribly endearing that Mydei couldn’t help but be enamored with the alpha..

“Are you always going to be this sappy?” Mydei mumbled out as he fully leaned his head back into the couch, closing his eyes slowly.

Truthfully.

He hadn’t slept well last night, his entire day was fried after they had sex in the middle of the afternoon. How the hell was he supposed to think about anything but Phainon?

Awfully, he didn’t even take a shower for a long time after Phainon left - some piece of him enjoyed having the scent of that man around him. Just as much as a piece of him hated it.

Terrible feelings, yet so addicting in the way they made Mydei feel insane and delirious when he tried to figure them out in any regard. 

“Up until the day you marry me and then some, yep!”

Mydei felt himself immediately laugh over that softly, fondly. Mainly in awe over how deadset Phainon sounded with such a thing. 

Marriage.

Phainon kept bringing that up, and it really was kind of silly considering the turbulent relationship they had been having by now.

But something about the way Phainon only leaned into him more, only slowly grabbing at his thigh made Mydei debate those words. Debate the reality of something so insane as someone liking him enough to marry him actually happening.

And that someone being a damn alpha.

Insane.

“.. Insane.” Mydei echoed his own  thoughts out loud numbly, because it truly was. No one in their right minds would say that when they just started dating - but Mydei was just as unwell as Phainon to actually find himself somewhat giddy at the idea of Phainon upholding that promise.

Only Phainon shuffled a bit at his side, unhanding him and leaning away. Movements that made Mydei open his eyes to watch the man, curious over why he was suddenly moving from Mydei.

“Wait, Mydei.” Phainon said in a tone that almost sounded distressed, so very distraught that Mydei found himself furrowing his brows and tightening his jaw.

Phainon only continued however, eyes seeming like they were teetering a thin line before crying as he visibly gnawed at his own lip for a brief second; “.. Are you the rich dude that always contributes to the cafe?”

Mydei found himself barking out a harsh laugh at that, taking a second to himself to bubble into a few more laughs before just slowly nodding his head in confirmation. 

“What?! Seriously?! So when I ask for a raise I’m indirectly taking money from you?!” Phainon resumed his earlier position at that, groaning deep and guttural and the realization and Mydei could only shrug giving another huff of laughter.

“.. I guess, technically yes?” 

He really hadn’t even thought about it like that, it was mainly non profit so in a way - he kind of was paying for Phainon regardless. 

Phainon only gave a somewhat louder groan at that, as if it was just hitting him like a train that he was in fact not paying for anything here. Not that Mydei really cared, selling literally everything his father held dear when he died was more than enough money, even if Mydei donated huge chunks of it.

More money than any one person deserved, let alone himself or his father.

Phainon, on the other hand, seemed to be battling his own turmoil over the situation; “Oh my god, this is the worst. I’m robbing my boyfriend..”

Mydei couldn’t help himself as he moved slightly, only to gently pat at the man’s head in an attempt of comfort, scrunching up his face to try his best at hiding his amusement towards the alpha’s breakdown. “You’re awfully silly, Phainon.”

Phainon at that only fakely sniffled as he dragged his hands away from his face - misty blue eyes blinking at Mydei before he slowly pushed his luck.

As Phainon always seemed to do - pushing his head into Mydei’s chest before flopping over again with a deep sigh. And Mydei halfway had to sit there and wonder if being held in Mydei’s arms was the goal the entire time.

At least, this didn’t piss off his alpha when Phainon was a needy clingy thing. 

“.. Her name is Caenis.” Those words fell out of Mydei’s lips without much thought as he moved just a miniscule amount to get comfortable, resting his hand on Phainon’s chest awkwardly as that man seemed to curl up into him.

Only Phainon did stiffen, just the slightest bit over that.

“.. Huh?”

Mydei couldn’t blame him for it, his words had been absolutely beyond random, but it had been bothering him all day long. Why had that accursed woman shown up again?

Why did she have to meet Phainon of all people? One of the few things Mydei wanted to keep for himself, wholly his own thing to have without ever being tainted by his father’s shadow?

Why?

“The woman in red that gave you the letter today. She worked as my father’s secretary for years, not sure what her job is anymore.”

It didn’t matter. Mydei had to explain himself, explain something at the very least. A relationship with zero communication and him shutting down Phainon’s worries and curiosity wasn’t fair. 

“Can.. I ask what they want with you? Didn’t the Kremnos heir sell the business, according to the news years ago?” Phainon asked that, but if anything, he was only leaning into Mydei even more, as if he was wordlessly trying to reassure Mydei that he wasn’t going anywhere.

And that made Mydei only move a hand to brush at Phainon’s hair again absent-mindedly, slowly as he gave a small chuckle over that question.

“You remember that, but not my name?” Mydei pointed out, not angry, just amused at what Phainon had obviously only heard about in passing.

“Well.. Oops?” Those words were simple in their meaning, but the way Phainon slowly wrapped his arms around Mydei’s chest to full on rub his face into Mydei made the alpha freeze.

Truly, Phainon had no shame, but at least he had waited until they were home. Mydei had easily been able to tell how antsy Phainon was most of the day with the way he kept looking at Mydei.

Probably over his terrible mood.. It most likely had switched something in Phainon’s head that Mydei needed this, needed this level of comfort from Phainon. From his ‘mate’ as Phainon had said..

“Whatever, I don’t mind. I did sell it when my father passed, yes.” Mydei sighed out rather dramatically as he twirled a few locks of Phainon’s hair between his fingers;  “I assume they still desire me to come work for it, however.”

“Why?”

That was a frustrating question.

Why?

Mydei had also been asking that for a lot of his life, he thought when his father died they would leave him alone. Finally come to terms that he hated them all, that he would never enjoy or want to work in that line of business.

So why didn’t they?

“Some people only trusted in my father’s choices and decisions, as such, that same trust falls on to me, I guess.” Mydei mumbled, though he didn’t have a straight answer to give Phainon, he could only bitterly laugh and choke down the bile over the idea of people assuming he was like that man.

“Even though we’re.. Nothing alike. I hope.” Mydei couldn’t help but add on with a heavy sigh, only vaguely aware of Phainon barely shifting in his lap at that.

“Huh..”

“I don’t want anything to do with that line of work, however. I’d much rather stay in my own much quieter lane and do some baking.” Mydei fully knew he was rambling now, but he couldn’t stop himself. He couldn’t cease those words from leaving his lips once he finally willed up the courage to confess at least something.

Anything.

But never that. 

But also hopefully enough to help satiate Phainon’s desire to learn about Mydei, just a bit. 

“Bad news is some people do not agree with that and haven’t quite given up hope on me leading the company, even if I don’t own it.” Mydei continued on, vaguely aware of the way one hand around his back had begun to press into him. A soothing motion up and down against his back comfortingly.

Mydei tried to ignore it, to ignore the way he just wanted to press his head into Phainon’s and shut out the world. 

He couldn’t.

Not when the world clearly still wanted to sink its teeth into him and drag him back.

“Family ties and whatnot, to sum it up. Even though it’s widely known my relationship with my father was.. Far from decent.”

Phainon was relatively quiet at that, only for a few drip drops of seconds before he gave a quiet hum, one that Mydei could only pray was out of understanding towards the situation. 

“But.. The other people still like you?” Phainon asked with a quiet laugh, and Mydei could only shrug his shoulders.

He barely understood it either - he refused to open all the dozens of letters they sent to him, anyway. He truly couldn’t say for certain what they wanted from him, he was doing his best to turn a blind-eye to them, no matter what.

“It’s my only guess, even though I’m not interested.” Mydei admitted with an exasperated sigh.

“What’s the.. Backstory behind the tattoos?”

That question made Mydei blink blankly, his own eyes moving to trail up his arms, at those crimson lines that were permanently etched into his skin. Phainon seemed to enjoy them a bit, thankfully, so the curiosity was to be expected.. But..

“.. My tattoos?” Mydei found himself repeating regardless as he tried to understand the shift in the topic - he could only assume something about his mood had changed and warped due to how Phainon himself seemed almost tensed as well.

It made sense that Phainon would have considered something as being pushing too far with Mydei, and changed the topic, he supposed.

“You seemed.. Really defensive about them, almost.” The quietness of Phainon’s voice made Mydei tilt his head slightly, trying to remember such a thing and well..

He did remember stressing about it yesterday, being distressed over what Phainon thought of them. For some reason, he hadn’t paid it much heed when it was Phainon’s rut, but when he knew the man had a clear head..

A clear enough head to languidly trace over his tattoos so devotedly..

“Ah..” Mydei mumbled at his thoughts more than to Phainon before huffing out a small laugh;  “I have to be. I have to tell myself I love them.”

“.. Huh?”

“I don’t blame people for not liking them - I didn’t like them either originally.” Mydei shrugged as he spoke, with a bitter laugh attached to the end. 

Because he truly had not originally liked them, they were a red flag to most people and made him appear way more terrifying than he actually felt his personality was. It was distressing.

Until he grew to love them slowly, painfully slowly with years and the acceptance they would be there forever. No matter how much he scrubbed his skin raw and stared at them, they were forever engraved onto him. 

Nothing he could ever do would change that, but at least he liked them now.

At least, Phainon seemed to like them too as he moved a hand to trail over Mydei’s arm, ghosting over those red markings with such a tender touch it made Mydei almost feel weak that he would treat an alpha with such a level of fragile care..

“Then.. Why did you get them?” Phainon’s quiet tone never got louder, acting as if he were going to scare off a stray cat with every question he asked further and well.

Mydei found himself barking out a laugh over that, at the memories of how he ended up with each and every trail of crimson on his skin.

“They were punishments, that’s all.”

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

phainon and how to not handle crazy news you got about your new boyfriend; the chapter.

Waking up to being sweaty and panting was always Phainon’s least desired way to wake up, and not even having the overly large cat named Mydei asleep beside him did anything to remedy his ongoing nightmares it seemed.  Even if his bizarrely sweet scent had done wonders to lull Phainon into a state of peace.

But as Phainon sat up straight in the bed, staring into the darkness of Mydei’s room, barely coming alive with the morning sun encroaching past the blinds he could only heave out a heavy sigh.

Another nightmare.

They never seemed to end lately - all he could do was move his gaze to focus on the peacefully sleeping Mydei. He looked absolutely perfect as always, and something about that easily made Phainon’s heart feel lighter as he slowly moved a gentle finger to brush back those blonde bangs.

Regardless, even while asleep, Mydei looked flawless with his hair fanning around him as if he had a fiery halo framing him - not to mention the shamelessness of his muscles being on display due to sleeping without a shirt on. An interesting thing, considering Phainon didn’t remember Mydei going to bed without one.

Had it thrown it off during the night in his sleep? That easily amused Phainon just enough to crack a silent smile onto his lips.

Phainon couldn’t help it as he crumpled down just a smidge - just enough to pepper a small amount of kisses onto the alpha’s soft cheeks. Doing his best to make them as light as possible while fully ingesting the scent of that slumbering man.

Only, apparently not light enough as golden eyes slowly opened, seeming extremely dazed as they took a moment to take in the sight of Phainon very languidly - almost searchingly as his face scrunched up very minisculely.

And Phainon couldn’t help the way he offered up a smile out of pure instinct, at the show of drowsy softness on display by Mydei so boldly.

Or, perhaps it was just Phainon’s morning breath getting to him, he couldn’t really blame him if that was the case.

Either way, Phainon was always impressed by how beautiful he was in the slight light of the morning.

“Mhm.. Take what you need..” Came Mydei’s raspy morning voice, a voice Phainon had heard a few times now - but had never fully adapted to it. It was always so very enchanting to hear him be so soft in the way he spoke, as if he was avoiding being too loud for his own sake and later attempts to go back to sleep.

“You’re so sweet.” Phainon murmured, unable to stop his hand from reaching forward and gently taking some of Mydei’s hair between his fingers gently; “You should stop by the cafe today.. Just for fun.”

Phainon was mainly teasing, but the idea of seeing Mydei made his heart feel so very light and full - it was truly addicting, especially as those golden eyes only weakly stared at him. So obviously tired, and Phainon couldn’t blame him, he had kept him up most the night just bantering with him after all.

He couldn’t help it! Talking to Mydei was his favorite hobby, even if the man was barely replying due to his own tiredness, but Phainon’s mind moved a mile a minute over the fact they would really be living together soon.

Later today, even, after Phainon got off work he had to start moving stuff into the apartment.. That made him so giddy he couldn’t help the way he almost shook and trembled like a pathetic little chihuahua.. 

“.. I don’t work there anymore, Phainon.” Mydei eventually mumbled, voice raspy and so very laced with sleep that Phainon couldn’t suppress the laugh that fluttered out of his own lips as he moved a hand to gently caress the man’s cheek.

Honestly.

Phainon only wanted to tuck him back into bed - safely and at peace where no one could lay their hands on him, as if Mydei was someone fragile.. As if he wasn’t six feet of pure muscle and growling instincts..

Phainon only went against his own desires to lean down and press a few more kisses against Mydei’s face - fighting the urge to laugh over the loud exhale Mydei made beneath his lips.

“Just for fun..” Phainon told him with a small grin as he leaned away again, a hand ghosting up to rub back those bangs again that had effortlessly fallen. Mydei enjoying that courting gift enough to wear it to sleep easily roused Phainon’s own alpha in a pleasured way, heart feeling so much more full than before.

Just enough to look at that bite he knew was still scarred into Mydei’s neck on his nape.

He couldn’t.

Phainon just.. Didn't think it would ever involve him, so why would he care?

A question for Aglaea.

This was… Certainly a question for Aglaea.

Distraught, perhaps, was a better word for it.

He didn’t know.

The thing Cipher had brought up so curiously, so randomly..

At least! That’s what he thought even just a few days ago..

.. Now that rich heir was the very same one he wanted to wake up to being in his arms every single day.

Ironic.

But it didn’t keep the demons at bay - his own inner thoughts and desires.

He had to know.

“Do you believe Mydeimos killed his own father?” Phainon blurted out, wincing at his own voice in hindsight as he watched both her eyebrows raise in clear shock - eyes widening before she immediately schooled her expression into one more kind.

“.. Quite an abrupt question, and what will you do with my answer?”

“It depends on the answer I’m given..”

It didn’t.

Phainon didn’t know what he would do, he really had no idea.

What was he supposed to do about the alpha he fully wanted to mate with and even probably marry was a murderer? 

Was that a deal breaker? Normally, of course it was, any sane person would say yes.

But Phainon wasn’t sure his own emotions towards this particular situation were ‘sane’.

“I trust Mydeimos with all of my being, that man has never wronged me once and has always had a caring touch towards everyone in his life.” Aglaea spoke firmly, not an ounce of hesitation etched into her voice, however, she did slowly sigh and shut her eyes; “That.. Being said; I do believe Mydei killed his father Eurypon, yes.”

To deny the idea that Mydei of all people could do that, Mydei who regretted hitting Phainon in self defense so very much that he had shut himself completely off and away from Phainon and rejected him for ‘both’ their sakes.

Mydei who was arguably more bark than bite in Phainon’s experience..

.. And he highly doubted that it was any type of facade from the alpha who had denied himself of Phainon truly being interested in him for so long.

Even though the lump in his throat was easily accomplishing that regardless - he felt as if he were drowning and no one was giving him a hand.

The worst part of it was he didn’t even quite understand it himself. 

Was he truly upset that Mydei had killed someone and gotten away with it, or was he more distressed over the impact it probably had on Mydei’s psyche for years to come?

Phainon felt himself shuffling his weight between his feet at Aglaea’s words, he knew that Eurypon Kremnos was a rather shady and hated man.

Aglaea said with a small wave of her hand as she moved to stifle through her purse slowly - looking for something but Phainon only watched with owl-wide eyes, completely baffled by those words.

Malleable.

Someone to control that wasn’t quite like his father. 

Eurypon was hated so very much that if Mydei had actually killed his father, enough rich people were willing to help bail him out and look the other way for their own sick desires.

.. Even though Mydei had sold Castrum Kremnos, they still wanted him to come back and work for them. They clearly lacked in bad blood with Mydei in specific; even if that feeling wasn’t mutual judging by how Mydei had reacted to that letter.

“Aren’t you? Your pheromones are extremely distressed right now, and something tells me it’s not because you’re finding out the man of your deepest affections may be a killer.”

Phainon couldn’t even say what he thought.

What he felt.

Was he willing to give up the only person he had ever felt any semblance of love for over a man that seemed to have tortured his own son?

Those red tattoos on Mydei being more than just simple tattoos - they more felt like a trail blood and sorrow so boldly written for anyone to read. Even if at first glance no one even knew the depths of the story written on his body.

Not even Phainon truly understood what had happened there - outside of the fact Eurypon was for sure a man that was beyond psychotic. 

“.. It’s hard to say what I feel over it.” Phainon started, breathing out a small sigh, he wasn’t even sure where his thoughts were. What he was thinking or truly feeling..? 

He had no idea.

“.. Huh?” Was all Phainon could manage to say, his mind spiraling immediately over the idea of Mydei killing both of his parents.

Surely not, right?

“I know Mydeimos enough to confidently without a doubt say he had no hands in that.” Aglaea stated as she waved her hand holding the key - as if to clear the air metaphorically and literally;  “But, I don’t doubt at all that it was a catalyst of sorts.” 

Phainon took a moment to take in those words.

A catalyst for Mydei taking his own fathers death?

Well that..

“Are you implying his father probably killed his mother?” Phainon rationalized his thoughts out loud, eyes searching Aglaea meticulously for answers and Aglaea only shook her head as her eyes peered past Phainon - as if to focus on something else.

But considering it was Aglaea.. He had nothing. Not a clue as to what she was possibly thinking of currently - or about.

The alpha had opened up, just barely, and this felt like it was wedging a blade right into his heart and forcing it open.

But what else was Phainon supposed to do?!

“Ah. Then I wouldn’t ever bring this up to him.”

Phainon dropped his hands at those words - just to tilt his head to the side and study her, study the way she seemed so very serious about that advice.

“.. You want me to just ignore the fact I learned he killed his own father?” Phainon inquired in a tone that bordered on laughing, or maybe crying. He wasn’t sure which one he felt like doing today when it came to things he didn’t think he would ever learn about Mydeimos..

“It’s either that, or you can just dump him now.”

Those words were so rough to Phainon’s ears from Aglaea - so brutal and flat that he had to gawk at her slightly.

He hadn’t even quite considered even the idea of dumping Mydei over this.. They had only just started actually dating and even the mere idea of Mydei leaving again made him feel absolutely nauseous and nervous.

“.. What?”

“You finally got that alpha to lower his walls, to let you in, and now you want to casually tell him you learned he killed his father? How do you think Mydei will handle that?” Aglaea asked him, and that question only made Phainon cock his head to the side.

There was only one real answer there, anyway..

“.. Poorly.”

Aglaea blinked at him before slowly nodding in understanding before giving quite a long drawn out sigh of exasperation; “Exactly, so if the idea that he may have done such a thing is too much to swallow, as both of your friends I’m telling you this now, Phainon. Dump him.”

Dump him.

Break up with Mydei.

That couldn’t possibly be the only decent option here, it absolutely couldn’t. There’s no way.

Sure, Mydei seemed.. Reluctant to opening up, but with enough reassurance Phainon was pretty sure he could get that alpha to put up with his questions..

.. Even if Phainon did halfway consider buying handcuffs to cuff them together if he did bring up this topic.

Instead, he only blankly stared at Aglaea, throat as parched as a desert before he slowly chose his words..

“Oh..” Phainon replied so very intelligently.

“Oh, Phainon, you’re here.”

Phainon was powerless to stop the grin from creeping onto his face as he closed the door behind him and that scent that he knew to be home flooded his senses. Mydei.

And god was that sight so painfully unfair as Mydei had chosen to wear a sleeveless black shirt today and put up his hair into a ponytail.

Absolutely sinful sight.

Yet, Phainon still regrettably felt the itch in his mind over the events from today - even as he tightened his grip on the small amount of items in his suitcase that he had deigned to bring over today they haunted him... He would go to the storage unit to actually unpack tomorrow, but for now, just his stuff from Aglaea’s was fine.

“Mydei! How.. How was your day?” Phainon asked after a few moments of admiring the man who didn’t seem to regard him very much at those words - instead disappearing into one of the rooms.

He would probably help Mydei unpack, and be normal. 

That was easy.

He loved Mydei.

“It was fine. This is for you.” Phainon jerked his head upwards at those words - blinking blankly as he watched Mydei walk over, almost appearing..

Flustered? Embarrassed? He was certainly more red tinted in his face than normal as he held out a small box for Phainon.

One of the boxes he himself had used for giving courting gifts to Mydei - but he respected the reusing and recycling angle of it!

And slightly was just enamored with the fact Mydei had kept those silly little gift boxes in general, even if they did get glitter everywhere from the sides of them being dusted in it..

Phainon couldn’t help but perk up as he stood, staring it down as Mydei only outstretched it to him; “Hmm? A gift for me?!”

Mydei only avoided looking at him, seemingly more flustered than Phainon thought possible as he tilted his head to admire the blush there; “Mm.” Was all Mydei hummed in reply.

Before his fingers dipped back in, just to pick up that black sleek leather, rolling his thumb over it slowly with acute fascination over it.

Over it being gifted to him, by Mydei.

“A choker.” Mydei supplied as he only stepped closer, removing it timidly from Phainon’s hands - and Phainon couldn’t help but be amused by the way his fingers almost seemed to be trembling out of near nervousness.

Endearing.

He really was such a kind alpha.. Mydei couldn’t.. have possibly.. 

“A choker..?” Phainon found himself echoing - but he didn’t have a single thought in his head as he immediately craned his head upwards, moving it to give Mydei all the space in the world that he could possibly want when he realized Mydei had unhooked it and was nearing his neck.

Phainon was powerless to stop the way his breath hitched as those fingers ghosted against his neck, gently moving to wrap that black sleek leather collar around his throat almost tightly.

Snuggly, as if it fit him perfectly.

Seemingly to inspect his own work with a tilt of his head, one that Phainon watched keenly as he lowered his own to its normal position to blink at him.

It was.

It was endearing..

Probably because he was avoiding the truth regardless of lying or not.

And.. For once..

Phainon didn’t even know what to think of it all.

Mydei was someone dear to him, and he wanted to know what had happened to Mydei in his life.

All of it.

Sure, he.. Wasn’t mentally all there today, but he was physically fine.

“No comment about me implying you can sleep in the nude - You must be unwell.”

Oh.

Oh..

A haunting reminder.

Even if he probably didn’t really feel extremely tired..

“Good night, Mydei.”

Phainon was blessed, he knew this much as he peered at those fragile barely moving eyelashes - just barely giving signs that Mydei was still conscious even though his eyes were closed.

Begging him not to.

This wasn’t just a question even murderers that were guilty liked to answer - so why did he think Mydei would answer it?

Why did he think he needed to know this?

“Yeah.. It is.” Phainon confirmed, though he was becoming less and less sure how much he truly wanted this answer.

Mydei didn’t waste a second thought on the other hand; “I see. Go ahead then.” 

“Did.. Did you actually kill your own father?”

Silence. 

Mydei’s golden eyes opened at that - sluggishly, languidly as if it was asking too much of him before they focused on Phainon’s chest for a moment. Just the briefest moment before Mydei seemed to scoff, some emotion flickering over his facial features just for the slightest of seconds.

And then Mydei rolled over to face the wall and away from Phainon.

Phainon knitted his brows together - staring at the back of Mydei’s head numbly in the silence before he smelled it. The slight change in Mydei’s scent, that scent he loved so dearly and now fully knew and recognized as only belonging to his beloved Mydei.. Soured. A scent Phainon enjoyed so very much - but knew fully well it was a bad sign..

“.. Mydeimos?” Phainon quietly asked, eyes searching the back of Mydei’s head as if it would tell him the answers he wanted - eyes only dropping slightly to stare at that scarring skin on his nape, the skin that didn’t seem to be healing. 

Instead, it just looked more and more like he truly had a mating bite lodged into his skin - and that normally made Phainon’s heart feel light and free, but right now.. He could only focus on the pure unfiltered dread that corrupted Mydei’s silence.

“.. You can keep the apartment.” Mydei said rather flatly - hollowly and brittle, like he was doing his best to not feel a single emotion towards this.

To not show any emotions, to just curl in on himself and hide away from Phainon until the morning.

But it’s not like Phainon would allow that as he only felt his breath hitch - staring at the back of Mydei’s head; “What do you mean by that?”

That query left his lips so quietly that he almost worried Mydei didn’t hear it, yet after a few brief seconds he watched Mydei’s shoulders move heavily.

Sighing. 

“I’ll pack up my stuff again tomorrow morning.”

Those words didn’t make it any better - didn’t make Phainon feel any better, if anything, he felt like his heart was being squeezed painfully. 

“.. That’s.. That isn’t what..” 

That’s not what I want. Those were the words on the tip of his tongue as he narrowed his eyes staring at the alpha - eyes dipping to where that bite mark was. To where that seemingly mating bite stayed buried beneath his hair.

Mydei didn’t reply to those broken rambles.

“Mydei..” Phainon almost whined out, feeling a sickening sense of fear settling into him with that silence - an uncomfortable lump settling in his throat; “Mydeimos, can we keep talking..?”

“There’s nothing to discuss.” 

Mydei’s rigidness on the matter did nothing to quell Phainon’s fear, only adding coal to the flames as Phainon tensed up slightly - brows knitting together as he stared at the alpha. 

Phainon could only fire a retort back in a hushed tone; “I would argue there’s plenty to discuss..”

Phainon waited a few moments.

Just a few.

Just enough to make his anxiety spike more and more as the silence from Mydei dragged on without an end in sight. 

And Phainon could only painfully readjust himself, his hands twitching and tensing painfully as he continued watching Mydei’s back.

“I don’t want you to move out..” Phainon began again, wholly unable to just sit in the words of Mydei’s earlier statement; “I wanted to live in this apartment with you..”

Phainon just.. Wanted to know if it was true, he just wanted answers about something involving Mydei and a piece of him felt like this was kind of important.

Did he actually have any right to know?

He didn’t know, actually!

The thing was! Mydei could just say no - he didn’t, he wasn’t found guilty and thus Phainon would have been sated and never asked again.

But Mydei didn’t.

Mydei was shutting him out and refusing to talk about it - and Phainon only desperately wanted to know if that was due to the breach of trust of even daring to ask such a thing.. Or out of guilt.

Phainon only knew one thing for sure - he definitely valued Mydei more than whatever the answer was, and maybe that realization should have happened before he actually asked that question..

Because now… Well…

“Mydei..” Phainon borderline whimpered out again, trying his best to sound as comforting and not angry as he could; “Speak to me, grumpy..”

Phainon could only pray the light teasing helped - that if Mydei knew he wasn’t angry or anything he would react better. Show more signs of life, or something.

Yet.

“Just go to sleep.” Was Mydei’s reply after a few more seconds - still as cold and hollow as the last, detached and unemotional, doing his best to mentally distance himself from the situation it appeared.

“.. I’m scared to now, haha..” Phainon gave a choked laugh, one that did nothing to hold his fears at bay and leaking into his shaky voice - terrified of..;  “What if I wake up and you’re gone?”

Those fears weren’t unbiased considering what Mydei had said - and a piece of Phainon felt uneasy and completely unwell to even think about how Mydei may try to slip away in the morning. 

May not even bother collecting his stuff - he could just buy it all again. Just completely vanish from Phainon’s life again.. Phainon found himself scooting closer at that, moving to press himself against Mydei’s back slightly in an attempt to soothe his own rising anxiety over the idea of it.

“You weren’t going to do that, were you?” Phainon’s voice came out more broken than he would have preferred - more shaky and obviously upset. He couldn’t help it as he only blabbered onwards;  “I don’t know.. If I could live without you again, you know that right, Mydei?”

Phainon expected to be met with silence.

Only, he wasn’t.

“I killed him.”

Those words were said in a tone that was so dull and lifeless that Phainon almost thought he heard incorrectly - almost assuming that Mydei didn’t just admit to murder.

But he..

He knew Mydei better than that.

“.. Huh?”

“You asked, and now I’ve answered. I killed him. Move on with your life and forget about me in the morning.” Mydei continued on, not sounding anymore desiring for conversation than he was just a few moments ago.

And Phainon felt so, painfully, numb at those words. 

A day of dating Mydei.. And Phainon had already started to push another wedge between them..? Was this also Mydei dumping Phainon..?

That alone made Phainon almost feel dizzy as he propped himself up on his elbow slightly - attempting to peer at Mydei’s face in the dim lighting.

“Forget about.. You?” Phainon echoed those words - sounding absolutely baffled before he gave a shallow laugh, a pained and pathetic noise; “Mydei, I’m in love with you.”

“Love isn’t meant for me.” Was Mydei’s immediate rebuttal, one that made Phainon jerk his head backwards - reeling over those words.

He couldn’t even stop his mouth from moving - his thoughts flooding out of his lips without a second chance to look back on them; “What exactly does that mean..?”

“You cannot be in love with a killer, Phainon. I’m sorry for leading you on.” Mydei said so painfully flatly, a tone that only drove Phainon up the wall as he knitted his brows together.

“.. Leading me on?” Phainon repeated, because those words were so very silly to his own ears, to even consider, and yet Mydei was considering them to be real in his own mind; “Mydei..”

Phainon waited a few moments, tense and stressed, but he did wait patiently.

Just enough, just long enough to feel his sinking dread settling deeper than he had ever wanted before he quietly spoke.

“Mydeimos, look at me.”

Mydei didn’t, he didn’t move at all or react. Only remained looking away.

And, Well.

Phainon deep down at his core, was an alpha, regrettably. 

“You annoying stubborn alpha, look at me!” Phainon had lost his temper slightly, sure, did he grab Mydei and push him onto his back and get fangs bared at him? Sure, Sure. Did he move to immediately straddle Mydei so that he couldn’t just turn on his side again and avoid looking at Phainon. Also, sure. 

But it was out of love, so that had to count for something, right?

Though, that low quiet noise from Mydei’s throat beneath him was probably not out of love. 

“Don’t growl at me.. I love you, Mydei..” Phainon found himself murmuring as he readjusting himself slightly - getting comfortable while also keeping Mydei pinned down. Minus actually holding his arms down, at least.

And it wasn’t as if Mydei was pushing against him - minus the growling and borderline snarl he was giving, he was on all accounts allowing Phainon to do this to him.

Phainon didn’t waste a single moment before moving a hand to Mydei’s cheek, gently running his thumb across his cheek bone with a small content sigh. 

This was fine.

Even if he had to glue himself to Mydei like this - as long as Mydei didn’t try to run away. It was fine. 

“If anything, I just wish.. I had been there to take that burden instead of you.” Those words left Phainon’s mouth without a single thought as he stared at those golden eyes that still seemed to gleam in the lighting that was teetering on the line of fully falling now.

Phainon wasn’t shocked with how Mydei’s vibrant eyes in question seemed to widen at that before quickly narrowing, clearly, not believing those words.

“You cannot mean that, Phainon. You are talking about ending someone’s life.” Mydei hissed at him, making it quite apparent that he was still angry and annoyed by this situation. Agitated and irritated beyond belief at Phainon’s questions and abrupt change in positioning. 

But that question made Phainon’s mind stall - the idea of taking someone’s life was horrifying.

But weren’t those tattoos lacing Mydei’s body that he hadn’t even wanted just as horrifying?

Wasn’t the idea of Mydei’s own father killing his mother just as horrifying?

“Why did you do it, then?” Phainon found himself asking - if it was such a crime, he wanted to know what truly brought Mydei to see that as the solution. 

To know why Mydei would trap himself in feeling unlovable if he thought being his father’s murderer was a deal breaking.

Phainon would admit, it was probably a giant and absurd red flag, but at the very least the color red had been growing on him quite a lot lately.. 

“.. Why?” Mydei only echoed out, and Phainon found himself leaning down, just enough to stare into those still wide and on edge eyes - just enough to try to understand Mydei’s feelings through his facial expression alone. 

Phainon couldn’t help it though, only shuffling slightly to be sitting more comfortably atop Mydei - still trapping him with both of his legs, but doing his best to keep him there.

“Yeah, why? Why did you kill your own father if it would still bring you this much distress? Why did you do that to yourself, Mydei?” Those questions fell out of his lips without much thought.

Those inquiries were things he just wanted to know - things that had been on his mind all day long.

He just.. Wanted to know what would drive this gentle alpha into doing something so irreversible? Something that you could never recover from? Never come back from?

“They were.. I had to..” Those words quietly left Mydei’s mouth in reply, at such a low volume that Phainon wasn’t even sure if he had heard him correctly or not.

They were? Who are they?

Phainon couldn’t find it in himself to question that however as he saw and felt Mydei finally actually breaking down - just barely able to make out how scrunched and skewed his face was. And only aware the man must be crying due to his fingers on Mydei’s face becoming wet. 

“Don’t cry, Mydei..” Phainon softly cooed, doing his best to use both his hands to wipe away at Mydei’s face;  “I’m not angry at you, don’t cry..”

Phainon was more shocked the man was crying than anything, and he wasn’t even sure if it was due to the fact he had confessed to murder or not.

But the way Mydei seemed to lean into Phainon’s hands on his face gave him a sinking feeling that it wasn’t, and the way Mydei’s hands finally rose to simply cup shakily at Phainon’s own hands told him it wasn’t.

The hold was tight and firm, and Phainon found himself only moving to gently lace their hands together gently - thumb rolling across the skin of Mydei’s own hand as he still sat there straddling the man and trapping him to the bed.

“It’s alright..” 

It was fine.

If Mydei was a mess, Phainon would be one right alongside him - his own curiosity had won over tonight, but he just.. Wanted to know everything about Mydei. Even if it was dark and twisted deep down within him; Phainon didn’t mind.

He just.. Wanted to be at Mydei’s side at the least, to lose himself fully and wholly in this alpha that still looked so very distressed. 

“I love you, Mydeimos..” Phainon could only try to convince him, to let him know of those feelings. That the idea of ‘dumping’ Mydei was an impossible one from Aglaea, and that ‘forgetting’ him was an even more insane idea from Mydei himself; “It’s alright..”

Phainon wouldn’t - couldn’t, lose this man again. But Phainon wasn’t afraid to ask him questions, maybe he shouldn’t have started with this s pecific one.

Phainon wanted all of Mydei.. Even if Mydei himself didn’t want some of those pieces to be remembered - Phainon would treasure them all the same, because at least… At least it’s Mydei.

“You don’t understand..” Mydei quietly informed him and.. Well..

Phainon didn’t understand the reasoning behind those actions.

That was true.

But he wasn’t sure it really ever mattered that he did understand or didn’t - he felt idiotic for even caring to try to learn in the first place; all he had done was upset Mydei more than anything..

He wanted communication, but this was probably.. Assuredly, the wrong question to start as a jumping point from.

“That’s okay.. You can explain more one day if you want..” Phainon told him - only squeezing where their hands were connected lightly before giving a huff of laughter. 

“Let’s get married.. You can take my name and we’ll move so far away you never have to think of this again.. I’m sorry for upsetting you like this.” Phainon offered, moving his hands to press Mydei’s own down into the bed, just enough to where Phainon thought the position was comfortable.

Just enough for Phainon to duck downwards and pepper a few kisses onto the alpha’s face - sniffing at him in a hopefully less noticeable manner to try to get a gauge on how upset the man was beneath him.

“Why is marriage where your mind always immediately goes..?” Mydei laughed quietly - softly and almost solemnly as his eyelashes fluttered at the kisses; “You can’t marry me.”

Phainon wasn’t convinced of that as he moved away again, leaning backwards to blink at Mydei in the dark lighting of the room. Just enough lighting to perfectly make out those furrowed brows that seemed focused on being still plainly distraught.

“Why? Because you killed the man that practically tortured you?” Phainon questioned, only giving a small huff of laughter as he considered his own words, as he tightened their hand holding slightly; “I think I would have done it for you if you hadn’t already..”

Mydei only gave a quiet scoff at that, a disbelieving one before speaking; “You’re insane.. You don’t even know me, either, Phainon.”

Phainon didn’t think that mattered anymore, truthfully.

 If he barely knew Mydei, why was Mydei also so willing to move in with him? So willing to make sure Phainon was comfortable as well? Going so far as to buy a choker for him to wear..

The answer was obvious to Phainon, at least.

“Yeah, but I think we’re soulmates.”  Phainon informed Mydei in a rather happy tone - one that was more aligned with the idea of just stating the truth.

Because he was!

This was a happy and chipper moment! One that he could only share with Mydei who was assuredly his soulmate in this world, in this life, and all of the rest.

Mydei only gave him an egregious one, one that looked wholly unconvinced even in the poor lighting; “You think those actually exist?” 

That question was an interesting one.

Mydei didn’t need to believe in them, Phainon would spend the rest of his days trying to convince him if he needed to - trying to convince Mydei that no matter his past, even he was worthy of being loved.

And that Phainon would love to love him.

“Only because I met you!”

Phainon had no shame in admitting he leaned down to immediately brush their noses together gently, before moving to nuzzle himself into the crook of Mydei’s neck - only savoring the way the alpha still didn’t react. Still didn’t shove him away, merely accepted this fate before giving a loud exhale that bordered on sounding like he was being dramatic.

“.. You are.. Insufferably sweet.”

Chapter End Notes
