chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.html:
Mydei sluggishly awoke - painfully slowly trying to lean up as he gave a low sigh. 

A sigh towards the feeling of a heavy ass weight on his chest, one that was coiled around him so tightly that he knew it to be only Phainon by scent alone while his own eyes were still closed.

That was an issue because no matter how much Mydei wiggled - the alpha didn’t budge at all, even stranger was the way his pheromones were off the charts. Absolutely blaring - as if he had spent the entire night on edge, threatening anyone that came near his prize so very possessively..

And Mydei could only lean his head back into his pillow as he came to terms once again that he was the prize in this scenario. It shouldn’t still feel unreal to him - but it did, every time he thought about those arms wrapped around him tightly, and a leg tangled in between his own legs beneath the blankets, it was odd.

He was pretty sure being a murderer was a deal breaker last he checked.

But if anything, the way when he blinked at the head laying on his chest - only staring right back at him - he was pretty sure it had only made Phainon somehow more protective and territorial of him.

Honestly, Mydei hadn’t thought much once Phainon had asked that question, practically only feeling numb and cold immediately that someone he actually enjoyed being around was going to immediately leave him like normal.. He had no real memory of what he had told this man before quietly sobbing his way into a slumber embarrassingly under Phainon’s cold yet soothing incessant touches.

Not one of his most ‘alpha male’ moments, to be sure, but whatever. It didn’t seem like Phainon cared too much, or maybe he cared way too much.

Mydei couldn’t tell.

“You’re already awake?” Mydei decidedly asked as those blue eyes only keenly continued to watch him in the morning sunrise dawning against the window to the left of the bed - they seemed to blink at that, as if considering something.

“I don’t.. Sleep well most of the time, you know?” Came Phainon’s quiet reply, so very hushed that Mydei couldn’t help but move a hand to card through his own hair before moving to scratch at the back of his head - letting himself flop back down on the pillow behind him again.

Only then did he move his hand to rest lightly on Phainon’s back - only vaguely aware of the way Phainon almost seemed to flinch oddly over that.

Mydei couldn’t blame him, not after learning Mydei was a killer, it made sense to be scared of him.

Mydei found himself shutting his eyes again - trying to focus on anything else but the way Phainon seemed terrified of him.

That was an impossible task to try to do.

“Oh, really?” Mydei asked, rivaling Phainon in the level of quiet volume - not really sure of what else to say.

How else to comfort this man.

Phainon had said a lot of silly things last night; so silly Mydei knew better than to actually believe them, no matter how his heart ached to believe in just one person.

He couldn’t. He could only do his best to forget those words - just like he forgot his own.

Only, completely and blissfully unaware of Mydei’s own thoughts, Phainon’s arms silently tightened around him; “.. A lot of nightmares lately, that’s all.”

Mydei.. Didn’t know how to comfort him in regards to that, he really didn’t - instead he could only choke out the simplest of words; “I see.”

A brief silence fell onto them, one that Mydei was more than happy to let extend further. He had too much on his mind, too much to consider involving Phainon now. He for sure hadn’t wanted to give Phainon this kind of stress, no one deserved to be scared their partner may murder them..

The way Phainon was physically trembling while still pressing himself against Mydei made his heart ache in a way he didn’t know possible - only able to lay there numbly and think about how to solve this issue.

It was to leave, wasn’t it..? 

But Phainon had handled that so poorly the last time.. Surely, it was different due to the fact he knew Mydei had an irreversible amount of  blood on his hands, right? 

Phainon would be able to sleep soundly if he wasn’t in bed with a literal murderer - the nightmares he had last night wouldn’t have happened..

“How are you feeling..?” Phainon asked softly, his head barely rubbing into Mydei’s chest as he readjusted himself, just enough to be almost laying his entire torso on Mydei’s own.

It didn’t help.

Even with Phainon’s fingers pressing into Mydei’s back - anxiously grabbing at him as they laid there.

Mydei could still tell he was trembling.

Mydei swallowed down that lump of guilt that was forming in his throat before pressing out an inaudible sigh over that question, and over the answer; “.. I have a headache.”

That simple statement did cause Phainon to release his grip on Mydei - just enough to raise himself slightly, appearing worried; “Do we.. Have any medicine here?”

Mydei really didn’t know what to do here.

Was he supposed to leave? If anything, it was almost blatantly obvious that Phainon was beyond uncomfortable around him currently.

But was that really the word for his emotions right now?

Mydei couldn’t say for certain as he searched into those icy blue eyes - only to dart his gaze away and towards the bedroom door. 

“I.. Should have some Advil in one of the boxes in the bathroom. I hadn’t unpacked it yet..” Mydei mumbled out, which was the truth - he hadn’t expected getting a headache, but he surely had one growing now. Most likely from last night’s rampant emotions, but what could he do?

Phainon looked to grow almost more nervous at those words before completely leaning away, almost perking up at his own thoughts; “Oh! I’ll go get it for you!”

“I can do it myself..” Those were the words Mydei managed to say at least as he rose to match Phainon’s sitting position - only to find a hand on his chest firmly pushing him back down. 

A hand that was still trembling rather obviously now, and Mydei found himself only blinking as Phainon moved quickly to tuck him back under the blankets.

“No, no! I’ll get it for you, Mydei!” Phainon told him in the most clipped and terrified tone Mydei had ever heard the alpha use towards him, so clearly distressed with every breath he took; “Stay here.. Stay in bed, okay? Just stay, okay?”

Those words were not Phainon asking, that much was blatantly on display to Mydei - those words were a plea spilling from Phainon’s mouth, one that Mydei was struggling to fully wrap his head around as he stared at the snowy haired alpha whose pheromones still hadn’t calmed down at all.

“.. Phainon?” Mydei started to ask, still a bit stunned;  “Are you.. Okay?”

The answer was no, clearly he wasn’t.

But Mydei couldn’t quite grasp if it was due to the fact he had just slept with a murderer or not anymore - Phainon was beyond distraught. Even his souring scent told Mydei that much, but Mydei.. Really wasn’t sure as to why at this point.

“I just.. It’s fine!” Phainon insisted with a painfully quick nod - one that made Mydei almost wonder if his neck was alright after such a movement; “I don’t work today, so I’ll stay home and help you unpack today too!”

That was.. Sweet, sure. But it wasn’t like Mydei needed that much help, he was perfectly capable of moving around boxes and even was planning on just treating it as if it were just his normal daily exercises..

Besides..

“.. Don’t you have to move your own stuff?” Mydei questioned incredulously as he stared at the clearly panicked alpha that was now moving to slide off the bed - almost seeming so quick to get away.

“No.. It can wait. It’s fine.” Phainon only waved him off however, as he slowly shuffled to the door - though he didn’t turn away from Mydei, as if he was terrified Mydei would lunge at him at any second; “You just.. If you’re unwell today, you don’t even have to pack! I’ll do it for you!”

Mydei couldn’t help but look away, look to his hands as he dragged them over the sleek jet-black comforter, not of his choice - but he hadn’t changed it yet.  

“It’s just a minor headache.. I’ll be fine.” Mydei mumbled out, eyes only focused on his own hands still.

“That’s..Just.. Stay here, okay? I’ll be right back.”

Mydei dragged his eyes up - just enough to give a blank look towards the alpha who was quite clearly anxious - so very stressed and almost moving like his mind was moving at a mile a minute.

“Don’t even bother getting up! It’s okay! Whatever you need I’ll get you, alright?” Phainon told him in a much too ragged tone, so clipped and jagged, like he was already at the fraying ends of his own patience with every word he told Mydei.

“Phainon..” Mydei started in a quiet tone, trying his best to wrap his head around why this man was so distraught - but Phainon didn’t seem keen on hearing him out just yet.

Instead; Mydei could only blink as Phainon shut the door behind him - staring at the white painted door with wide eyes before pressing himself upwards and to a sitting position once again.

That had been.. Odd, to put it extremely simply.

Phainon was obviously trembling - shaking like a scared chihuahua when he looked at Mydei, and Mydei wasn’t sure how to exactly soothe that..

Leaving was the easiest option, Phainon was undeniably bothered by him being a murderer and probably using the time now to rethink his choices.. If he hadn’t already done that one Mydei drifted off to sleep.

Mydei didn’t know.

What was he supposed to do in this situation? 

Mydei honestly.. Never thought he would tell someone about killing his father - but Phainon seemed so desperate to know that Mydei wasn’t sure what other option there was.

.. He was a murderer, that was the cold and simple truth on the surface, and the one even if he tried to deny and ignore it lingered in the depths of his mind cruelly.

Never a moment of rest, even if he hated that man, the face of his own father when he had taken his life from him was.. Haunting. More than anything else in his life.

“Oh! You’re sitting up again.. I got you some water too to take them with if you need it.”

Mydei jerked his head upwards at that, eyes trailed the alpha who was still so blatantly stressed, still having such sour pheromones rolling off of him in waves. 

Different than his normal protective ones - Mydei could only reason it was due to the news after all. He wasn’t sure, really. It was an odd note of sour and distressed emotions seeping into Phainon’s scent, and that same familiar possessive one he had wafted off of him since the day Mydei had met him.

This scent made Mydei fight the urge to scrunch up his nose - vaguely aware of the dissatisfied itch in the back of his head over an alpha smelling like this crawling back into bed with him.

But how could he refuse when Phainon’s eyes were only staring him down, flicking at him with wide pupils that seemed almost panicked - wetly blinking several times as he crawled on his knees across to bed to Mydei.

“.. Uh huh.” Was all Mydei said, slowly accepting the water and blinking over the way Phainon hadn’t brought the bottle - but the two pills instead. Though, his eyes only drifted to blink at Phainon in a stunned fashion, gazing at how heavily his chest was rising and falling. The sound of his breathing out of his nose harsh against Mydei’s ears.

“Are you alright, Phainon?” Mydei decided to ask, eyes only narrowing as he watched the man stare him down - so painfully intently that Mydei really wasn’t sure what was transpiring here anymore.

Mydei could only move to quickly down the two pills he was given with some water before Phainon immediately stole the glass from him again in a hurried movement and put it on the nightstand.

It was strange. So very bizarre as Phainon moved back to him, peering at him almost expectantly before nodding quickly. 

“I.. I’m fine!”

Mydei really didn’t believe that as his own eyes dropped to Phainon’s hands - glancing to see if they were still shaking, only Phainon instantly moved to grasp at the covers roughly. Acting like the cover could possibly act as an anchor in the situation.

“You’re.. Panting really hard.” Mydei pointed out almost quietly, eyes still focused on Phainon’s shirtless chest that was still heaving - clearly, he had truly moved at a panicked speed to find the medicine for Mydei, and probably to locate the cups..

“I was trying to be really quick with finding the Advil for you! That’s all!” Phainon told him earnestly, and the way that Phainon was languidly, almost timidly, moving closer to him couldn’t be ignored. An action that Mydei found himself only baffled over - because why.. Would he want to be closer?

“.. Right.” 

Phainon immediately followed up at that, a hand moving to gently grasp at Mydei’s leg that was beneath the covers - Phainon himself not dipping below those covers.

“You’re.. Not going to leave me, are you, Mydei?”

Mydei felt himself stiffen so immediately at that - quickly becoming so very rigid.

Not because he was guilty of thinking about it, but because of the way Phainon sounded so absolutely in pain as he borderline choked out those words. His voice sounded strained, on edge and fraying, like this was the hardest thing he ever had to ask.

It was baffling.

So very baffling that Mydei wasn’t sure anymore what the correct answer was here anymore - that the way Phainon had latched on him was so obviously a plea for him to stay by his side.

“Mydei.. You’re taking a while to respond to that, you know?” Phainon probed with a small huff of laughter, a shallow and forced thing, one that made Mydei dart his eyes away almost nervously.

He had.. Misread this he feared.

Was the level of panic and fear Phainon was currently undergoing, so high strung and stressed, because he expected Mydei to flee from him?

“..Sorry.” Was all Mydei could manage as he tried his best to look that panicked man in the eyes - to own up for his own actions and confused emotions. 

But Phainon only seemed to desire more than just that; “Will you.. Answer me?”

“Stop, stop! I said we should trade boxes!” His tone was gentle, almost soothing, as if Phainon was doing his best to try to calm a raging street cat hissing at him.

Mydei found himself staring at his boyfriend egregiously over that - brows knitting as he stared at the demonic man that he knew was trying to protect his evil collection.

Phainon only stood there before swaying slightly, eyes dancing around before landing on Mydei again swiftly; “Hear me out.. If my clothes suck.. Then I get to wear my boyfriend’s clothes and smell like him all day long!”

That was.. Sweet in a way, but Mydei could only clench his jaw over the thought of it.

“.. My clothes do not fit you well.” Mydei grumbled out as he narrowed his eyes to the man in a rising threat.

A threat against his wardrobe, but a threat regardless.

“Well.. Your shirts are a little bit more baggy around my pecs and the pants are, like, also baggy which is funny because I’m taller than you.”

Mydei could only blink upwards at the man from his own crouched position; “.. Uh huh.”

“But they don’t fit really because you have well.. You know..” Phainon only continued slowly trailing off as he seemed almost nervous, shy almost, probably because of his next chosen words while under Mydei’s burning and intense stare; “A bigger bum..”

Mydei blinked at that.

Not once, not twice, but three times over those words.

A bigger bum.

“‘Bum’..? Why is bum a word in your vocabulary?” Mydei found himself inquiring almost blankly as he cocked his head to the side, eyes darting between the cursed box of Phainon’s fashion, and his boyfriend.

“It adds flair.”

Those words were said so instantly, so quickly out of Phainon’s mouth that Mydei found himself to be completely miffed. Absolutely flabbergasted at the fact he seemed so dead set on such a thing. 

Mydei blinked at that once again.

“Just like the minion shirts, or..?” Mydei incredulously asked as his eyes wandered back to that demented box on the floor, 

“You are such a hater.” Phainon mumbled out so pathetically and whiny that Mydei didn’t even need to look at him to know that he was so clearly doing his normal fake pout he loved to pull over the simplest of things.

Mydei didn’t budge however, only rolling his shoulders back to loosen them up; “I’m not alone in this stance, do you want me to call Aglaea?”

“You wouldn’t..” Phainon’s voice was a ghost of its former self, one knowing fully well his goose was beyond cooked if Mydei did that.

If Mydei facetimed Aglaea and showed her all of Phainon’s clothes.. It was so over for him.

“With every minion shirt of yours I find, I’m an inch closer.” Mydei mumbled, moving to leave Phainon’s bedroom to escape the horrors, though he was painfully aware of the alpha trailing behind him immediately.

Probably still somewhat terrified that Mydei was going to slink away and hide, but truly, he just needed to stop seeing the minions before he started making a donation pile against Phainon’s wishes.

“That is actually the max hater mentality you’re displaying to me, Mydeimos!” Phainon whined pathetically behind him, a distressed wail that Mydei paid no heed to as he instead stopped in the living room, moving to actually go through his own things.

Phainon tried to copy, of course he did, but he paused.

“What’s in this box?” Phainon asked politely, making Mydei pause as he stared at the cardboard box Phainon had chosen - unopened, but clearly he had intentions of changing that.

The writing on the front of it was unmistakable, written by Mydei many moves ago.

‘Keep’.

“Oh.” Mydei blinked as the realization of what was in that box dawned on him; “Family things.”

Phainon immediately jerked his head to the side, almost looking at him like he had just seen a ghost; “Family.. Things?”

Well.

Mydei should have expected that in hindsight, but he could only give a small smirk over that reaction - over those blue eyes widening so easily. 

“Not as scary as you think. Picture albums and the sort, a few frames photos. You can keep them in the box, I meant to drop them off while helping you pick up your stuff.” Mydei explained as he walked over to the box, Phainon sidestepped him to give him room as he opened it up.

“You uh.. Used to be close to your parents?” Phainon asked, and even without looking at the alpha he could tell the man was so terribly nervous over this topic.

Couldn’t blame him there, not even as his eyes raked over the contents.

“My mom.” Mydei corrected lightly with a small huff of laughter, not even daring to go through that box as he closed it again. He had meant to drop it off at his own storage unit instead of bringing it here, but he was so distracted with how Phainon was beyond lovey-dovey today that he had forgotten.

Plus, it would have been hard to carry that box with the way Phainon was incessantly tied to his arm, clinging on like his life depended on it or Mydei would sneak off.

.. Valid worries, he guessed.

“.. Oh.” Was Phainon’s amazing reply to that information, and Mydei couldn’t even stop from scoffing quietly at that as he straightened himself out, stretching slightly with his hands over his head.

Mydei regarded him for a moment - taking in the sight of how blatantly Phainon looked as if he were a kicked puppy, shuffling his weight almost nervously over this topic being brought back up. Mydei couldn’t help but trail his eyes back down to the box.

“Do you.. Want to know why I killed my father?” Those words left his lips so easily, so quickly and freely that even he had to blink at them - still staying focused on that cardboard box of memories as if it were the most interesting thing in the world to him.

It wasn’t.

“I.. If you’re willing to tell me, I’ll hear you out, beloved.” Phainon quietly yet plainly supportably said at his side, and Mydei didn’t even try to stop himself from combing a hand through his hair idly.

Just before a hand fell to his braid instead to fiddle with it - an awful nervous habit he had never been able to break easily.

Granted, the answer was to just stop braiding his hair, but he really didn’t feel like doing that.

He liked that braid too much.

“I expected to go to jail for killing my father, naturally, but I was being blackmailed into killing him in the first place.” Mydei mumbled out, not really sure where else to begin but by stating the obvious things about that case.

About that situation he had found himself in as his eyes slowly drifted to Phainon.

Phainon held that eye contact as he nodded curtly; “.. Right.”

“The very same people that were blackmailing me into killing my father were defending me in court, practically throwing money to save me. It didn’t even matter if I fully admitted to it.”

The memory was funny in Mydei’s opinion, how quickly the law could be swayed with enough money. It was as if Mydei’s record was being wiped completely clean, and a piece of him should have been glad.

But how could he?

He had killed his own father due to those very same scheming people, and they wouldn’t even allow him to face his own retribution. And he knew they would never face their own until death claimed them, either.

Phainon’s shock in that was evident as he blinked at Mydei slowly, an action that was rather cute - if not for the topic at hand.. 

“What?”

Mydei squeezed at that braid in between his fingers testingly, almost timidly before pushing out a deep sigh; “They would cut out the confessions from cameras, frame me as just being distraught over my ‘beloved father’s’ death, etcetera.” 

“It worked out well for them, I didn’t want the company, and I sold it for way cheaper than my father ever would have - if he ever wanted to sell it, that is.” Mydei could only shrug, everything had been a free fall spiral for months during that period of his life.

He just wanted any traces of his father gone from his life - there were no good memories from the start, but he didn’t want those new horrid ones that only made him feel guilty.

Even keeping the money made him feel guilty, he could only hope to offset those feelings through philanthropy.

“What.. Did they blackmail you with?”

That was the question, wasn’t it?

Something that Mydei had never really expected someone to threaten in his life - someone that he didn’t think he would put in danger.

“Aglaea.” Mydei flatly answered, and as he dragged his eyes to meet Phainon’s - he really supposed he should have expected the look of absolute bewilderment written all over his features..

“Huh?” Was Phainon’s immediate questioning reply, and Mydei couldn’t really blame him for that one considering it was .. Probably left field for her of all people to be targeted. 

Mydei could only shrug over it; “I’m not a man of many friends, but I have always supported Aglaea. That leaves a paper trail, I was just too naive to realize such a thing.”

He had long since thought about how it had happened, anyway.

But it had been years - and nothing had happened nor had they continued their blackmailing, Mydei could only assume him killing his father and staying quiet about why was enough for them.

Phainon on the other hand, seemed absolutely horror stricken and Mydei couldn’t really blame him; “They.. Were going to do something to Aglaea?”

“Probably. Maybe. It’s what they threatened, at the least.” Mydei confessed - he wasn’t one-hundred percent sure, but considering they paid off the law to let him go.

Who knew?

He wasn’t even really sure why they didn’t just have him killed as well to easily own the company, why even bother keeping Mydei alive when the rest of his family was dead?

If anything, it felt like they were just toying with him mentally when he thought too much about it all.

Insane.

“Most likely wasn’t just going to end there, but I didn’t even want to imagine it starting there.” Mydei continued after a few seconds of silence, pressing out a heavy sigh as he even considered it all, it probably had started elsewhere regardless..

He really was starting to have such a terrible headache..

“So, I was left with a choice. My father, or Aglaea.” Mydei only looked down, eyes studying the way his own hands were trembling as he spoke; “Not really much of a choice to consider, honestly.”

“I wanted that man to die, I’ll admit to it.” He wasn’t even sure if his voice was steady - because it certainly didn’t feel like it as he kept his eyes locked onto his hands as he flexed them almost testingly. “But not.. To my own hands.”

“Though, He did kill my mother just a few months before, so I..” Mydei began, though he only cleared his throat as he glanced at Phainon again - realizing he was borderline rambling by this point. “Anyway, I have no desire for those people to know anything about me.”

“As much as they want me to work for them; they know I won’t say anything either.”

That’s what Mydei believed, at least.

“He.. Killed your mother?” Phainon inquired remarkably slowly, and Mydei couldn’t help but turn away at that. Eyes only wandering back to that closed box and the memories within it.

Not all were bad memories, but sometimes, he didn’t even quite remember what her voice sounded like.

“With enough money, you can pay off anyone, even paying for people to kill your own wife in cold blood to fully own your company’s shares.” Mydei explained simply, as if that actually explained anything at all.

But at this point - rich people lived in their own little world, Mydei knew that better than most people.

Even two mates who were once so very in love can have tragedy befall them due to greed.

“That’s.. Really insane.” Phainon slowly sputtered out, making Mydei raise his head to look at him again almost incredulously. “You.. Killed your father for Aglaea’s sake?”

“It’s.. Hard to explain, but yes.”

Mydei thought it was deeper than that - without a doubt, it was for her sake and her own safety. But on a deeper level, it was so much more than just that to those people. 

He was just some pawn in a game of chess that he had no idea he was even playing in, only praying that he had gotten out.

Only hoping that it wouldn’t become an issue for the newfound slice of happiness he had allowed himself named Phainon.

“Does she know?” Phainon asked, and that question made Mydei tilt his head.

He had never even considered telling Aglaea such a thing.

“I’m never telling her such a thing.”

“Really?”

“She doesn’t need to know, it wouldn’t do her any good to learn that.”

She didn’t need the extra stress of knowing why everything there had unfolded - he was sure she knew he did in fact kill his own father, even if she had never asked about it. But telling her that it was her life on the line?

He didn’t know if he was in the right, or in the wrong with making the choice that she didn’t need to know.

But Mydei was sticking to his choice regardless.

“I..” Phainon trailed off, clearly unsure of how to debate that.

And well, Mydei only shrugged, choosing to move on, Phainon didn’t have to understand it all.

But if he was curious, at least that much was hopefully sated with that conversation - even if Mydei would do his best not to ever have it brought up again.

Instead, he could only rapidly change the topic away to the best of his abilities. 

“I’m burning your hoard of minion shirts, by the way.” Mydei was lying, of course he was, he would donate them if he had the option, maybe Phainon wouldn’t notice.

Phainon only seemed flabbergasted by that, immediately dropping his mouth agape as he gave a startled and quiet noise over those words. 

“You can’t just change topics like that!” Phainon told him in such a disbelieving tone that Mydei couldn’t stop the huff of laughter that left his lips - nor the grin he gave to the awestruck alpha.

Mydei could only shrug; “It’s not a change in topics, we discussed my crimes; now we’re discussing yours.”

Phainon grew more distressed over that; “My crime is my minion shirts?!”

And as Mydei crept back into Phainon’s room, he couldn’t help but pause as his eyes fell onto the bed - onto the mess of clothes Phainon himself had been organizing.

Onto one item in specific that made him draw his facial expression into a heavy scowl as soon as his eyes saw the atrocity. The true crime that was taking place in their new apartment, the true horrible act of violence Phainon was forcing upon Mydei. 

“Your fashion sense is really atrocious. Why are your swim trunks these?” Mydei found himself borderline bristling as he picked the item in question up. 

Demonic.

Evil .

A giant face of SpongeBob staring right back at him with those beady little eyes and goofy ass smile.

Phainon’s voice was quiet; “They’re.. Funny?” 

Mydei was pretty sure he was going to fry this man alive over his fashion choices - there was no way he was so luckily gifted to be such a gorgeous looking alpha yet have the fashion sense of a twelve year old gamer that lives off energy drinks and microwaveable food alone.

“Is your dick supposed to be his nose?” Mydei idly asked, tiredly slowly looking up and to the side - staring Phainon down as if the man had wronged him.

And Phainon, rightfully, looked like a scolded dog as he answered again - and that choker on his neck really didn't help his case..

“I.. Yes..”

Mydei let out a deep exhale.

One that was really, truly and utterly, born from the depths of his very soul as his closed his eyes - thinking of all the possible words he could choose next.

All the possible ideas.

Only one sounded correct.

“It’s being burned too.”

“Noo!”

Chapter Notes

long time no puppy love. had some months of not wanting to write this but uh im determined to finish it the way i originally wanted, everyone explode and die idgaf

anyway, ao3 curse is real because i started working on this and then was sick the entire time writing it and now feel fine finishing it up LMAOOOO

It felt too real.

Every single time he had that dream, watching blood flow and wondering why it wasn’t the color of crimson. Crimson to match those tattoos of the man he wanted in his life more than anything else, crimson the color that blood should be.

Yet it wasn’t.

The blood that seeped out of that wound wasn’t that familiar deep red that Phainon knew to be the shade of blood - so very off as it flowed golden from that deep wound.

Why?

Why was it gold?

And why was the blade covered in gold always in Phainon’s hand? Even as he wept and stood there over that body he had grown so attached to - the man it belonged to and he wanted to belong to as well - why was he always the one holding the weapon that had taken his life?

Even if he was awake now, sitting there hunched over the sleeping form of the very same man that was once bleeding in his dream - why did it feel so real? 

Why did it feel like he had actually robbed Mydei of his life?

And why did he dream about killing him again and again nightly?

How was he supposed to act like it didn’t hurt to keep dreaming of such a thing? 

Worst of all - he had always dreamed about this. Always dreamed nightly of killing someone he knew was close to him again and again, but until Mydei he had never been able to discern their face. Always blurred, always forgetful - nothing on their body to make out decently, those crimson tattoos were just a mess of blurry lines that never once looked like anything more than blood.

But now.. Now ever since meeting Mydei he could make it all out - take in all the horrifying details as Mydei murmured quiet words every time. Things Phainon couldn’t hear over his own heart in his ears - thudding thunderously and deafening him from his crimes. Every single moment felt like agony as he continuously watched Mydei crumple onto the floor beneath him.

His only solace now from that ever recurring nightmare was the fact he could wake himself up through his own mourning and find that alpha blissfully asleep beside him. Phainon frequently now found himself weeping into the night, sitting there as he brushed Mydei’s hair timidly. 

Terrified.

He shouldn’t be terrified of breaking Mydei - he wasn’t someone that was fragile and easily snappable, yet Phainon couldn’t help it.

Everyday he dreamed of this very man dying and suffering, always at his own hands. How could he not brush back those golden locks with a shaky hand?

How could he not treat Mydei like the alpha may shatter if he’s too rough?

Even if he loses himself during the moment and is rough with Mydei in bed, the idea of ever actually hurting him was.. A horrible constant on Phainon’s mind..

How could he not quietly sob and sniffle as he pet that soft haired man, trying his best to soothe his own emotional issues without waking him.

A failure, it seemed as a golden eye slowly blinked open from Mydei’s position - flat on his stomach hugging a pillow so tightly as Phainon sat beside him in the early morning light.

“Phainon? Are you alright?” Mydei drowsily said - unmoving thankfully as he seemed rather fond of letting Phainon pet him slowly. At least, for now.

“Sorry.. Did I wake you?” Phainon choked out, voice coming out more strained than he had desired as he moved his free hand to wipe away messily tears from his eyes - not caring for the staining feeling they left behind. Especially as those golden eyes settled completely on him and stared upwards. 

“‘S fine..” Mydei slurred, obviously trying to rouse himself further into the waking world as Phainon’s hold on him only tightened upon his sluggish movements to try to sit up. A tightness that Mydei seemed to take as a sign to give up - instead melting right back down with a quiet sigh into Phainon’s arms.

“Are you okay, though?” Mydei asked, tone still struggling to adapt to the fact he was indeed now awake and that - that made Phainon give a small laugh. A hushed thing considering how awful he felt mentally.

It was torture, really. To watch himself kill Mydeimos again and again, never stopping, blade sinking into his flesh in that same spot repeatedly.

Why?

Why was he so intent on killing the man he loved like that?

He would never do that, so why would he keep dreaming of that?

“I’m fine..” Phainon managed, shaking his his slightly to attempt to dissipate those thoughts - praying that Mydei didn’t question it too deeply

A hopeless endeavor as those golden eyes seemed to blink at him innocently, staring him down; “Are you? You’re crying like something awful happened..”

Ah.

Well, that would make hiding his feelings just a tad bit harder after all. 

“I’m fine! Really.. Having you safe by my side is comforting enough..” Phainon gave a small smile as he spoke - trying his best to soothe the alpha whose scent now smelled off. Clearly growing more and more worried over this issue as he watched Phainon still cry.

It’s not like Phainon wanted to cry, alright? It just.. How was he supposed to stop as he stared at this alpha who had opened up to him and not think about the sickening sound of his blade tearing through sinew and sundering Mydei’s life from him in one foul movement?

Again and again. 

 “It was just a bad dream..” Phainon explained, halfway to Mydei - halfway to himself as those tears didn’t stop. 

Mydei stared at him for a moment, all before giving him such a lazy yawn - one that was more fitting of a cat than a man his size; “Mm.. About me leaving again?”

Phainon swallowed roughly at that - throat feeling “No.. About you dying..”

“Oh.” Mydei flatly said, sounding almost stunned before he sighed tiredly - breaking into a toothy yawn slowly, “That’s a bit more out of my control.”

Out of Mydei’s control.. Yeah. Considering every time Phainon closed his eyes he could still that familiar weight in his hands - heavy and metallic, daunting and so very horrifying when he remembered that sword gleaming with golden blood dripping from it. 

It always felt so real.

So hauntingly real as that heavy sword felt so right in his hands.

Yet so very wrong as that blood dripped from it and he stared at the unmoving body of Mydei at his feet. Every night. The same end. Again and again.

“Haha..” Phainon forced himself to try to laugh, failing horribly as Mydei lazily raised a hand up - one that Phainon could only watch and lean into just a tad as Mydei moved to wipe the still falling tears from his face.

Tears he couldn’t quite manage to stop fully - especially not as that gentle hand brushed against him. 

“I’ll try to stay safe, if it helps.” Mydei mumbled out, still sounding so blatantly sleepy as his hand rolled gently across Phainon’s cheeks - effortlessly wiping those tears away again and again.

“I..” Phainon had to sniffle, forcing himself to chuckle over the idea of Mydei staying safe - even if in his dreams Phainon was the problem, “Yeah.. That would be nice..”

Phainon watched Mydei keenly - watching as those lightly colored eyelashes fluttered closed gently. Clearly falling back to sleep, but Phainon couldn’t help but sigh contentedly over the sight of it; “Away from omegas and betas too..”

Mydei didn’t stir at that, and Phainon found himself watching Mydei’s back rise and fall beneath those covers - slowly and on pace as always.

“Alright, now you’re just being insecure.” Mydei grumbled after a few moments of silence, voice quiet into the empty air to where Phainon couldn’t help but laugh slightly. Just a bit as he tilted his head, fingers still combing through those blonde locks of hair slowly.

“It’s not insecure!” Phainon argued, though his tone was very hushed - a mere whisper as he fully knew the alpha beside him was drifting off to sleep again. That much was obvious as Phainon moved his hand down to Mydei’s neck, brushing those hairs there to the side to expose his nape.

To expose that bite he had left there - a sad thing, really.

He would have liked for it to be more romantic if he had known it was going to stay - or at least to have not been on his rut during that time. 

Even if not he could gently trail his finger around that spot - trying his best to ignore the way Mydei seemed to give way to a shiver over the tender circle Phainon was tracing.

“Is it not?” Mydei growled out - and Phainon almost would have assumed Mydei was annoyed with him, if not for the way he didn’t budge at all.

More bark than bite when tired, it seemed. 

Phainon had to hum over that, still dragging his fingers gently over that bite mark - such an intimate thing that Phainon couldn’t believe was lingering on Mydei’s skin.

“It’s called being greedy..” Phainon murmured after a few seconds of staring at that bite, only before bringing his hand back to Mydei hair - combing through it slowly with a quiet exhale escaping him.

“Mm..” Was Mydei’s reply, Mydei wasn’t the wordy type of guy. Never a yapper, but even that was a bit.. Lacking.

So much so that Phainon felt himself cracking a small smile, eyes staring at that growing still form yet again. 

“Falling back asleep?” Phainon asked, not really needing to have Mydei answer -  yet Mydei gave a quiet noise. Almost like a hummed out sigh before he shuffled slightly, rolling almost yet not fully committing as he stayed on his stomach with a grunt.

“Sorry..”

Phainon couldn’t help but give a small huff of laughter, a gentle thing - more akin to an exhale than an actual laugh due to not wanting to wake up Mydei too much or disturb him more than he already had. 

His hand combing through Mydei’s hair was enough comfort from Mydei; “It’s alright.. I just want to pet your hair anyway.. Sleep well, Mydeimos..”

No reply.

Mydei had already let sleep claim him yet again, and Phainon wasn’t angry at all over it - he didn’t fault him at all. Nor had he even wanted to wake up Mydei, his damnedable crying had done that for himself. 

But how.. How was he supposed to stay sane and normal when he had to keep watching Mydei die to his own hands - again and again?

He could only slide back down into the bed beside the alpha - all before slowly curling himself as close to Mydei as possible. All the while moving a hand to that spot on his spine almost defensively - ironic, considering it was always his own blade that pierced through there cruelly.

Did he have any right to try to defend Mydei from Phainon himself?

He didn’t know. 

Not like it mattered as he slipped back into sleep, and found himself yet again powerlessly watching himself take Mydei’s life.

Again and again.

──────────────

“Mydei,” Mydei blatantly paused at his name being called, dragging his eyes across the mirror to watch the man that was walking up behind him. Joining him in the bathroom all while eyeing Mydei’s fingers deftly (and out of habit) swiftly working to tie his normal braid at the side of his head, “Can you wear your hair up?”

Mydei paused over that, fingers tugging his hair to make sure it was taut enough before blinking at the fellow alpha who now was fully on the prowl being him - walking up to him with a quiet hum. A devious thing, considering that question.

“My.. Hair up?” Mydei quoted and echoed out, and Phainon had the sinking feeling that Mydei already knew why as his eyebrows slowly knitted together in concentration. 

“It’s supposed to be a little hot today, why not?” Phainon shrugged, moving to lean on the doorframe as he stared at the back of the still shirtless Mydei - underwear, sure. Shirt? Lacking.

Not that Phainon minded at all as he hummed over the sight of those back muscles, eyes lingering on that spot where his  tattoos converged together.  

“You’re cute with a ponytail.” Phainon told him as he flicked his eyes upwards - winking at the alpha who was still staring at him through the mirror. Hand moving from his braid now to rest on the sink with a small hum. 

“You want me to..” Mydei trailed off, and the way Mydei’s eyes seemed to flicker as he leaned on that sink made Phainon feel curious.. Curious over the chances he actually would get what he wanted or not..

Phainon had to tilt his head innocently over that, blinking as he stared at those sunset eyes; “Please? You’re pretty with any hairstyle, but I want to see you out and about with a ponytail more!”

Mydei remained silent for a few too many breaths for Phainon’s own liking before he slowly shook his head, moving to grab another hair tie from the side of the sink; “Ah.. Alright..”

“Really?” Phainon gawked as he widened his eyes over how easy this victory had been - swallowing harshly as he watched Mydei mess with that 

“I’ll indulge you for today, sure.” Mydei grumbled out, sounding almost tired and Phainon was opting to believe it was the lingering drowsiness from his slumber.

Anyway, Phainon didn’t even try to hold back the grin that crept up on his face over that indulging his pretty mate was willing to do for him; “Wow.. My sweet Mydeimos..”

“Go get dressed. Stop just standing there staring at me.” Mydei growled out, and Phainon couldn’t help but watch as Mydei moved to gather some hair in his fingers. Deftly and with so much practice that Phainon found himself huffing a quiet little laugh. 

“You’re so bossy today.. But as you command, beloved.”

Phainon hated turning away from that man, he really did - even if it was just to creep off to his own bedroom and start getting ready - he hated it.  He really did feel like he was going borderline insane when he thought about it too much.

His life had been fine, no love life to speak of, but that was fine.

And now every single thought was spent worrying over Mydei and wanting to be near him - that’s not a bad thing at all! 

In fact he loved having a love life now, and he loved thinking about Mydei!

But going from feeling nothing romantic his entire life - thinking his nose was broken for years and years due to never smelling a ‘sweet’ person that would make his instincts go crazy - to having a person that did smell like that around him all the time?

It was quite the perspective switch, always at the forefront of his mind - even as he moved through his own clothes to get dressed for whatever Mydei was dragging him to do, he still found himself sniffing at his clothes. Trying his best to nose and figure out which one already smelled of Mydei.

Which one reminded him the most of Mydei - and told people who he was mated to, who he smelled like no matter what. And the only person he wanted to smell like. 

The looks of it didn’t matter, and somehow, his favorite silly minion shirt with the text “Bad news for Dr. Pepper” on the front and a low quality off center minion’s ass on the back with  “I Woke Up” smelled oddly of him.

Whatever.

It would have to do as Phainon tugged it over his head while moving into his own bathroom - a neglected thing just like his bedroom. Why did he need his own when he was more than just a little happy to be rubbing shoulders with Mydei? He could only tut at his thoughts, almost bitterly.

It was a waste of Mydei’s money.. But at least they could get a small house when they got married.

That stray thought made Phainon’s feet pause in his bathroom, blinking as he walked into there to brush his teeth. 

Marriage.

Marrying Mydei?

Would that man ever say yes to such a thing? Maybe not.. Right now, but eventually could he? Further down the line, would Mydei really fully accept him as his one and only in his life, even if they both are alphas? 

No use dwelling on that right now, at least, that’s what Phainon had to tell himself to be able to quickly brush his teeth and more to put on some pants - he didn’t dare want to stall for too long on the idea of Mydei saying yes or no on that.

Not yet.

Mydei didn’t think so.

Phainon studied him for a second, all before giving a small hum as he seemed to think about those words around his food; “Huh.. I’d probably be really excited..”

“Excited?” Mydei echoed out, tilting his head to the side as he idly listened to the rain pelt the window at their side. Somewhat mourning the fact that the cat had run away at some point and left Mydei alone with this alpha staring him down. 

“Well that I.. Get to have children with you.. And take care of you.. And dote on my sweet mate more than I already do..” Phainon started, all before giving a small laugh, “It would be a great excuse to be more handsy in public as well to rub your stomach and help hold it up for you.”

Mydei wasn’t even sure what he thought of that had he raised a brow over the idea of his stomach being rubbed in public.. Especially since he was in fact an alpha still.. 

“Or scent you more deeply.. Though I guess a pregnant male alpha would be kind of territorial on their own, right?” Phainon was speaking mainly to himself now, idly returning to humming softly, “Mm..”

“I would be so happy over it..” Phainon seemed to decide as he moved his eyes to peer outside - at the rainy weather, all before moving his gaze back to Mydei. Just to perk up immediately as their eyes met, “Why do you ask? Should we start trying more to knock you up? I’m in if you want, we can go in the bathroom a-”

“Be silent. I was just curious.” Mydei hissed out as he interrupted Phainon’s thoughts, feeling his own stomach churn over the way Phainon was so eager. 

Even if joking..

“Hehe.”

And they once again fell into silence. Not an uncomfortable one with the pitter of rain against the window and the talks of other people behind Mydei in the cat area, just.. A silence of a man who was focused on eating, and Mydei who was still lost in the possibility of being pregnant..

“Mm.. Were you asking that due to fear I’d leave our marriage for someone who can give me children? You’re insane if so, because I promise you’re the only person I’ve ever looked at in terms of love.” Phainon spoke after a few moments, and Mydei couldn’t stop the way he gave a blank stare to Phainon over that.

Blinking over those sweet words that he didn’t need, reassurance that he hadn’t asked for - but Phainon was always more than willing to lend them to him without needing to be asked regardless.

“We could just adopt if you want children, I’ll love them all the same.” Phainon added with Mydei’s silence, and Mydei was plenty sure he could hear Phainon’s nonexistent tail already beginning to wag happily over the idea.

“That’s good to hear.” Mydei huffed out, biting back a laugh over how eager Phainon seemed over it all,  “Maybe we should start with a pet, though.”

“Oh! But they already let your cat be adopted..” Phainon immediately whined out, seeming more and more depressed as he came over the conclusion - but Mydei only chuckled over that, shaking his head slowly. 

“I didn’t mean today.” Mydei pointed out, only to jolt a bit over Phainon’s phone randomly ringing out an alarm - clearly telling him his time here was up by the deep frown that came over his features. 

“Awe.. My break is over.. How much longer will you be here, Mydei?” Phainon asked out in a cooing voice - one that made Mydei shake his head slowly over it.

Eyes only moving to give a small look over his shoulder to the kitchen he had assuredly been kicked out of so the girls could gossip freely; “.. I’ll keep helping out when Cipher lets me back in the kitchen, so I don’t know. I’ll stay until you leave, probably.”

Phainon stood with those words, easily packing up his lunch he had finished with a small huff.

“The romantic umbrella walk is so back on..” Phainon murmured, all while pushing his own chair in before darting to Mydei’s side - just fast enough to kiss the top of Mydei’s head before Mydei cut him a glare. 

Mydei sighed over it, shaking his head instead over that alpha that was already merrily walking away, “Fine, fine..”

And his eyes only watched that man happily scratch a cat’s head, all before walking with that bounce in his step to the door and opening it. Just to pause and give a wave to Mydei, such an energetic thing that Mydei found himself scoffing over it - waving back a little less energetically than that pet dog did. 

But a wave nonetheless. And that seemed to be enough for Phainon to beam even more before disappearing again.

Mydei had to shake his head over that, going back to his phone to continue his idle scrolling over dishes he was debating making for Phainon later. All to have his thoughts stuck on how sweet that alpha really was.. So earnest and giddy over seeing Mydei, that it made his own heart beat faster in his ears.

He would feel embarrassed, if not for the way that very same alpha kept talking about marrying him - a part of him would argue it's too soon but.. How was he supposed to say that to such a puppy?

Mydei wasn’t really sure.

Instead, all he could do was idly return back to work - much to Cipher’s own chagrin as she kept muttering things about ‘moody pregnant people’ under her breath while they worked in the kitchen together. But honestly, Mydei didn’t even think he was acting differently. He was ninety-five percent sure she was just making up reasons to keep pushing the pregnancy idea into his head.. Oddly. 

The day wasn’t much to speak on either, not as Mydei cleaned his hands after helping Hyacine and Cipher clean up the cat area - now with significantly less cats. All while his eyes kept lingering on the rain outside, sighing over the fact Phainon was so keen on walking home together.. In that mess.. 

And Mydei couldn’t help but huff as he stopped at the dog area of the cafe - waiting a moment as he turned to watch that alpha he adored that was still moving about to put up dog food.

All before Phainon ushered Mydei out of the door, just to lock it after them both now that everyone had already left before them, and to retrieve his own umbrella. An action that made Mydei watch him keenly, mainly in pure wonder that they really were going to walk home in basically a storm.

“Mydeimos, my beloved, are you ready?” Phainon asked, already popping his light-blue umbrella open and Mydei had to blink upwards at it, only to feel himself jolt as soon as Phainon’s hand snuck onto his waist. All to pull Mydei closer to him with a rather happy hum leaving his throat.

But Mydei had to stare at him inquisitively, arching a brow over the close proximity, “You’re really intending on us cuddling under it?”

It’s not like he was against being pressed against Phainon and the alpha’s hands on his body - not anymore - but the fact of them both were under one umbrella..

They weren’t exactly.. Small men…

“Yep! I’ll keep you warm and safe from rain!” Phainon promised, tucking Mydei even closer to him and Mydei didn’t need to be able to hear that alpha practically purring under the heavy rainfall to know that he was.

It was written all over his smug face as he pulled Mydei as close to himself as he could - and Mydei almost wanted to call him beyond territorial and jealous. But it was sweet, really, nothing more.. 

A nice little walk under an umbrella, close together with the man he loved..

.. If only it wasn’t practically storming and Mydei was pretty sure their chances of being struck by lightning were escalating by the second.

Mydei couldn’t help but look out at the rain, blinking over it and back to Phainon - still heavily debating calling a cab or something instead of whatever Phainon was wanting. But it was so hard to argue when Phainon looked like a pouting and begging puppy - and Mydei was plenty sure he could see his drooping tail and ears if he stared closely.

Mydei had to sigh over it, “.. Are you sure?”

“Yep, stay nice and close to me, Mydei.” Phainon gleefully and instantly replied, already ushering Mydei forward and at his side - smile never once dropping from his face all while still walking into the rain.

Mydei thought it was silly, they both were assuredly going to be soaked by the end of this, and yet.. He stayed at Phainon’s side; “Right..”

It didn’t take but a few moments on their walk for Phainon to grow tired of listening to the rain it seemed, instead loudly yawning all before striking up conversation, “A lot of the dogs were approved and adopted, how were the cats?”

Mydei had to strain his own ears to try to hear that man under the rain and the umbrella being pelted, sighing softly as he gave a hum over the question, “Four out of seven were adopted.”

“Woah.. That’s a lot of kitties.” Phainon mumbled out a bit quietly, which didn’t help Mydei’s struggle to hear that man, but his mind was still focused on the umbrella in a thunderstorm anyway.. Instead blinking upwards to plead for mercy from the sky above.

He was pretty sure they didn’t deserve to be struck by lightning. 

“Mhm.” Was all Mydei replied with as he focused on the path in front of them both again, feeling the way Phainon’s hand was still resting on his back gently. 

“I’m surprised that so many people showed up with all the rain, honestly..” Phainon admitted, but Mydei had to chuckle over that - over the fact they were probably the only two people walking home in such a mess. Any normal person was using a car right now, not having a lovely stroll together in the frigid icy rain that was pelting their faces when the wind whipped up.

But Mydei had to ignore those thoughts, “Rain wouldn’t stop you from finding your new best friend for life if you were really serious about finding one.”

“That’s true!” Phainon was nodding as he spoke - Mydei could tell that much from the corner of his eye and that already made Mydei struggle to keep a small smile at bay on his lips. 

“Do you think we got any decent donations?” Phainon asked quickly after, all while gently bumping into Mydei’s shoulder - a clear sign that he was being playful about this line of questioning.

Questions that made Mydei chuckle softly as he stepped into a puddle alongside Phainon, eyes moving to look at the bleak sky; “I don’t know.. Maybe they saw one of their employees kneeing someone’s crotch in the cat area..” Mydei hummed out those words, grinning at the grey skies as he spoke mundanely.

“Oh.. Surely not! I can tell them the alpha enjoyed it, if the donor wants..” Phainon instantly argued back - and Mydei had to give him a scowl over that, mainly to also escape the window that was blowing directly onto his face and getting him even more wet.

.. They really should have just ran home like they did that one time, and if one of them got sick, who cares? 

Mydei sighed over his thoughts - only jolting slightly as Phainon’s hand tightened on his waist. Clearly doing his best to make sure he was as close as possible under the umbrella, and Mydei didn’t dare comment on the way he could tell Phainon was holding it over Mydei more than himself.

Instead shaking his head, knowing damned well that it would be a losing battle as he sighed; “The donor thinks you’re getting a bit too handsy right now..”

Phainon laughed at that, a genuine and sweet sound that made Mydei’s ears burn when he considered how much he enjoyed it - even under the rumbling thunder over their heads; “Mm? Am I? You still smell so good. Are you sure it was fine for you to come out here so soon after your rut?”

Phainon didn’t hesitate, moving his head to obviously sniff at Mydei - and by now.. Mydei was more than a little used to being sniffed at by Phainon, if anything, he somewhat expected it.

.. Freaky.

“I’m fine, if anything, you’re the more dangerous one nowadays.” Mydei mumbled out, mainly because it was true. He was quite sure people were in more danger with Phainon lurking around Mydei than Mydei left alone with other people. Mydei was aggressive on his ruts, yeah, but he was mostly subsided now and satisfied.. 

.. The demon beside him that was rubbing his pheromones all over Mydei still to show who he was mated to, on the other hand, didn’t seem to understand the meaning of being ‘satisfied’.

“I just need to make sure you’re nice and safe. Is that a bad thing?” Phainon innocently asked, all while rubbing his head onto Mydei’s - and that was an interesting thing because Mydei didn’t think that was comfortable to do while they were both walking.. But maybe he had just never tried to do such a thing.

Instead, he was still wincing over the amount of rain being spat into his face through the brash wind they were walking against; “.. You should be more worried about others than the alpha on his rut.”

Phainon only seemed to rub his head more onto Mydei’s - all before audibly kissing at his head loudly, “And yet! Here I am doting and sniffing at the alpha!”

Mydei had to be thankful over the way no one else was taking a scenic walk in a storm over how loud Phainon was being - sighing, all while fighting back that smile that was creeping onto his features over the show of affection.

“I haven’t donated yet, but I was never public about it anyway so it’s fine. I’ll do it when we get home.” Mydei told Phainon, listening to the way Phainon was softly humming and still leisurely rubbing on him.

Phainon pulled away, only to make a small little noise over those words; “Should we stop somewhere to eat?”

Mydei tutted over that, thinking of the fact he had already been planning out their night in his head - though, it’s not like Phainon knew that.. 

“No. I’m cooking.” Mydei blankly explained, which didn’t fully convey his thoughts that were still stuck and frozen on the idea of him being pregnant. He just.. Wanted to go home and think deeply on the idea of it all. 

Not that Phainon seemed to care however, instead rather blatantly rubbing himself against Mydei again happily, “Oh.. A home cooked meal from you is better anyway!”

Mydei didn’t doubt those words being spoken from that alpha, how could he ever when Phainon seemed so excited to say them? So earnest and giddy in the way he was borderline singing them out - all while the rain fall thundered against his umbrella so loudly.

Not really matching the mood of them both, but Mydei didn’t mind that at all as he hummed over his mate being so gleeful over something so minute.. 

“Are you trying to get on my good side today?” Mydei teased regardless of his own thoughts - instead giving a small simper smile to his mate who still was snuggling up against him. Probably not even seeing Mydei’s face, but that didn’t matter.

No against the rough wind and thunderous downpour they were for some reason waltzing through slowly together. None of it mattered when Phainon gave such a gentle and earnest laugh over that question into Mydei’s ears soothingly. 

“Always am, dearest!”

Mydei didn’t instantly reply to that, instead only fondly smiling over how honest his mate was, “Cute..”

It was cute.

It was something Mydei had never once considered would be his in this life, or in another life - A love so true and sweet that Phainon didn’t even think twice about any of it. He didn’t have to think over his answers or what to say when Mydei questioned both of them - he just answered honestly and with whatever he felt.

And for once, Mydei felt at peace with his life as he stared forward into the misty and heavily raining streets before them.

But.. 

Mydei couldn’t take it anymore, shaking his head as he peered out of the side of the umbrella, “Also, Phainon, I have something to tell you..”

“What is it Mydei?” Phainon asked, turning his head so quickly that Mydei knew he was getting serious - taking this as earnestly as possible and was genuinely worried about whatever Mydei could be wanting to tell him.

But Mydei could only sigh. 

“.. My shoulder is really soaked.”

“I won’t lie to you, Mydei.. Mine is too..”

Chapter End Notes

lol

Chapter Notes
