anyways
this fanfic is over for you if you hate mpreg. so have a good one. good bye. i do not car

Mydei had been acting weird.

Phainon couldn’t put his finger on it - not really, but everyday it was the little things of Mydei being more careful, moving slower, and seeming more and more touchy with Phainon. Not that he minded his mate wanting love from him, he was just a little confused every time Mydei did rub against him for affection.. 

.. Mainly because he didn’t used to do that, and after days in a row of him being so needy - Phainon was baffled by it. 

Everyday he got home from work, Mydei would instantly pepper him in kisses - and that’s nothing he could complain about at all, but he just didn’t know what he had done to deserve all the love. Even if he happily leaned into it and snuggled Mydei as soon as the man gave a sign that he wanted it, he would give in. 

He couldn’t complain about that - but what he was growing more and more worried about was the way Mydei seemed to be so active now. Always moving about and cleaning, even if Phainon didn’t see a mess - it was almost baffling.

“Do you want to go to the gym?” Phainon had once asked innocently, confused and baffled as he watched Mydei rearrange the bookcases yet again - sitting there rubbing at his temples as he combed through them. 

“No.” Was the flat response he had gotten in return, making Phainon huff and flop onto his side as he stared at his mate’s back flatly. 

And after that; Phainon was out of ideas, really. Instead all he could do was watch his mate keep himself seemingly busy. If it made Mydei happy, should he worry about it?

… Was Mydei happy?

That was another question that was making Phainon’s skin crawl nervously now as he came home everyday - basking in those sweet welcoming kisses and the closeness Mydei desired but was.. Mydei happy?

Was he stress baking and cleaning because he was unhappy with his life with Phainon?

Phainon didn’t know, but all he did know was now he was sitting on their couch, phone in hand, staring at Aglaea’s messages: 

Phainon:
aglaea.. mydei has been acting.. different.. do you know why

Aglaea:
Have you tried asking him about it before asking me?

Phainon:
well.. not yet.. 

Aglaea:
Do consider asking him first - He is not my boyfriend.

Phainon:
gulps ..

Aglaea:
… Do not text me the word ‘gulps’ ever again.

Phainon:
yes maam sorry maam

The issue there was Phainon didn’t even know if he was actually seeing and witnessing a change in Mydei’s behaviors, or if he was just slowly going insane. Plus, he couldn’t even really say anything to Mydei about him being.. Clingier and more affectionate. 

Because if he did.. What if Mydei withdrew himself again!? What if he thought it was annoying Phainon and he stopped seeking out that reassurance from his mate?!

Phainon would actually bury himself alive if he upset Mydei so much that he stopped being lovey-dovey to him like he had been as of late.

Instead, he could only watch as Mydei continued his creed of cleaning mindlessly - all before seemingly crashing onto the couch unceremoniously beside Phainon, all to focus on his phone in comfortable silence as well.

.. Comfortable, but only a little as Phainon had to dart his eyes to that alpha beside him - sniffing at the air to try to see if anything had changed. 

It hadn’t. It was the same Mydei pheromones he adored so much.. Strange. It all was so strange.

“Are you.. Feeling okay, Mydei?” Phainon asked after a few moments, doing his best to stay sane as he darted his eyes to the side - not even shocked as Mydei completely flopped down. Instead putting his legs into Phainon’s lap as he sunk into the couch more comfortably. 

“Yep.” Mydei answered immediately, eyes still on his own phone that he was holding above his face as he laid there.

But Phainon stared at him, peering at those golden eyes that appeared wholly focused on his phone - anything but on the man he was comfortably laying on top of currently.. 

Phainon couldn’t stop himself from pressing forward over that, swallowing harshly; “Really?”

“Yep.” Came Mydei’s instant reply, sounding almost bored to where Phainon found himself being almost completely flabbergasted over this. 

“Huh..” Phainon intelligently mumbled out, feeling himself crease his brows together over that flat response from Mydei. 

“Why do you ask that?” Mydei asked, all while setting his phone down - discarding it to the side of himself to instead stare at Phainon meticulously. Clearly studying every breath he took, every slight jitteriness in his bones over this topic with a raised brow. 

“I’m just.. You’ve been working overtime lately at home..” Phainon murmured as he stared into those golden eyes that were assuredly picking him apart silently. Still watching him so painfully keenly that Phainon could feel it.

Feel the way Mydei was sniffing the air, trying to understand his mood due to his pheromones alone as he slowly tilted his head from his position on the couch - looking almost confused as he seemed to give up on that, “Have I? I wanted to hurry up and get everything unpacked while you worked.”

“Right..” Phainon instantly hummed out, moving his head to focus on the bookshelves that had been cleaned several times over and reorganized, the amount of times he had watched Mydei mess with his collection of books he loved dearly was not to be understated.

… And he had the itching feeling Mydei might do it again, mess with those books before moving to cuddle Phainon - just like he kept doing after dinner. Which was nice, but.. So confusing compared to how Mydei once kept affection at an arm’s reach. Something for Phainon to beg for, and he didn’t miss it, he was just.. A bit baffled over the sudden change.

But Mydei only seemed to be growing more and more displeased as the conversation continued; “Why are you acting like that’s odd?”

“You know.. I don’t know - I’ve just felt like lately you’ve been..” Phainon felt his mind racing as he tried to work  this alpha down from the way he was starting to bristle over this topic, “Almost a workaholic?”

Mydei was silent for a few moments, still laying lazily on the couch before he sighed so egregiously loudly, almost too dramatic for Phainon to really believe it was his Mydei making that sound, “Mm.. I’m resting right now, isn’t that good enough?”

Right now didn’t exactly erase the fact Mydei had been rather blatant about his stress working and cleaning at home - repeating things he had already done before many times. And Phainon almost wondered if that was just how he actually acted while comfortable at home.

But he doubted it, mainly due to the fact Mydei’s level of clinginess was something that had changed - there was no debating that. 

“Okay.. But in general..” Phainon sighed out after a few moments, all to move and drag a hand up his face before slowly putting his hand on Mydei’s legs on his lap. Just to idly rub at the side of one. Trying his best to soothe whatever aches Mydei was currently feeling in his heart over this topic, because Phainon wasn’t trying to complain.

He was just.. Worried. 

“I think you’re reading into it too much. I’m just tidying up.” Mydei replied without even a scant amount of hesitation, seeming a bit bored over the idea of it all now. Like his mood had swapped from being defensive or on edge to instead dully staring at Phainon over it.

But Phainon couldn’t stop himself, “.. You cook at all hours of the day.”

“I’ve always done that.” Mydei countered effortlessly. 

Phainon was fighting a losing battle here, he knew that much as he pressed out such a heavy sigh while feeling like he was going insane anyway, “That’s.. True, but I don’t know..”

Mydei was silent for a moment, all before he made an odd clicking noise with his tongue - loudly as if he was puzzling over this just as much as Phainon currently was, “I’ve just been trying out new recipes as of late.. Why? Do they taste bad?”

“Well, no.. They’re always delicious.” Phainon asserted, feeling himself nod slowly over it as he gave Mydei a strange look. Mainly because he couldn’t figure out how to really talk about this subject - not when it was nothing particularly bad, and he didn’t want it to stop he just.. Was curious..

“I fear I’m not seeing the issue then.” Mydei mumbled as he laid there, eyes still staring at Phainon from his lazy position. Almost hauntingly as he seemed so very stoic currently, as if he was doing his best to give nothing away.

But Phainon just couldn’t understand what exactly was going on with him at all, “Are you.. Going stir-crazy? Should we go out more?”

Mydei stared at him over that one.

Really, really hard - almost unblinking as he held eye contact with him, all before giving a small chuckle. Shaking his head as he brought a hand up to his braid - fiddling with it, “I’m fine, Phainon. I’m not locked inside the house while you’re gone, if I wanted to go out for a bit, I could.”

Fine.

Mydei was fine.

Yet he was doing that odd nervous habit he had of messing with his braid when he was stressed out. This topic was stressing Mydei out, and Phainon hadn’t wanted that he just..

… He wanted Mydei to be happy, that’s all. 

“Are these habits bothering you?” Mydei instantly followed up with, sounding very concerned as he kept his eyes on Phainon - only for Phainon to finally look away, just to shake his own head roughly. Rough enough to where he brought up his hand that was stroking Mydei’s leg to instead ruffle up his own hair. 

“No, no, you could never bother me.. I just.. I don’t know.” Phainon conceded after a few moments.

Mydei didn’t seem convinced by that, only sighing softly - too softly, clearly aiming to be inaudible and that, that bothered Phainon horribly, “.. If they’re bothering you I can stop.”

“They’re not bothering me, I just want to make sure you’re alright..” Phainon immediately told him as he jerked his head to look at that alpha again, his mind reeling over the way Mydei was assuming he was a burden or annoyance to Phainon.

If Mydei tried to leave again, Phainon may actually lose his mind a little. 

Mydei only kept staring at him however, face void of any decipherable emotions all while still twirling his braid between his fingers, “I’m fine, Phainon. Outside of the fact I need to start making dinner soon..”

Phainon had to try to lighten the mood up, laughing softly as he keenly watched Mydei give up on that braid, “Such a busy bee lately, do you want any help?”

Mydei didn’t answer instantly, instead moving to swing his feet off the couch and instead stand up - just to stretch with his arms over his head with his phone in his hands. All while Phainon blinked at the sway of his hair, staring at the way he seemed to hesitate for a moment before turning to look at Phainon.

Such a heavy glare dancing in his eyes as he seemed to find it in himself to growl darkly, “Absolutely not. Stay there.”

That.. That was more like the alpha Phainon knew, and Phainon found himself wishing he could wag his tail over it. Just to give a dazzling smile at those eyes narrowly glaring at him, “Ah.. Okay.. Forever grounded from the kitchen.”

“Yep.” Was all Mydei offered as he immediately moved out of the living room, not even looking back as Phainon stared at him. 

And.. Well.. Phainon flopped over onto the couch where Mydei had been now that his mate was gone - readjusting to stare at the ceiling blankly as he listened to the sounds of Mydei in the kitchen. Ears keening to try to listen to Mydei in their kitchen, trying his best to listen to and sniff at the air - trying to see if Mydei was upset, trying to see if he was lying.. 

Instead he found nothing, staring at the ceiling dully as he simply heard Mydei making dinner. 

Confusing.

It all was so painfully confusing right now, his mind could only reel over it all, mindlessly trying to figure out if Mydei was hiding something. Or if he really was just going insane trying to clean everything and that somehow was making him extra needy with Phainon. Rubbing on him constantly and nipping at his skin..

He wasn’t sure how many times he had to tell himself it was a good thing, but something about it still was odd. This was his alpha mate who used to hiss and growl at him over just the simplest of affection due to his own instincts running wild while Phainon’s did nothing.. And now he was the one seeking out the love and attention. 

Surely he wasn’t the insane one here, right!?

Mydei had definitely changed - in a good way - but he had changed and only he was the one able to tell, right? 

It was his job to take care of his mate, to love him no matter what, and as he dragged his fingers up to feel that choker Mydei had given to him as a show of possessiveness… He felt like he was going insane. He was clearly failing on some front, but he couldn’t figure it out. And it didn’t even matter, because Mydei was happy, right!?

Right?!

What the hell is wrong with Phainon!?

“Dinner is ready.” Mydei told him, not very loudly - but loud enough to make Phainon yawn and stretch. Rolling his shoulders as he pushed his hands over his head lazily, all before following Mydei’s voice into the kitchen. 

And nothing prepared Phainon for the plate of food already set where he normally sat - already waiting for him. Such a thing made him raise his brows towards the almost nervous looking Mydeimos who was standing behind his own chair. 

“Wow, you already got me a plate ready?” Phainon practically purred out his words - feeling himself keen over the way Mydei always cooked for him. His own way of trying to please his mate, but it didn’t help that the odd fear was still nipping at Phainon’s skull unrelentingly. 

“Of course.” Mydei answered, not aware of Phainon’s inner turmoil at all as he gave the smallest little chuckle - amused by Phainon’s shock over Mydei already putting food on his plate for him. 

But Mydei had never done that before, was it to be sweet, or because something was bothering him?

… Phainon was probably over-thinking this, right?

Whatever.

Phainon could only slowly move to pull out his chair - moving to sit down along with Mydei who had already sat down while he was having an odd mental breakdown about whatever is up with Mydei.

He probably was just over reacting, right? 

That had to be it, even as he leisurely started to eat, he could only imagine he was making it all up - going insane because he didn’t want to lose Mydei no matter what. He just wanted to please Mydei! That was all..

And yet..

“Phainon.” Mydei said after a few seconds, not even having taken a bite of food yet. All while  looking so very serious across the table that Phainon found himself tilting his head over it. Eyes dropping down to look at his food and then back to Mydei slowly. 

“Mhm?” Phainon pressed quietly, not really sure what he was expecting - honestly, but at the very least.. Mydei sounded serious, as if this was a very dire topic.

Mydei didn’t sound any less serious as he uttered the next cursed words: “.. Can I be honest with you?”

Ah.

And there it was, Phainon felt an agonizing sense of anxiety creep into his bones chillingly, all before he gave a small chuckle - forcing himself to try to stay at least a little calm right now. 

“Aren’t you always?” Phainon asked gently, staring at those vivid golden eyes - trying his best not to betray his inner emotions. Hoping and praying that Mydei couldn’t see the way his hands were almost trembling.

“It’s a serious topic.” Mydei replied, and Phainon had to swallow over that - harshly and roughly.. Mydei couldn’t be wanting to split up, right? It didn’t make sense that this conversation was about that when Mydei had been unpacking and tidying up for days on end. All his free time was dedicated to it almost..

Was it about that?

Had Phainon given an awkward air of laziness? He sure hoped he hadn’t, he had tried many times to aid Mydei only to be growled at over how Mydei wanted everything a certain way. 

“Go ahead, Mydei. I’ll always be there for you.” Phainon told him with a curt nod, holding that he seemed extremely serious to match Mydei’s own tone towards this topic.

Only, Mydei remained sitting there for a few moments silently - all before chuckling softly, “For us?”

“For both of us, yeah.” Phainon agreed, because he meant it. He would do anything for that alpha that was sitting across from him, he thought he had made that much obvious with how much he wanted to always be around him.

With how often he brought up wanting to marry him, as well. And with how much he fondly licked at Mydei’s neck nowadays, even if the alpha still huffed and puffed over it, he couldn’t help himself but to fondly sniff at his neck and that mating bite that had never gone away from Mydei’s neck.

He was just so.. Incredibly fond of Mydei. 

“No.” Mydei said after a few moments, shaking his head slowly in a scolding fashion, “Not what I meant.”

Phainon didn’t understand that, instead blinking his eyes widely as he tried to comprehend what else he could have meant by ‘us’, if not Mydei and Phainon?

“Not.. What you meant?” Phainon slowly pressed out, feeling his throat tightening with the heavy weight and fear of it as he stared at Mydei - hoping that he wasn’t being broken up with or worse.. He wasn’t sure if his heart could take that. 

“I’m pregnant, Phainon.”

Phainon had to continue staring at Mydei over that - blankly and with the dawn of confusion slowly coming over him and etching onto his features as he tried to process that. Mydei.. Is an alpha, that much hadn’t changed, so what on earth did he mean by ‘pregnant’?

“Uh..” Phainon intelligently started, feeling his voice come out rough and hoarse as he tried to process it, “Like, with a child?”

Only, Mydei still didn’t seem like he was joking - merely tilting his head lazily to the side as he stared daggers into Phainon’s own eyes; “What else would I be pregnant with?”

“I.. Didn’t know male alphas can even get pregnant?” Phainon inquired, feeling as if his head was spinning when he even tried to consider Mydei actually being pregnant. Sure.. If he was an omega this matter would be really simple; Phainon would celebrate, wag his tail a little, and feel overjoyed by it. 

But.. He was an alpha? Was it truly a pregnancy?

Phainon was beyond merely baffled. 

“They can apparently.. Through an enigma putting pups into them.” Mydei told him, shrugging a shoulder as he sat there - and Phainon was still struggling to wrap his mind around that. The wording, and the fact that Mydei was saying he’s..?

“An.. Enigma?” Phainon echoed with a small laugh, shaking his head as his eyes trailed down to his food that was now getting cold,  “Woah, woah.. I know the girls were saying something about that a lot, but you can’t seriously-”

“How else would I be pregnant then, Phainon?” Mydei interrupted roughly, sounding less than pleased over the way Phainon was struggling on this matter but it wasn’t like Phainon had ever expected this to be why Mydei had been.. Cleaning so much!?

Was that his way of nesting as a distressed alpha?!

“Right.. That’s.. Right.” Phainon slowly rambled out, moving a hand to rub at his head slowly - trying his best to understand this.

Mydei is pregnant. 

With his child.

Because he’s an enigma..?

Those exist, and he’s one, and he impregnated the alpha named Mydei..

Right? That’s what he was supposed to be gathering from all of this right now? That he impregnated an alpha, and Mydei sitting across from him is currently carrying his child..?

Was this a dream?

“You seem.. Upset.” Mydei mumbled after a few seconds, sounding less serious and more depressed - and that was enough to wave his hands dismissively. In a hurry to try to quell those thoughts because he certainly was not upset.

No, no.. Confused.. But..

“What? No, no.. Not like that, I'm just..” Phainon denied with a few rough shakes of his head, only to stare at Mydei again in disbelief, “You’re pregnant?”

Mydei only shrugged over that, “I took four tests across multiple days, and they all were positive.”

All positive. Over several days of taking them.

Mydei is pregnant..?

“You’re pregnant..” Phainon repeatedly, feeling as though his head was spinning as he tried to understand what the hell was happening here now. Mydei really was pregnant..?

“Uh huh.” 

“But you’re still.. An alpha?”

“Mhm.”

Phainon took a moment, all before slowly trying to understand it even more; “But I got you pregnant.”

Mydei broke into a small chuckle over that, clearly growing more amused over the way Phainon was fighting inner demons to try to comprehend this all; “Yeah, just like you kept wishing you would manage to do during sex.”

Right.. He certainly had kept babbling about some nonsense of breeding Mydei full of his kids every time they had sex.. But he didn’t think Mydei’s body would actually listen to him either!?

“Huh..” Was Phainon’s well thought out reply as he felt dazed over it all. Dazed and confused over the fact his alpha mate was pregnant with his own child, and it wasn’t some odd surgery that had brought it about or anything.

Just natural sex..

… Phainon really didn’t know what to make of all of this. 

“I’m keeping them whether you want to or not.” Mydei growled out, almost threateningly, that made Phainon move his head backwards slightly - eyes widening over that. He more so was stuck on the whole issue of..

“What? No, of course I want to be a father I just -” Phainon trailed off, trying to still understand the situation, “What do you mean I impregnated an alpha..?”

Mydei didn’t reply, he instead only still seemed to be scowling towards him - grumpy and perturbed. So much so that Phainon found himself blinking over the sight, staring at the clearly angry alpha across the table. 

“Wait, that’s not important.” Phainon murmured out, all before pushing himself out of his chair to stand at the table instead - all to move towards Mydei. That angry alpha that was evidently growling at him possessively over his child.

Their child.

Phainon could only find it in himself to swiftly move to that alpha’s side to press kisses on top of his head, sniffing at him in between those peppered and chaste kisses. He didn’t smell any pregnancy or shifts in Mydei’s scent, but maybe it was too soon.

That didn’t matter anyway as he instead moved his hands to Mydei’s cheeks - forcing him to look upwards so Phainon could press kisses onto his face as well. Trying his best to reassure his sweet mate that it was fine. All before moving his lips to Mydei’s softly, a gentle thing - but Mydei didn’t need roughness right now.. He needed care and comfort, that much was obvious.

Phainon paused, pressing his hands into Mydei’s cheeks lightly to cause Mydei to scoff loudly - but Phainon didn’t let up as he pulled away. Staring into those cat-like eyes as he spoke quietly; “You’re pregnant, like, you’re actually pregnant?”

“Mhm.” Was Mydei’s quiet reply, a hushed thing that only made Phainon feel the urge to bite on his cheeks over it. Staring at those vivid eyes as he only continued to ask further. 

“With my child?”

Mydei narrowed his eyes slowly over that; “Who else if not for the guy that keeps knotting me?”

Phainon gave a small laugh over that, “Erm.. Fair enough I guess.”

“Mhm..”

“Wait.. If you’re pregnant I..” Phainon trailed off - losing himself in his own thoughts as he stared at that alpha that was trapped between his hands. Golden eyes flickering but never once giving away the emotions he was hiding beneath them. 

But that was fine! Phainon was busy holding his mouth open only to snap it closed as the realization hit him so painfully hard. He needed to marry Mydei.

He absolutely needed Mydei to understand that he was more than willing to be his mate for life, and.. His partner in parenting, which was probably the more important part that Mydei was seeking comfort in currently.

“You’ve been extra needy because you knew, right?” Phainon asked in line with his thoughts of his mate seeking out comfort in Phainon, just like a sweet omega.. But Mydei wasn’t an omega.. He was just.. A pregnant alpha..?

Surely that still messed with his hormones, even if it was early in his pregnancy, right?

Phainon didn’t dare try to think about how far along Mydei could actually be - and he certainly couldn’t try to look at the man to see if he had any swell in his stomach yet. Plus.. He saw Mydei daily, all the time, noticing a small weight gain wasn’t something he would naturally do.

“Needy?” Mydei echoed out, making Phainon drop his hands to instead move a hand to groom his hair idly - pushing golden locks of hair back and off his face. Neatly putting them back into place from when he had been kissing him messily. 

“Rubbing on me.. Scenting me.. Curling up onto me like you’re a cat..” Phainon muttered out, all to move back to his own chair - even if he didn’t really think he could manage to eat his meal right now. Not when his stomach was churning with a mess of emotions, excited and almost terrified were the main ones.

But..

He was undoubtedly happy when he considered a life actually always by Mydei’s side - a life with the man he had fallen for so deeply, and a child with him.. It was almost a dream come true, really.. 

Mydei only quietly watched him go, all before narrowing his eyes towards Phainon as he sat back down, “I didn’t notice myself acting any different, actually.”

“No way.. You for sure were.” Phainon huffed out, leaning back into his chair to think about how needy Mydei had been as of late;  “Like the other day while we were watching a movie, you started rubbing on my neck and then sucked on my scent gland for several minutes.”

Mydei took a minute, all before tilting his head to the side adorably, “.. What’s wrong with that?”

“I used to have to beg for you to bite me, and I left our couch with so many hickeys after just one movie.” Phainon pointed out with a small laugh escaping him as he shook his head - knitting his brows as he thought about how much Mydei had been sucking on his neck.

… Praying a little that his memories didn’t stir more feelings inside of him deep in his core. 

“The plot wasn’t very good.” Mydei grumbled out in reply, sounding less than enthused as he said it so very flatly. 

And that only made Phainon chuckle yet again as he gave a lop-sided smile to his mate sitting across from him; “You started doing that before I even pressed play, mind you..”

“Okay, so you want less of th-”

“No, no, no. Let’s not put words in my mouth, we both know I enjoyed it thoroughly.” Phainon felt his face burn over the memory of that night - a simple movie night on their couch that ended with Mydei deepthroating him a couple of times and sucking on his neck.

… Phainon really wanted to ask if he had an oral fixation, but now was not the time for that line of questioning he feared. 

“I’m just saying you’ve been way more affectionate than before.” Phainon said lightly, tilting his head as he stared at Mydei who had undoubtedly been way clingier and needy. 

Mydei only seemed to bristle over it as his eyes narrowed towards Phainon, “Isn’t that normal to do with your mate?”

Phainon nodded, feeling his body sweat over the pointed question, sniffing the air to try to get a whiff of his sweet smelling mate to calm himself down over it; “Yes, but I meant.. You did that because you knew you’re pregnant, yeah?”

Mydei took a moment over that, seeming somewhat stunned over the callout all before chuckling rather quietly, “.. Yes, I guess so. It’s comforting to be around you in a way.”

“You’re so sweet..” Phainon immediately uttered, barely able to stop himself as those words came to his mind. But that one earned such a glare from Mydei - one that seemed threatening, if not for the way Mydei’s face was beginning to bleed into a red shade on his cheeks. 

“Eat your damn dinner.” Mydei growled, and Phainon had half a mind to comment on the fact it was cold now - but instead his smarter half of his brain told him ‘That’s Not A Good Idea’ and he found himself whimpering.

Instead immediately moving to start gathering rice to shovel into his mouth.

“Yes sir, sorry sir.”

──────────────

Every night felt like it was the same where Phainon would be woken up by his nightmares and left staring into the darkness at his mate that was resting beside him.

Today was a bit different however as his hand was beneath the covers as he stared at Mydei’s peacefully sleeping face, all while Phainon’s hand slowly dragged circles into his stomach. Feeling where their child would be.. Trying to see if he could feel them, all while feeling somewhat soothed by touching Mydei in general. 

“Phainon..” Mydei rumbled out after a few silent moments, voice deep and heavy with his sleep lingering on it - sinking into that name being uttered and Phainon.. Could only freeze his hand on Mydei’s stomach, pausing his soothing circular motions to swallow harshly over his name being called out.

“Ah, sorry..” That was all he managed between his thumb still gently caressing his lover’s soft belly - pressing onto it tenderly all before he heard Mydei give a warm chuckle.

A quiet one given the raspiness etched into his voice due to wanting to go back to bed, surely, but a laugh nonetheless; “I don’t have a belly yet, if you’re trying to figure that out..”

Phainon had to bite back the bark of a laugh he felt brewing in his throat, mainly over the fact he was so easily guessable in his actions for Mydei; “I.. Was, yeah.”

Mydei moved at that, just enough to raise the blankets they both were nestled under, “Mm.. There’s nothing there, see?”

Phainon’s eyes immediately fell to where his hand was on Mydei, on that lower abdomen that was.. Arguably not round with a child.. Not yet.

“.. Yeah.” Phainon conceded in the dim lighting, staring at the flat tummy of his mate blankly,  “When.. Will you start to show?”

Phainon couldn’t help but wonder about it, eyes staring at Mydei’s stomach mindlessly before Mydei lowered the blanket with a huffed out sigh, sounding more and more tired. Probably because he was tired and Phainon had woken him up.. But regardless..

“Don’t know.. A few more weeks, probably?” Mydei replied with a small huff leaving his lips - one  that Phainon couldn’t decipher the emotions of as his hand idly went back to rubbing Mydei’s stomach. Massaging him softly, so very tenderly as his mind tried to riddle out what emotions he would feel over seeing Mydei with his child..

Round and glowing.. 

“Can I keep rubbing them while you sleep?” Phainon asked in a hushed tone, feeling like his throat was choking him as he uttered those words - something about it was soothing. Knowing that Mydei was his like this, knowing that he would spend his life with Mydei forever at his side.. 

With someone else, too. 

Mydei was quiet for a moment, making Phainon flicker his eyes to Mydei’s face - staring at the way he was looking right back at Phainon; “.. Did you wake up from another nightmare?”

Phainon had to bite down the urge to chuckle over how easily Mydei could clock his emotions, shaking his head softly, “I.. Did, yeah.”

It was silent for a few moments - just a few before Mydei seemed to let out a quiet humming noise, as if he were thinking about it while he closed his eyes. Phainon couldn’t find it in himself to look away from his mate either, fingers still grazing along Mydei’s abdomen lazily - just enough to remind himself of the child there.. 

“Can I ask how I die in those dreams?” Mydei questioned after a few moments, making Phainon almost jump slightly as he watched those eyes open in the darkness again - only barely illuminated by the moon outside their bedroom window.

How he dies..?

Phainon found himself swallowing roughly over that - mouth burning somehow as he thought about those dreams again and again. Those dreams that felt so awfully real, and those dreams that only made him feel more and more confused. Especially as he now recognized some things from it.

The very earring Phainon had given to Mydei - items passed down from his heritage, and yet.. They were worn by Mydei every single time. His outfit was nothing Phainon recognized, nothing from this time period and yet..

Every time..

“I..” Phainon tried to start, feeling his throat closing yet again due to his own anxiety over this topic, “I kill you, every time. It’s different but it’s always.. A sword.. Through your back.”

This wasn’t what his mate needed to hear. He didn’t have any desire to hurt Mydei, let alone actively kill him - or anyone for that matter. He didn’t want Mydei to think he was insane or anything like that.

Only Mydei hummed over it, instantly speaking instead; “Oh.. That is a scary dream to keep having.”

Scary.

That was one word for it as Mydei’s amber eyes flicked to look into Phainon’s - staring at the man who was now leaning over him just a bit while they talked. And those eyes didn’t betray much, not outside of the fact he was obviously still fighting his own tiredness away. 

“I just want to keep you safe, so why.. Am I doomed to have such horrible dreams about you?” Phainon asked that, sure, but he didn’t really expect a reply or answer as he instead crashed back into their bed. Hand still stroked Mydei’s stomach slowly, languidly to remind himself how gentle he needed to be with that alpha now.

Especially to combat his dreams.. 

“Why can’t I keep you safe in at least my dreams?” Phainon mindlessly asked as he laid there, sniffling a little as he felt Mydei move a bit closer to him. Evidently not overly bothered by those dreams somehow - and that felt beyond insane to think about considering the contents of them..

“I’m safe with you now.” Mydei mumbled out his reply, etched with a layer of sleepiness that Phainon had to fight the urge to kiss away, “I don’t know how to stop those dreams, but I’m sure I would forgive you, anyway..”

I would forgive you.

Those were beyond odd words to Phainon’s ears as he moved his eyes to the darkened ceiling in the veil of night. Odd and Phainon didn’t know what to feel over them, not when he didn’t feel like he deserved them. Not when he knew what it felt like to have a sword sink into someone’s body, again and again.

Phainon grit his teeth over it, clenching his eyes closed before he sighed deeply; “I just.. Want them to stop.”

“I’m sorry.” Was Mydei’s quiet response as he laid at Phainon’s side.

But he didn’t understand that either, not when it wasn’t Mydei’s fault. And certainly not when Mydei was the victim, again and again. The person that should be apologizing and begging for forgiveness was none other than Phainon. Not Mydei.

At least, that's how he felt as he thumbed over Mydei’s soft skin. 

“No.. You should be resting.. Not fretting over me..” Phainon murmured, huffing softly over the way he knew he was doomed to have these recurring nightmares again and again. That was fine.

As long as he could awake and find his mate beside him, it didn’t matter. The dawn would still light a new day for both of them, and he just needed to make sure he saw it at Mydei’s side.

“Caring for my mate is something I naturally want to do.. Even if I'm tired.” Mydei argued against that, loudly making a scoffing noise that Phainon could only softly chuckle over as he marveled over that warm skin under his fingers. The softness there..

Right below his firm abs from his workouts and daily exercises.. Yet a soft little pocket remained where he would sire their pups.. And that only made Phainon feel more and more territorial over this sleepy man the more thoughts he gave to it. 

“Then going back to sleep would put me more at ease, Mydeimos..” Phainon rumbled back, somewhat already feeling his own mind calming down over just the way he did love Mydei.

No matter his nightmares, he did love this alpha to bits and pieces - enough to be willing to spend his entire life with him, and certainly enough to be able to protect him from whatever blade his own mind thought he owned. 

He would never do that to Mydei, not now, not ever in this lifetime. 

“Cheater..” Mydei quietly hissed out, but even that made Phainon chuckle over it - mainly because Mydei was so sleepy sounding that his words were beginning to be muffled as well. A struggle to utter as he seemed to be lulling himself back to sleep. 

Phainon raised his free hand to Mydei’s face, gently tucking back his hair softly away from his face as that alpha laid there on his back - not even moving as Phainon pet his checks gingerly, “You’re so sleepy sounding, just go to sleep, Mydei..”

“Mhm..”

Phainon dropped his hand at that, relaxing again as he gave a small amused hum, “See.. You’re not even arguing anymore.”

“‘S hard.” Mydei barely managed to reason out, and that was enough to make Phainon chuckle so softly over it - fondly eyeing that sleepy lion beside him that had wrapped one of his own arms onto Phainon tightly. As if he desperately just wanted the support.

And all Phainon wanted to do anymore was support him, anyway..

“I know.” Phainon murmured, hushed and quietly as he moved to press a gentle kiss to Mydei’s forehead - a little amused over the way those golden eyes had already closed once again. But he couldn’t say that, he couldn’t risk waking Mydei up.

Instead he only laid beside him and caressed his stomach mindlessly - fondly feeling his mind drift off with the thoughts of their child..

... That was until he noticed his phone lighting up.

chapters.html:
“Which one do you like more, the giraffes or the elephants?”

That question made Mydei yawn slowly, raising his arms over his head to give a nice stretch all before leaning over to see what his mate was even asking him about, sitting lazily on the couch beside him for a nice quiet day. But Phainon more than happily showed him his phone, thumbing back and forth through the little baby onesies he was looking at.

A sight that made Mydei blink and mindlessly put a hand to his small baby bump, “.. You’re already looking at baby clothes? I’m not due for several more months..”

Granted, time was flying by and Mydei wasn’t exactly immune for doing that as well - his phone was a mess of bookmarks as he kept finding cute stuff and debated buying it.. He probably would go back through and buy it anyway, it’s not like money really mattered to him and if he could overload them with a bunch of gifts.. Why not?

“But you already have a little tummy.. I need to start looking sooner than later.” Phainon hummed out, and Mydei had to lean back at that, relaxing again against that arm that was resting behind him - always coiling around Mydei to pull him closer and kiss at him sometimes.

Not that Mydei minded, of course, if anything.. He fully knew now that he was guilty of being more needy and craving Phainon’s affection. Even if he was an alpha, his body and mind certainly did want to feel his mate loving him even now. Probably way worse now, really.

“Mm… I like the elephant one” Mydei said after a few moments of deliberation in his head, and eyeing those big fat and flappy ears. 

Somehow it reminded him of Phainon, and that made him feel a little bit more partial to them. Not because of the ears, mind you.

“Anything for you..” Phainon murmured in a soft little voice as his hand on Mydei moved a little, seeming like he was readjusting himself as he removed it from Mydei’s back to instead rest it on Mydei’s leg.

Always touching him somewhere when they were both home, probably out of pure territorial-ness - but somehow Mydei didn’t really even feel his alpha bothering anymore. As if it had been snuffed out by being filled with a child and well.. Mydei couldn’t blame it for giving up once that happened. 

Clearly, he was not winning the show of dominance fight it wanted him to endure through. Instead he felt more like a stray cat that had been taken home and got trapped inside someone’s house until they were fat and lazy. Though.. The fat part wasn’t really his fault, anyway.

Mydei had to hum as he watched Phainon go back to scrolling - ignoring the dreary hum of the TV in favor of watching his mate idly look through cute baby clothes, “Are you hoping for a boy or a girl?”

Phainon took a moment before clicking off his phone with a small laugh leaving his lips - icy blue eyes immediately darting to look at Mydei warmly, “What? I don’t know. I don’t think I care as long as you’re both healthy..”

Mydei chuckled over that, “That’s sappy of you.”

He agreed, of course, but he still did love to tease his mate no matter what.

“I love my husband and our child, is that a crime?” Phainon asked with a tilt of his head and a raised brow.

But that word always made Mydei keen and feel the urge to purr over it being used towards him; A person who didn’t think he would ever fall in love to such a deep depth.

Husband.

Phainon had taken up the habit of always calling him his husband within the past few weeks of Mydei being pregnant, even if they weren’t married yet, always kissing and nipping at him while mumbling things about their marriage. He was especially getting worse about it in his sleep - nightmares still rampant but now Phainon would also be snuggling into Mydei and whimpering about his husband suffering.

Sweet in a way to have that alpha clinging to him and calling him husband, odd to remember he was always dying to Phainon’s own hands while asleep. 

Weird, but it’s not like Mydei had any real worries about it considering he didn’t even know Phainon would buy a sword - and the man seemed more keen on rubbing and licking Mydei’s skin than ever harming him. Usually tracing that bite still on his neck lovingly while they fell asleep together.

“Of course not, but I can call you sappy for it too.” Mydei chided with a huff leaving his lips as he leaned back - sliding into that hand more that was resting on him. 

“Should we have a baby shower?” Phainon inquired softly - sounding a bit unsure himself and Mydei had to scoff over the idea.

He had thought about it, sure but also..; “.. For a pregnant male alpha? I’d rather we just have a party with like four people that won’t stare at me like I’m a freak.”

“Fair.” Phainon hummed out, sounding like he had also somewhat worried over that.

He probably did quite often considering how much Phainon rubbed and crowded around him needily. Always wanting his attention, and Mydei was more than happy to give it to him. 

“Hyacine wants me to meet her for lunch tomorrow.” Mydei mumbled as he wiggled on the couch a little - never quite used to the way Phainon had taken up the habit of resting his hand on Mydei’s inner thigh and rubbing him. It always was a test of his sanity, even while pregnant.. 

But those words were enough to pause Phainon’s thumb that was rubbing him slowly, “Oh? Alone?”

“Mhm..” Mydei answered, not daring to question the way he could already smell Phainon getting defensive. His scent turning a growing familiar scent when people got too close to Mydei nowadays, it was almost amusing in a way. 

“That’s a rarity.. Last time I talked to her alone she-” Phainon coughed over his own words, cutting himself off as he instead shook his head beside Mydei, “Nevermind. It’s not important. I got out of the room eventually.”

“What?” Mydei instantly asked over whatever the hell those words meant, removing his eyes from the TV to instead look at his mate that was sitting beside him. Eyes still focused ahead of him before seemingly sensing Mydei’s  gaze on him. 

Instead, jerking them to look at Mydei as well, “Anyway! What do you think she wants to talk to you about?”

Mydei had grown used to this - this possessive and defensive man that was always keen on knowing what he was up to. That was fair in Mydei’s opinion, considering it was their child, but Mydei also found it a bit amusing. 

He really did, somehow, feel like he was an omega being cornered by an alpha - and maybe considering his position in life currently that had really happened to him.

.. Somehow he didn’t think he cared, though. A piece of him kind of enjoyed that Phainon loved him so much. 

“Maybe baby things..? I don’t know.” Mydei admitted cluelessly as he blinked at those vivid and sharp blue eyes - raising a brow over the way Phainon chuckled, tilting his own head over the answer. 

“She is probably the second most excited you’re pregnant behind myself of course..” 

That was true, Hyacine had basically jumped up and down so excitedly when he told her - staring at her all before she calmed down and whispered things along the lines of ‘I knew it’ and ‘Another win for Hyacine’.

Mydei didn’t dare question the last part.

But she had been just like Phainon in a way, immediately asking if she could touch his stomach and feel his child for herself.. Too eager. Everyone was too eager for this.. At least now he actually had grown a small bump for them to actually have something to be fond of instead of Mydei’s flat abdomen awkwardly.

Mydei huffed over that, shaking his head as he looked at the table idly - raising a brow over how it was his favorite meal.. That was fine, but the confusing thing was how Phainon’s meal was lasagna. 

Mydei didn’t recall Phainon ever ordering lasagna or seeking it out in place of other foods, so that was an odd display on his plate. 

“I am not that pregnant, Phainon.” Mydei chastised, shaking his head slowly as he felt Phainon drag his fingers up Mydei’s neck. Always possessive in the way he loved to touch that bite mark. 

“But still pregnant nonetheless.” Phainon reminded him, all before pressing a chaste kiss to the scalp of Mydei’s head before quickly moving to take his own seat across from him. Looking much too pleased with himself to where Mydei had to raise a brow.

“Fine, fine, but why did you order lasagna..?” Mydei questioned as he watched Phainon settle into his seat - resisting the urge to tilt his head to the side as Phainon immediately put his arm on the table. Just his elbow, all to prop up his head as he stared at Mydei - looking so deeply in love that even Mydei felt second-hand embarrassment, and it was aimed towards him.

… Sweet. It was also incredibly sweet and that's how Mydei knew he was slowly losing his mind and was very in love with this man just as well. He probably looked no better either.

“Mm? I like lasagna, it’s rather dear to me emotionally actually.” Phainon mused out, tone rather soft and gentle for the thing he was talking about that made Mydei blink over that - eyes trailing down to Phainon’s only plate to just emptily stare at it. 

All before snapping his eyes up again, not really very sure of what that man was going on about, because how on earth was lasagna emotionally important to him?

“... Lasagna is dear to you emotionally? Like the food? The food is dear to you?” Mydei slowly asked, tilting his head even more to the side as he tried to understand since when his mate had such a deep level of fondness for lasagna of all things.

If he always had it, he never really brought it up. Instead just letting Mydei never make his favorite meal and that made Mydei tense up a little.

Did Mydei not make good lasagna..?

So Phainon never asked for it..?

Mydei had to blink and look at his own plate over that, resisting the urge to chew on his own lips at his thoughts. He could try to get better, if Phainon wanted.. 

“Yep.” Was Phainon’s rather flat response, popping his ‘p’ loudly as he agreed to that and that only made Mydei feel more and more baffled over the situation.

Lasagna.

Maybe he was just in the mood for it and was being dramatic about being called out, Mydei had no idea..

“You.. May be more insane than I first assumed you to be.” Mydei muttered out as he lazily moved to grab his fork - almost hesitating over the way Phainon was only keenly watching him. As if he was waiting for Mydei to start eating before he would.

And honestly, that wasn’t that odd.

If anything, that was pretty normal for Phainon to stare him down like a hawk and wait to see Mydei take the first bite out of his food - as if he were waiting to make sure Mydei was happy with his tail wagging behind him and that choker always on his neck.

Phainon only chuckled a little quietly however, eyes never moving from Mydei even as he slowly started to stir his own food idly; “Haven’t you learned that in these past few months?”

“A little, but the lasagna is new.” Mydei countered, choosing to look away and look at his rice he was stirring cheese into with furrowed brows. Eyes only moving slowly to a cat that was rubbing at his leg - he could have licks to rub at it, but honestly..

.. He didn’t want to have to hand sanitizer after it. Huffing instead as he tried his best to ignore the sweet creature’s weak meows.

“There’s a lot of treasured memories in it for me.” Phainon murmured as Mydei took a bite of his own food - and that surely was the sign for Phainon to straighten up and start eating as well with a pleasant hum leaving his lips. Clearly satisfied that his mate was eating now, and that always made Mydei shake his head over it.

… But that sentence certainly made him shake it even more in this instance. 

“.. Okay, Garfield.”

Phainon laughed over that, an incredibly gentle sound all before he pointed his fork at Mydei accusatorily; “You like cats, shouldn’t you be happy?”

Mydei shrugged as he instead took another lazy bite of his food - closing his eyes as he let out a rumbly hum through his chest, “I’m quite fond of my puppy, mind you.”

Phainon took a moment, all before grinning a little lop-sidedly, “Smooth.”

“I have to keep you interested somehow.” Mydei countered immediately, moving a hand almost idly to his stomach to rub at that swell in his tummy - not unaware of the way Phainon’s eyes were fully watching his movements. 

Staring him down almost, but Mydei was used to that as well by now.

“I don’t think I could ever not be interested in you, beloved..” Phainon told him in an awfully sincere voice - drenched in honey as he spoke those words. So tender to Mydei’s ears that he felt like he was definitely being coaxed into something currently. 

“Too sweet, dessert isn’t until after the main course, you know.” Mydei chastised immediately.

Only Mydei then had to huff as he immediately moved to grab his water with his own words - instead hitting his spoon off the table. He didn’t know if pregnancy normally made people clumsier, but he certainly felt that way as he gave a heaving sigh - knitting his brows over the spoon on the floor now.

At least the floor was way more clear than a normal cat cafe looked to be, but it’s not like he was going to use it anyway.

… But he couldn’t leave it there, instead.

“Oh.” Mydei mindlessly sighed out to the tune of his fallen spoon, all before huffing a little and shuffling to get out of his chair.

Only, Phainon had moved way quicker - much too quickly as he practically slid on the floor to grab his spoon for him; “Let me, I’ll get it.”

And Mydei felt himself sigh to reprimand that man, he wasn’t that pregnant to not be able to get something off the floor, “Phai-”

“Mydeimos,” Mydei stiffened over the way Phainon had immediately moved to one knee, hands holding on Mydei’s one hand gently - so tenderly it felt like he was scared he could snap at any moment, “This might be a little poorly timed considering how you’re already pregnant but..”

Mydei huffed over that, not even reacting as those blue eyes flickered to the swell of his baby bump, all before flickering right back up - just to meet and hold Mydei’s gaze. And that, that was when Mydei’s brain actually connected the dots of what was happening here. Stomach doing a flip ass nervousness seeped into his bones. 

A warm nervousness.

One he hadn’t felt before, not like this, giddy and anxious as he stared at the enigma on the floor - unable to look away as he waited eagerly to hear his mate out. Almost feeling as if that bite on his neck was tingling over it as well.

“You already make me the happiest man that’s ever lived, I just want to seal it and make it official forever.” Phainon started, voice warm and smooth like honey as he spoke those words - only barely could Mydei hear the slightest tremble in his voice, “Together.. You and I, and whoever is in there of course.”

Mydei scoffed over that, feeling the way those warm calloused hands were clinging to him so much - desperate to get his own words across as he held onto Mydei. And Mydei could feel his stress so easily in the way he was rubbing his thumb over the top of Mydei’s hand timidly, slowly as if Mydei could crack and break from any roughness at all. 

“But, I truly thought love was not for me until I met you, you changed my entire perspective on the world and I feel like I finally understand what people mean by seeing colors. My world was dreary until a fiery burst of flames came into my life -”

Mydei couldn’t bite back a quiet chuckle over those words as Phainon paused due to his laughter. Only making Mydei knit his brows together with an amused smile on his lips, “.. You mean my hair?”

Mydei enjoyed watching Phainon look embarrassed, the way his eyes went so wide like an owl, the tint of red that creeped onto his cheeks immediately - it was adorable in all the right ways as Mydei sat there seeing the view of it. So plainly laid out for him that he couldn’t help but give a small smile over it.

A gentle thing, one that made it obvious he was waiting for Phainon to continue. 

Phainon made a weak little noise over it, all before sniffling and barely clearing his throat as he tried to gain a sense of himself back apparently; “Please let me finish, I worked hard on this in my head.”

“Okay, sorry.” Mydei mused, rolling his eyes in a joking manner - only able to feel himself get a bit flustered as well as Phainon pressed a kiss to that hand he was still holding, all before continuing once more with his prepared speech. 

“I know we arguably had our ups and downs in the short time we’ve known each other, but I genuinely do not think I could ever be the same without you in my life.” Phainon told him, fingers still blatantly trembling - but Mydei was pretty sure his was as well in Phainon’s hand, “You make me so happy every single day, and all I want to do is try to do the same for you.”

Phainon released his hand over that, instead moving to retrieve something from his back pocket with a quiet hum. A sleek black box, only to be opened rather effortlessly to reveal a rather large golden ring - not with a diamond.

Mydei had lazily told Phainon he didn’t want a diamond once, instead muttering something about ‘red for you, blue for me’ as a cute color swap. And yet.. There surely was a blue gem inlaid in the middle of it, a rather large one that made Mydei tilt his head over how pretty it looked.

Personally.. He did think blue looked rather nice on him, so he had grown very fond of it. Even if he wouldn’t admit it to Phainon due to how insufferable the enigma could be over showing off his territorialness towards Mydei.

Though.. A wedding ring probably was the final step of that, huh?

“Please give me that chance, Mydeimos Gorgo. Will you marry me?”

Mydei felt his heart stop as the man he adored finally said those words to him, words he hadn’t even realized he was waiting for with baited breath from the first few weeks of living with Phainon. Words he had wanted to hear ever since Phainon had decreed they would be married one day.

Words from the man he looked forward to seeing every second of his life, blue eyes twinkling with heavy emotions behind them while his own gentle smile crinkled them a little. 

“Yes, of course I will, Phainon.” Mydei spoke those words that he had been waiting to say for so long - feeling his chest ease up just a little as he finally was able to say them to that man. 

Unable to hold in a smile over the way Phainon immediately perked up as he moved to slide that ring onto Mydei’s finger gingerly. 

“Yay!” 

Mydei had to bite his tongue over that - not daring to chastise him anymore over his happy little yay habit he had. Instead only softly giving a few amused chuckles as he watched Phainon jolt up immediately - all to eye the door leading in the employees only room. 

“He said yes!”

Mydei blinked over how loud Phainon was as he was pulled out of his seat to match Phainon standing up - eyes blinking at his mate and the door confusedly, “Wh-”

He didn’t need to finish his words. Not as the pile of girls flooded out of the backroom with bouquets in hand and little party poppers that Mydei had to imagine were a Cipher and Phainon plot considering the small grimace Aglaea gave as one as popped at her and spilled confetti onto her and the floor. 

“How.. How many of you are here?” Mydei confusedly asked - but it’s not like there were that many.. Just the four girls - but that was confusing enough to him. 

“Everyone from the normal cafe, considering these are our new cats you don’t recognize.” Hyacine told him, speaking around a mess of flowers she was holding with a happy smile on her lips.

New cats.

Right.. He hadn’t been there in a bit..

But he had other worries about that right now, “Wh..What? Isn’t it stressful to move them like that?”

Phainon had to laugh over that, “Can you please focus on your ring over the c-”

But Mydei wasn’t willing to listen to that, instead cocking his head to the side to blink at Phainon - narrowing his eyes, “We could have just went to the normal cafe in-”

Phainon made an odd huffing noise, all before a hand was on the back of Mydei’s head, holding him in place while Phainon’s lips crashed into his own. His tongue immediately slid into Mydei’s own mouth to make him shut up about the cats apparently as he eagerly accepted his mate’s licks. Holding back the whimper that had shot up through his body over the affection - barely able to keep his mind focused.

… It helped that all the girls were watching them at least, his ears were pricking to listen to them whisper all while Phainon didn’t seem bothered at all. Still messily pressing their lips together and tasting Mydei’s mouth. Tongue lapping over everything slowly before pulling away - just to lick up the drool and practically purr over the way Mydei was assuredly flushed now. 

“You are too sweet, my precious alpha..” Phainon hummed out those words - seductively low as he remained close to Mydei’s face, scent heavy in the air and crisp against Mydei’s nose as he seemed to be getting more territorial (probably due to being his fiancé now, but Mydei couldn’t say for certain), “I rented this place and got some help setting it up so we could have a fancy dinner.”

“But..” Mydei started, mind still reeling as his eyes blinked at the girls who were still just waiting there - apparently not very bothered by the fact Phainon was kissing Mydei and ignoring their existence completely.

“No dogs allowed, minus me, of course.” Phainon didn’t waste a moment before leaning into Mydei more - blatantly scenting him as he rubbed into him lovingly and slowly with a hum,“I thought it would be more fun to make it fancier.”

“What a silly alpha..” Mydei mumbled over that, shaking his head and doing his best to ignore the fact he was still thinking about the cats. Eyes moving to look at the girls who were only staring right back. 

“Enigma.” Cipher corrected though, wagging her finger as if she was scolding him all while holding those flowers still - and Mydei had to figure it was because they couldn’t really celebrate with wine. 

… And flowers certainly did cover up their scents decently, Mydei had never questioned the overly floral scent lingering in the air while in here. But it certainly was obvious now - usually he had Phainon’s pheromones in his own nose anyway with how that many loved to rub onto him aggressively. 

“Right.. Enigma.” Mydei huffed out, shaking his head all before blinking at the line of girls - all in gorgeous dresses while standing there.

… And Mydei had been lazy today and wore his normal attire - nothing that was too tight on his chest anymore and slacking pants. He felt horribly underdressed for today, but it’s not like Phainon looked much better as he kept rubbing Mydei and humming about how it was just a relaxed dinner, no reason to dress up as he hugged him from behind. 

Clearly purring and marking his territory, but Mydei didn’t mind that much anymore, and he didn’t want to dress up for date night anyway.. So he had been easily coaxed to just wear what was comfortable with his mate’s mouth on his neck and mumbled reassurance about how pretty he looked, breathing hot against that mating bite at the back of Mydei’s neck.

Annoying.

Annoying bastard that Mydei had taken up a liking to listening to..

Mydei had to tilt his head very slowly however, “.. Why is everyone here, anyway?”

“Someone had to take care of the cats and help him set it all up, didn’t they?” Phainon hummed out, looking more than just a little amused over the question. 

“I offered to be a waitress but then Phainon said it would be too obvious.” Aglaea spoke after a few moments, and that was enough to make Mydei tense up - feeling Phainon rumble out a laugh as he still stood at Mydei’s side. Refusing to leave, but it’s not like Mydei wanted him to.

His brain was still fried and stuck on Aglaea’s words anyway. 

“Aglaea, if you were my waitress I think I would have choked on my water.” Mydei told her slowly, unable to stop the way he felt his jaw twitching slowly, feeling like this was unreal.

Out of all the things he could ever imagine in his head, imagining Aglaea asking for his order was certainly not one of them. He almost felt uncomfortable over it, for her sake and his own if he had to ask her to do stuff for him..

Cipher hummed over that, making plastic wrinkling noises as she seemed to be moving around and holding those flowers dramatically, “But it would have been memorable, no?”

Memorable.

It certainly would have been, but Mydei was pretty sure his stomach would have started hurting - and he didn’t think it was due to the baby nestled inside of him at all.. His stomach already hurt, anyway, so he doubted that mattered.

“I think the ring on my finger makes it memorable already, Cipher.” Mydei murmured, moving his hand to idly touch it on his finger again - blinking as he kept eye contact with Cipher instead of looking at it.

“Can I ask..” Mydei slowly started, fingers still rubbing that jewelry before flicking his eyes to the table, “What’s with the lasagna?”

Phainon laughed over that - a sweet and gentle sound as he rubbed into Mydei, rather aggressively about it as he seemed drunk off his own happiness; “You’re still stuck on that?”

“How could I not be? You never go out to eat with me and order lasagna.” Mydei hissed out immediately, cutting his eyes to the taller man, furrowing them a little as well before gritting his teeth. 

“It’s the first meal you cooked for me.” Phainon answered with such a gentle smile on his lips that Mydei felt himself jerk back slightly - looking so eager to say that. Unable to hold back from this clear victory of Mydei’s confusion, apparently, as he gave a toothy grin instead.

“Pardon?”

Phainon hummed over that, “You cooked me lasagna, and I was so happy because even without you realizing it. You were trying to provide for me in your own way.. I took it as a nice courting gift.”

Lasagna.

Mydei didn’t remember that at all, tilting his head to the side as he stumbled over his own line of thinking and how he had made Phainon so many meals by now that he didn’t recall; “... Huh.”

“You forgot, huh?” Phainon asked in a teasing ton, but Mydei could only huff over it - shaking his head slowly over the accusation.

… Because he was right, anyway; “Of course I did, it’s just lasagna.”

“To you it’s just lasagna, to me it was the first time my mate was accidentally trying to care for me and be doting..” Phainon purred out his words, moving even closer to Mydei as he spoke,  “I’m fond of lasagna for that reason.”

Lasagna was the first meal and courting attempt from Mydei.. 

And Mydei hadn’t even thought about it again - it was almost embarrassing in a way, but so unbelievably sweet at the same time that he knew he was growing flustered the longer it went on; “That’s so very sappy.. You’ve turned into mush lately.”

“Anything for you.” Phainon told him easily, rubbing his own head into Mydei’s and Mydei was powerless but to copy the action - sniffing in Phainon’s deep scent now that he was able to intoxicatingly. 

Only..

“Good lord, I know I agreed to watch this engagement happen but now I’m feeling like a sixth wheel.” Cipher mumbled over the display, making Mydei blink at the girls he had completely been ignoring a little bit - mainly because it was his engagement. He didn’t need to greet people when his mate was still purring and greedy for his attention.

Instead, Aglaea sighed over that for him; “Cipher..”

“What? I know you agree. Look at Castorice.. She’s reading on her phone.” Cipher pointed out - and Mydei’s own eyes did immediately move to look at the pink haired girl who didn’t even look up, completely focused and locked in on her phone.

“It’s chapter twelve.” She replied, as if that meant something.

And apparently to Castorice it did, “No way, I loved that chapter.”

“Oh that’s when it gets to its peak..” And Cipher as well, and that made Mydei blink over all of their comments.

Were all of them (minus Aglaea, allegedly) reading cookie fanfictions in their free time now..?

“Mydeimos..” Phainon purred out, voice low and seductive as he nosed against Mydei’s neck, already moving behind him and leisurely angling himself to hug him. Breath hot and heavy against Mydei’s body, but he didn’t dare let it rile himself up.

“Mhm..?” Mydei hummed out, feeling his own body press against that man - enjoying the embrace over his rather overprotective mate as Phainon snuggled even closer. 

“What kind of wedding do you want?” Phainon’s voice was low and quiet, obviously not trying to interrupt the girls talking as Mydei’s eyes only watched them talk amongst each other. Eyes keenly focused on them as Phainon’s hands moved beneath the swell of his stomach - holding onto that little bump gently.

Mydei sighed contently over that, voice dropping to a quiet one as well, “You’ve asked me this many times.”

Phainon’s nose rubbed into Mydei’s nape slowly, all before Mydei felt a streak of wet heat trail up his neck. Obviously from Phainon’s tongue licking over his possessive mating bite still on Mydei’s neck, still marking him as Phainon’s mate. And well.. Mydei certainly no longer felt angry over it, especially not with a ring on his finger. 

“I know. Is it still the same?” Phainon asked after swiping wet licks against his own teeth marks in Mydei’s skin, and Mydei only focused on those girls discussing whatever they were talking about - Castorice’s phone seemed to be the main focus as Aglaea merely shook her head and watched from a bit away.

“A quiet one.” Mydei replied, not really having many other thoughts than that, not for a man that was a pregnant alpha marrying another (appearing) alpha.. He just wanted to be able to call Phainon his forever, and that would be enough. 

Phainon hummed over that, a nice and rumbly noise against Mydei’s neck as he pressed a kiss to that spot as well, “Mhm.. You wanted to elope.”

Elope.

Just them and maybe a few friends, neither of them had family to speak of - so a big wedding was useless anyway.. He just wanted for him to be Phainon’s, and vice versa. No need for much else, even if they certainly could afford it easily.

“My name isn’t exactly a quiet one, you know?” Mydei mumbled, thinking about if word actually got out involving any of his recent situations in life.

From the fact he was pregnant, to the fact he was marrying some random alpha - he really didn’t enjoy the idea of anyone from his father’s company finding out. Or anyone else, for that matter..

“I know.” Phainon purred out, giving a small chuckle, “I just don’t care.”

“Mmm..” Mydei knew that, he knew that since so long ago due to the fact Phainon didn’t even try to figure out Mydei’s last name for such a period, “Can I take my chicken and rice to go?”

Phainon seemed to tense over that, “Huh? You want to go home?”

And Mydei could only give a quiet chuckle as he lazily moved a hand to his stomach - threading his hand into Phainon’s own to make him hold his hand. All while making a loud sighing noise over the churning he felt repeatedly.

“... I feel sick to my stomach.”

Chapter End Notes

his ass didnt even pick up the spoon this useless ass enigma

“White has nothing to do with purity, you know.”

Mydei only cut a look through the mirror over hearing those words being said to him - blinking at Hyacine that was beaming a smile to him so painfully happily. And Mydei had to tilt his head over that, fingers sliding to press that silk feeling coat against himself. 

“Mhm..” Mydei hummed out, blinking at the slightly off-white top he was wearing, narrowing his eyes to try to think about wearing it for a long period. It was too tight, too firm and sucking against his body that it was bothering him to breathe with the swell of his stomach. All to make him sigh as Hyacine moved to her tippy toes - patting his shoulders gently as he lowered himself a little. 

“You can wear white if you want to, even with a baby bump.” Hyacine told him, but Mydei only stared at her in the mirrors - barely scoffing over those words of reassurance.

He did appreciate them, really, but he just.. 

“I’m more focused on being comfortable, honestly.” Mydei mumbled, flicking his eyes back to the mirror with a tilt of his head as he stared at himself. He looked nice in a tux, even if it was horribly uncomfortable around his lower abdomen now - but he guessed that was the price of being pregnant. 

“Is there any way to wear a tuxedo and be comfortable with a belly?” Hyacine asked, moving to look Mydei up and down - and he could only raise a brow at her questioningly. 

“.. Are you implying I wear a dress?” Mydei hissed out, feeling his hand twitch over the way he really wouldn’t mind - if not for that tiny voice in the back of his head annoyingly. 

Hyacine seemed to pick up on it however, looking almost a little more nervous as she gave a quiet coughing noise; “Well.. I’m just saying they make pregnancy wedding dresses..”

Mydei turned just a little to her, raising a brow as he huffed over that - trying his best to not focus on the fact his inner alpha was hissing and snapping at him. It’s not like it was his fault, and he certainly would prefer to be comfortable, “.. And no tuxedos? What about the male omegas?”

“Uhm.. I don’t know..” Hyacine nervously replied, but Mydei only had to huff over that type of response - knowing full well omegas probably didn’t mind at all wearing the dress. But Mydei felt his own secondary gender already snarling at the idea, as quiet as it was lately regarding most things.. 

That, apparently, still made it claw and snap over Mydei’s chosen attire - or even the thought of it when his skin felt itchy idly.

Annoying. 

“Society sucks.” Mydei mumbled, praying that his inner self could at least strangle that damn voice in the back of his head yelling at him that he shouldn’t wear a dress. A piece of him agreed, yet, he didn’t know if he cared enough about that as his eyes flicked back to the mirror - focusing on the rise in his stomach.

Hyacine sighed loudly at his side, shaking her head over that; “Maybe in another world secondary genders didn’t exist and it was normal and fine..”

Secondary genders didn’t exist..?

Mydei had to scoff over that, raising a brow at her without missing much of a beat; “You’ve been reading too many of Castorice’s fanfictions, you know?”

“Nonsense, they’re really good!” Hyacine countered immediately, waving her hand with a quiet click of her tongue following suit. But that easily made Mydei huff over that - eyes staring at himself in the mirror.

He didn’t look tired, but he certainly always felt the heavy weight of drowsiness lingering in his bones. Especially in instances like there where he was thinking about decisions for their wedding. As of late he had just been leaving it to Phainon, not caring too much for the minute details

“I like being able to have a child, actually.” Mydei mumbled at the thought of having this child removed from him, sighing as he moved a hand to his stomach slowly. Languidly dragging his fingers over the rather nice fabric tucking his abdomen away - but he had to sigh over it all.

“I know, I know..” Hyacine chidded softly, all to shake her head as his golden eyes flickered to her - focusing on her for the briefest of moments all before she shrugged her shoulders, “There should be some specialty shops for tuxedos, if you want to put your name on a list.”

“.. A list?” Mydei questioned very slowly, seeming unconvinced of such a thing and really.. It was because he wasn’t fond of putting his name on most things - it always had some eyebrows being raised and well..

.. Realistically, he would much rather take Phainon’s last name sooner than later preferably. 

“Mm.. Well.. People usually don’t get married with omegas, you know? So..” Hyacine told him, dragging her thoughts off as Mydei hummed over that - moving a hand to rub at his neck and trace his fingers over that bite that had never gone away.

Not that he wanted it to anymore, but it certainly had stayed etched into his neck under his hair in almost a burning way. A stark and odd reminder of whose mate he belonged to, a thing that had always made his stomach twist in a bizarre fashion.

By now he should feel happy it was still there, ecstatic that the mark of his mate was still there sweetly. And instead, his inner alpha only kept gnawing at the metal bars - angry and fierce when he rubbed at it himself. Somehow, quieter when it was Phainon paying attention to it, scenting him and licking him like a dog, as if his secondary gender had given up on that situation.

“Just a mating bite and claiming them as your property, I know.” Mydei replied with another heavy sigh as he moved a hand to push his bangs back uselessly - they would always just fall right back onto his face every time anyway, “So I have to be on a list due to being pregnant?”

“Uh.. Yes.. Probably..?” Hyacine replied, though she seemed as equally confused as she pursed her lips for a moment, “Actually, why am I here instead of Aglaea?”

That question made Mydei chuckle, just a little as he looked at her in the rather empty store - not much traffic at twelve on a Tuesday, he supposed. 

“That’s easy.” Mydei started to explain, but he found himself not even needing to finish his thoughts. 

“Mydei! I found you!” That familiar voice chirped out so happily instead, making Mydei’s thoughts pause as he lifted his head up to see his beaming and excited puppy trouting towards both of them.

“Phainon?!” Hyacine immediately spoke, turning to see that quickly bounding up dog - voice giving away how stunned she truly was as Phainon’s own eyes just moved between the pair innocently. Like he didn’t know what the problem was.

And to be honest, as Mydei stood there, he smugly did know that Phainon was just as clueless as Hyacine was.

“Hello!” Phainon greeted her innocently, doing his best to hide the fact he was just as equally confused blatantly - but maybe Mydei only assumed that since he was the person knowing what was happening here.

That much became a bit more obvious as both of them now looked at him, clearly lost in the situation and Mydei.. Had to bite back his own laughter over both of them being stunned and looked to him for aid.

It was almost cute..
