“Oh..”

Mydei sighed over that reaction, wiggling a little on Phainon’s lap to try to get comfortable on his mate’s rather beefy thighs beneath him, “Any others? Preferably not your joke ones?”

“Mmm.” Phainon hummed out, eyes twinkling and sparkling as he cut Mydei an innocent glance upwards,  “I don’t know.. It’s hard to name a baby.. Why not like.. Steve?”

“Steve.” Mydei repeatedly, deadtone and flat as he felt himself bite at his own tongue - something about this felt like Phainon simply wanted Mydei to name their child.

There was no way these were his actual choices, no.. This sap was certainly egging Mydei on to name them. 

Phainon only looked as innocent as ever over the way Mydei had parroted that name, “Yeah?”

“You want our alleged son to be named Steve, son to Mydeimos and Phainon.” Mydei inquired, tilting his head as he searched those blue eyes for answers uselessly. 

“.. I’m sensing you’re trying to say it sticks out.” Phainon mumbled after a few moments, and that was enough to make Mydei chuckle quietly. Moving to sway himself off of his husband’s lap and back onto the couch. 

All to cuddle against the armrest as he hummed a little, “I like Eos.”

“Eos?” Phainon questioned - eyes staring at the way Mydei was trying to get more comfortable. A harder task now as his stomach continued to grow more and more, moving his legs a bit as he shuffled into his favorite lazy position. 

Who was going to yell at him over his manspreading? Certainly not Phainon, so no one was there to reprimand his awkward pose anyway. 

“Mhm.” Mydei hummed out over his husband’s silence as he watched Mydei’s struggle.

“Eos..” Phainon repeated yet again before giving a quiet noise in thought over it, “Is that a boy’s or a girl's name?”

Boy’s or girl’s name. 

Mydei found his mind pausing over that as he gave an odd look to Phainon, raising a brow over how they were anything but a normal couple, and how he didn’t think it mattered much at all.

“The enigma I’m married to is asking me this.. Does it matter?” Mydei asked, and Phainon only instantly gave a quiet sounding chuckle over that. 

“Well.. No, I guess not.” Phainon conceded with an extremely soft sounding noise leaving his throat, “If you want to name them Eos, I honestly don’t mind. I’m just happy to be here, as they say..”

Mydei had to stare at Phainon before giving a quiet little laugh over how sweet this enigma was. Always too kind and gentle, a truly good enigma who assumed he was an alpha for all his life.. Though, maybe that was what made him such a good mate, anyway, destined to be caring and endearing with his instincts driving his soft nature. 

Mydei tutted over his thoughts, blinking his eyes away from that doting enigma, “.. That makes two of us, you know? I am just as happy to be here with you.”

“Eos is a good name..” Phainon retorted without missing a beat, and Mydei could only blink over the way Phainon’s hand found its way to his belly. Soothingly curling around it repeatedly, almost seeming like it was merely a habit of Phainon’s now to massage Mydei’s stomach in his spare time. 

“Yeah.. I think it’s a nice name.” Mydei agreed, but he felt a little silly doing so considering it was the name he himself thought of.

Of course he thought it was a nice name - only able to look at Phainon and try to study was what was going through his husband’s head currently as he stared at those blue eyes. Eyes that were wholly focused on Mydei’s stomach as he rubbed it repeatedly, as if he didn’t dare take his hand away from his mate.

All before those blue eyes flickered to meet Mydei’s own, “.. Should we come up with others, or are you set on Eos?”

Mydei chuckled over that, mainly due to the fact Phainon hadn’t really offered any good counter names to be considered, “Well, I wanted to know about your names you had thought of, but it seems your head is a bit empty on the topic right now.”

Phainon was silent over that for a few heartbeats, all before making a small humming noise as if he had decided on something. 

“I don’t.. I don’t know. I’m just happy to have a child with you of all people, honestly. So I.. I am more than a little happy over the idea of you naming them whatever you want.”

Sappy.

Mydei could admit one thing, having a child on the way and being married to this enigma had assuredly made both of them so painfully sappy nowadays. It didn’t help that Mydei’s own secondary gender seemed more muted with his pregnancy. 

Thus, Mydei could only give a pleased sounding trill from his own throat - an embarrassing sound, but not one that was new to Phainon of all people, “Well, It’s not going to be Chris P. Lettuce or Steve, I will inform you of that much.”

“As you say, beloved..” Phainon purred out, sounding a bit too proud of himself as he spoke his next words; “You’re growing so round..”

“And you’re just as territorial as ever.” Mydei mumbled right back over that, clicking his tongue loudly over how Phainon was clearly eyeing him over that.

Phainon moved to lay on his side rather quickly after Mydei’s words - practically laying his head onto Mydei’s lap, at least, where he could as he moved a hand to rub Mydei’s baby bump tenderly, “I have to be.. Look at this.. It’s my child in there.”

Mydei’s eyes only watched as Phainon idly rubbed his stomach, pressing chaste kisses into the fabric of his shirt as he did so. Something about that made Mydei keen just a little, moving a hand to brush at Phainon’s hair idly as he blinked at the enigma whose eyes were focused on Mydei’s, “I’m aware of that.”

Phainon only dramatically sighed before speaking some more, “My poor sweet mate.. His body is doing its best to defy his nature and give me a child, isn’t my Mydei so perfect?”

Mydei felt his mind reel just a little bit as he realized he was being talked about, not towards. Like Phainon was addressing someone else in the room, even though it was just the both of them and their unborn child. 

“Who are you talking to?” Mydei asked, because he had to bite the bait that was being laid out - lest his own confusion keep nipping at his nerves over how mystifying his mate was being right now. 

“Whoever will listen to my praise of you.. Kephale, I think would listen to it happily..”

Mydei found his breath halting in his throat over that - pausing his petting to blink at Phainon, staring at those vivid icy blue eyes in a stunned fashion because.. No one worshiped those gods, not anymore. 

Mydei had to tilt his head, trying his best to understand why Phainon was saying that god of all gods, all before giving up. 

“.. Kephale?” He quoted leisurely, feeling a bit more confused as he knitted his brows over the way Phainon was nosing into his stomach again. Seemingly doing his best to scent their unborn child that was buried away there.

All before pulling away and humming, “The god the Deliverer worshiped, allegedly.”

“Allegedly.” Mydei echoed out, tilting his head to the side as his mate gave an odd noise before yawning and cuddling into Mydei just a bit more. Seeming more and more satiated the longer he laid on Mydei’s lap - and Mydei didn’t know how to break it to him he could not be allowing this enigma to sleep on him. 

“Maybe that god would be willing to hear my praises for you since the Deliverer was so loyal to him.” Phainon murmured out, “I’m so lucky to be born into a lifetime where you’re bearing my pups for me.”

Mydei leaned back a little into the couch over that, humming as he felt Phainon rubbing his stomach slowly - leisurely and full of care and something about that was endlessly soothing to him. Mydei often felt much too big, too round and heavy, and having his mate dote on him and always seemed eager to snuggle him easily bit those feelings away.

Even if Mydei felt like growling over it sometimes, he is an alpha, he didn’t need to be pampered and nestled into a makeshift nest on their bed while Phainon left to go to work. 

Mydei sighed however over those words, closing his eyes as he focused on that hand massaging his abdomen, “.. Have you been reading about the Crown Prince and the Deliverer?”

“Can you tell?” Phainon asked, all while nuzzling against Mydei’s swollen pregnant belly, much too innocently for Mydei’s own sanity as that man needily scented him a bit more with his neck rubbing into Mydei’s shirt.

Can you tell?

Who couldn't tell..? 

Mydei had to sniffle due to that, knitting his brows as he kept his eyes closed, focusing on the way Phainon was gently rubbing him possessively. It didn’t feel possessive, but considering how Phainon acted in public and did just this while glaring at everyone - scent much too heavy - he knew it still was a sort of territorialness even if they were alone seeping into his personality.

Maybe due to the fact it was his baby nestled inside of Mydei, or just because Phainon had always been much too territorial over Mydei in general so the baby only amplified those feelings. Mydei didn’t know the answer for certain around Phainon’s growling, either way. 

“.. They wanted children very badly, so it sounds like you’re happy you’re not him.” Mydei mumbled as he idly moved his hand to pet Phainon’s head again, thumbing over his cheekbones slowly as he sat there.

Only to jerk his eyes open and blink at that enigma as he propped himself up, voice raised to speak on this matter loudly, “Of course I’m happy I’m not that guy! He killed his own lover! That’s a nightmare.. I would know, I’m the one forced to have them!”

Mydei had to growl over that - borderline snarling at his mate’s panicked words, “Not so loud against my stomach, go back to cooing to them sweetly.”

That was all it took for Phainon to immediately look like a scolded puppy - deflating and returning to rubbing his head on Mydei’s tummy. All while looking up at Mydei with wet pathetic eyes, “‘M sorry..”

“Good boy.” Mydei hissed out, all before lazily resuming his relaxed position, feeling his hand twitch as he moved it back to that enigma’s head to rest on him. He could feel it though.

The slight tensing in Phainon’s body, the way he seemed restless and unsettled in this situation. It was odd, and he almost had half his mind to question it.

If not for the way Phainon broke the silence first.

“Mydeimos..”

“Mm?”

“I love you.. In this life and the next, I love you so much.. Stay with me forever, won’t you?” Phainon asked, and that made Mydei look at him slowly, studying the way that enigma seemed so nervous about this topic.

Like there was something more that he was beating around a bush shyly. 

“I already told you I will, Phainon.” Mydei mumbled, feeling a brow raise as Phainon’s eyes darted away, hands moving to hug at Mydei slowly as he snaked them around his back to cling onto Mydei needily.

And nothing could have prepared Mydei for Phainon’s next words. 

“Let’s have a second baby so you can’t leave me as soon as this one is born..”

Mydei had to laugh over those words - giving a lop-sided smile to that rather sincere seeming enigma that was pleading silently to him with his eyes; “.. Phainon, there’s no need to try to baby trap the man who is already married to you.”

Not to say Mydei was fully against it as he let out a rumbly noise, moving a hand to his stomach to mindlessly pat himself for once - fondly blinking over the way Phainon still seemed so desperate to keep Mydei here, to go as far as assuming more children would make him stay.

.. There was something wrong with Mydei when he considered how he enjoyed that idea, but he decided to tuck that away for a next week when he had therapy with Hyacine scheduled.

“Please..?” Phainon whined out, making Mydei blink and take in the sight of his little enigma mate who didn’t appear to be joking at all. As if he fully meant he did want to breed Mydei full of another child as soon as they had this one.

And Mydei could only sigh.

Sigh over the fact that he somehow did enjoy feeling this deep devotion from Phainon, and the fullness that was comforting in his body of having a child inside of his womb.

“Insufferable..” Moving to shake his head, all before grinning at Phainon who still was watching him with all the adoration in the world in his eyes, “But I do love you regardless of that, let’s try for the other gender next time, mm? I guess we’ll just have to keep trying if not.”

“Yay!”
